meta.canonical_order: data/item_assets.jsonl（输出 items 顺序与之一致）

weapon_profiles.scope: cat=weapon 与 cat=mod（weapon_profile_map.json 里 81 武器 + 45 mod）

base_stats.source: data/stats_tables.json（DataTable StatDef_* 行）+ data/weapon_stats_row_map.json（item→候选行名）
base_stats.match_rules: 候选行名 = row_candidates（类链派生）+ 去 Weapon_/Armor_/Mod_ 前缀原名 X 的变体（CamelCase 拆词、_Rusty 后缀前置、Special_/Boss_/Rusty_ 前缀、护甲套名/部位交换）；row==cand → exact，row 以 '_'+cand 结尾 / cand 以 '_'+row 结尾 → suffix（大小写不敏感）
base_stats.field_normalization: 去掉尾部 `_<数字>_<32位HEX>`（正则 _\d+_[0-9A-Fa-f]{32}$），得到 Damage/RateOfFire/CritChance 等

type_inherited.source: data/type_inherited.json（证据驱动补全；生成脚本 tools/derive_types.py）
rules: 数据源：_raw_results.json 的 refs_all（不回读 items.json，避免自污染）；CDO 直读优先（source=cdo），缺失时按下面规则推导
祖先证据按「类别 + 具体祖先类」分别统计：≥2 票且 ≥75% 一致才采用（避免 Trinket_Base 这类共享祖先串味）
类型-类别一致性校验：weapon 不继承 WeaponMod；mod 只继承 WeaponMod；weapon 只继承 HandGun/LongGun/Melee/SpecialGun/PrimaryWeapon

armor 按部位名规则（Helmet/Gloves/Legs/Body → ItemType_Helmet/Gloves/Legs/Body）；weapon 按链上 Weapon_HandGun/LongGun/Melee_Base 或名称规则（shotgun/rifle/bow/lmg/sniper→LongGun；pistol/revolver/magnum/smg/machinepistol/repeater/rupturecannon/shortbarrel/repairtool/cube/meridian/savior/rune 等→HandGun；sword/axe/hammer/spear/scythe/katana/claw/flail/dagger/staff/fist→Melee）；mod 仅枪械链 → ItemType_RangedWeaponMod；gem/metagem 按链上 Melee/Ranged
action 与 skill 类别不推导（保持 null，属内部配置资产）
category 仅在 ≥3 票一致证据时采用，否则按 weapon/mod→ItemCategory_Weapons、consumable/relic→ItemCategory_Consumables 映射（其余类别无 cat_mapping，保持 null 除非 CDO 直读）
type_inherited.merge_rule: CDO 直读优先（type_source/category_source='cdo'）；否则取本文件对应字段并记录 source；都为 null 则字段留空
type_inherited.counting_note: 覆盖率按 1769 行计（2 组重名资产各占 2 行）；按唯一 name 计为 1131 / 476

locale.note: pak index AES key 未取得（DRM 保护），中文文本仅 zh_name 可用；见 data/zh_locres_meta.json

notes: items 顺序 = data/item_assets.jsonl 顺序（canonical）；id 一般等于 name，重名资产会加 @pkg 后缀
decode_status=partial：贪心前缀解码 + 文本扫描恢复；字段来自前若干个属性，覆盖率见 flags.prefix_coverage
numbers_quality=suspect（22 条）：数值含 NaN/Inf/|v|>1e7/<1e-30，confidence 已降一级，数值保留原值
no_schema/no_cdo/decode_error 条目保留状态与空字段，不做数值输出
numbers 已剔除对象/类引用属性并清洗 NaN/Inf；非 suspect 条目的量级不可信值置 null；文本占位符（locres key）置 null
对象引用优先取 refs_all（1393 条），partial/rescued 缺失时回退 refs
base_stats 来自 DataTable StatDef_* 行（Damage/RateOfFire/MaxAmmo/CritChance 等），字段名已归一化；未命中为 null
weapon_profile 来自 WeaponProfile 资产（散布/后坐/摆动/瞄准/蓄力，不含 damage/rof/ammo），已并入 weapon 与 mod
type/category 优先 CDO 直读（source='cdo'），缺失时用 data/type_inherited.json 证据补全；type_source/category_source 记录来源，action/skill 不推导

v14.fieldpolicy: 只增不改：v1.3 字段全部保留且值不变；新增 kind/is_item/dup_of/variant_of/kind_reason/slot/set/effect/stats_flat/display/text/description_zh/flavor_text_zh/description_raw
v14.effect_rule: effect.lines 由 numbers + base_stats 派生（glossary.show=true）；trait/perk/skill/mod/action 额外给 effect.text_en/text_zh（官方 locres Description 清洗富文本）

text_source.file: data/text_by_item.json（pak AES key + repak 解 locres，官方 en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant） + locres_*.json 直查表
text_source.note: text_by_item 条目权威；via=reverse 为英文原文反查（flags.text_confidence=medium）；synthesized 为 locres key/英文原文补全的条目（官方 key 直查仍为 high）

items.name: Amulet_AbrasiveWhetstone
items.description_en: A coarse-grained stone from a desolate, frozen land. It hasn’t been used properly in years. Shameful, considering the razor-sharp weapons it could have, and once, honed.
items.flavor_text_en: “In truly dire times, you’ve got to get back to your roots—no pun intended! A lot of weapons we use today, even the deadliest, are made from sticks and stones and whatever else we can find.”

description.en: A coarse-grained stone from a desolate, frozen land. It hasn’t been used properly in years. Shameful, considering the razor-sharp weapons it could have, and once, honed.
description.zh: 来自荒凉冰冻土地的粗粝石头。如果打磨得法，它本可以被制成极锋利的武器。可惜的是，多年来从没有人能正确使用它。

items.description_en: A holy symbol miraculously unsullied by the Root. The gods of this Earth may not have been so different from the ones you know.
items.flavor_text_en: "In the absence of a tangible creator, intelligent beings often conceive of their own. These ‘gods’ are likewise entities that house the segments. Is this concurrence deliberate...or the culmination of the significance placed upon them?"

items.name: Amulet_BeadsOfTheValorous
items.description_en: "There are many kinds of valor, and not all of them require the spilling of blood. It takes valor, also, to face the perils of the jungle alone, does it not? More still to stand up to the powers that be. But does our society care anything for valor such as that? Regrettably, it does not. At least, not yet."

description.en: "There are many kinds of valor, and not all of them require the spilling of blood. It takes valor, also, to face the perils of the jungle alone, does it not? More still to stand up to the powers that be. But does our society care anything for valor such as that? Regrettably, it does not. At least, not yet."
description.zh: “勇气多种多样，但并非所有勇气都得流血牺牲。谁说独面丛林的危险不是勇气的一种？更何况是直面强权呢。但是，我们的社会真的在乎这样的勇气吗？很遗憾，社会不在乎。至少，现在不在乎。”

items.name: Amulet_BirthrightOfTheLost
items.description_en: This necklace, worn by Dran orphans, features two pale stones, each representing one of their deceased parents. It hangs from entwined yarn to remind its wearer to humbly bear the threads of fate that ensnare us all.”
items.flavor_text_en: “There is a tradition among the Dran of presenting their orphans with a necklace. Its purported purpose is to protect and comfort these sad creatures in the wake of their loss. Or so they say. Yet if we may be honest, which is a principle I take deeply, deeply to heart, then we must admit that its true aim is to quiet their incessant wailing that the other Dran may enjoy a good night’s sleep.”

description.en: This necklace, worn by Dran orphans, features two pale stones, each representing one of their deceased parents. It hangs from entwined yarn to remind its wearer to humbly bear the threads of fate that ensnare us all.”
description.zh: 这种由德兰孤儿佩戴的项链上有两块浅色石头，分别代表他们已故的父母。它们悬挂在交织的纱线上，提醒佩戴者谦卑地接受主宰我们所有人的命运之线。

flavor.en: “There is a tradition among the Dran of presenting their orphans with a necklace. Its purported purpose is to protect and comfort these sad creatures in the wake of their loss. Or so they say. Yet if we may be honest, which is a principle I take deeply, deeply to heart, then we must admit that its true aim is to quiet their incessant wailing that the other Dran may enjoy a good night’s sleep.”
flavor.zh: “德兰人有给孤儿赠送项链的传统。这是为了保护和安慰这些失去亲人的可怜孩子——至少他们是这么说的。但是我喜欢实话实说，所以还是承认吧，真正的目的是哄那些孩子不要再哭，好让其他德兰人能安稳地睡上一觉。”

items.name: Amulet_BrewmastersCork
items.description_en: As heavy and bitter as the dark pall that shrouds the king’s castle, the nose of the wine that clings to this cork harkens to mulled fruits and sinister musings.
items.flavor_text_en: “Oh, no, no, no. I never indulge in such things. Shaedberry wine has a way of loosening the tongue, and loosened tongues are quickly severed in these lands. Many Fae have met their shameful, hastened end by consequence of indulgence.”

description.en: As heavy and bitter as the dark pall that shrouds the king’s castle, the nose of the wine that clings to this cork harkens to mulled fruits and sinister musings.
description.zh: 软木塞上的酒香让人想起糖渍水果和阴森思虑，就像笼罩着国王城堡的黑暗阴影一样沉重又苦涩。

flavor.en: “Oh, no, no, no. I never indulge in such things. Shaedberry wine has a way of loosening the tongue, and loosened tongues are quickly severed in these lands. Many Fae have met their shameful, hastened end by consequence of indulgence.”
flavor.zh: “哦，不，不，不。我从来不沉迷于这种东西。刹邸莓酒有一种神奇的魔力，能让人管不住嘴巴。但在这片土地上，管不住嘴巴的人刻活不长。许多翡族都因为放纵享乐而落得凄惨的下场。”

items.name: Amulet_ButchersFetish
items.description_en: A grotesque sight to behold. The centerpiece of this eerie amulet is a massive eyeball, far larger than any human eye, suspended from a twisted leather cord. One can only speculate what monstrous creature it was harvested from.
items.flavor_text_en: “I can tell just by looking at it that it's from Corsus. That place where its inhabitants have fully embraced the 'Iskal'. The fact that it's made from an eye much larger than any human's only adds to its gruesome nature.”

description.zh: 这条怪异的项链真让人毛骨悚然。中心是一颗远大于人类尺寸的巨大眼球，用一条弯弯扭扭的皮绳拴着。估计是从某个怪物那里获得的战利品。

items.name: Amulet_CanineKeepsake
items.description_en: "Nothing comes without a price. That is one of the first and inescapable lessons that even a youngling must learn in Yaesha. Ah, but most are unwilling to pay whatever the toll may be for their heart's greatest desires. That is why they fail."

description.en: "Nothing comes without a price. That is one of the first and inescapable lessons that even a youngling must learn in Yaesha. Ah, but most are unwilling to pay whatever the toll may be for their heart's greatest desires. That is why they fail."
description.zh: “想有所求，先付代价。这是耶莎第一个也是必须要学会的教训之一，甚至连幼崽都不例外。但大多数人都不愿为他们心中最大的渴求付出代价，这也是他们失败的原因。”

items.name: Amulet_CervineKeepsake
items.description_en: An effigy left in offering to a great doe. It was carved with patience and skill, by a hand belonging to a Pan who worshipped the creature with godlike reverence.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Red Doe is not the only doe of Pan legend. Countless tales and songs have been sung of the wise, graceful creatures. Admittedly, I have wondered if it was the same enigmatic doe, appearing in different forms. But that is only a theory."

description.zh: 供奉伟大神鹿的雕像，由一名潘恩以耐心和技巧雕刻而成。潘恩族把这种动物当作神一样崇拜。

flavor.zh: “红鹿并非潘恩传说中唯一的母鹿。有无数的故事和歌曲赞颂着这些智慧而优雅的生物。我承认，我曾想过这会不会是同一只神秘之鹿的不同形态，但这仅仅是一个猜测而已。”

items.name: Amulet_CessationBulbel
items.description_en: The thought of donning a gift from the Root fills you with unease, yet the potential of its power overshadows any trepidation you might have.
items.flavor_text_en: “You have served the Root well, but do not mistake this for favor. You sought power, and in doing so, betrayed your kind for a fleeting taste of what is inevitable—cessation.”

items.name: Amulet_ChainsOfAmplification
items.description_en: Quite possibly the most painful-looking collar you have ever seen. Yet there are some Fae, those who delight in agony, who would wear it willingly.
items.flavor_text_en: "I will tell you what the Fae do not wish to hear. True freedom, unopposed and unrestricted, makes us weak. It is though our chains themselves that we acquire the strength needed to throw them off."

description.en: Quite possibly the most painful-looking collar you have ever seen. Yet there are some Fae, those who delight in agony, who would wear it willingly.
description.zh: 你大概没见过比它更让人痛苦的项圈了。但那些以苦难为乐的翡族人会甘之如饴地佩戴它。

flavor.en: "I will tell you what the Fae do not wish to hear. True freedom, unopposed and unrestricted, makes us weak. It is though our chains themselves that we acquire the strength needed to throw them off."
flavor.zh: “这是翡族不愿听到的话：不受任何反对和限制的绝对自由让我们软弱；正是加在身上的枷锁让我们获得了挣脱它的力量。”

items.name: Amulet_ChefMedal
items.description_en: A crude approximation of a medal, polished with care. You wondered briefly if a child made this, but no... This thing was lovingly crafted by none other than the world's greatest chef himself.
items.flavor_text_en: "Yanno, I may never have discovered a whole new world of meat magic without you bringing me the goods. I know it wasn't always easy, but that's the kind of dedication greatness demands. This award might not be "real," as some Alices say, but I don't think anyone could argue with our results now!"

description.en: A crude approximation of a medal, polished with care. You wondered briefly if a child made this, but no... This thing was lovingly crafted by none other than the world's greatest chef himself.
description.zh: 一枚粗糙的奖章，被小心地擦亮。曾有一瞬间，你想过这是不是出自一名孩童之手，但你错了……它是由世界上最伟大的厨师亲手制作的。

flavor.en: "Yanno, I may never have discovered a whole new world of meat magic without you bringing me the goods. I know it wasn't always easy, but that's the kind of dedication greatness demands. This award might not be "real," as some Alices say, but I don't think anyone could argue with our results now!"
flavor.zh: “没错，没有你给我带来这些东西，我或许就要和这个全新的肉肉魔法世界擦肩而过了。我明白事情不会一直简简单单，但这正是伟大所需的奉献。正如艾丽丝所说，这个奖励或许没那么‘真实’，但我认为现在没人能质疑我们的成果了！”

items.name: Amulet_CleansingStone
items.description_en: The stone is rumored to be have broken off the legendary Temple of the Great Spirit, though it is contested whether such place or being ever existed and, if they did, whether they would be beneficial to the Fae.
items.flavor_text_en:
"There is no empirical evidence that the Fey legends of the past ever truly occurred. Indeed, some see history as more allegory than fact, while others claim the past to be unknown and unknowable.

It is worth considering what matters more—whether a thing actually happened or whether they believe that it did."

description.en: The stone is rumored to be have broken off the legendary Temple of the Great Spirit, though it is contested whether such place or being ever existed and, if they did, whether they would be beneficial to the Fae.
description.zh: 据说这块石头是从传说中的上神殿拆下来的。关于上神殿的争议颇多，比如它是否真的存在，以及如果存在的话是否对翡族有益。

flavor.en:
"There is no empirical evidence that the Fey legends of the past ever truly occurred. Indeed, some see history as more allegory than fact, while others claim the past to be unknown and unknowable.

It is worth considering what matters more—whether a thing actually happened or whether they believe that it did."
flavor.zh:
“没有可靠的证据能证明费伦过去的传说真的发生过。在有些人眼中，历史就像任人打扮的小姑娘，而其他人则认为历史虚无不可知。

真正值得思考的是，究竟是一件事的真实性更重要，还是人们所认为的更重要。”

items.name: Amulet_CoreBooster
items.description_en: The tendrils connecting the components together look organic, as if fashioned after tendons and viscera. Fashioned after—or made from.
items.flavor_text_en: "I cannot begrudge the possibility of a creator. Alepsis-Taura may very well have served as its last and final test, a grand appraisal to prove ourselves worthy of cosmic elevation. But we proved only our desperation, that extinction was preferrable to despair."

description.en: The tendrils connecting the components together look organic, as if fashioned after tendons and viscera. Fashioned after—or made from.
description.zh: 将组件连接在一起的触须看上去是有机材料，就好像是根据肌腱和内脏仿制的一样。可能是仿制，也可能是直接拿来用的。

flavor.en: "I cannot begrudge the possibility of a creator. Alepsis-Taura may very well have served as its last and final test, a grand appraisal to prove ourselves worthy of cosmic elevation. But we proved only our desperation, that extinction was preferrable to despair."
flavor.zh: “大概造物主真的存在吧，对此我不该心生怨恨。阿莱普西斯-陶拉可能就是祂给出的最终测试，用来证明我们配得上宇宙的高度。但我们只证明了自己有多绝望，在灭绝与绝望之间，我们宁可选择前者。”

items.name: Amulet_CostOfBetrayal
items.description_en: Upon closer inspection, you recognize the dangly chunks as severed tongues and eyeballs, plucked from their sockets moments before death and bound together as a monument to their owners’ gravest mistake.
items.flavor_text_en: “The councilors gracelessly served no master but themselves, and their ill-plotted coup was doomed from its conception. Perhaps if they had made room for a properly brilliant, astute tactician to guide their slavering whims, they might have succeeded. Alas. I’ll not shed a tear for them.”

description.en: Upon closer inspection, you recognize the dangly chunks as severed tongues and eyeballs, plucked from their sockets moments before death and bound together as a monument to their owners’ gravest mistake.
description.zh: 仔细观察后，你认出挂在那里的东西是舌头和眼球，它们在主人死亡前被生生拔出，然后绑在一起，成为主人最严重错误的纪念碑。

flavor.en: “The councilors gracelessly served no master but themselves, and their ill-plotted coup was doomed from its conception. Perhaps if they had made room for a properly brilliant, astute tactician to guide their slavering whims, they might have succeeded. Alas. I’ll not shed a tear for them.”
flavor.zh: “议会成员明摆着心里只有自己，他们精心策划的政变从一开始就注定失败。如果他们能找到一个真正聪明谋略家来指引他们贪婪的欲望，那也许还有成功的机会。唉，我不会为他们流一滴眼泪。”

items.name: Amulet_CrisisCore
items.description_en: The surface of this ring crackles with the molten plasma of a burning star, the genesis of life without which even the Drzyr could not survive.
items.flavor_text_en: "The revelation that the star from which their home planet drew life would one day die terrified Drzyr scientists. In those early days, mass hysteria and immense pressure from leadership consumed some of their brightest minds. Although many were ultimately unable to make the journey themselves, without their contributions, the creation of N’Erud would not have been possible."

description.en: The surface of this ring crackles with the molten plasma of a burning star, the genesis of life without which even the Drzyr could not survive.
description.zh: 这个环的表面因燃烧恒星的熔融等离子体而爆裂。那是生命的起源，如果没有它，即使是泽厄尔人也无法生存。

flavor.en: "The revelation that the star from which their home planet drew life would one day die terrified Drzyr scientists. In those early days, mass hysteria and immense pressure from leadership consumed some of their brightest minds. Although many were ultimately unable to make the journey themselves, without their contributions, the creation of N’Erud would not have been possible."
flavor.zh: “得知自己家园所依赖的恒星有一天会消亡后，泽厄尔科学家无比恐惧。最初，大规模的歇斯底里和领导层的巨大压力折损了一批最聪明的头脑。尽管许多人未能亲自踏上这段旅程，但没有他们的贡献，涅鲁德就不会存在。”

items.name: Amulet_DaredevilsCharm
items.description_en: A simple yet intriguing piece of jewelry. It consists of a small skull of an unknown creature, suspended on a sturdy yet humble rope. Despite its unassuming appearance, this amulet is said to bring good luck and protection to those who dare to take risks and live life on the edge.
items.flavor_text_en: "Looks rather insignificant, but I know better than to judge a book by its cover. It must have taken a lot of time to acquire it. Though, I must say, I hope whoever wears it keeps their clothes on."

items.name: Amulet_DeathsEmbrace
items.description_en: Though the Immortals and the Nobility have come to fear death, amulets like these have long been a part of Pan culture. Just as death is universal, so the power of this amulet has never waned.
items.flavor_text_en: "Even before the Pan first arrived on Yaesha, there was a strong belief in the Balance—the idea that death begets life."

description.en: Though the Immortals and the Nobility have come to fear death, amulets like these have long been a part of Pan culture. Just as death is universal, so the power of this amulet has never waned.
description.zh: 尽管不朽者和贵族都对死亡产生了恐惧，但这种项链已是潘恩历史文化的一部分。“死亡”本身不会湮灭，这串项链的力量也从未消减。

flavor.zh: “尚未抵达耶莎之时，平衡就已经根植于潘恩的信仰之中，他们相信——死亡孕育生命。”

items.name: Amulet_DecayedMargin
items.description_en: Wilted and brittle, it feels as though it could crumble between your fingers at a moment's notice.
items.flavor_text_en: “Someday, a long time from now, today’s horrors will be no more than a dark, distant memory. I can only hope the people of tomorrow remember the sacrifices it took to take back what’s ours. It’s easy to forget these things when they’re not right under your nose.”

description.en: Wilted and brittle, it feels as though it could crumble between your fingers at a moment's notice.

flavor.en: “Someday, a long time from now, today’s horrors will be no more than a dark, distant memory. I can only hope the people of tomorrow remember the sacrifices it took to take back what’s ours. It’s easy to forget these things when they’re not right under your nose.”
flavor.zh: “很久很久以后，总有一天，今天的恐怖景象会变成黑暗但遥远的记忆。我只希望那时的人们还能记得我们为夺回一切所做的牺牲。但是没有亲身经历过的事总会被轻易遗忘。”

items.name: Amulet_DifferenceEngine
items.description_en: It is cold to the touch, built from mechanical precision in place of artistry. Even its bright center seems sterile and lifeless.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Custodian does not fear death, as by its very nature it has never known life. The ancient Drzyr once relied upon instincts—the needs of the flesh. Again and again, we surpassed ourselves until there was nothing to surpass. But I now see it as the shame it was: we forsook the wisdom of our bones."

description.en: It is cold to the touch, built from mechanical precision in place of artistry. Even its bright center seems sterile and lifeless.
description.zh: 触感冰冷。它的打造过程毫无艺术可言，取而代之的是机械的精准。即便是它明亮的中心也显得死气沉沉，毫无生机。

flavor.en: "The Custodian does not fear death, as by its very nature it has never known life. The ancient Drzyr once relied upon instincts—the needs of the flesh. Again and again, we surpassed ourselves until there was nothing to surpass. But I now see it as the shame it was: we forsook the wisdom of our bones."
flavor.zh: “保管人没有真正的生命，也不惧怕死亡。古时的泽厄尔人听从血肉之躯需要的指引，依靠自己的直觉。后来的我们则依靠理智，一次又一次地超越自身，直到最后无可超越。现在才知道当初的路走错了，悔不该放弃生命直觉的智慧。”

items.flavor_text_en: "All life draws naturally from the Balance. Much is asked of those with plenty, and little is asked of those who lack. Thus is the Balance maintained."

items.description_en: The way this amplifies your explosive power, you can tell it’s using extremely advanced acoustics of some sort. It’s not great on your ears, but if it makes the booms bigger, that’s all that really matters.
items.flavor_text_en: "After the uprising, the already strictly controlled society of the Drzyr came under further lockdown. Individual agency was stifled in the name of protecting N’Erud. Meeting halls and public auditoriums alike became little more than echo chambers for the will of those in charge."

items.description_en: This amulet is an artifact from the lost tribe of Yaesha. It took several harrowing adventures to find all three pieces, but you finally did it. This thing can apparently reveal something that was hidden. What could that mean...
items.flavor_text_en: "Dwell is full of shock that the legends of Yaesha’s lost tribe have turned out to be true! If fairytales have come to life, then perhaps that forgotten fable is also true, and this is the piece that can reveal that which is hidden."

items.name: Amulet_EffigyPendant
items.description_en: Clearly, the effigy bears a humanoid image, but the pose it strikes could be one of joy and reverence—or agony and crucifixion.
items.flavor_text_en:
"According to the tales, Tola the Dreamer performed many great deeds in her time. They say she was a prophet and a healer, a protector and a warrior. They say she could not be killed and also that she gave her life so that others might live.

The tales conflict, but I assure you, they are all true."

description.zh: 这枚吊坠很显然是人形，但它摆出的姿态非常奇异，既可以说是喜悦和崇敬，也可以说是痛苦和受难。

flavor.en:
"According to the tales, Tola the Dreamer performed many great deeds in her time. They say she was a prophet and a healer, a protector and a warrior. They say she could not be killed and also that she gave her life so that others might live.

The tales conflict, but I assure you, they are all true."
flavor.zh:
“根据传说，梦想家陶拉在她那个时代中完成了许多伟大的事迹。据说她是一位预言家兼医者，一位守护者兼战士。据说她不会被杀死，又说她为了让其他同族活下去而献出了生命。

这些传说有些矛盾，但我向你保证，它们都是真的。”

items.flavor_text_en: "The stasis pods could not save them—piece-by-piece, by hand, they built their own caskets. Where they built a graveyard, I have built an ark. I am all that remains. Our final salvation."

items.description_en: The button peers at you like an unblinking eye. Whatever its intended purpose once was, the bulging growth stuck atop this device surely altered its function.
items.flavor_text_en: "I have witnessed the final moments of countless realms. That which occurred upon the Core was...unique. Necessitated investigation. Termination was undesirable for innumerable reasons... Far too many to delineate at this moment."

description.en: The button peers at you like an unblinking eye. Whatever its intended purpose once was, the bulging growth stuck atop this device surely altered its function.

flavor.en: "I have witnessed the final moments of countless realms. That which occurred upon the Core was...unique. Necessitated investigation. Termination was undesirable for innumerable reasons... Far too many to delineate at this moment."

items.name: Amulet_GiftOfMelancholy
items.description_en: An elegant pendant the hue of evening moonmist. It belonged to a Fae precious enough to earn a resplendent garden in honor of her memory.
items.flavor_text_en: “Century-wizened Fae state that the king was stricken with grief upon the death of his beloved. To think, had she not succumbed to the mortal cruelty of age, together they may have maintained some semblance of peace in this realm. To think that the king could register grief at all... An unexpected revelation. And an exploitable weakness.”

flavor.en: “Century-wizened Fae state that the king was stricken with grief upon the death of his beloved. To think, had she not succumbed to the mortal cruelty of age, together they may have maintained some semblance of peace in this realm. To think that the king could register grief at all... An unexpected revelation. And an exploitable weakness.”
flavor.zh: “年岁上百的翡族人说，国王在心爱之人去世后悲伤成疾。想想看，如果她没有屈服于时间的残酷，他们俩或许能携手在这个国度维持一丝和平。国王居然也有哀伤……真是出人意料。也是一个可以利用的弱点。”

items.name: Amulet_GiftOfTheUnbound
items.description_en: This amulet represents a tethered goddess freed by the kindness of a traveling stranger. It glows with a mystical light that never seems to dim, and wearing it makes you feel as though a heavy burden has been lifted from your shoulders.
items.flavor_text_en: “Gratitude and platitudes are all well and good, but without material gain to back them up, they are as worthless as the air used to breathe them into existence. Remarkable deeds come at a remarkable price, and without said price, those in need, “divine” or no, ought to be left to their miserly suffering.”

description.en: This amulet represents a tethered goddess freed by the kindness of a traveling stranger. It glows with a mystical light that never seems to dim, and wearing it makes you feel as though a heavy burden has been lifted from your shoulders.
description.zh: 这条项链象征了一位被束缚的女神，她因一位陌生旅者的仁慈得以释放。项链散发着永不暗淡的神秘光芒，佩戴时，会给人一种肩头重担终于被卸下的感觉。

flavor.en: “Gratitude and platitudes are all well and good, but without material gain to back them up, they are as worthless as the air used to breathe them into existence. Remarkable deeds come at a remarkable price, and without said price, those in need, “divine” or no, ought to be left to their miserly suffering.”
flavor.zh: “感激和客套固然重要，但如果没有切实的利益支持，就会如同空气一样毫无价值。非凡的作为需要非凡的代价。如若不付出代价，就算再需要帮助，再‘神圣’或低贱，都活该继续吃苦。”

items.name: Amulet_GunslingersCharm
items.description_en: Worn by superstitious gunslingers who believe it enhances their speed and accuracy when handling firearms. Despite its unassuming appearance, the charm holds a great deal of power for those who put their faith in it.
items.flavor_text_en: "I've never been one to put stock in superstitions, but I've seen enough gunslingers wear this and handle their weapons with lightning speed to know there's something to it. Maybe it's just a placebo effect, but when it works, it works."

items.name: Amulet_HallowedEgg
items.description_en: Pulsing crystals hide within this shell, shyly poking out of the top like sprouts seeking sunlight. The runes were carved on either side by a priest to prompt the crystals’ growth.
items.flavor_text_en: "The crystals are gifts from Yaesha herself. Yet the Ahanae loathe to see the Gul with even a pebble of their power, and thus the priests regulate their harvest. The Radiant Ones fear that the rebels may unlock the crystals’ true power—or a power greater than even they themselves know."

items.name: Amulet_HangmansNoose
items.description_en: This noose, cursed by an enchanted woven strand, has absorbed thousands of souls—guilty and innocent alike. Now it awaits its next neck to adorn.
items.flavor_text_en: “There are no innocents among the Fae, at least not in the One True King’s mind. He possessed a certain vision for our kind—one we by our very natures could never hope to achieve. After all, what he saw as desecrations were to us simple instincts. Even so, not even the Dran, docile as they are, were spared his condemnation.”

description.en: This noose, cursed by an enchanted woven strand, has absorbed thousands of souls—guilty and innocent alike. Now it awaits its next neck to adorn.
description.zh: 这条绳索中织入了一根被诅咒的附魔丝线，已经吸收了成千上万的灵魂——包括罪人和无辜者。如今，它正伺机而动，等待着装饰下一个受害者的脖子。

flavor.en: “There are no innocents among the Fae, at least not in the One True King’s mind. He possessed a certain vision for our kind—one we by our very natures could never hope to achieve. items.name: Amulet_IndexOfTheScribe
items.description_en: A cylindrical seal matrix impressed with the official signature of the Royal Scribe. Its waxy impression has been used to seal countless decrees, letters, and fates.
items.flavor_text_en: “I inherited this seal from my predecessor. The previous Royal Scribe was tragically terminated from his position after earning the ire of the king’s mistress. His downfall was my ascension, and I am far too sagacious to repeat such foolhardy mistakes.”

description.en: A cylindrical seal matrix impressed with the official signature of the Royal Scribe. Its waxy impression has been used to seal countless decrees, letters, and fates.
description.zh: 一个圆柱形的印台，上面刻有皇家抄写员的官方签名。它的蜡印曾经封印过无数的法令、信件和命运。

flavor.en: “I inherited this seal from my predecessor. The previous Royal Scribe was tragically terminated from his position after earning the ire of the king’s mistress. His downfall was my ascension, and I am far too sagacious to repeat such foolhardy mistakes.”
flavor.zh: “我从前任那里继承了这枚印章。前任王室抄写员惹怒了国王情妇，悲惨地丢掉了职位。他的失败是我的崛起，而我绝不会重蹈他的覆辙。”

items.name: Amulet_IndignantFetish
items.description_en:
The Fae believe there is a spirit trapped inside this amulet and that its rage at its imprisonment is transferred to the wearer at need.

It does sound like the kind of thing the Fae would do.
items.flavor_text_en: "What the One True King did not understand—what no tyrant understands—is that you cannot control a people through force. Eventually, they will harden like a diamond, and you will be crushed by that which you had thought broken."

items.name: Amulet_InsulationDriver
items.description_en: A seldom-used apparatus that protected the Drzyr from solar flares. As the stars died out one-by-one, the rarity of such events brought unease in place of solace.
items.flavor_text_en: "Ten generations perished in the time it took to reach the Curatu-Seltis. Only borne upon their entire lifetimes did we arrive at our destination. Fortuitous, then, that they did not live long enough to see the sour fruits of their legacy."

description.zh: 一台很少用到的仪器，能保护泽厄尔人免受太阳耀斑的影响。随着恒星逐个死亡，耀斑活动也越来越罕见，绝缘驱动器带来的慰藉也慢慢变成了不安。

flavor.en: "Ten generations perished in the time it took to reach the Curatu-Seltis. Only borne upon their entire lifetimes did we arrive at our destination. Fortuitous, then, that they did not live long enough to see the sour fruits of their legacy."
flavor.zh: “我们花了十代人的时间才抵达库拉图-塞尔提斯。一代又一代人用他们的整个生命支撑我们抵达目的地。幸运的是，先辈们没有看到他们的遗志换来了怎样的苦果。”

items.name: Amulet_JestersBell
items.description_en:
Rumor says the jester was once a lowly farmer, sent away by his family and pitied by the king. They say his bell is a kind of keepsake, once worn by one of his father's animals.

The jester, of course, neither confirms nor denies this rumor, but rather uses it to great effect as a part of his persona.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Those who served the One True King—many of whom now serve under the imposter—were given their positions out of pity or fear. The king preferred to keep close to him those who needed either succor or surveillance.

Perhaps predictably, this proved unwise."

description.en:
Rumor says the jester was once a lowly farmer, sent away by his family and pitied by the king. They say his bell is a kind of keepsake, once worn by one of his father's animals.

The jester, of course, neither confirms nor denies this rumor, but rather uses it to great effect as a part of his persona.
description.zh:
传言说小丑曾是个卑微的农民，被家人抛弃后幸得君主怜悯。他们还说他的铃铛是个纪念品，曾经挂在他父亲蓄养的牲畜身上。

对于这些流言，小丑既没承认也没反驳，而是把它们内化成自己角色的一部分，从而发挥了巨大作用。

flavor.en:
"Those who served the One True King—many of whom now serve under the imposter—were given their positions out of pity or fear. The king preferred to keep close to him those who needed either succor or surveillance.

Perhaps predictably, this proved unwise."
flavor.zh:
“独一真皇出于怜悯或者恐惧而选择近身侍臣——顺便说一句，其中很多人已转而效忠冒名顶替者。真皇喜欢把需要救助或者监视的人放在身边。

不出所料，事实证明这并非明智之举。”

items.description_en: The sweet, smoky scent of incense lingers on this vessel. The Laemir tie several of these to their horns to keep their hands free during elaborate ceremonies.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Laemir have served the dead so long, they forget what it means to live. Gentle winds whispering through fur, the warmth of morning sun, the tender embrace of another... Void of life’s pleasures, they become death themselves."

description.zh: 这件容器上萦绕着焚香的香甜和烟火气。在举行复杂仪式时，莱米尔会把这种香炉系在角上以解放双手。

flavor.en: "The Laemir have served the dead so long, they forget what it means to live. Gentle winds whispering through fur, the warmth of morning sun, the tender embrace of another... Void of life’s pleasures, they become death themselves."
flavor.zh: “莱米尔为死亡服务太久，已经遗忘了生命的意义。吹拂过皮毛的清风，温暖大地的朝阳，爱人甜蜜的怀抱……没有这些生命的快乐，他们等同于已经步入死亡。”

items.name: Amulet_LegacyProtocol
items.description_en: The dull blue glow emitted by this amulet is strangely comforting. That it has remained glowing for so long means it’s unlikely to be extinguished any time soon.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Drzyr legacy must endure. If we are truly the only sentient life in this dark, empty expanse, then our species must be preserved no matter the cost. The ambit ember has revealed this to be my destiny. My sacrifice to bear. For I love the Drzyr, fallible as we are.”

flavor.zh: “泽厄尔的遗产必须延续下去。如果我们真的是这个黑暗、空旷的广袤空间中唯一有智识的生命，那么无论任何代价都要把我们种族保存下来。灵烬揭示了这就是我的命运，是我要承担的牺牲。因为我深爱泽厄尔人，尽管我们也会犯错。”

items.description_en: The stone seems to radiate a gentle blue light, almost as if it contains a piece of the night sky itself. Despite its unassuming appearance, the amulet seems to hold an undeniable power, as if it has been imbued with some kind of mystical force.
items.flavor_text_en: "Leto was always seeking answers and trying to make sense of the chaos that surrounded him. Some say that the weight of his questions was what gave him his strength, as if he carried the weight of the world on his back."

items.flavor_text_en: "Some particularly ignorant Dran believe they can peer into the distant future to avoid their miserable, tragic fates. We Fae know that fate is not something to be feared nor avoided. Rather, we make of it ourselves, in whatever design we please!"

items.description_en: A metal amulet on a delicate golden chain. It features the phases of the moon unfolding around a circular pendant, from waning to waxing, and ultimately culminating in an iridescent moonstone situated at the top.

items.name: Amulet_NavigatorsPendant
items.description_en: As pristine as it was the day it was made. Almost as if the one you hold now was pulled from another time, another reality, another outcome.
items.flavor_text_en:
"I foresaw our death. I saw it all. Few listened. Even the other Astropaths rejected the ember’s sagacity. Rejected their own eyes. Rejected me.

In that moment, we were doomed."

description.en: As pristine as it was the day it was made. Almost as if the one you hold now was pulled from another time, another reality, another outcome.

“我早已预见我们的灭亡。我看到了一切。没有人相信。甚至连其他星语者也拒绝灵烬的智慧。拒绝他们自己的双眼。拒绝我。

在那一刻，我们的命运业已注定。”

items.name: Amulet_NeckboneNecklace
items.description_en: The furcula, or neck bone, of the carnivorous noctura is difficult to obtain but highly valued in Fae folklore. They say that if one can bind the noctura to his or her will, then the creature will grant their most earnest wish.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Wishes are deadly, dangerous things. Oh, to make a wish is harmless of course, but to have one granted? If such a thing could be done without cost, the world as we know it would cease to be.

There is, therefore, always a cost."

description.en: The furcula, or neck bone, of the carnivorous noctura is difficult to obtain but highly valued in Fae folklore. They say that if one can bind the noctura to his or her will, then the creature will grant their most earnest wish.
description.zh: 肉食夜翼的叉骨——也就是颈骨——很难获得，但是在翡族传说中极具价值。据说只要能将夜翼束缚于自己的意志之下，它就能实现你最诚挚的愿望。

flavor.en:
"Wishes are deadly, dangerous things. Oh, to make a wish is harmless of course, but to have one granted? If such a thing could be done without cost, the world as we know it would cease to be.

There is, therefore, always a cost."
flavor.zh:
“‘愿望’这东西有致命的危险。哦，简单许个愿当然没什么问题，但一定会实现的愿望就完全是另一码事了。如果不用付出代价就能实现愿望，我们的这个世界早就不复存在了。

所以，永远都会有代价。”

items.name: Amulet_NecklaceOfFlowingLife
items.description_en: This necklace requires both the Blood Moon and Death. It is believed that the life it gives to the bearer comes directly from the sacrifices used to forge it.
items.flavor_text_en: "The ancients taught us many things, and we still benefit from their wisdom. So it is that Death can beget Life even long after."

items.name: Amulet_NecklaceOfSupremacy
items.description_en: The Laemir are not often thought of as warriors, but those trained in the martial arts are deadlier than any noble. Such warriors wore this necklace with pride.
items.flavor_text_en: "Do not underestimate the Laemir. They have interred the dead for long and long. If there is a secret to the Immortals' strength, the Laemir would be the ones to know."

items.name: Amulet_NightmareSpiral
items.description_en: An eerie piece of jewelry that resembles a twisted vortex of unnatural floating shards of Root encircling a glowing red core. The Root fragments appear to be suspended in mid-air, as if defying gravity, and seem to writhe and twist in a never-ending dance.
items.flavor_text_en: "I can't imagine who in their right mind would want a cursed trinket like this. And to think someone went through the trouble of obtaining it? Madness, pure madness."

description.en: An eerie piece of jewelry that resembles a twisted vortex of unnatural floating shards of Root encircling a glowing red core. The Root fragments appear to be suspended in mid-air, as if defying gravity, and seem to writhe and twist in a never-ending dance.
description.zh: 一条瘆人的项链，中间有一个发光的红色核心，被一圈漂浮的根蔓碎片包围，看起来非常扭曲、不自然。根蔓的碎片似乎不受重力影响，悬浮在空中，不停地扭曲、伸展、蜷缩，如同跳着永恒的舞蹈。

flavor.en: "I can't imagine who in their right mind would want a cursed trinket like this. And to think someone went through the trouble of obtaining it? Madness, pure madness."

items.description_en: "My sister cared not what befell others, perhaps because she cared not what befell herself. Fear and suffering are all of the same flavor to her, whomever the target of suffering might be."

items.name: Amulet_NimuesRibbon
items.description_en: The ribbon weaves both silver and gold, like the halo that lines a shadow’s edge. Nimue has personally crafted several of the most lauded Fae relics, and her craftsmanship reflects her own elegance and permanence.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Fae have a long and illustrious past, but they have always valued storytellers over historians. The relics tell their tales, passing wisdom from one generation to the next."

description.en: The ribbon weaves both silver and gold, like the halo that lines a shadow’s edge. Nimue has personally crafted several of the most lauded Fae relics, and her craftsmanship reflects her own elegance and permanence.

items.name: Amulet_OneTrueKingSigil
items.description_en: Crafted by Nimue, yet imbued with the One True King's own power in ways that not even Nimue can reproduce. Now this sigil may be all that remains of his power.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Those close to the king could not be trusted. Indeed, that is why he brought us near. He offered us a portion of his power, tempting us with desire.

But eventually, we learned that the cost for this temptation was greater than the offering."

description.en: Crafted by Nimue, yet imbued with the One True King's own power in ways that not even Nimue can reproduce. Now this sigil may be all that remains of his power.
description.zh: 由尼姆埃打造，灌注了独一真皇自己的力量，连尼姆埃都无法复刻。现在，这枚魔符恐怕是真皇留在世间的唯一力量了。

flavor.en:
"Those close to the king could not be trusted. Indeed, that is why he brought us near. He offered us a portion of his power, tempting us with desire.

But eventually, we learned that the cost for this temptation was greater than the offering."

“亲近吾皇者不可信。确实，这就是他让我们靠近的原因。他向我们许诺他的部分力量，用欲望诱惑我们。

最后我们才知道，欲望的代价远高于他的许诺。”

items.name: Amulet_OnyxPendulum
items.description_en: A breathtaking piece of jewelry that only the most dedicated can hope to obtain. The flawless, shiny black stone is adorned with stunning veins of gold that seem to pulse and shimmer as it catches the light. Suspended from a delicate chain, the amulet swings freely, enticing all who lay eyes upon it with its hypnotic beauty.
items.flavor_text_en: "I've seen my fair share of jewelry, but nothing quite like this. I can't help but wonder about the person who created it and the story behind its creation."

description.en: A breathtaking piece of jewelry that only the most dedicated can hope to obtain. The flawless, shiny black stone is adorned with stunning veins of gold that seem to pulse and shimmer as it catches the light. Suspended from a delicate chain, the amulet swings freely, enticing all who lay eyes upon it with its hypnotic beauty.
description.zh: 一件令人叹为观止的珠宝，只有最专注者才有希望获得。闪亮的黑色宝石完美无瑕，上面装饰着绝美的金脉，在光线下会发出微光，甚至似乎在脉动。悬挂在精致的链子上吊坠能够自由摆动，以催眠般的魔力迷住所有注视它的人。

flavor.en: "I've seen my fair share of jewelry, but nothing quite like this. I can't help but wonder about the person who created it and the story behind its creation."
flavor.zh: “我这辈子见过不少珠宝，但从没见过这种。不知道作者是何许人也？这件宝贝诞生的背后又有怎样的故事？”

items.name: Amulet_OrnateAmulet
items.description_en: This seemingly simple box is locked shut with a wildly complex lock for which no key exists, ensuring that the secret kept inside remains undisclosed until the end of the universe.
items.flavor_text_en: “Since the beginning of the Drzyr civilization, the Drzyr held forums to determine the future of their species. At no point in Drzyr history was there only one ruler. Calculation: there is a high probability that the Drzyr would not have mastered spacefaring under the leadership of a singular mind.”

items.name: Amulet_ParticipationMedal
items.description_en: Some believe that the true victory is in trying and never giving up. Others believe that it’s an utter waste of time to celebrate anything other than successful completion of the task at hand. She didn’t say it with words, but it came across loud and clear that McCabe falls in the second camp.
items.flavor_text_en: “I’ve got better things to do than cobble together meaningless prizes to cushion some random traveler’s bruised ego. Keep it. Toss it. Eat it, for all I care. Just stay the hell away from me if you know what’s good for you.”

description.en: Some believe that the true victory is in trying and never giving up. Others believe that it’s an utter waste of time to celebrate anything other than successful completion of the task at hand. She didn’t say it with words, but it came across loud and clear that McCabe falls in the second camp.
description.zh: 有些人认为真正的胜利在于尝试并永不放弃。其他人认为，除了成功完成手头任务之外，其他的一切都是浪费时间。虽然麦凯布自己从没说过，但所有人都知道她属于第二种。

flavor.en: “I’ve got better things to do than cobble together meaningless prizes to cushion some random traveler’s bruised ego. Keep it. Toss it. Eat it, for all I care. Just stay the hell away from me if you know what’s good for you.”
flavor.zh: “我有更重要的事情要做，不想浪费时间拼凑一些毫无意义的奖品来安慰某个旅行者受伤的自尊心。随你怎么处理，留下也好，扔掉也罢，吃掉也行。只要你还有点脑子，就应该知道要离我远点。”

items.name: Amulet_SinisterTotem
items.description_en: A thorned necklace bearing a totem that is nothing short of ominous. It pricks you when you place it around your neck, teasing out drops of blood that somehow seem to satiate the inanimate idol. You’re certain you’d rather not know the origins of those tufts of red fur caught in the braided thorns.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Red Doe has long been revered as a blessed symbol for the Pan. A portent of the end of hardship and the beginning of a new journey for our kind. What, then, shall become of those corrupted souls who would harm such a pure being for their own prosperity?”

items.flavor_text_en: "That the corruption is capable of manipulation indicates a high level of intelligence. I query from where or whom this intellect was gained. It is possible that the corruption learned to deceive by observing the ways of its creators...the children of the Core."

items.name: Amulet_VengeanceIdol
items.description_en: This idol was worn by great warriors of the past. It is said they would lull their enemies into a false sense of security, letting them feel they'd won before the true battle had begun.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Balance works both ways, for that is what the word means. When the strong become weak, the weak become strong."

items.description_en: The center twists with the beauty, mystery, and intensity of an event horizon. Stare too long, and you fear you may be pulled inside, never to return.
items.flavor_text_en:
"And had we come face-to-face with our creator, what would we have found? To be deprived of one’s origin is to give it the purpose to seek. To discover the undiscoverable was our ultimate folly.           
                              
My folly."

items.description_en: The canister is split open in several places, simulating an imminent hazard. Yet the leaking radioactive material within doesn’t appear to be truly dangerous, and it’s best not to test that observation.
items.flavor_text_en: "There are many security protocols put in place for machines like me. For example, I’m unable to access the core of N’Erud. I have never interfaced with Guardian: Sha’Hala. Yet my stellar battery is charged with energy he produced, so I still feel connected in some small way."

flavor.en: "There are many security protocols put in place for machines like me. For example, I’m unable to access the core of N’Erud. I have never interfaced with Guardian: Sha’Hala. Yet my stellar battery is charged with energy he produced, so I still feel connected in some small way."
flavor.zh: “像我这样的机器有很多安全协议。比如，我无法访问涅鲁德的核心。我从未直接接触过守护生物沙哈拉，但我的恒星电池是靠他产生的能量充电的，所以我仍然感觉我们有些许联系。”

items.description_en: Despite its name, the weight on this cord is heavy—really heavy. It's such a burden, in fact, that when you wear it, you hardly notice the weight of anything else.
items.flavor_text_en: "We must be allowed to choose our hardships. A burden borne willingly is infinitely lighter than that imposed by another."

items.name: Amulet_WhisperingMarble
items.description_en: A finely polished marble talisman featuring an abstract face. Though its lips never move, you’re certain you hear whispered words when you’re near it. Words of strength and resilience, of creation and destruction...so many words planted in your mind, spurring you onward.
items.flavor_text_en: “I could happily live the rest of my days without ever again glimpsing the horrific creations that the Dran attempt to pass off as art. Unrefined, unnerving, and wholly without merit, every last piece!”

description.en: A finely polished marble talisman featuring an abstract face. Though its lips never move, you’re certain you hear whispered words when you’re near it. Words of strength and resilience, of creation and destruction...so many words planted in your mind, spurring you onward.
description.zh: 抛光精美的大理石护身符，上面刻有一个抽象的面孔。尽管它的嘴唇从未动过，但你确定靠近时就会听到低语。那是力量和坚韧的话语，是创造和毁灭的话语……这些声音在你的脑海中扎根，激励着你继续前行。

items.name: Amulet_WornDogTags
items.description_en: A small piece of metal on a chain. There are a few basic facts about a soldier from a bygone era etched on its surface. It’s an odd piece of ephemera, but it feels right to hold on to it. Driver would have liked the idea that at least this made it out of that unforgiving jungle.
items.flavor_text_en: "I’m not even really sure myself why I held on to this blasted thing all these years. Maybe it’s just a reminder of who I am and where I came from. Or maybe somewhere in the back of my mind, I liked the idea that when this jungle finally took me, I’d leave something behind. Some small proof that I was here."

description.en: A small piece of metal on a chain. There are a few basic facts about a soldier from a bygone era etched on its surface. It’s an odd piece of ephemera, but it feels right to hold on to it. Driver would have liked the idea that at least this made it out of that unforgiving jungle.
description.zh: 挂在链条上的一块小金属牌，上面篆刻着已消逝的时代里，一名士兵的基本情况。这是一件奇特的纪念品，但感觉非常适合握在手里。德瑞弗可能会喜欢这个想法：至少这块狗牌逃离了那片无情的丛林。

flavor.en: "I’m not even really sure myself why I held on to this blasted thing all these years. Maybe it’s just a reminder of who I am and where I came from. Or maybe somewhere in the back of my mind, I liked the idea that when this jungle finally took me, I’d leave something behind. Some small proof that I was here."
flavor.zh: “我甚至不确定自己这么多年来一直守着这个该死的东西的原因。也许它只是一个关于我是谁，我从哪里来的提醒。或许在我心底，我喜欢这样的想法：当这片丛林最终吞噬我时，我想留下一些东西。一点小小的证明，证明我来过这里。”

items.name: Amulet_ZeroDivide
items.description_en: The energy stored within this amulet buzzes with unbridled potential, ready to be converted into various states of matter both familiar and alien.
items.flavor_text_en: "We sought not to dominate the mechanisms of this universe, but to better understand its inner workings, its origin, its purpose...and in doing so, we hoped, better understand ourselves. Only now, as I gaze upon the ruination of my precious civilization, do I see how tragically little we understood."

flavor.en: "We sought not to dominate the mechanisms of this universe, but to better understand its inner workings, its origin, its purpose...and in doing so, we hoped, better understand ourselves. Only now, as I gaze upon the ruination of my precious civilization, do I see how tragically little we understood."
flavor.zh: “我们并非寻求主宰这个宇宙的机制，而是为了深入地理解其内在运作、起源和目的……同时希望能在这么做的同时，更好地理解我们自己。但直到现在，当我凝视着我所珍视的文明毁灭之时，我才认识到，之前所理解的竟然如此之少，多么可悲。”

items.name: Amulet_ZeroHour
items.description_en: Wearing this strange contraption conjures a feeling of restless energy and immediacy. It triggers a dizzying adrenaline rush that pushes you to fight and strive as though each moment were your last. Since that’s pretty much always true, it’s a useful tool.
items.flavor_text_en: “The culmination of everything the Drzyr had worked for over the course of countless generations came down to a single second. Time stood still, and in that endless moment, the fate of Drzyr civilization was forever altered.”

items.name: Armor_Body_Army
items.description_en: A simple, standard-issue army shirt made from a durable canvas composite. It’s seen a lot of action but was clearly carefully maintained. There appears to be some kind of tag above the pocket, but whatever it once said, time washed it away long ago.
items.flavor_text_en: "Before I left, Dawn told me she thought I looked “rather dapper” in my uniform. I know she was just being a sweetheart but given that I wound up stuck in these rags for the rest of my days, that thought always brought me some little slice of joy. Any chance to remember her always does..."

description.zh: 一件简单的标准军用衬衫，由耐用的帆布复合材料制成。它经历了许多战斗，但显然一直被小心翼翼地保养着。口袋上方似乎有一种标签，但无论它曾经标示了什么，时间早已将其洗褪。

flavor.en: "Before I left, Dawn told me she thought I looked “rather dapper” in my uniform. I know she was just being a sweetheart but given that I wound up stuck in these rags for the rest of my days, that thought always brought me some little slice of joy. Any chance to remember her always does..."
flavor.zh: “在我离开之前，晨曦告诉我，她认为穿制服的我看起来‘相当帅气’。我知道她只是想让我开心，但鉴于我最终会穿着这些破旧的衣服度过余生，这段回忆总能给我带来些小小的快乐。任何能记起她的机会都是这样……”

items.description_en: This heavy suit of armor encumbers your shoulders with weight befitting the burdens of a sovereign. It emits a faint heat, as if forged from an ever-hot metal.
items.flavor_text_en: “The knights who aided the prince in his rebellion have long since succumbed to the dregs of time, but the prince honors their names and likenesses still. And the knights who serve him now are as loyal and gallant as their forebearers—I daresay more so than any knight who ever served the One True King.”

While it may not provide as much protection as some other types of armor, its lightweight construction and flexible design allow for exceptional mobility and ease of movement in combat.

items.name: Armor_Body_Leto2
items.description_en: A masterpiece of impenetrability. Even though quick maneuvering is near impossible in this metal behemoth, you can’t help but be impressed by the ingenuity of the design and the inspired craftsmanship.
items.flavor_text_en: “When humanity was barely scraping by an existence and everyone was gripped with a sense of fear and dread, there was Leto, tinkering away. Somehow, from the scant resources of that shattered wasteland, he found a way to engineer a suit of armor befitting the end of the world.”

description.zh: 防护性能无与伦比的杰作。虽然穿上此金属巨兽般的腿甲会让你的动作略显笨重，但其独具匠心的设计与工艺还是给你留下了不可磨灭的印象。

flavor.en: “When humanity was barely scraping by an existence and everyone was gripped with a sense of fear and dread, there was Leto, tinkering away. Somehow, from the scant resources of that shattered wasteland, he found a way to engineer a suit of armor befitting the end of the world.”
flavor.zh: “当人类只能勉强求生时，所有人都被恐惧攫住，但莱托还在敲敲打打。不知道用了什么办法，他居然靠着破碎废土上的稀少资源，打造了一套能抵御世界末日的铠甲。”

items.name: Armor_Body_NerudWarrior
items.description_en: This heavily fortified chassis was designed to endure harsh alien environments. Its structure can withstand subzero temperatures, scorching heat, acidic liquids, and even glass rain native to faraway planets.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Phetyr’s competitions began as mere training excursions, but when the Ofildi took greater interest in watching their contests, the competitions became elaborate performances over time. Some famous Phetyr warriors even took on villainous personas to entertain the crowds."

description.zh: 这种坚固的护甲专为承受严酷的外星环境而设计。特殊的结构让它可以承受零下严寒、酷热、酸液，甚至是遥远星球上的玻璃雨。

items.name: Armor_Body_Radiant
items.description_en: A dazzling sight, its golden surface featuring a stunning sun burst pattern etched into the chest. Adorned with blue gems embedded in the shoulders, this armor is fit for only the most esteemed members of the Laemir.
items.flavor_text_en: "The way I hear it, the 'Radiant Ones' were Pan who could control crystals like it was no big deal. And rumor has it, they used their skills to make spells for the immortals, but no one really knows what those spells were for, or who they were meant to help."

flavor.zh: “据我所知，‘闪耀者’能够轻松控制水晶。而且有传言说，他们用这种技能为不朽者创造了许多法术，但谁都不知道这些法术的具体作用，也不知道是为谁而创造。”

items.name: Armor_Body_RedWidow
items.description_en: This chestpiece must be hundreds—thousands—of years old, yet it shows no sign of rust or decay. One can only imagine a Pan king or queen wearing such majestic regalia.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The people looked to King Kolket for courage. History does not relate whether he was a good king, but he was a necessary king. Pan were dying by dozens, and the only option left was to flee their home into the dark unknown.

I do not believe the Pan could have succeeded under any other monarch (save perhaps the Eternal Empress herself, of course)."

description.zh: 这件胸甲肯定有几百——不，几千年的历史了，但丝毫没有锈蚀腐烂的迹象。如此华美庄重，其主人只可能是潘恩的国王或女王。

"The people looked to King Kolket for courage. History does not relate whether he was a good king, but he was a necessary king. Pan were dying by dozens, and the only option left was to flee their home into the dark unknown.

I do not believe the Pan could have succeeded under any other monarch (save perhaps the Eternal Empress herself, of course)."
flavor.zh:
“民众将希望寄托于国王科尔凯特的勇气之上。史料并未记载他是不是一位好国王，但他无疑是一位不可或缺的国王。当时潘恩大批死亡，他们唯一的选择就是逃离家园，进入黑暗的未知之中。

我认为，除了他，其他君主（当然除了永恒女皇）绝不可能带领潘恩走出困境。”

items.name: Armor_Body_Ritualist
items.description_en: This long and tattered cloak is ideal for skulking about in the dead of night in pursuance of iniquitous aims. If you ever see the back of this cloak ahead of you, you would do well to run. If you ever see its wearer facing you, it is already too late.
items.flavor_text_en: “I can scarcely tolerate lowering myself to wear such rags in the name of self-preservation, but must they be so tattered as to reveal glimpses of a fugitive Fae’s wings?! One truly cannot trust the Dran to adequately accomplish anything!”

items.name: Armor_Body_Void
items.description_en: Crafted from the same mysterious material as the Void gloves, helm, and greaves, the chest armor completes the set's unsettling aesthetic. Its angular design is both practical and intimidating, providing unparalleled protection against the deadly environments and creatures of Rhom.
items.flavor_text_en: "Looking at this chest armor sends chills down my spine. It's as if I can feel the hot, unyielding grip of Rhom's brutal environment all over again. This armor is a haunting reminder of the world's unrelenting violence and unforgiving nature.”

description.zh: 这件胸甲采用了与虚空手套、头盔和护腿一样的神秘材料，使整套护甲浑然一体，透露着骇人的气息。其棱角分明的设计既实用又令人望而生畏，能够为穿戴者提供无与伦比的保护，抵御洛姆的危险环境和危险生物。

items.flavor_text_en: "Risynth Neko’s reputation as a Seeker faltered in recent cycles due to a rumor arising about his addiction to ambit ember. His reputation was not the only one damaged during the civil debates regarding N’Erud jump, but it was one of the most momentous."

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Army
items.description_en: This pair of leather army gloves couldn’t be more to the point. They help guard against knicks and cuts and will help you keep a strong grip even in extreme conditions. It’s not the most effective gear you’ve ever seen, but it’s better than nothing.
items.flavor_text_en: "Being stranded away from home for a dog’s age, you never really stop pining after the things you left behind, but you do come to appreciate the things you have. These may seem like normal gloves, but they’re a life saver for your grip when you’ve been in a standoff with rock monsters for 18 hours straight."

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Bandit
items.description_en: The bandit gloves are rough, patched together from scraps of leather and cloth, a testament to their owner's resourcefulness and willingness to do whatever it takes to survive. Despite their rough and worn appearance, the gloves provide unexpected durability and protection amidst the unforgiving ruins of the city.
items.flavor_text_en: "I can't help but feel uneasy looking at these gloves, knowing they were once used to harm innocent people. It's a reminder that even in the midst of chaos and destruction, we must hold onto our humanity and resist the temptation to become monsters like those before us."

description.zh: 强盗手套相当粗糙，是用碎皮料和布块拼凑而成的，这证明了其主人足智多谋，而且为了生存不惜一切代价。虽然这双手套潦草又破旧，但在残酷的城市废墟中，它们却能提供意想不到的保护和耐久性。

items.description_en: An unusual piece of attire that consist of leather and rope wrappings that encircle the wearer's wrists. These unconventional gloves were favored by the members of a mysterious cult that valued secrecy and esoteric knowledge above all else.
items.flavor_text_en: "I used to dismiss cultist beliefs as nothing more than dangerous fanaticism, however I can't help but reconsider. flavor.en: "I used to dismiss cultist beliefs as nothing more than dangerous fanaticism, however I can't help but reconsider. I've simply seen too much in my time to dismiss anything outright anymore. Whatever the case may be, there is always more to learn and discover in this world, even in the most unexpected of places."
flavor.zh: “我曾经以为，异教徒的信仰不过是危险的狂热主义，然而现在我不得不重新考虑。我这一生已经见过太多事，知道不该轻率地做出否定。无论情况如何，这个世界上总有更多事物需要学习和发掘，即使是在最意想不到的地方。”

items.description_zh: 一双不同寻常的手套，带有皮革和绳索缠成的护腕，曾经颇受一个神秘邪教团的青睐。对于这个邪教团的成员来说，隐秘、深奥的学识高于一切。

items.description_en: A tingle runs across your palm within these gloves—like bugs skittering over your hand.
items.flavor_text_en: "Everything within N'Erud was constructed by machines, most of them microscopic. It's astounding that such a massive monument could be built by something so small, yet did not the Drzyr create a star in the same way? Through cooperation, there is nothing a species cannot accomplish."

flavor.en: "Everything within N'Erud was constructed by machines, most of them microscopic. It's astounding that such a massive monument could be built by something so small, yet did not the Drzyr create a star in the same way? Through cooperation, there is nothing a species cannot accomplish."
flavor.zh: “涅鲁德之中的一切都由机械打造，其中大部分都是微观机械。这个里程碑式的庞然大物，居然由如此微小的东西建成，真是令人震惊。不过泽厄尔人不是还以同样的方式创造了一颗星辰吗？只要团结一致，一个种族可以成就一切伟业。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Explorer
items.description_en: Ford's gloves were designed for warmth and dexterity. The soldier who wore these was not swinging blades or forging metal. He was pulling triggers and throwing grenades.
items.flavor_text_en:
"It was Harsgaard's idea to distribute our research. He figured out the World Stone would still function in shards. So began the Wards, where the real work was done.

Progress came faster then, for a while at least—until the Wards became doors for the enemy.

Hindsight's a bitch."

flavor.en:
"It was Harsgaard's idea to distribute our research. He figured out the World Stone would still function in shards. So began the Wards, where the real work was done.

Progress came faster then, for a while at least—until the Wards became doors for the enemy.

Hindsight's a bitch."
flavor.zh:
“把我们的研究分散开来是哈斯加德的主意。他发现世界之石可以在其碎片中发挥作用，于是就建立了各个实验区，真正的工作就是在那里进行的。

之后的研究进展就更快了，至少在一段时间内是如此——直到实验区变成了敌人入侵的大门。

最痛苦的事，莫过于事后诸葛亮了。”

They’re tough and intimidating while providing the bare-minimum level of dexterity for a steady grip on your weapon of choice. Just don’t plan on completing any tasks that require subtlety when wearing these.

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Medic
items.description_en: At a glance it’s clear that these fingerless gloves won’t keep you warm or offer much protection. Even still, you wear them because they provide improved grip without impacting precision.
items.flavor_text_en: “A field medic’s hands are something special. They can be a blessing or a curse depending whose side you’re on. They harbor the power to give life, and to just as easily take it away.”

items.flavor_text_en: "The most famous Phetyr warrior in N’Erud’s history went by the stage name of Vert Vulpes. Many Phetyr attempted to rival her glory in the colosseum, but she defended her title of Primis Bellator up until the moment N’Erud crossed the event horizon."

items.description_en: “The fingerless leather gloves provide exceptional dexterity to the wearer, while the vambraces are adorned with a blue gem that gives the wearer access to the volatile energy stored within.”
items.flavor_text_en: "Even though I've spent years on Yaesha, I still can't wrap my head around how some of the Pan folks use those glowing stones to do the stuff they do. But hey, I've seen it with my own two eyes, so I can't deny it either. It's just one of those things that I can't quite explain."

items.name: Armor_Gloves_RedWidow
items.description_en: These gloves are light, with openings for the fingers to allow the wearer maximum dexterity—a necessary consideration for traditional Pan weaponry.
items.flavor_text_en: "Though the Red Widows now rule, they were once the hands of the king, serving as both healers and morticians. It was they who interred King Kolket in his tomb, protecting his royal form and artifacts from the chaotic seasons that would come after his death."

flavor.en: "Though the Red Widows now rule, they were once the hands of the king, serving as both healers and morticians. It was they who interred King Kolket in his tomb, protecting his royal form and artifacts from the chaotic seasons that would come after his death."
flavor.zh: “虽然红寡妇现在统治着潘恩，但她们以前是侍奉国王的治疗师和殡葬师。正是她们将科尔凯特国王葬入坟墓。他的死亡开启了混乱时代，但红寡妇保护了他的皇室形象和宝藏免受其影响。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Ritualist
items.description_en: Long gloves fit like a vice around your arms, the pressure quickening your pulse and increasing your awareness. Your hands are well protected with the exception of a few exposed fingertips, intentionally left unguarded in case a given ritual requires quick access to fresh blood.
items.flavor_text_en: “Dran ritualists keep their means of sorcery a closely guarded secret—and so, naturally, I took it upon myself to surface as much detail as I could safely muster without tempting death too greatly. What I uncovered was a world of blood, death, and mutilation that I shall not soon erase from my mind’s eye.”

description.en: Long gloves fit like a vice around your arms, the pressure quickening your pulse and increasing your awareness. Your hands are well protected with the exception of a few exposed fingertips, intentionally left unguarded in case a given ritual requires quick access to fresh blood.
description.zh: 这双长手套会像钳子一样紧紧箍在手臂上，借此产生压力，加快穿戴者的脉搏，同时提高防范意识。整个手部都将得到良好的防护，除了少数几个故意暴露在外的指尖，以方便特定仪式需要，快速获取新鲜血液。

flavor.en: “Dran ritualists keep their means of sorcery a closely guarded secret—and so, naturally, I took it upon myself to surface as much detail as I could safely muster without tempting death too greatly. What I uncovered was a world of blood, death, and mutilation that I shall not soon erase from my mind’s eye.”
flavor.zh: “德兰祭祀者对他们的巫术严加保密，因此，我自然而然地承担起揭露细节的重任，同时又要保证不引发太大伤亡。结果，我发现了一个充满血腥、死亡和残缺的世界，那些画面久久无法从我脑海中抹去。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_SpaceWorker
items.description_en: Electromagnets are worked into the grip, activating automatically when the hand closes. Seems like a useful feature, so long as everything you work with is metal.
items.flavor_text_en:
"It is said that the Seekers are the heart of the Drzyr, the Astropaths our sight, the Xul our thoughts, and the Phetyr our strength.

The Ofildi were often omitted from this proverb, but without hands, the Drzyr could accomplish nothing."

flavor.zh:
“人们常说追寻者是我们的心脏，星语者是我们的眼睛，苏勒是我们的思想，菲特尔是我们的力量。

这句谚语里略去了欧菲迪，但没有他们——我们的双手，泽厄尔人将一事无成。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Survivor
items.description_en: Made of durable leather and include a makeshift wrist guard consisting of a metal plate secured by leather straps, providing additional protection to the wearer's wrists without sacrificing dexterity.
items.flavor_text_en: "When you're out there, you gotta protect your hands, but you also gotta have enough mobility to use your weapon when it counts. These gloves might not be fancy, but they get the job done - a little protection and enough dexterity to handle whatever comes your way."

description.zh: 用结实的皮革制成，护腕用金属板拼凑，以皮革边角料固定，能在不牺牲灵活性的前提下更好地保护佩戴者的手腕。

flavor.en: "When you're out there, you gotta protect your hands, but you also gotta have enough mobility to use your weapon when it counts. These gloves might not be fancy, but they get the job done - a little protection and enough dexterity to handle whatever comes your way."
flavor.zh: “在外面的时候必须要保护好双手，但也要有足够的机动性，以便在必要的时候使用武器。这双手套不怎么时髦，但是很实用——适当的防御力加上足够的灵活性，让你能对任何状况应付自如。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Void
items.description_en: Crafted from an enigmatic substance that resembles hardened bone in appearance. These gloves are a powerful tool in the hands of those who would wield the void, drawing energy from the emptiness between worlds to unleash devastating attacks. But with great power comes great cost, and those who dare to wear these gloves must be prepared to pay the price.
items.flavor_text_en: "Every time I lay eyes upon these, I'm transported back to the horrors of Rhom. The twisted contours of their bone-like appearance fill me with an unease that I just can't shake. The power they offer may be tempting, but I've had enough of that forsaken planet's terrors to know better.”

description.en: Crafted from an enigmatic substance that resembles hardened bone in appearance. These gloves are a powerful tool in the hands of those who would wield the void, drawing energy from the emptiness between worlds to unleash devastating attacks. But with great power comes great cost, and those who dare to wear these gloves must be prepared to pay the price.
description.zh: 用看起来像硬化骨骼的神秘物质打造而成。如果你想操纵虚空，如果你想在世界之间的虚无中汲取能量以发动毁灭性的打击，那么这双手套绝对能为你提供强大的助力。但是力量越大，代价也越大，敢带上这双手套，就要准备好付出巨大的代价。

flavor.en: "Every time I lay eyes upon these, I'm transported back to the horrors of Rhom. The twisted contours of their bone-like appearance fill me with an unease that I just can't shake. The power they offer may be tempting, but I've had enough of that forsaken planet's terrors to know better.”
flavor.zh: “这副手套外表如同骸骨，形状扭曲怪异，说不出的瘆人。每次看到，在洛姆时经历的种种恐怖就又浮现在我的眼前。手套所能带来的力量的确很诱人，但我在那该死的星球上经历的太多了，绝不会向这种诱惑投降。”

items.name: Armor_Gloves_Warden
items.description_en: These lithe vambraces taper to tightly fitted gloves made of thin, malleable metal sourced from passing asteroids caught in N’Erud’s gravitational pull.
items.flavor_text_en: "Axiom Cadyar was a high-ranking member of House Al’Maruun and the eldest of the Convocation. It was only his demoralizing temper that kept him from becoming Seeker Primis. Though he and I engaged in countless debates, he could never shake his distrust of my artificial design."

description.en: These lithe vambraces taper to tightly fitted gloves made of thin, malleable metal sourced from passing asteroids caught in N’Erud’s gravitational pull.
description.zh: 涅鲁德引力捕获的小行星上存在某种轻薄可塑的金属，这件轻盈的护手就是由这种金属锻造而成的。它自上而下越来越纤细，手部成了完全贴合肉体的手套。

flavor.en: "Axiom Cadyar was a high-ranking member of House Al’Maruun and the eldest of the Convocation. It was only his demoralizing temper that kept him from becoming Seeker Primis. Though he and I engaged in countless debates, he could never shake his distrust of my artificial design."
flavor.zh: “公理者卡迪亚尔是阿玛鲁圣院的高级成员，是议会中的长老。但他那让人丧气的性格使他无法成为首席追寻者。虽然我和他进行了无数次辩论，但他仍然不信任我的人工设计。”

items.name: Armor_Head_Army
items.description_en: This helmet looks heavier than it is, which isn’t all that surprising, considering it isn’t bulletproof. Still, it’s useful for protecting against falling debris, and if the angle’s just right, it may get lucky and deflect a stray bullet or two. I wouldn’t count on it, though.
items.flavor_text_en: "Never underestimate solid head protection. If I had a nickel for every time one of us soldiers lost track of our helmet and had to risk one of our lives to go and fetch it, believe you me, I’d be a real-life Richie Rich by now!"

items.name: Armor_Head_Bandit
items.description_en: The helm of the Bandit Armor is a haunting symbol of the ruthless opportunism that arose after the cataclysmic destruction of Earth. Yet, for those who wear it, it also represents a means of survival in a world where mercy is a scarce commodity.
items.flavor_text_en: "Folks like Brabus resorted to killing each other when the world crumbled, succumbing to fear that permeated their minds. It's not unexpected, but it is a tragedy."

items.name: Armor_Head_BloodlessCrown
items.description_en: The weight of this crown is heavy, so much heavier than you might have guessed. Though aged, the shining metal has been carefully preserved, and the crown jewel radiates with a passionate fury you can scarcely comprehend.
items.flavor_text_en: “It is said that King Thalos was beloved by his Pan, even as a prince back in our original homeland. It is an abomination that he came to be known as the Bloodless King due to the machinations of the stone goddess. Yet the Pan need never know of his descent... No, indeed. Some secrets are best left buried, so as not to dull the brilliance of the legends that give us the strength to carry on.”

description.en: The weight of this crown is heavy, so much heavier than you might have guessed. Though aged, the shining metal has been carefully preserved, and the crown jewel radiates with a passionate fury you can scarcely comprehend.
description.zh: 这顶皇冠的重量，远比你想象的要重得多。尽管历经岁月，但王冠被保管得很好，金属仍然熠熠生辉。其上的宝石以一种你几乎无法理解的激怒闪耀着。

flavor.en: “It is said that King Thalos was beloved by his Pan, even as a prince back in our original homeland. It is an abomination that he came to be known as the Bloodless King due to the machinations of the stone goddess. Yet the Pan need never know of his descent... No, indeed. Some secrets are best left buried, so as not to dull the brilliance of the legends that give us the strength to carry on.”
flavor.zh: “据说萨洛斯王深受他潘恩臣民的爱戴，哪怕在我们原初的故乡，在他还是一名王子时就是如此了。但因为石之女神的阴谋，他现在更广为人知的身份是断血王，这无疑令人作呕。但潘恩永远不需知道断血王的真正血统……没错，永不。有些秘密还是埋藏在心底为好，以免玷污那些赋予我们继续前行力量的，传奇的光芒。”

items.flavor_text_en: "You'd think the Root would'a brought us together--common enemy and all that. But it ain't so. In this world, you find those few what got your back and you run with 'em to the end."

items.name: Armor_Head_Challenger
items.description_en: The visibility in this helmet leaves much to be desired, but that’s not really the point. It goes a long way in keeping your head on your shoulders.
items.flavor_text_en: “Believe it or not, I’ve met certain folks who have risen above reliance on the five senses. In place of sight and sound, they rely on foresight and instinct.”

items.name: Armor_Head_CrimsonGuard
items.description_en: The hooded mask wreathes you in a vicious, fiery visage that evokes both fear and admiration. The incandescent eye slits color your vision with the hues of hellfire.
items.flavor_text_en: “The prince’s mother is always depicted with her face veiled by a mask. Some claim the mask concealed harrowing battle scars, or perhaps preserved an impossibly beautiful and delicate visage. Of course, I know the truth of the matter: that the king would not dare permit his consort to ever reveal her face, not even to her son—who now obscures his own in precisely the same manner.”

description.en: The hooded mask wreathes you in a vicious, fiery visage that evokes both fear and admiration. The incandescent eye slits color your vision with the hues of hellfire.
description.zh: 带上这兜帽下的面具，你展现出的面容炽热且邪恶，令人恐惧的同时又让人钦佩。透过面具白炽色的眼缝之中，你所见到的一切都将染上地狱火焰的色彩。

flavor.en: “The prince’s mother is always depicted with her face veiled by a mask. Some claim the mask concealed harrowing battle scars, or perhaps preserved an impossibly beautiful and delicate visage. Of course, I know the truth of the matter: that the king would not dare permit his consort to ever reveal her face, not even to her son—who now obscures his own in precisely the same manner.”
flavor.zh: “在描述中，王子的母亲总是戴着面具。有人声称，戴面具是为了掩盖战斗留下的苦痛伤疤，亦或是为了隐藏其难以置信的仙姿玉色。当然，我知道事情的真相：国王不敢允许他的妻子露脸，甚至对她的亲生儿子亦是如此——而王子现在，也以完全相同的方式隐藏了自己的面容。”

items.name: Armor_Head_Cultist
items.description_en: A simple and unassuming headpiece that belies its storied past. Once worn by members of a secretive and enigmatic cult, it now serves as a symbol of redemption for those who have turned their backs on the group's teachings.
items.flavor_text_en: "Some believe that the cultists deliberately averted their eyes from the truth, but I can't help but wonder whether they may have uncovered some truths that the rest of us have missed."

items.description_en: This headpiece hails from the wild and mysterious world of Yaesha. Its smooth, featureless design is both eerie and elegant, painted a stark white and adorned with luxuriant fur and imposing horns.
items.flavor_text_en: “The mask, crafted by the Red Widows of Yaesha, serves as a haunting reminder that power can shift in an instant, depending on the tools at hand. It's a testament to the fact that those who were once healers and medicine women can become queens, elders, and even gods with the right resources.”

items.name: Armor_Head_Engineer
items.description_en: An overwhelming amount of information shines within the helmet's display, the vast majority of it incomprehensible. Whether that's because it's a foreign language or the helmet has been damaged by whatever destroyed this place is anybody's guess.
items.flavor_text_en: "House Lythla acquired knowledge beyond anything the other houses could imagine. While the rest of us spent ageless eons searching for signs of life that didn't exist, the Xul's field of study was right in front of them at all times."

description.en: An overwhelming amount of information shines within the helmet's display, the vast majority of it incomprehensible. Whether that's because it's a foreign language or the helmet has been damaged by whatever destroyed this place is anybody's guess.
description.zh: 头盔内的显示器上闪烁着大量信息，绝大部分都无法读懂。这到底是一种外语，还是头盔屏幕受损导致，谁也说不准。

flavor.en: "House Lythla acquired knowledge beyond anything the other houses could imagine. While the rest of us spent ageless eons searching for signs of life that didn't exist, the Xul's field of study was right in front of them at all times."
flavor.zh: “里斯拉圣院获得的知识比其他圣院所能想象的更多。我们花费千百年寻找本就不存在的生命迹象，而苏勒所研究的课题却近在眼前，触手可及。”

items.description_en: This hat once belonged to Founder Ford. He was only a captain then—a much younger Ford, from a long time and many lives ago.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The Dreamer Program was Harsgaard's brain child. He wasn't the one who discovered the runes or the World Stone, but he figured out what they meant—what they could show us.

I wish to God he hadn't."

"The Dreamer Program was Harsgaard's brain child. He wasn't the one who discovered the runes or the World Stone, but he figured out what they meant—what they could show us.

“梦游者计划源自哈斯加德的创想。他并不是符文石——也就是世界之石——的发现者，但他研究出了它们的意义，知道了它们想给我们展现的东西。

要是他从未这么做过该有多好啊。”

items.flavor_text_en: "Who watches the king's men? They themselves do. There is no trust among the royal guard except in battle. Each watches the other, seeking any opportunity to betray one another, thus gaining accolades for themselves."

items.flavor_text_en: “It’s funny how something as trivial as a cloth cap can call to mind more innocent times. In these dark days, that’s arguably more vital than a solid defense.”

flavor.en: “It’s funny how something as trivial as a cloth cap can call to mind more innocent times. In these dark days, that’s arguably more vital than a solid defense.”

items.flavor_text_en: “When you find yourself staring down a situation where even the air promises destruction, sometimes all that keeps you moving one foot in front of the other is the hunt.”

items.name: Armor_Head_Invader
items.description_en: It's like putting your head inside the monsters you've been killing all this time. It's comfortable enough though, so long as you don't think about where it's been.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The corruption began as an idea, a seed released by witnessing the truth of all things.

Like all ideas, the seed took root. It bloomed, and the idea took form, growing of its own accord, until it could no longer be quelled even by those who created it."

Like all ideas, the seed took root. It bloomed, and the idea took form, growing of its own accord, until it could no longer be quelled even by those who created it."

“腐坏始于一个想法，一粒因见证万物真相而播撒的种子。

就如所有想法一般，这颗种子扎了根，开了花。这个想法开始成形，生长，直到它的创造者也无法遏止。”

items.description_en: The unwavering visage of Lydusa carves the shape of this mask. Though her sisters wandered far and wide, Lydusa seldom traveled at all, for stone by its nature is unmoving and lonely.
items.flavor_text_en: "Sweet Lydusa lifts the mountains tall and digs the canyons deep. She shapes the earth so that others may frolic atop it, and she crushes those who stray too far from the path."

description.en: The unwavering visage of Lydusa carves the shape of this mask. Though her sisters wandered far and wide, Lydusa seldom traveled at all, for stone by its nature is unmoving and lonely.
description.zh: 这副面具精准勾勒出莉杜莎坚定不移的面容。虽然她的姐妹都已远去，但莉杜莎本人却极少旅行，毕竟，孤零零地一动不动是石头的本性啊。

flavor.en: "Sweet Lydusa lifts the mountains tall and digs the canyons deep. She shapes the earth so that others may frolic atop it, and she crushes those who stray too far from the path."
flavor.zh: “甜美的莉杜莎上起高山，下掘深谷。她塑造了大地，让其他生灵可以在其上嬉戏；而对于那些偏离正道的人，她则将其粉碎。”
