items.description_en: Reinforced and designed to completely enclose the head, providing maximum protection against the dangers of the Root.
items.flavor_text_en: "After the Root came, most people were content to hide behind their walls and accept their fate, but a few of us dared to seek answers. Leto was among us, a man of courage and determination."

description.en: Reinforced and designed to completely enclose the head, providing maximum protection against the dangers of the Root.

items.description_en: While this ironclad helmet is somewhat difficult to breathe in, you feel secure knowing even the heaviest weapon would have little chance of cracking into your skull.
items.flavor_text_en: “When the whole world could disappear in the blink of an eye and most folks are getting their affairs in order or trying to find a glimmer of joy in the chaos, leave it to a tried-and-true scientist to focus on protecting their gray matter from the faintest threat of potential damage.”

items.name: Armor_Head_LodestoneCrown
items.description_en: This crown was worn by King Kolket himself. It could be heresy for a paxultek to wear such an artifact, but there are few left among the Pan who would even recognize it as their own.
items.flavor_text_en: "Although much of the knowledge of the ancient Pan has been lost to time, it is known they had their own form of magic. The lodestones are thought to be part of this, allowing them to create artifacts that reacted to each other's presence in unique and sometimes powerful ways."

description.en: This crown was worn by King Kolket himself. It could be heresy for a paxultek to wear such an artifact, but there are few left among the Pan who would even recognize it as their own.
description.zh: 科尔凯特国王本人曾佩戴过这顶王冠。帕苏泰克佩戴此种圣物可能会被视为异端，但如今已经几乎没有潘恩人能认出这是他们的遗产了。

flavor.en: "Although much of the knowledge of the ancient Pan has been lost to time, it is known they had their own form of magic. The lodestones are thought to be part of this, allowing them to create artifacts that reacted to each other's presence in unique and sometimes powerful ways."
flavor.zh: “尽管关于古代潘恩的许多知识都已被时间湮没，但可以确定的是，他们拥有自己的魔法形式。磁石很可能就是其中的一环，让他们能制作出对彼此有独特反应的宝物，有时甚至有非常强大的效果。”

items.description_zh: 科尔凯特国王本人曾佩戴过这顶王冠。帕苏泰克佩戴此种圣物可能会被视为异端，但如今已经几乎没有潘恩人能认出这是他们的遗产了。

items.name: Armor_Head_Medic
items.description_en: This face covering protects you from contagions without obstructing your sight. You feel like a creature from another world in this thing. Perhaps that’s fitting.
items.flavor_text_en: “In a world of living nightmares, you think of a hero as the person with the shiny blade spilling blood and slicing up monsters. Don’t ever forget that it takes a certain brand of bravery to go back for the wounded and challenge death itself.”

items.name: Armor_Head_MudtoothsHat
items.description_en: A hat that once belonged to some kind of man in black. Or did it? Mudtooth went through some kind of crazy experience to get this thing, though the details are a little muddled. Either that, or he found it in a dumpster. You’re going to choose to believe it’s the former.
items.flavor_text_en: “Ol’ Mudtooth has gone a-wanderin’ ‘round every corner of this here big, blue marble, and I tell ya, I still ain’t never seen a hat no fancier than this un! You plop this beaut on yer noggin and you’ll be a gen-u-wine cassee-nova! Hehehe!”

description.zh: 这顶帽子曾经属于某个黑衣人，又或者并非如此？一段疯狂的经历后，泥牙方才获得这顶帽子，尽管他所说的细节有点模糊不清。也许，他是在垃圾桶里翻到的，只是你选择相信前者。

flavor.zh: “老泥牙可是踏足过这个巨大蓝色大理石上的每一个角落，我跟你说，我还没见过有哪顶帽子比这顶更出色的！把这顶美丽的帽子戴在头上，你就会成为一个真正的万人迷！啊哈哈哈！”

items.name: Armor_Head_NerudWarrior
items.description_en: This helmet resembles the carapace of an otherworldly arthropod. It boasts auto-targeting and vision enhancing software within the visor, which particularly haughty Phetyr refused to utilize.
items.flavor_text_en: "Every cycle, House M’Ertal hosted a grand competition in which the winner was named the Primis Bellator. The competition showcased one’s skill and technique with N’Erudian weaponry and ended with one-on-one duels. The competitors could utilize anything within their arsenal, and so, understandably, the Seekers disliked this tradition."

The competition showcased one’s skill and technique with N’Erudian weaponry and ended with one-on-one duels. The competitors could utilize anything within their arsenal, and so, understandably, the Seekers disliked this tradition."
flavor.zh: “每个周期，姆埃塔圣院都会举办一场盛大的比武，获胜者会被称为‘第一武士’。参与者需要在一对一的决斗中展示格斗技巧和武器使用技术，并且可以使用武器库中的任何工具，因此，追寻者不喜欢这种传统也就很容易理解了。”

items.name: Armor_Head_PilotsHelm
items.description_en: It's hard to imagine someone piloting an entire world, but that's who this helm was for. The sockets allowed them to speak with N'Erud directly. N'Erud had dozens of pilots, all working in concert—both with each other and with the world itself.
items.flavor_text_en: "Those we dubbed "pilots" were little more than tools—minds serving as interfaces. The Astropaths determined N'Erud's course, and the Custodian ensured the ship arrived safely. Pilots were merely delegates for our collective will."

description.en: It's hard to imagine someone piloting an entire world, but that's who this helm was for. The sockets allowed them to speak with N'Erud directly. N'Erud had dozens of pilots, all working in concert—both with each other and with the world itself.
description.zh: 很难想象有人能“驾驶”整个世界，但这件头盔的佩戴者就做到了。上面的插槽让他们能跟涅鲁德直接对话。涅鲁德有几十名飞行员，全部协同工作——既彼此配合，也与这个世界本身协作。

flavor.en: "Those we dubbed "pilots" were little more than tools—minds serving as interfaces. The Astropaths determined N'Erud's course, and the Custodian ensured the ship arrived safely. Pilots were merely delegates for our collective will."
flavor.zh: “那些所谓的‘飞行员’只能算是工具——被用作界面的头脑。星语者决定涅鲁德的航线，保管人确保飞船安全抵达。飞行员只不过是我们集体意志的体现。”

items.description_en: The cowl is a striking blue, which contrasts with the large, featureless golden mask that covers the face of the wearer. This armor was highly coveted and only granted to those few who were recognized as the "Radiant Ones."
items.flavor_text_en: "Despite spending many years on Yaesha, the intricacies of Pan society still elude me, but what I do know for certain is that the Ahanae possessed a mastery over crystal manipulation that defies comprehension."

items.flavor_text_en: “That the One True King suffered the young prince to live despite his attempted coup is a curious thing. Either the king thought exile a punishment graver than death...or his mercy bespoke that which he dared not otherwise admit.”

items.description_en: The horns of this helmet are ornamental, designed to be displayed in addition to the Pan wearer's own horns—which themselves protrude from additional openings in the armor—to create a truly frightening visage.
items.flavor_text_en: "They say King Kolket was tall—taller than any Pan. He spent most days on the prow of his vessel so that he could be clearly seen by his people on any other ship as a symbol of hope and defiance against the black waters."

items.name: Armor_Head_Ritualist
items.description_en: A large-brimmed hat that manages to strike fear in those who see it despite its simplistic and unintimidating design. Its main use is to cast its wearer's face in a shadow as dark as the deeds they seek to commit under black of night.
items.flavor_text_en: “In these times of political upheaval and rampant vengeance, a clever disguise is perhaps more integral to survival than a sharpened blade. After all, the latter will only get you killed, while the former allows one to move amongst the shadows until an opportune time for reemergence presents itself.”

description.zh: 一顶大檐帽，设计简单，毫无威慑力，但却能让看到它的人心惊肉跳。它的主要用途是让佩戴者的脸笼罩在一片阴影中，就像他们即将在黑夜中实施的恶行。

items.name: Armor_Head_SpaceWorker
items.description_en: People (Mudtooth mostly) tell stories of how, before the Root, humans could fly into space. It's probably not true, but if it were, they'd need something like this to keep them alive out there.
items.flavor_text_en: "As an Astropath, I have never been outside N'Erud's shell myself. That was the domain of Xul and Ofildi. That is not to say I have not seen the void. I see everything, but what others call void is, to me, an infinite dance of force and light."

flavor.zh: “了解猎物是成功狩猎的关键——见其所见，闻其所闻。但假若了解猎物过甚，自身就有成为猎物的风险。”

items.name: Armor_Head_Survivor
items.description_en: A makeshift accessory that may not offer any protection to the head, but they do serve a vital function of shielding the eyes. With the harsh conditions of the wasteland and the debris flying around, it's crucial to keep your vision clear and safe.
items.flavor_text_en: "These goggles might make you look a bit bug eyed, but hey, I get it. Gotta keep those eyes safe, and these’ll do the job."

description.en: A makeshift accessory that may not offer any protection to the head, but they do serve a vital function of shielding the eyes. With the harsh conditions of the wasteland and the debris flying around, it's crucial to keep your vision clear and safe.

items.name: Armor_Head_TopHat
items.description_en: Lovingly crafted by a skilled hatter who clearly takes great pride in their work. After being exposed to endless days of rain, the shell began to separate from the crown, so a woven cord was tied around the center to hold it in place—for now.
items.flavor_text_en: "My, now that is a proper hat, quite proper! A showstopper, truly! In fact, should you ever tire of wearing such a terribly tasteful hat—or dare you misplace it—I would be pleased to take it off your hands."

description.en: Lovingly crafted by a skilled hatter who clearly takes great pride in their work. After being exposed to endless days of rain, the shell began to separate from the crown, so a woven cord was tied around the center to hold it in place—for now.
description.zh: 一顶由技艺精湛的帽匠精心制作的帽子，其显然对这件作品非常自豪。经过经年的日晒雨淋，帽壳和帽体逐渐分离，因此在中间系上了一条编织绳，暂时固定住了它。

flavor.en: "My, now that is a proper hat, quite proper! A showstopper, truly! In fact, should you ever tire of wearing such a terribly tasteful hat—or dare you misplace it—I would be pleased to take it off your hands."

items.name: Armor_Head_TrueCrimsonCrown
items.description_en: Unified at long last, this enigmatic mask and flaming diadem signify that its wearer is not only forever loyal to the Red King but stands as his most favored equal.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Red King’s true name, you ask? Who’s to say he was ever granted one? He was born to inherit a title, after all, and inherit it, he did! Of course, were he in possession of a true name, I would most certainly know it."

description.zh: 终于统一，这个神秘的面具和燃烧的冠冕表明，其佩戴者不仅永远忠于红王，而且是王最宠爱的平等者。

items.name: Armor_Head_Void
items.description_en: The skull-like helm hails from the inhospitable world of Rhom, where survival demands more than just strength and cunning. Fashioned from a mysterious material, its surface glimmers with an otherworldly sheen that seems to shift and change with the light. Its sleek and angular lines, reminiscent of some alien technology, evoke a sense of unease in those who gaze upon it.
items.flavor_text_en: "I don't ever want to go back to that hellhole, just looking this helm reminds me of the horrors I faced on Rhom. I may have left that world behind, but it will always be a part of me."

description.en: The skull-like helm hails from the inhospitable world of Rhom, where survival demands more than just strength and cunning. Fashioned from a mysterious material, its surface glimmers with an otherworldly sheen that seems to shift and change with the light. Its sleek and angular lines, reminiscent of some alien technology, evoke a sense of unease in those who gaze upon it.
description.zh: 这个骷髅头样式的头盔来自荒凉的洛姆。想在那里生存下去，只有力量和智慧还远远不够。这顶头盔由一种神秘材料制成，其表面闪烁着异样的光泽，似乎会随着光线的变化而不同。流畅而棱角分明的线条，让人不禁联想到外星科技，如果看得久了，心底会泛起不安。

flavor.en: "I don't ever want to go back to that hellhole, just looking this helm reminds me of the horrors I faced on Rhom. I may have left that world behind, but it will always be a part of me."
flavor.zh: “一看到这顶头盔，我就想起洛姆上经历的种种恐怖。我可不想再回那个鬼地方了。即便离开洛姆，那里给我打下的烙印也永远不会磨灭。”

items.description_en: The wide, dish-shaped helmet functions as a long-range radar to translate the wearer’s thoughts into commands for their drone.
items.flavor_text_en: "Cae’Loa Iturius was nominated to the Convocation on account of her innovative genius. However, she preferred the company of machines and artificial intelligence and rarely appeared in the public eye. Of the five Seekers, she was the least resistant to accepting my analysis of Alepsis-Taura."

items.name: Armor_Legs_Army
items.description_en: A rugged pair of army pants complete with a functional, nondescript belt, a belt buckle, and a set of worn leather boots. They’re designed to withstand whatever the mission demands of a soldier.
items.flavor_text_en: "They’re just pants, for cryin’ out loud. Nothin’ to write home to Mama about. I’ll tell you what, though. If I had to be stuck with the same pair all these years, thank God they’re not bell bottoms. Private Jack Driver will not be caught dead in hippie clothes."

items.description_en: Consists of a pair of basic slacks and sturdy boots. items.flavor_text_en: "I wouldn't be caught dead in these. Those bandits cause nothing but misery and chaos for the innocent people trying to survive in what remains of this world."

items.description_raw: Consists of a pair of basic slacks and sturdy boots. While it may not offer much in terms of protection, it allows for easy movement and agility in the dangerous terrain of the ruined cityscapes. The simplicity of the design is a testament to the practicality of the bandits, who prioritize functionality over aesthetics.

items.name: Armor_Legs_Challenger
items.description_en: While they’re not exactly aesthetic, you’re more comfortable in twice-tempered steel and repurposed tire tread than you care to admit.
items.flavor_text_en: “Just like a discarded tire fashioned into makeshift armor, for certain stalwart individuals, their service never ends—it simply evolves.”

description.en: While they’re not exactly aesthetic, you’re more comfortable in twice-tempered steel and repurposed tire tread than you care to admit.
description.zh: 虽然不怎么美观，但你不得不承认——穿着这件两次淬火，经由轮胎橡胶强化过的钢铁护甲时，你会感到更安心。

flavor.en: “Just like a discarded tire fashioned into makeshift armor, for certain stalwart individuals, their service never ends—it simply evolves.”
flavor.zh: “就像废弃的轮胎可以被改造成临时护甲，对某些意志坚定的人来说，服役永远不会结束——只不过会进化。”

items.name: Armor_Legs_CrimsonGuard
items.description_en: The crimson greaves clink and clank as you walk, announcing your presence to those honored enough to know it. Each sabaton tapers to a sharp, defiant point.
items.flavor_text_en: “An amusing rumor claims that the prince’s armor was not forged crimson, but rather stained by the gore of the countless Fae who challenged his reign. It has never been affirmed nor denied by the prince himself, and I would not dare deign to ask.”

description.en: The crimson greaves clink and clank as you walk, announcing your presence to those honored enough to know it. Each sabaton tapers to a sharp, defiant point.
description.zh: 当你迈步前进时，猩红色的护胫叮当作响，向那些有幸知道的人宣布你的存在。战靴脚趾处逐渐变细的设计，仿佛是你对敌人尖锐的挑衅。

flavor.en: “An amusing rumor claims that the prince’s armor was not forged crimson, but rather stained by the gore of the countless Fae who challenged his reign. It has never been affirmed nor denied by the prince himself, and I would not dare deign to ask.”
flavor.zh: “有个耐人寻味的传闻，据说王子的护甲原本并不是猩红色，而是被无数挑战王权的翡族的鲜血所染红。王子本人并未承认，也未否认，而我也不敢多问。”

items.flavor_text_en: "They may look like little more than scraps of cloth and rope, but those leggings are surprisingly durable. It's almost as if the cultists have put their faith in something other than sturdy armor."

items.name: Armor_Legs_Elder
items.description_en: Designed for both form and function. Made from durable yet lightweight materials, they allow for a full range of movement and flexibility in combat.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan are known for their meticulous attention to detail, even when it comes to putting on a pair of pants. Their ceremonial approach extended to the intricate wrapping of their feet in leather straps, ensuring that every aspect of their dress was imbued with meaning and significance."

items.name: Armor_Legs_Engineer
items.description_en: Designed for stability rather than speed. Plant your weight in these things, and you'd be very difficult to move.
items.flavor_text_en: "Though all other Drzyr desired to travel, to search this vast universe of ours for any sign of life, the Xul were content where they were. They served the greater good while at the same time being themselves fulfilled without ever leaving N'Erud's metal hull."

description.en: Designed for stability rather than speed. Plant your weight in these things, and you'd be very difficult to move.
description.zh: 以稳定性而非速度见长，所以负重过高的话你可能寸步难行。

flavor.en: "Though all other Drzyr desired to travel, to search this vast universe of ours for any sign of life, the Xul were content where they were. They served the greater good while at the same time being themselves fulfilled without ever leaving N'Erud's metal hull."
flavor.zh: “尽管其他泽厄尔人都渴望旅行，渴望探索广袤的宇宙，但苏勒却对自己所处的状态非常满意。他们一边为伟大的事业添砖加瓦，一边在涅鲁德的金属船体中得到了满足。”

items.name: Armor_Legs_Explorer
items.description_en: There is hardly a world where these boots haven't tread.
items.flavor_text_en:
"There were something like twenty Wards across the country, each with room for at least a dozen Dreamers. Neville wanted to see every world there was, not that we ever got close.

Only a couple of people I know have walked the worlds, and I'm pretty sure every one of 'em would say we're better off alone."

description.en: There is hardly a world where these boots haven't tread.
description.zh: 这双靴子差不多踏遍了所有世界。

flavor.en:
"There were something like twenty Wards across the country, each with room for at least a dozen Dreamers. Neville wanted to see every world there was, not that we ever got close.

Only a couple of people I know have walked the worlds, and I'm pretty sure every one of 'em would say we're better off alone."
flavor.zh:
“整个国家分布着大概二十个实验区，每个试验区都能容纳至少十数名梦游者。内维尔想看遍所有世界，但我们距离这个目标差得太远了。

在我认识的人中，只有寥寥数人穿越过不同世界，我敢说他们所有人都赞同最好还是不要与其他世界产生联系。”

Although apparently made of steel, they feel lighter than any boots you've ever worn.

No... you feel lighter when wearing them.
items.flavor_text_en:

所以，不要依赖你的双眼，因为在所有感官中，视觉是最容易被欺骗的。”

items.description_en: Durable pants with spurred boots and a strip of leather for a belt. The only accent is an imposing skull on the belt buckle, a constant reminder that death is always lurking in the shadows.
items.flavor_text_en: “You’d do well to remember that the clinking of spurs followed by the deafening burst of a bullet are the last sounds many a soul will ever hear.”

items.flavor_text_en: "The sister spirits are the daughters of Yaesha, and every mortal who resides in their jungle takes equally of their blessings and their wrath."

items.description_raw: You can feel all of Yaesha beneath the soles of these heavy greaves: the soft loam of the soil, the plush of green clovers, and the cold chill of a gurgling stream. You walk with the ease of those who were born of the forest.

items.flavor_text_en: "Leto didn't believe in hiding to survive. He knew the only way to get answers was to face the Root head-on, even if it meant confronting them with force."

items.description_en: Strong yet streamlined. Practical yet aesthetic. Although you can’t expect to make a quick getaway in these, they’re just what you need to stand strong against the looming threat of destruction. The care and attention to detail that went into them is something to behold.
items.flavor_text_en: “Like a firefighter running towards the flame, scientists don’t run from an impossible problem. They face it head on, even at the risk of life and limb. They’ll never back down until they’ve achieved the understanding they seek, ‘cause for folks like them, that’s the ultimate victory.”

description.zh: 耐用的流线型设计，造型实用且美观。尽管这条裤子不能让你跑得更快，但穿上它抵御迫近中的威胁再合适不过了。这条裤子做工之精细令人赞叹。

items.name: Armor_Legs_Radiant
items.description_en: Gleaming golden plates overlap and protect the wearer's feet and shins. Originally designed to be worn by the Pan, it's impressive how the armor can be adapted to fit human proportions without sacrificing its durability or protective properties.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan give credit to the Thaen Tree for their continued existence, but it's the arcane magic of the Ahanae that really helps them crush their enemies in the end."

items.name: Armor_Legs_Ritualist
items.description_en: Tall wading boots and toughened leather may protect your legs from the unruly waters of Losomn, but they will do nothing to guard against the treacherous creatures that lurk just beneath those sullied waves, thirsting for the blood of those who stray too far from shore.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Dran live their menial lives at the sea’s behest, tromping through dank sewers and damp docks like the vermin they are. To walk a mile in their dismal shoes is more than enough to demonstrate the good fortune there is in being born a Fae...though I daresay only a few steps would have sufficed.”

description.zh: 高筒涉水靴和坚韧的皮革或许能阻隔洛斯曼汹涌的海水，但无法抵御那些潜伏在肮脏海浪之下的危险生物——它们对内陆人的鲜血如饥似渴。

To walk a mile in their dismal shoes is more than enough to demonstrate the good fortune there is in being born a Fae...though I daresay only a few steps would have sufficed.”
flavor.zh: “德兰人在大海的召唤下过着卑微的生活，像害虫一样在潮湿的下水道和码头上蠕动。穿着德兰人的破鞋走上一里地，就足以证明生为翡族的幸运了……我敢说，只要走上几步其实就足够了。”

items.description_en: The magnets in the boots are far stronger than those in the gloves. It's unclear how they know when to activate, but they do so on their own. Massive as N'Erud is, it must not provide enough gravity to ensure its workers remain attached to it.
items.flavor_text_en: "Despite being seen as the least of all Drzyr, great care was taken to protect and preserve the Ofildi. A lifeform's utility does not determine its worth. Life itself does that."

items.name: Armor_Legs_Void
items.description_en: A sturdy pair of footwear, expertly crafted from the same unknown material as the other Void armor pieces. Their angular design and jagged edges give their wearer an intimidating and fearsome look. But these boots are more than just a fashion statement—they provided unparalleled protection and stability in the treacherous environments of Rhom.
items.flavor_text_en: “Every time I look at these boots, I'm reminded of the horrors I faced on Rhom. I wouldn't dare set foot on that planet again, not even with these boots on. They may look like they were pulled straight from a nightmare, but the memories they bring back are too real."

description.en: A sturdy pair of footwear, expertly crafted from the same unknown material as the other Void armor pieces. Their angular design and jagged edges give their wearer an intimidating and fearsome look. But these boots are more than just a fashion statement—they provided unparalleled protection and stability in the treacherous environments of Rhom.
description.zh: 一双结实的靴子，制作工艺高超，使用和其他虚空护甲一样的神秘材料，棱角分明，边缘带有锋利锯齿，令人见之魂飞魄散。不过这双靴子的实际防护能力和稳定性无以比肩，能帮助使用者轻松穿越危险四伏的洛姆，因此并不是光用来炫耀、吓人的。

flavor.en: “Every time I look at these boots, I'm reminded of the horrors I faced on Rhom. I wouldn't dare set foot on that planet again, not even with these boots on. They may look like they were pulled straight from a nightmare, but the memories they bring back are too real."
flavor.zh: “每次看到这双靴子，我都会想起曾经面对的噩梦般的恐惧。哪怕穿着这双靴子，我也不敢再踏上那颗星球半步。它们看上去好像刚从噩梦中逃出生天，但它们带来的回忆太过真实。”

items.description_en: These boots end in a foot with three long toes, which help augment the wearer’s balance and flexibility, allowing them to navigate complex and unforeseen environments.
items.flavor_text_en: "Maxim Lar’Veli, the People’s Seeker, was nominated to the Convocation despite his relatively low status within House Al’Maruun due to his earnest nature and passionate dedication to his people. He elected himself to stay awake alongside the Seeker Primis while the rest of the Drzyr entered cryostasis. For that short while, Precept Surus and I were his only confidants."

items.name: Consumable_AllSeeingEye
items.description_en:
It's looking at you, but that's not what bothers you about it. It sees the future somehow, but that doesn't bother you either. What bothers you is this question you've been asking yourself since she gave it to you.

Who did this eye belong to?
items.flavor_text_en:
"Folks are always asking me if their future can be changed. Of course it can, dear—that's why you came to me in the first place. The future's just the present stretched and unraveled.

The question isn't can you change it, but will you?"

description.en:
It's looking at you, but that's not what bothers you about it. It sees the future somehow, but that doesn't bother you either. What bothers you is this question you've been asking yourself since she gave it to you.

Who did this eye belong to?
description.zh:
它在看着你，但困扰你的并不是这点。它似乎能看到未来，但这也并未让你介怀。真正折磨你的是一个问题——自从她把它给你之后，你就一直在问自己的问题：

这只眼睛到底属于谁？

你该问的不是未来能否被改变，而是自己是否愿意改变。”

items.name: Consumable_AmmoBox
items.description_en: A sturdy metal container filled to the brim with a variety of ammunition types for all your weapons. It's the perfect solution for those running low on ammo during a heated battle. With just a simple click, the lid pops open, revealing neatly arranged rounds that are ready to be loaded into your weapons.
items.flavor_text_en: "After the Root arrived, ammunition was abundant, yet it wasn't enough to combat the dangers that lurked around every corner. Nowadays, we scavenge for every last bullet we can find, making an ammo box a true lifesaver in the fight for survival."

items.flavor_text_en: "Personally, I can't fathom why anyone would willingly ingest the Root, but there must be something to it if people are actually willing to do it."

items.description_en: The Drzyr used orbs like these to corral the animals they kept for food and biodiversity. The orb works just as well on intelligent targets.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Although N'Erud is mostly machine—and now but a tomb—it once contained remarkable beauty. Gardens, parks, wildlife preserves... everything a world needs to be a world.

It breaks my hearts to think of all that Alepsis-Taura took from us."

“虽然涅鲁德的绝大部分都是机械——当然了，现在已经成了坟墓——但它曾蕴含着无与伦比的美。花园、公园、野生保护区……它有组成世界所需的一切。

一想到阿莱普西斯-陶拉从我们手中夺走的东西，我的心都要碎了。”

items.flavor_text_en: “There’s one thing all manner of Dran, critter, and monster share a fright of, and that thing is flame. My sweet Dran have learned to use it to their advantage, even before the creatures came. Oh, I sometimes wish they hadn’t, seeing what with where it got them.”

items.name: Consumable_BottledShaedberry
items.description_en:
Fae tradition is to drink Shaedberry wine for strength before a battle. It's also traditional after the battle to celebrate a victory or nurse a defeat.

Some believe these traditions have nothing to do with battle at all. The Fae drink to this belief too.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Shaedberry, fruit of shadows, harvest of darkness. The berry will not grow in the sun, and its flavor wanes in the light. Its nourishment comes from some other source, and it blesses those who consume it with the same."

description.en:
Fae tradition is to drink Shaedberry wine for strength before a battle. It's also traditional after the battle to celebrate a victory or nurse a defeat.

Some believe these traditions have nothing to do with battle at all. The Fae drink to this belief too.
description.zh:
按照传统，翡族人会在战斗前饮用刹邸莓酒以增强力量，也会在战斗后饮用此酒以庆祝胜利或哀悼失败。

有人认为这种传统根本与战斗毫无关系。翡族人听到这种说法也会饮酒致敬。

items.name: Consumable_DransDream
items.description_en: It feels as though the soothing glow within this thing is calling to you, whispering of a dream yet unrealized and an escape from the cold grip of reality. You’ve seen far too many inexplicable things in your day, yet the lure of this dreamer’s promise is too much to resist.
items.flavor_text_en: “It is utterly absurd to believe farfetched tales about an object that can whisk one away to an ethereal coast wholly separate from reality! Who is capable of conjuring such a thing, and to what end? For what toll? Questions like these leave a foul taste in my mouth, and yet...I find it difficult to lay aside my fascination with the thought of possessing such a rare treasure.”

description.en: It feels as though the soothing glow within this thing is calling to you, whispering of a dream yet unrealized and an escape from the cold grip of reality. You’ve seen far too many inexplicable things in your day, yet the lure of this dreamer’s promise is too much to resist.
description.zh: 它散发着的舒缓光芒，仿佛在呼唤你，低声诉说着一个尚未实现的梦，以及一个逃离现实冰冷束缚的出口。你已经见过了太多无法解释的事情，然而这位梦游者的诱惑却让你无法抗拒。

items.description_raw: Carved from otherworldly crystals, its faint glow reminds you of silent lightning hidden beneath distant storm clouds.

items.name: Consumable_FaerieNeedle
items.description_en: This needle has been dipped in a smooth, vivid liquid that reminds you of lacquer. The Fae use it to imbue magic into ribbons, dolls, even clothing.
items.flavor_text_en: "Fae magic suffuses every part of our being, from our skin to our hair to the blood that runs within our veins. It is a part of us as we are a part of our world—the magic of chaos and creation. So it is true that there is no god but ourselves."

flavor.en: "Fae magic suffuses every part of our being, from our skin to our hair to the blood that runs within our veins. It is a part of us as we are a part of our world—the magic of chaos and creation. So it is true that there is no god but ourselves."
flavor.zh: “翡族的魔法充斥着我们身体的各个角落，从皮肤、头发到流动的鲜血。它是我们的一部分，就像我们是这个世界的一部分——混沌和创造的魔法。因此，这里没有神祇，除了我们自己。”

items.description_en: The needle is large and crude, meant for something far more sizeable and thick-skinned than you. It’s sticky to the touch and reeks of a foul-smelling medicine, as if it was left to soak overnight—and promptly forgotten.
items.flavor_text_en: "For years, the Gul were made to feel lesser than the Nobility. If it is their nature to be less, then ingenuity must make them more."

items.description_en: The sphere emits a soft breeze that smells of flowers and ash. You can't explain why, but you feel like it's watching you. Waiting.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Huntress rarely sleeps and does so only lightly. She is ever aware of her environment. Those who think to have caught her off guard are themselves in the most danger."

items.name: Consumable_LightExtract
items.description_en: A container of pure, pulsating light. It’s reinvigorating, but there’s something more to it. Though it burns your eyes, it somehow also manages to fill you with renewed hope, no matter how dark the situation may be.
items.flavor_text_en: “The very genesis of the Drzyr’s long journey was the fear and despair born of the knowledge that their host star would one day burn out, extinguishing all life and hope along with it. It could be considered poetic that fearing the loss of light is what led the Drzyr to ultimate darkness.”

description.zh: 一个容器，里面盛满了纯净而脉动着的光芒。它能让人重振精神，但显然其作用不止于此。尽管会灼伤你的双目，但无论情况多么绝望，它总能设法让你充满新的希望。

flavor.en: “The very genesis of the Drzyr’s long journey was the fear and despair born of the knowledge that their host star would one day burn out, extinguishing all life and hope along with it. It could be considered poetic that fearing the loss of light is what led the Drzyr to ultimate darkness.”
flavor.zh: “对自己母星在某天会燃烧殆尽、并摧毁所有生命与希望的恐惧与绝望，是泽厄尔人漫长旅程的起源。可以说，正是出于对失去光明的恐惧，才导致了泽厄尔人走向终极的黑暗。”

items.name: Consumable_LiquidEscape
items.description_en: A mysterious, murky liquid substance that resembles something scraped from the bottom of a fetid sewer. It's not the most glamorous way to travel, but when you're in a tight spot and need a quick escape, it can be a real lifesaver.
items.flavor_text_en: "I don't understand why some folks rely on Liquid Escape. It's like admitting defeat before even trying. Sure, it might save your life, but what's the point if you don't even get to experience the thrill of the fight?"

items.name: Consumable_MeatShake
items.description_en: You don’t know what kind of unholy concoction this is that Duane whipped up, but one whiff of it is enough knock even the most hardened adventurer off their feet. If nightmares had a smell, this would be it.
items.flavor_text_en: “Sometimes the meat muses just speak to you, and then boom, outta nowhere you’ve got a whole new kind of food no one’s ever even heard of! I don’t mean to brag or anything, but not just anyone has that kinda gift. Just...don’t tell Alice about my meat muses, promise?”

items.name: Consumable_MudRub
items.description_en: A thick and gritty ointment made from a mixture of mud, herbs, and other natural ingredients. It is primarily used as a remedy for burns, as its cooling properties help to soothe and heal damaged skin. In addition, it also provides a protective layer over the skin that makes it more resistant to the harmful effects of fire.
items.flavor_text_en: "Look, I know it’s not the most pleasant thing to slather yourself in mud like some kind of swamp monster, but trust me, it's better than the alternative of being burned to a crisp. And hey, if it makes you feel any better, at least you'll smell like earth instead of charred flesh."

description.en: A thick and gritty ointment made from a mixture of mud, herbs, and other natural ingredients. It is primarily used as a remedy for burns, as its cooling properties help to soothe and heal damaged skin. In addition, it also provides a protective layer over the skin that makes it more resistant to the harmful effects of fire.
description.zh: 一种粘稠的磨砂质地药膏，由泥浆和草药等天然成分混合制成。它的清凉特性有助于舒缓和治愈受损的皮肤，因此主要用于治疗烧伤。此外，它还能在皮肤上形成一层保护层，能够抵御火焰的伤害。

flavor.en: "Look, I know it’s not the most pleasant thing to slather yourself in mud like some kind of swamp monster, but trust me, it's better than the alternative of being burned to a crisp. And hey, if it makes you feel any better, at least you'll smell like earth instead of charred flesh."
flavor.zh: “听着，我知道像沼泽怪物一样把自己浑身上下涂满泥巴肯定很难受，但是相信我，这比被烧焦可舒服多了。你猜怎么着？至少你闻起来像泥土，而不是焦糊的肉。这有没有让你好受些？”

items.name: Consumable_MudToothsStew
items.description_en: This stew's appearance is quite opaque, with a thick and brown texture that keeps its contents a mystery. However, the potent medicinal scent emanating from it suggests that it's no ordinary stew.
items.flavor_text_en: “Sit down now and let me tell ya somethin'. I got tales to spin and stew to serve, and this ain't no ordinary stew mind ya. I reckon the recipe for this here concoction came to me in a vision, or was it a dream? Either way, it's a mighty powerful palate pleaser!"

description.zh: 这种炖汤呈现出不透明的棕色，质地浓稠，根本看不出里面有什么材料。但从中散发出的浓重药味说明这绝不是普通的炖汤。

items.flavor_text_en: "Listen up, Traveler. If you're lookin' for a drink that'll put a spring in your step and strip the paint off a barn door, you've struck gold with this one. Ain't nothin' finer out here in these parts."

items.description_en: Jerky made from meat of unknown origin. It’s tough as leather and smells...interesting, to say the least. Still, tough times call for tough stomachs, so you can’t afford to turn your nose up at something that is almost certainly edible.
items.flavor_text_en: “Turning whatever you can scrounge up into somethin’ tasty is kind of an art, ya know? The pot is my canvas and the meat is my paint. Just sit back and watch the master at work!”

items.name: Consumable_NimuesDream
items.description_en: An alto hum emanates from the sphere, rising and falling seemingly at random in a peaceful, unrepeated melody.
items.flavor_text_en: "Fae dreams are no mere subconscious hallucinations. They exist in a world all their own, full of joys and delights, fears and sorrows. There are those lacking in self-discipline who struggle to escape the lure of another life, those who remain sleeping even now."

items.flavor_text_en: "Some recipes take a lot of experimenting. Lots of trial and error and all that. But other recipes just make themselves. it’s like they want to be born, and I’m just the chef vessel!"

items.description_en: A thick, sweet-smelling salve meant for fur. Its scent has a deep, earthy base—its essential ingredients plucked fresh from the jungle floor. At least... it was fresh at some point.
items.flavor_text_en: "Vestigial memories of the plague endure to this day. A Pan must always keep his fur clean and well-groomed during war, for when blood spills freely and wounds fester beneath every robe, a clean Pan is as unsullied as the One of Many."

items.description_en: The strange white orb glows with an ethereal light that seems to emanate from deep within. Looking too long at the orb causes a strange sensation, like memories slipping away, leaving you with a feeling of unease and uncertainty.

items.name: Consumable_PipeBomb
items.description_en: A deadly explosive device made from scrap materials. When detonated, it creates a vicious explosion that sprays shrapnel in all directions, causing widespread damage to anything caught in its blast radius. In addition to its explosive power, the bomb's shrapnel is coated in a corrosive agent that causes deep lacerations, resulting in severe bleeding.

items.description_en: The Custodian said this would weaken Tal'Ratha if ingested. It looks no different from the ember found elsewhere in this strange place, which is, of course, the point.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The Custodian was designed as a caretaker, a created mind to handle billions of tasks we could not, or did not wish to, handle ourselves. Without the Custodian, N'Erud could no longer function.

Yet without oversight, the Custodian's functioning comes into question as well."

items.name: Consumable_RocketFuel
items.description_en: The contents of the syringe shimmer like liquid gold, emanating a faint hum that seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy. As the needle pierces your skin, a burst of warmth spreads through your veins, quickening your pulse and sharpening your reflexes. Your shots fly faster and truer, and your strikes connect with a satisfyingly swift and deadly precision.
items.flavor_text_en: "Sure, this may give you a quick burst of speed and power, but relying on it alone is a recipe for disaster. Success requires a long-term plan, taking into account strengths, weaknesses, hard work, and dedication. This may give you a temporary edge, but its impact ultimately depends on how it's used."

description.zh: 注射器中的液体像黄金一样闪闪发光，并发出微弱的嗡鸣声，似乎脉动着异世界的能量。当针尖刺入皮肤，会感到一阵温暖在血管中蔓延，令人脉搏加速，反应更加敏锐。你的射击会变得更快更扎实，以震撼人心的攻速和致命的精度展开打击。

flavor.en: "Sure, this may give you a quick burst of speed and power, but relying on it alone is a recipe for disaster. Success requires a long-term plan, taking into account strengths, weaknesses, hard work, and dedication. This may give you a temporary edge, but its impact ultimately depends on how it's used."
flavor.zh: “当然，它能让你的速度和力量快速爆发，但如果你完全依赖它，就会为你种下祸根。成功需要长期的计划，需要考虑到优势和劣势，需要努力和专注。虽然它能带给你短暂的提升，但最终结果还是要取决于你如何使用它。”

Your shots fly faster and truer, and your strikes connect with a satisfyingly swift and deadly precision.

items.name: Consumable_Spice
items.description_en:
The Astropaths call this "ambit ember." When consumed, it opens their senses to a kind of current in space, spectral energies that—they claim—lead to and originate from a single point of origin.

Alepsis-Taura.
items.flavor_text_en: "The ember is a gift. The raw plant from which it is processed could be found only on our homeworld. The Seekers considered this to be further proof that our creator designed us to explore—that it wanted us to find it."

description.en:

Alepsis-Taura.
description.zh:
星语者称之为“灵烬”。服用后可以打开感官，使你能感知到一种隐秘空间能量流，他们声称这种能量来自并指向同一源点——

阿莱普西斯-陶拉。

flavor.en: "The ember is a gift. The raw plant from which it is processed could be found only on our homeworld. The Seekers considered this to be further proof that our creator designed us to explore—that it wanted us to find it."

items.name: Consumable_StrongDrink
items.description_en: A dark amber liquid fills the bottle, swirling with hints of gold and brown. With each gulp, you feel invigorated, as though you can take on the world. Your muscles tense, and you feel a newfound strength in your limbs.
items.flavor_text_en: "Drinking this is like taking a load off your shoulders, both mentally and physically. It's like lifting the weight of the world from your mind and replacing it with a warm, comforting buzz. But you can't deny that once the drink wears off, the physical weight comes crashing back down on you, heavier than before."

items.name: Consumable_SweetLeaf
items.description_en: Apparently, this little leaf is a delicacy from the jungles of Yaesha. If you rub it between your fingers, it gives off a sweet scent that is admittedly captivating. This would be just the thing to add a luxurious touch to a special recipe.
items.flavor_text_en: “Ah, yes, only the best for friendly paxulteks of refined taste! It is most difficult to grow this fine treat in our harsh jungles, and so few Pan have ever tasted of its splendor, much less a hornless creature. Yet even an item of such rarity and value can be procured by those with a heart of determination.”

items.name: Mod_Bore
items.description_en: The spikes launched from this weapon are alive... sort of. They drill into their target, leeching life and creating a kind of open wound.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Even on our homeworld—or, I suppose, only on our homeworld—life took on a myriad of forms, everything from single-minded cells to expansive behemoths.

It is statistically improbable that life never occurred elsewhere in this vast universe. The fact that it didn't proved, to the Seekers at least, that we were intentionally created beings."

"Even on our homeworld—or, I suppose, only on our homeworld—life took on a myriad of forms, everything from single-minded cells to expansive behemoths.

“即便在我们的母星上——或者说，大概只有在我们的母星上，生命有许许多多的存在形式，从单细胞生物，到体型庞大的巨怪，凡此种种，不一而足。

items.name: Mod_PrismaticDriver
items.description_en: The power from this beam is so focused that it lingers in place, consolidating and condensing until the excess energy is released in a single, violent reaction.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Energy fuels life and can also take it. It can be absorbed, delayed, transferred, converted, even detonated. One must focus energy to become its master.

Animals serve the energies that drive them, but Drzyr bend energy to serve ourselves."

description.en: The power from this beam is so focused that it lingers in place, consolidating and condensing until the excess energy is released in a single, violent reaction.
description.zh: 光束能量极为集中，能暂时汇聚一处，不断强化，凝聚，直至无法容纳更多能量，继而产生一次剧烈的反应。

flavor.en:
"Energy fuels life and can also take it. It can be absorbed, delayed, transferred, converted, even detonated. One must focus energy to become its master.

Animals serve the energies that drive them, but Drzyr bend energy to serve ourselves."
flavor.zh:
“生，是能量的注入；死，是能量的消散。能量可以被吸收、被延迟、被转化——甚至被引爆。只有汇聚能量，才能成为它的主人。

动物受能量的驱使浑浑噩噩，而泽厄尔人能掌控能量，为己所用。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_BloodlessHeart
items.description_en: This mummified heart last beat long, long ago. Underneath its cracked sarcophagus of a shell, the organ itself is only marginally singed, as the damning proof of its existence could never be fully concealed by the guilty, no matter how viciously they tried.
items.flavor_text_en: "If King Thalos had not resisted his capture, I am certain the priests would not have harmed him. But he was under Lydusa’s curse! He was not of a sound mind—there was no other way. What a horrible, dishonorable death for such a brave, beloved king. Lydusa took everything from Thalos...even his legacy."

description.en: This mummified heart last beat long, long ago. Underneath its cracked sarcophagus of a shell, the organ itself is only marginally singed, as the damning proof of its existence could never be fully concealed by the guilty, no matter how viciously they tried.
description.zh: 这颗木乃伊化的心脏早在很久以前就停止了跳动。在其仿若开裂石棺一般的外壳下，心脏本体只被轻微灼伤。因为无论有罪者如何穷凶极恶地试图掩盖，如山铁证永远不可能被完全隐藏。

flavor.en: "If King Thalos had not resisted his capture, I am certain the priests would not have harmed him. But he was under Lydusa’s curse! He was not of a sound mind—there was no other way. What a horrible, dishonorable death for such a brave, beloved king. Lydusa took everything from Thalos...even his legacy."
flavor.zh: “如果萨洛斯王没有在被捕时反抗，我相信祭司们一定不会伤害他。但他已经被莉杜莎诅咒了！他已经失去了理智——我们别无选择。对于一位勇敢而深受爱戴的国王来说，这是一种多么可怕而不光彩的死法啊。莉杜莎夺走了萨洛斯的一切……甚至包括他的遗产。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_BloomingHeart
items.description_en: The petals and leaves are as thick as muscle, but life beats within—a sweet scent emanating from it like breath.
items.flavor_text_en: "In the first twilight of her years, when she had become an old crone, the Red Widow Jinas had a vision of the Thaen calling to her. She left to find it. After twenty years of searching, of the five hundred Pan who left with her only fifty returned. They were young, healthy, and strong. These fifty, including Jinas herself, became the Immortals, and all of Pan society changed with them."

description.en: The petals and leaves are as thick as muscle, but life beats within—a sweet scent emanating from it like breath.
description.zh: 花瓣和叶子像肌肉一样厚实，生命在其中跳动——甜美的香味像呼吸一样从它身上散发出来。

flavor.en: "In the first twilight of her years, when she had become an old crone, the Red Widow Jinas had a vision of the Thaen calling to her. She left to find it. After twenty years of searching, of the five hundred Pan who left with her only fifty returned. They were young, healthy, and strong. These fifty, including Jinas herself, became the Immortals, and all of Pan society changed with them."
flavor.zh: “红寡妇吉娜斯成为老妪，病重垂危之时，在幻象中看到塞恩向她招手，便带着五百潘恩应唤而去。经过二十年的苦苦搜寻，只有五十人回归故里。但时光的流逝似乎并未影响这五十个潘恩，他们依旧年轻健壮，同吉娜斯一样成了不朽者，而整个潘恩社会也因此发生了改变。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_BrokenHeart
items.description_en: A once tranquil heart, now withered by the ravages of vengeance. Your own heart is stabbed with pangs of guilt when you look at it, but you know you did what must be done, and so you’ll deal with that feeling and reap your ill-gotten reward all the same.
items.flavor_text_en: “For those who have the stomach for it, there is no force more powerful than that of a shattered spirit or broken heart. Pure, unadulterated agony such as that can be manipulated, harvested, and repurposed to whatever end you please. Not that I have firsthand knowledge of such practices, of course...”

description.en: A once tranquil heart, now withered by the ravages of vengeance. Your own heart is stabbed with pangs of guilt when you look at it, but you know you did what must be done, and so you’ll deal with that feeling and reap your ill-gotten reward all the same.
description.zh: 那颗曾经平静的心，早已因复仇的摧残而枯萎。看向它时，你的内心会被负罪感刺痛，但你知道这是不得不做的事，所以你压下了这种感觉，也收下了不义之财。

flavor.en: “For those who have the stomach for it, there is no force more powerful than that of a shattered spirit or broken heart. Pure, unadulterated agony such as that can be manipulated, harvested, and repurposed to whatever end you please. Not that I have firsthand knowledge of such practices, of course...”
flavor.zh: “对于那些有胆量的人来说，没有比破碎的心和灵魂更强大的力量。纯粹、毫无杂质的痛苦可以被操纵、收割和重新利用，以满足你的任何目的。当然，我没有亲身经历过这种做法……”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_ConstrainedHeart
items.description_en:
Crudely wired in an effort to restrict the heart's power—to slow it down, stretch it out, make it last.

Surprisingly, it works.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Scientists being what they are, they weren't content to study the shit we found out there. They had to understand it, change it, improve it.

The military being what it is, they always allowed it...provided the results were useful to them."

description.en:
Crudely wired in an effort to restrict the heart's power—to slow it down, stretch it out, make it last.

Surprisingly, it works.
description.zh:
非常粗鲁地试图限制心脏的力量——让它慢下来，伸展开来，持续更久。

令人惊讶的是，居然有效。

flavor.en:
"Scientists being what they are, they weren't content to study the shit we found out there. They had to understand it, change it, improve it.

The military being what it is, they always allowed it...provided the results were useful to them."
flavor.zh:
“科学家就是这样，对我们在外太空发现的东西，不会满足于单纯的研究，他们得吃透它，改变它，升级它。

军方就是这样，只要研究结果对他们有用，他们就会同意。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_CrystalHeart
items.description_en: Residue from the star at N'Erud's center retains a variety of properties that the Drzyr used to full effect. This device, for example, speeds the natural healing process, drawing energy from other processes to do so.
items.flavor_text_en: "We fashioned N'Erud's star after that of our homeworld, and so we have always carried a piece of home wherever we go. It has been so long now that even I no longer remember the differences. The star of N'Erud is the only sun we require."

description.en: Residue from the star at N'Erud's center retains a variety of properties that the Drzyr used to full effect. This device, for example, speeds the natural healing process, drawing energy from other processes to do so.
description.zh: 涅鲁德中央恒星的遗留物，具有各种特性，曾为泽厄尔人完全开发。例如，这架设备就能汲取其他机能中的能量，加快自然愈伤速度。

flavor.en: "We fashioned N'Erud's star after that of our homeworld, and so we have always carried a piece of home wherever we go. It has been so long now that even I no longer remember the differences. The star of N'Erud is the only sun we require."
flavor.zh: “我们以家园的恒星为蓝本打造了涅鲁德之星，所以无论走到哪里，我们都会带着家的一部分。时间已经过去太久，我甚至已经记不清它们的区别。涅鲁德之星就是我们唯一需要的太阳。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_DecayedHeart
items.description_en: A heart as dead as this world, yet not wholly dead. It is, perhaps, a hint of what the inhabitants of this place created in the Root, for it desires and rewards annihilation.
items.flavor_text_en:
"My desire for elucidation caused history to repeat. There was a moment in which the people of the Core could have prevented their corruption from spreading—when they foresaw what might occur and could have ended it.

They chose to preserve their corruption, for the same reason I preserved their world."

description.en: A heart as dead as this world, yet not wholly dead. It is, perhaps, a hint of what the inhabitants of this place created in the Root, for it desires and rewards annihilation.
description.zh: 这颗心脏与这个世界一样死气沉沉，但又尚未真正死去。也许它就是此地居民于根蔓之中创造的暗示，因为它渴望并奖赏湮没。

flavor.en:
"My desire for elucidation caused history to repeat. There was a moment in which the people of the Core could have prevented their corruption from spreading—when they foresaw what might occur and could have ended it.

They chose to preserve their corruption, for the same reason I preserved their world."
flavor.zh:
“我对澄清的渴望导致了历史的重演。当时，核心区的人们预见到了未来可能的走向，而且尚有机会终结腐坏，阻止扩散。

但他们选择维护腐坏，而我也是出于同样的原因，选择维护他们的世界。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_DivertingHeart
items.description_en: A variety of tubes, injectors, and plugs have been grafted on to this thing to see if its healing energies could be used for something else. I mean, what if you're perfectly healthy, but you're just tired?
items.flavor_text_en:
“’We split the atom!’ they said. ‘We're about to put a man on the moon!’ they said. As if any of that gave us license to do the shit we did. Just 'cause you can doesn't mean you should.

I wish I'd said so back then. Even once.”

description.en: A variety of tubes, injectors, and plugs have been grafted on to this thing to see if its healing energies could be used for something else. I mean, what if you're perfectly healthy, but you're just tired?
description.zh: 为了测试其治愈能量是否可以用于其他方面，于是嫁接了很多管子、注射器和插头上去。我想说，万一你其实很健康只是有点累了呢？

flavor.en:
“’We split the atom!’ they said. ‘We're about to put a man on the moon!’ they said. As if any of that gave us license to do the shit we did. Just 'cause you can doesn't mean you should.

I wish I'd said so back then. Even once.”
flavor.zh:
“‘我们分裂了原子！’他们说。‘我们即将把人类送上月球！’他们说。就好像这给了我们干那些烂事儿的许可似的。真正的强大是有所不为。

真希望我当时说过这话。哪怕一次也好啊。”

items.description_en: It looks swollen, distended. Pus oozes from foul-smelling cysts. Whatever they did to this thing, it was effective—and gross.
items.flavor_text_en: "Some of our scientists... I'm glad I don't know all of what they did. Hell, I wish I didn't know as much as I do. The United States government required me to do a lot of things I ain't proud of, but I got the feeling some of them scientists didn't feel as bad about things as I did."

flavor.en: "Some of our scientists... I'm glad I don't know all of what they did. Hell, I wish I didn't know as much as I do. The United States government required me to do a lot of things I ain't proud of, but I got the feeling some of them scientists didn't feel as bad about things as I did."
flavor.zh: “我们的一些科学家……只能说我不了解他们的全部研究真是幸事。该死，我知道的已经太多了。在美国政府的要求下，我做了许多连自己都感到羞愧的事，但我觉得很多科学家做那些事完全是出于自愿。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_GossamerHeart
items.description_en: A surprisingly sturdy, translucent membrane protects the precious inner flesh, which is lined with mycotic gills. Beneath that, a dense network of mycelium keeps this mass alive—if it truly is alive.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr do not prioritize non-necessities such as delectability. Most flavors become tasteless to Drzyr palates after countless cycles of consumption on account of their long life spans, so little merit was put into the taste of N’Erud’s crops."

description.en: A surprisingly sturdy, translucent membrane protects the precious inner flesh, which is lined with mycotic gills. Beneath that, a dense network of mycelium keeps this mass alive—if it truly is alive.
description.zh: 一层异常坚固的半透明膜保护着宝贵的内层肉质。肉质部布满了菌褶，其下是维持这团物质生命的密集菌丝网络——如果它真的有生命的话。

flavor.en: "The Drzyr do not prioritize non-necessities such as delectability. Most flavors become tasteless to Drzyr palates after countless cycles of consumption on account of their long life spans, so little merit was put into the taste of N’Erud’s crops."
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人并不看重非必需的品质，比如‘美味’。泽厄尔人在漫长的生命中吃过无数的食物，大多数口味对他们来说都没有区别，因此涅鲁德农作物的味道并不受重视。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_LatentHeart
items.description_en: The core at the center of this metal apparatus glows faintly, desperately trying to power whatever device it once belonged to, as if its small beacon of stellar light could reactivate all of N’Erud.
items.flavor_text_en: "Precept Surus was the Seeker Primis at the time of N’Erud’s jump. His shoulders bore the weight of the entirety of his species’ future; it was his decisions that would save or doom his people. We shared many in-depth conversations together, and of all the Drzyr, the loss of his presence...affected me the most."

description.zh: 这件金属装置的核心散发着微弱的光芒，绝望地试图给曾经拥有它的任何设备供能，仿佛它的小灯塔能够激活整个涅鲁德。

flavor.en: "Precept Surus was the Seeker Primis at the time of N’Erud’s jump. His shoulders bore the weight of the entirety of his species’ future; it was his decisions that would save or doom his people. We shared many in-depth conversations together, and of all the Drzyr, the loss of his presence...affected me the most."
flavor.zh: “戒律者苏鲁司是涅鲁德跃迁时的首席追寻者。他肩负着整个种族的未来，他的决定将拯救或毁灭他的人民。我们进行了许多次深入交谈，在所有泽厄尔人中，他的离去……对我的影响最大。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_LifelessHeart
items.description_en: Though cold as stone, a faint tremor can be felt within—the barest whisper of a heart that will not, perhaps cannot, die.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The Thaen cannot die, for it is the lifeblood of the Pan and perhaps Yaesha itself. When the impossible came to pass, some believed it to be the end of the world. Others believed the Thaen could not, therefore, be as singular as was previously thought.

As of yet, neither faith has been proven wrong."

description.en: Though cold as stone, a faint tremor can be felt within—the barest whisper of a heart that will not, perhaps cannot, die.
description.zh: 虽然冰冷如石，但其中却传来若有似无的震颤——一颗不会也不能枯萎的心脏那最微弱的低语。

flavor.en:
"The Thaen cannot die, for it is the lifeblood of the Pan and perhaps Yaesha itself. When the impossible came to pass, some believed it to be the end of the world. Others believed the Thaen could not, therefore, be as singular as was previously thought.

As of yet, neither faith has been proven wrong."
flavor.zh:
“塞恩是潘恩和耶莎之血，永生不死。但当塞恩枯萎时，有些人认为世界已迎来终结之日，有的人则三观崩塌，认为塞恩并没有以前认为的那么伟大。

究竟哪一种看法正确？迄今没有定论。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_PaperHeart
items.description_en: The fragile contraption appears to be hollow on the inside. For every lurid secret and hushed confession scrawled on its outside, the only thing at its center is the simple, empty joy of knowing.
items.flavor_text_en: “I once served as an archivist in the royal library. There I was most content, lost in the forbidden tomes and secrets of eld... Including those the king dared not reveal to the Fae. Such was my misfortunate undoing as an archivist, and my beginning as his scribe.”

description.en: The fragile contraption appears to be hollow on the inside. For every lurid secret and hushed confession scrawled on its outside, the only thing at its center is the simple, empty joy of knowing.
description.zh: 此脆弱装置的内部似乎是中空的。表面那些耸人听闻的秘密和匆忙的忏悔之下，其核心却是知晓这些消息时获得的简单而空洞的快乐。

flavor.en: “I once served as an archivist in the royal library. There I was most content, lost in the forbidden tomes and secrets of eld... Including those the king dared not reveal to the Fae. Such was my misfortunate undoing as an archivist, and my beginning as his scribe.”
flavor.zh: “我在皇家图书馆担任过档案管理员。期间我最乐在其中的就是阅读禁忌典籍和古老秘密……包括真皇不敢向翡族透露的秘密。就是我作为档案管理员的不幸结局，也是我成为他抄写员的序章。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_ProfaneHeart
items.description_en: A large crystal of Pan origin, now swallowed by Root tendrils, casting it in the design of a much more sinister foe. It once served as the heart of a great statue, but whatever passion and honor it once bore has long since been smothered.
items.flavor_text_en: "Greed. Misery. Wrath. Meritless sentimentalities that have rendered countless empires to dust. The fragile inadequacies of the living are but tools to serve my design."

description.en: A large crystal of Pan origin, now swallowed by Root tendrils, casting it in the design of a much more sinister foe. It once served as the heart of a great statue, but whatever passion and honor it once bore has long since been smothered.
description.zh: 一枚原属于潘恩一族的巨大水晶，如今已被根蔓的卷须吞噬，成为了更为不祥的敌人。它曾是一座伟大雕像的心脏，但如今，曾经满溢的激情与荣耀早已被扼杀殆尽。

items.name: Relic_Consumable_PulsingHeart
items.description_en: It beats with an eerie steadiness that somehow soothes those in your vicinity. The latent power coursing through its pulsing veins is palpable.
items.flavor_text_en: "It was Jinas's ruling and firm belief that the fruits of power belonged to the chosen few. For in her merciless jungles, what could be more foolish than wasting the sweet nectar of prolonged life on the unsanctified rabble?”

flavor.en: "It was Jinas's ruling and firm belief that the fruits of power belonged to the chosen few. For in her merciless jungles, what could be more foolish than wasting the sweet nectar of prolonged life on the unsanctified rabble?”

items.description_en: The heart still beats...and bleeds. The fabric it is swaddled in does not soak up as much as one might hope.
items.flavor_text_en: "There is comfort in haste, in acting without forethought. It removes the heavy burden of what might be and allows one to focus only on what is."

items.flavor_text_en: "Before, the Labyrinth was protected by a Guardian. When that Guardian fell to the Destroyer, the corruption saw opportunity—and seized it."

description.zh: 这颗密实、沉重的心脏原本属于一位强大的主人，这位主人与迷宫和守卫有着斩不断的联系。

flavor.en: "Before, the Labyrinth was protected by a Guardian. When that Guardian fell to the Destroyer, the corruption saw opportunity—and seized it."

items.name: Relic_Consumable_ResonatingHeart
items.description_en: Whereas the heat of the Dragon Heart scalded, this heart soothes. It's like the heart of the world, ever-giving, ever-nourishing.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Though the first Core originated the corruption, it was not itself corrupt. By a variety of measurements, it was the best of the worlds, the true heart of the Creator.

That it fell in spite of this implies much...though proves nothing."

description.zh: 与炙热的龙心相反，这颗心会令人感到舒缓。它就像是世界的心脏，永远在给予，永远在滋养。

flavor.en:
"Though the first Core originated the corruption, it was not itself corrupt. By a variety of measurements, it was the best of the worlds, the true heart of the Creator.

That it fell in spite of this implies much...though proves nothing."
flavor.zh:
“虽然第一个核心正是腐坏的起源，但它本身并不是腐坏。按照各种标准，它都是无数世界中最美好的存在，是造物主真正的心脏。

尽管如此，它还是堕落了，这意味着很多……但什么都无法证明。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_RipenedHeart
items.description_en: Life and light pulse from within the hardened outer shell. Holding it in your hand, you feel invincible—like there is nothing in the worlds that could harm you.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Several seasons after the Pan arrived on Yaesha's shores, a young Red Widow named Jinas grew deathly ill. Funerary rites could not be performed for fear of spreading the plague, so she was wrapped in cloth and left in the jungle to die alone.

After many days, she returned—miraculously cured and with a vision of a mystical tree that could fend off even death: the Thaen."

description.en: Life and light pulse from within the hardened outer shell. Holding it in your hand, you feel invincible—like there is nothing in the worlds that could harm you.
description.zh: 坚硬的外壳下涌动着生命和光芒。把它拿在手里，你会觉得自己天下无敌——好像世间再没有什么能伤害你了。

flavor.en:
"Several seasons after the Pan arrived on Yaesha's shores, a young Red Widow named Jinas grew deathly ill. Funerary rites could not be performed for fear of spreading the plague, so she was wrapped in cloth and left in the jungle to die alone.

After many days, she returned—miraculously cured and with a vision of a mystical tree that could fend off even death: the Thaen."
flavor.zh:
“在潘恩人抵达耶莎海岸的数季后，一位名叫吉娜斯的红寡妇患了重病。由于惧怕瘟疫传播，大家不准备为她举办葬礼，于是便将她裹上薄布，扔进森林独自等死。

数日后，她回来了——已经奇迹般地痊愈，还在幻象中看到了一棵甚至可以抵御死亡的树：塞恩。”

items.description_en: The runes glow in such an eager way, you feel as though they are trying to reach out, whispering at the edges of your consciousness in a language you can’t comprehend.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The worlds and their children are different. This is indisputable. Yet they seek similar things. Life. Hope. Connection. 

They seek each other."

items.name: Relic_Consumable_SalvagedHeart
items.description_en: Forged in the final moments of the Drzyr, as Alepsis-Taura wiped their existence from the universe. This device represents their last attempt at survival, but even this heart did not remain untouched by the singularity's ravaging energies.
items.flavor_text_en: "Others joined me in this chamber, spared for a time from Alepsis-Taura's wrath, but they would not have survived the ages since. It was necessary to create an ark to save them. Their lives would be saved through oneness with my own."

description.en: Forged in the final moments of the Drzyr, as Alepsis-Taura wiped their existence from the universe. This device represents their last attempt at survival, but even this heart did not remain untouched by the singularity's ravaging energies.
description.zh: 泽厄尔人即将被阿莱普西斯-陶拉灭绝时打造的遗作，是前者求生的最后一搏。但这颗心脏也没有逃过肆虐的奇点能量。

flavor.en: "Others joined me in this chamber, spared for a time from Alepsis-Taura's wrath, but they would not have survived the ages since. It was necessary to create an ark to save them. Their lives would be saved through oneness with my own."
flavor.zh: “加入我舱室的其他人也暂时躲过了阿莱普西斯-陶拉的怒火，但无法在其后的漫长岁月中存活下来。所以我必须打造一条方舟来拯救他们。他们的生命将通过与我合为一体而得到救赎。”

items.description_zh: 泽厄尔人即将被阿莱普西斯-陶拉灭绝时打造的遗作，是前者求生的最后一搏。但这颗心脏也没有逃过肆虐的奇点能量。

items.description_raw: Forged in the final moments of the Drzyr, as Alepsis-Taura wiped their existence from the universe. This device represents their last attempt at survival, but even this heart did not remain untouched by the singularity's ravaging energies.

items.name: Relic_Consumable_ShieldedHeart
items.description_en: A microminiaturized shield generator, the same kind that protects N'Erud—not the ones that protect the ship from space, but those that protect the ship within from the powerful star at its core.
items.flavor_text_en:
"N'Erud is rife with redundancies. One cannot transplant an entire species from a planet to the void without accounting for endless contingencies.

Unfortunately, the Custodian was in charge of most such contingencies. The Custodian has its own redundancies of course, but it has always been N'Erud's greatest point of vulnerability."

description.en: A microminiaturized shield generator, the same kind that protects N'Erud—not the ones that protect the ship from space, but those that protect the ship within from the powerful star at its core.
description.zh: 一种微型的护盾发生器，和守护涅鲁德的相同——不是用来抵御空间影响的那种飞船护盾，而是抵御飞船内部核心恒星的护盾。

flavor.en:
"N'Erud is rife with redundancies. One cannot transplant an entire species from a planet to the void without accounting for endless contingencies.

Unfortunately, the Custodian was in charge of most such contingencies. The Custodian has its own redundancies of course, but it has always been N'Erud's greatest point of vulnerability."
flavor.zh:
“涅鲁德充斥着冗余。如果不把无穷无尽的可能性都考虑在内，就无法把整个物种从行星移植到虚空中。

不幸的是，大部分可能性的考量均由保管人负责。保管人当然也有自己的冗余，这也一直是涅鲁德最大的弱点。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_SiphonHeart
items.description_en: Life for life—that is the idea behind this technology. Apparently, when one lives as long as the Drzyr, exchanging a few years of one's lifespan here and there is no big deal.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The average lifespan of a Drzyr is several hundred years. By contrast, I have survived for ages, siphoning life from space and time through consumption of the ambit ember.

I often wonder if the Seekers knew we could extend our lives in this manner and hid it from us for reasons of their own. I myself see no disadvantages to the process."

description.en: Life for life—that is the idea behind this technology. Apparently, when one lives as long as the Drzyr, exchanging a few years of one's lifespan here and there is no big deal.
description.zh: 以命换命——这就是这项技术背后的理念。很明显，如果你也像泽厄尔人一样长寿，那在漫长的一生中偶尔交换出去几年就没什么大不了的。

flavor.en:
"The average lifespan of a Drzyr is several hundred years. By contrast, I have survived for ages, siphoning life from space and time through consumption of the ambit ember.

I often wonder if the Seekers knew we could extend our lives in this manner and hid it from us for reasons of their own. I myself see no disadvantages to the process."
flavor.zh:
“泽厄尔人的平均寿命是数百年。相较之下，我已经活了太久，通过吞噬灵烬从时空中汲取生命。

我常常会想，也许追寻者早已知晓我们能通过这种方法延长寿命，但出于某种原因隐藏了这一信息。我自己并没有看到这一方法有何缺陷。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_TormentedHeart
items.description_en: A pulsating heart pushes against an encrusted web shell. The webbing appears to be squeezing the heart, constricting it... yet the heart seems to beat all the stronger for it.
items.flavor_text_en: "Dragons hold no power over the Fae. Dragons, phantasma, wraiths, eidolons... The Fae do not fear the powerful and unknown, for this what the Fae themselves are."

description.zh: 一颗跳动的心脏对抗着包裹在外面的网壳。网似乎在挤压心脏……但心脏却因此跳动得更加有力。

flavor.zh: “龙对翡族来说毫无威胁。龙、幽魂、阴灵、精怪……翡族不惧怕强大和未知的东西，因为翡族本就强大且未知。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_TranquilHeart
items.description_en: Encased within wiry tendrils, a crystal beats softly. It beats in time with your own—exactly in time. As you watch, your heart races...and so does the crystal's pulse.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Our king once called us lunatics, accusing us of killing for no purpose but sport.

He was only partially correct, for our kills always served at least one purpose—joy itself being a worthy goal."

flavor.en:
"Our king once called us lunatics, accusing us of killing for no purpose but sport.

He was only partially correct, for our kills always served at least one purpose—joy itself being a worthy goal."
flavor.zh:
“因为纯为了取乐而杀戮，我们曾被国王斥做疯子。

他说的并不全对。我们的杀戮总会有起码一个目的。而乐趣本身就是相当好的目的。何乐而不为？”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_UnsulliedHeart
items.description_en: A pleasing scent wafts from within this heart's strange surface. It springs forth with each thumping beat, cleansing the air like a spring rain.
items.flavor_text_en: "Some have said that what the Fae truly seek is not salvation or supremacy, but purity—a world untarnished by the demands and griefs of others, a world in which the Fae can live their lives to the full, without fear or reprisal or consequence."

description.en: A pleasing scent wafts from within this heart's strange surface. It springs forth with each thumping beat, cleansing the air like a spring rain.
description.zh: 这颗心奇怪的表皮下散发出宜人的芬芳。香气随着心脏的每次跳动喷涌而出，像春雨一样净化着空气。

flavor.en: "Some have said that what the Fae truly seek is not salvation or supremacy, but purity—a world untarnished by the demands and griefs of others, a world in which the Fae can live their lives to the full, without fear or reprisal or consequence."
flavor.zh: “有人说，翡族真正追求的不是救赎，也不是至高无上的地位，而是‘纯净’，一个不受他人索取和不满玷污的纯净世界。在那里没有恐惧，没有报复，也没有后果，翡族可以充分享受自己想要的生活。”

items.name: Relic_Consumable_VoidHeart
items.description_en: The Custodian was wrong. Entropy did not consume everything here. Or perhaps it is merely semantics, for this thing that was left is itself Nothing.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Singularities are a wonder of creation. From within, they are matter condensed, yet from without, they are a hungering void—everything and nothing existing simultaneously.

Yet the true void lies outside of Alepsis-Taura, and everything that exists lies within. To cross that threshold however, one must let go of all rationality."

description.en: The Custodian was wrong. Entropy did not consume everything here. Or perhaps it is merely semantics, for this thing that was left is itself Nothing.
description.zh: 保管人错了。熵并没有吞噬这里的一切。或许这只能从语义上说的通——如果虚无本身也算是一种存在的话。

flavor.en:
"Singularities are a wonder of creation. From within, they are matter condensed, yet from without, they are a hungering void—everything and nothing existing simultaneously.

Yet the true void lies outside of Alepsis-Taura, and everything that exists lies within. To cross that threshold however, one must let go of all rationality."
flavor.zh:
“从内部看，奇点是高密度的物质，而从外部看，则是吞食天地的饥饿虚空，集万物与虚无为一体，是造物的奇迹。

但真正的虚空在阿莱普西斯-陶拉之外，世间万物又存其内。要突破两者之界，就必须抛却一切理智思维。”

items.name: Ring_ATaeriiBooster
items.description_en: The bright core in the center of this coil appears to power the rest of it, pulling its energy from the very dark matter that composes the universe. Miraculously, exposure to Alepsis-Taura seems only to have bolstered its function.
items.flavor_text_en: “A’Taerii... A familiar and reverent name. The prodigy of House Lythla, the genius mind behind countless N’Erudian weapons. If only I had convinced you to join my ark, A’Taerii. If only you had possessed as much foresight as you did brilliance.”

description.en: The bright core in the center of this coil appears to power the rest of it, pulling its energy from the very dark matter that composes the universe. Miraculously, exposure to Alepsis-Taura seems only to have bolstered its function.
description.zh: 指环那明亮核心似乎能从构成宇宙的黑暗物质中汲取能量，并供给其余部分使用。神奇的是，暴露于阿莱普西斯-陶拉似乎只是增强了它的功能。

flavor.en: “A’Taerii... A familiar and reverent name. The prodigy of House Lythla, the genius mind behind countless N’Erudian weapons. If only I had convinced you to join my ark, A’Taerii. If only you had possessed as much foresight as you did brilliance.”
flavor.zh: “阿泰瑞……一个熟悉而备受推崇的名字。里斯拉圣院的奇子，以天才的思维设计了无数武器的涅鲁德武器之父。阿泰瑞，要是我成功说服你加入“方舟”就好了。要是你的远见和你出色的智慧一样就好了。”

items.name: Ring_AcidStone
items.description_en: Sickly green liquid moves within the band, pooling in places and leaking from others. It emits a strangely fragrant chemical odor.
items.flavor_text_en: "It’s not pleasant to talk about, but many of our initial efforts to fight the Root resulted in collateral damage. Of course we tried biochemical weapons—the things look like walking trees, for crying out loud! Worst part is, it wasn’t even effective. At least, not against the Root."

description.en: Sickly green liquid moves within the band, pooling in places and leaking from others. It emits a strangely fragrant chemical odor.
description.zh: 难看的绿色液体在其中流动，在某些地方汇聚，又某些地方渗漏出来。散发着一种奇怪的化学气味。

flavor.en: "It’s not pleasant to talk about, but many of our initial efforts to fight the Root resulted in collateral damage. Of course we tried biochemical weapons—the things look like walking trees, for crying out loud! Worst part is, it wasn’t even effective. At least, not against the Root."
flavor.zh: “虽然这不是什么愉快的话题，但我们最初打击根蔓的许多努力都伤到了自己人。我们当然试过生化武器——毕竟这些东西看起来就像会走路树木！最可怕的是，生化武器完全没用，至少对根蔓没起效果。”

items.name: Ring_AkariWarBand
items.description_en: Despite its humble appearance, the ring carries with it the proud legacy of the Akari tribe's history of battle and honor.
items.flavor_text_en: "During one of my visits to Rhom, I was able to witness firsthand the Akari's remarkable skill in subterfuge and evasion. Their ability to deftly avoid their adversaries before delivering a decisive blow was a testament to their combat expertise."

description.en: Despite its humble appearance, the ring carries with it the proud legacy of the Akari tribe's history of battle and honor.
description.zh: 这枚戒指尽管外观朴素，却承载着阿卡里部落的战争与荣耀史。

items.name: Ring_AlchemyStone
items.description_en: A cast iron ring dotted with rust. You can see where someone desperately tried to polish it in places, rubbing the shaped metal raw. But no amount of waxing or wishing will ever make it gold.
items.flavor_text_en: "That old yarn that any Dran can turn iron to gold proved too tempting for some folk. Spent their whole meager lives trying to do it. Even if it were true, you can’t make something out of nothing. Take too much of another and you’ll be made into something you’re not, or worse—something nobody should ever be."

description.en: A cast iron ring dotted with rust. You can see where someone desperately tried to polish it in places, rubbing the shaped metal raw. But no amount of waxing or wishing will ever make it gold.
description.zh: 一枚布满了锈迹的铸铁戒指。可以看出，曾经有人为了把它擦亮，导致部分地方被磨到走形。但是不管如何打蜡或祈愿，它都不会变成黄金。

flavor.en: "That old yarn that any Dran can turn iron to gold proved too tempting for some folk. Spent their whole meager lives trying to do it. Even if it were true, you can’t make something out of nothing. Take too much of another and you’ll be made into something you’re not, or worse—something nobody should ever be."
flavor.zh: “在古老的怪谈中，所有德兰人都能点铁成金。这对很多人来说太有诱惑力了，他们穷尽一生去试图实现这一点。就算传说是真的，你也不可能无中生有。而如果你吸收了过多的其他东西，你也就不再是你，甚至可能更糟糕——你会变成本不应该存在的东西。”

items.name: Ring_AlumniRing
items.description_en: It says it's from the Noble Conservatory of Psychiatry. The number 529—presumably a year—is etched into the underside, and the visage of the school's founder, Dr. Hidigar Roper, has been carved into the sides.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Noble Psychiatry Conservatory styles itself as academy and ministry both. But who can govern science? Feels to me like a group of folk who don't know what they don't know."

description.en: It says it's from the Noble Conservatory of Psychiatry. The number 529—presumably a year—is etched into the underside, and the visage of the school's founder, Dr. Hidigar Roper, has been carved into the sides.

items.flavor_text_en: "I knew an artist once, real keen eye. She showed me there’s beauty in all worlds, including our own—as it was, and as it is now. If you can’t see it for yourself, well... I’m sure she’ll show you, too."

items.flavor_text_en: "It is said, truly, that no weapon forged or wielded by the Fae can kill the One True King. What the imposter realized, however, is that one does not need to kill a king in order to depose him."

items.name: Ring_AtonementFold
items.description_en: A ring lined with sharp spikes that causes immense pain and a steady trickle of blood while you wear it. It’s a sacrifice of sorts just to put it on, and though you can’t stand to wear it for long at risk of losing too much blood, something about the pain adds a sense of urgency and intensity to your every attack.
items.flavor_text_en: “The currency of the Dran is blood and sorrow, and for those willing to pay, there is much to be gained. I am not personally an enthusiast of self-inflicted pain—nor any pain aimed at myself, for that matter—but I must admit there is something endlessly fascinating about these strange and grisly customs of theirs.”

description.en: A ring lined with sharp spikes that causes immense pain and a steady trickle of blood while you wear it. It’s a sacrifice of sorts just to put it on, and though you can’t stand to wear it for long at risk of losing too much blood, something about the pain adds a sense of urgency and intensity to your every attack.
description.zh: 这枚戒指内衬锋利的尖刺，会让佩戴者感到巨大的痛苦并流血不止——这就是为了戴上它而进行的献祭。虽然为了避免失血过多，你无法长时间佩戴它，但佩戴时的疼痛却让你的每次进攻都更加迅速、强烈。

flavor.en: “The currency of the Dran is blood and sorrow, and for those willing to pay, there is much to be gained. I am not personally an enthusiast of self-inflicted pain—nor any pain aimed at myself, for that matter—but I must admit there is something endlessly fascinating about these strange and grisly customs of theirs.”
flavor.zh: “德兰人的货币是鲜血与悲伤。只要你愿意付出代价，就能获得更多回报。我个人并不是自虐爱好者——也不喜欢别人让我痛苦，但我必须承认，他们的这种奇怪而可怕的习俗确实有着巨大的吸引力。”

items.flavor_text_en: "The empress buys loyalty with falsehoods and bribery. The rebel fights today because another died for him—his loyalty is not bought, but forged."

items.name: Ring_BandOfAccord
items.description_en: A unique ring that seems to exude an aura of cooperation and unity. When worn by an individual, the band seems to enhance their ability to work well with others, but it is said that the true power of the ring is unlocked when multiple allies wear the same band.
items.flavor_text_en: “When allies wear it together, it fosters a sense of teamwork and encourages them to watch each other's backs out there. In a world as dangerous as this, having each other's support can make all the difference."

description.en: A unique ring that seems to exude an aura of cooperation and unity. When worn by an individual, the band seems to enhance their ability to work well with others, but it is said that the true power of the ring is unlocked when multiple allies wear the same band.
description.zh: 一枚非常独特的戒指，似乎能营造出团结协作的氛围。单人佩戴时，这种指环能加强佩戴者与他人合作的能力，但据说只有所有盟友都佩戴这种戒指，才能解锁它的真正力量。

flavor.en: “When allies wear it together, it fosters a sense of teamwork and encourages them to watch each other's backs out there. In a world as dangerous as this, having each other's support can make all the difference."

items.name: Ring_BandOfTheFanatic
items.description_en: This ring is comprised of cold metal adorned by some sort of occult symbol of sharp and foreboding fangs. Wearing it draws the attention of the most nefarious sort possible, which could be seen as a curse, or perhaps as an opportunity to temper your spirit through trials by fire.
items.flavor_text_en: “I’ve heard tale of a band of Dran occultists who operate in the shadows and distinguish each other by means of dark symbology. As a master of surfacing that which others mean to keep buried, I am of course aware of said symbology, and I use this knowledge to stay as far away from those rabid ritualists as my feet can carry me.”

flavor.zh: “我听说过一群德兰神秘学家的故事，他们在暗处行动，通过黑暗符号来区分彼此。作为一位挖掘秘密的大师，我当然知道这些符号，而且我会利用这些知识，尽可能远离那些狂热的祭祀者。”

items.name: Ring_BerserkersCrest
items.description_en: The crest on this ring represents the hero Linedhel. It was worn by the most powerful Gul warriors—those who overcame harrowing odds through strength, speed, and guts.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Krell had become entrenched around Elenran, but Linedhel refused to die a coward. She picked up a massive halberd and smashed through the Krell lines singlehanded, allowing the Pan warriors to overwhelm and defeat them."
