items.name: Ring_BitterMemento
items.description_en: This ring is a vessel of loss, eternally harboring a child’s grief over the death of his mother. You can feel the sting of tears threatening to fall from your eyes when you wear it, and it takes everything you have to keep them at bay. As with any tragedy, you can choose either to let it break you or make you stronger.
items.flavor_text_en: “In perusing a prior scribe’s memoirs, I came upon an entry about a certain young princeling crying his eyes out for weeks on end over the sudden loss of his mother, the only soul who harbored any love for the child. This insight into the Red Prince’s fear of loss and secret longing to be cared for has proven most valuable.”

description.en: This ring is a vessel of loss, eternally harboring a child’s grief over the death of his mother. You can feel the sting of tears threatening to fall from your eyes when you wear it, and it takes everything you have to keep them at bay. As with any tragedy, you can choose either to let it break you or make you stronger.
description.zh: 这枚戒指是一个失落的容器，永远承载着一个孩子失去母亲的悲伤。当你戴上它时，可以感受到泪水即将从眼中滑落，让你难以自抑。就像任何悲剧一样，你可以选择让它击垮你，或者让你变得更强大。

flavor.en: “In perusing a prior scribe’s memoirs, I came upon an entry about a certain young princeling crying his eyes out for weeks on end over the sudden loss of his mother, the only soul who harbored any love for the child. This insight into the Red Prince’s fear of loss and secret longing to be cared for has proven most valuable.”
flavor.zh: “在阅读一位前任抄写员的回忆录时，我发现了一篇关于一位年轻亲王的记录，他因为突然失去了母亲而连续数周痛哭不止——因为母亲是世上唯一一个对这个孩子怀有爱意人。这让人得以窥见红王子对失去的恐惧和隐藏在内心深处的对被爱的渴望，因此极有价值。”

items.name: Ring_BlastingCapRing
items.description_en:
The nodules on this ring detect explosive force then blast out of the ring to add to its destructive energy. They also regenerate from within the ring shortly afterwards.

None of that makes sense but neither does anything else in this place.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Even the Seekers sometimes questioned the purpose of the Phetyr class. What need was there for warriors when all Drzyr were united in singular purpose?

But the Drzyr are not a singular consciousness, and our unity was sometimes more optimism than reality. The Phetyr found frequent enough use for their talents."

items.description_en:
The blue plating on this ring grows ever so imperceptibly, fed by absorbing the afflictions of the bearer. Fae legend says when the ring has turned completely blue, it will release all of its afflictions at once, killing the next person who wears it.

It's unclear if that's true, but it's the kind of thing the Fae would make.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Some believe the Fae immortal, impervious to death and disease—a delusion we are all too happy to entertain. The truth is we have mastered the art of endurance.

The fact that some of our kind enjoy pain is irrelevant."

items.description_en: A ring bearing the symbol of the Pan who have dedicated their lives to protecting their immortal queen. It’s quite bulky, but it’s still much heavier than it looks. Even with the added weight, you feel as though it makes your movements nimbler and more fluid.
items.flavor_text_en: “Across the great expanse of history, it has been proven time and again that speed is as integral to victory as might, though when joined, the two traits become immeasurably more fearsome. That is why they are chosen for their task, and also why they are nearly infallible at it.”

flavor.en: “Across the great expanse of history, it has been proven time and again that speed is as integral to victory as might, though when joined, the two traits become immeasurably more fearsome. That is why they are chosen for their task, and also why they are nearly infallible at it.”
flavor.zh: “历史已经多次证明，速度与力量一样重要，而当二者相结合时，则会变得无比的可怕。保护吉娜斯的潘恩守护生物不仅兼具这两个特质，还对自己事业的怀有强烈热忱和敬意。这也是他们被选中执行任务，并且几乎无懈可击的原因。”

items.description_zh: 一枚戒指，上面的符号代表了用生命保护不朽女王的潘恩人。非常笨重，但却能让你的动作更加敏捷流畅。

items.description_raw: A ring bearing the symbol of the Pan who have dedicated their lives to protecting their immortal queen. It’s quite bulky, but it’s still much heavier than it looks. Even with the added weight, you feel as though it makes your movements nimbler and more fluid.

items.name: Ring_BreachAccelerator
items.description_en: This hydraulic vise can atomize anything unfortunate enough—and small enough—to be placed inside it. The fine particles are then converted into raw power inside the ring.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Drzyr made countless attempts to petition Sha’Hala directly. I would have liked to attempt making contact myself, but the Seekers refused. It is unlikely, yet possible that Sha’Hala’s means of communication more closely resembles that of an artificial intelligence than those of my creators. Regrettably, we may never find out.”

items.name: Ring_BridgeWardensCrest
items.description_en: Only the most well-disciplined and loyal Fae carry this crest, those who have fully forsaken the accursed ways of their ancient kin. The bright luster of its cobalt gemstone proves its rarity and worth.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Wasting, a fabled plague that ravaged Fae-kind as divine retribution for our nefarious misdeeds. Please, only a proper fool would believe the king’s carefully weaved fictions. But such fools are the masses made of, I suppose!”

description.zh: “只有纪律严明且忠诚的翡族佼佼者才能佩戴此纹章，他们已经完全抛弃了远古同族那受诅咒般的生活方式。首饰上钴宝石的明亮光泽，正是其价值与不凡的证明。”

flavor.en: “The Wasting, a fabled plague that ravaged Fae-kind as divine retribution for our nefarious misdeeds. Please, only a proper fool would believe the king’s carefully weaved fictions. But such fools are the masses made of, I suppose!”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheAudacious
items.description_en: Stubborn rust makes its home in whatever crevice it can find, clinging for as long as it can, too. Hard to imagine what it would look like polished.
items.flavor_text_en: “Renegades, rebels, resistors... Call them what you want. Every world’s got 'em, and in my experience, it’s worth hearing them out. Most of the time, they understand the world around them better than the ones in charge.”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheDeparted
items.description_en: It seems a contradiction that a ring so dark and twisted as to bear resemblance to the mad king who forged it could invoke intense tenderness and grief, yet it does just that. Just as these burdensome rings have been reunited, one can only hope that their original bearers have also found their way back to each other.
items.flavor_text_en: “The One True King has many secrets hidden within the dark recesses of his castle, and it would seem, the blackened organ he calls a heart. Such secrets, of course, are ripe for the picking, begging those clever enough to spy them to uncover such treasures and await the opportune moment to bring them to light.”

description.en: It seems a contradiction that a ring so dark and twisted as to bear resemblance to the mad king who forged it could invoke intense tenderness and grief, yet it does just that. Just as these burdensome rings have been reunited, one can only hope that their original bearers have also found their way back to each other.
description.zh: 一如铸造它的疯王，这枚戒指散发着浓烈的黑暗和扭曲，同时又会激起悲伤与柔情，看似矛盾，但事实如此。这些沉重的戒指已经重聚，只愿它们最初的主人也能有朝一日得见彼此。

flavor.en: “The One True King has many secrets hidden within the dark recesses of his castle, and it would seem, the blackened organ he calls a heart. Such secrets, of course, are ripe for the picking, begging those clever enough to spy them to uncover such treasures and await the opportune moment to bring them to light.”
flavor.zh: “许多秘密隐藏在独一真皇城堡的黑暗深处，似乎是他称之为‘心脏’的黑化器官。当然，这些秘密已经成熟，可供采摘，如同乞求足够聪明的人来发掘的宝藏，等待恰当的时机将它们公之于众。”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheDestroyer
items.description_en: Frigid to the touch, as if it was forged in the midst of a blizzard and imbued with a glacial chill. Wearing it brings out your most primal instincts.
items.flavor_text_en: “The one thing the Root doesn’t have is the will to live. It’s that stubbornness, those instincts to survive, that have kept humanity going for so long.”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheDivine
items.description_en: This ring was forged by the One True King himself as a gift for someone important, but not important enough to ever be known—or perhaps so important as to be hidden away.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The One True King tried to instill in us a sense of responsibility for our fellow Fae, saying it was the burden of those who ruled to care for those they ruled over. 

There exists one of whom he tried to instill these lessons harsher than others, but those most disciplined so often turn rebellious."

description.en: This ring was forged by the One True King himself as a gift for someone important, but not important enough to ever be known—or perhaps so important as to be hidden away.
description.zh: 这只戒指是独一真皇亲自铸造的礼物，送给某位重要的人，不过具体是谁尚无人得知。此人要么没那么重要，已经被历史忘记，要么极度重要，必须隐姓埋名。

“独一真皇试图向翡族灌输一种责任感，让我们认为上位者有责任照顾自己的臣民奴仆。

他对其中一个人的要求格外严苛，可惜被管得最严的孩子往往是最叛逆的。”

items.flavor_text_en: "Although N’Erud is largely automated, the Ofildi oversaw quality assurance and reported failures or improvements in the machinery. The Ofildi were required to wear extensive protective gear as the automation processes could be...extremely dangerous."

flavor.zh: “虽然涅鲁德基本上是自动化的，但欧菲迪需要监督运行质量，并对报告机械故障和改进。欧菲迪需要穿戴重装防护设备，因为自动化的过程可能会……极度危险。”

items.description_en: These rings were once given to Pan slaves to inhibit escape while enhancing strength for their daily tasks. This proved more dangerous than useful among those who did not wish to serve.
items.flavor_text_en: "Most believe Jinas's power comes from her immortality, but she would have no power at all without mortals who serve with our lives."

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheGambler
items.description_en: A gaudy and flamboyant piece of jewelry, crafted from shimmering gold and adorned with an intricate circular pattern. Those who dare to wear this ring are known to be gamblers, always willing to take risks and push their luck to the limit.
items.flavor_text_en: "Those who think they can press their luck will soon find it running out when they need it most. In a world like ours, it's better to rely on skill and preparation than chance."

description.en: A gaudy and flamboyant piece of jewelry, crafted from shimmering gold and adorned with an intricate circular pattern. Those who dare to wear this ring are known to be gamblers, always willing to take risks and push their luck to the limit.
description.zh: 一件奢华浮夸的珠宝，用灿灿黄金制成，装饰着精巧的圆形图案。有胆戴这戒指的人总是敢于冒险，愿将自己的运气利用到极限，人称“赌徒”。

flavor.en: "Those who think they can press their luck will soon find it running out when they need it most. In a world like ours, it's better to rely on skill and preparation than chance."

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheMariner
items.description_en: This technology was devised by House Rigol, the overseers of the Ofildi. They saw that much more was asked of common laborers than other more focused classes, and so House Rigol gave the Ofildi the means to, if not excel, at least survive.
items.flavor_text_en:
"There is an ancient Drzyrian tale of a mariner on a perilous journey across the seas of our homeworld. His crewmates perished one by one, until only the mariner was left, and every burden of travel was left to him alone to accomplish.

For most of my life, this tale meant little to me—not until I myself became the mariner."

description.en: This technology was devised by House Rigol, the overseers of the Ofildi. They saw that much more was asked of common laborers than other more focused classes, and so House Rigol gave the Ofildi the means to, if not excel, at least survive.
description.zh: 由欧菲迪的督察者——睿果圣院发明的技术。睿果圣院看到，与其他有所专攻的阶层相比，普通劳动者阶层的负担更沉重，因而圣院赐予了后者能力，让欧菲迪即便无法出人头地，起码生存不成问题。

flavor.en:
"There is an ancient Drzyrian tale of a mariner on a perilous journey across the seas of our homeworld. His crewmates perished one by one, until only the mariner was left, and every burden of travel was left to him alone to accomplish.

For most of my life, this tale meant little to me—not until I myself became the mariner."
flavor.zh:
“有一个古老的泽厄尔故事，讲的是一位水手在我们的故乡世界横渡大海的危险旅程。他的同伴一个接一个地倒下，最后只剩下他一人，旅程的所有使命都留给他自己去完成。

在我的大部分人生中，这个故事都没有什么意义——直到我成为了那位水手。”

items.description_zh: 由欧菲迪的督察者——睿果圣院发明的技术。睿果圣院看到，与其他有所专攻的阶层相比，普通劳动者阶层的负担更沉重，因而圣院赐予了后者能力，让欧菲迪即便无法出人头地，起码生存不成问题。

items.description_raw: This technology was devised by House Rigol, the overseers of the Ofildi. They saw that much more was asked of common laborers than other more focused classes, and so House Rigol gave the Ofildi the means to, if not excel, at least survive.

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheMason
items.description_en: An intricate piece of jewelry made from clay and dried into hard stone inside a hot kiln. Though the skilled artist who lovingly shaped this ring has long since perished, their life’s work perseveres.
items.flavor_text_en: "The living stones do not fear the pestilence. Indeed, the two seem to hardly regard each other at all. But if I can somehow wrest control of the living stones, we can use them to expel the pestilence from our beloved Yaesha! Then the Pan will finally understand the true power of the lifesong."

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheMesmer
items.description_en: This ring fills you with an inexplicable emptiness and longing, made all the more cutting by the blinding rage that accompanies it. It’s hard to explain, but somehow this feeling both strengthens and weakens you all at once.
items.flavor_text_en: "Sometimes there is no choice but to do the unthinkable. If your resolve is true and your cause is noble, then even tearing your own heart to shreds is a worthwhile sacrifice. I must believe that all I have done will be worth it in the end. That my Pan will know the taste of freedom again! It will come to pass... It must!"

description.zh: 这枚戒指让你感到一种难以言喻的空虚和渴望，这种感觉因随之而来的盲目怒火而变得更为锋利。很难解释其中缘由，但不知为何，这种感觉既让你变强，又将你削弱。

flavor.en: "Sometimes there is no choice but to do the unthinkable. If your resolve is true and your cause is noble, then even tearing your own heart to shreds is a worthwhile sacrifice. I must believe that all I have done will be worth it in the end. That my Pan will know the taste of freedom again! It will come to pass... It must!"
flavor.zh: “有时除了做难以想象的事，你别无选择。如果你的决心是真实的，你的事业是崇高的，那么哪怕心被撕成碎片，这一切也是值得的。而我必须相信，我所做的一切最终都会是值得的。我们潘恩族必将再次了解自由的滋味！这一切终将实现……必将实现！”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheProtector
items.description_en: The solar shield on this ring contains enough stellar energy and heat to reignite a dying sun.
items.flavor_text_en: "At first, great effort was put into deciphering a way to reignite our homeworld’s star. Upon the realization that our planet’s star was not the only one experiencing a rapid death, however, saving each star at the micro level was deemed futile. Thus we began to think on a macro scale."

flavor.en: "At first, great effort was put into deciphering a way to reignite our homeworld’s star. Upon the realization that our planet’s star was not the only one experiencing a rapid death, however, saving each star at the micro level was deemed futile. Thus we began to think on a macro scale."

items.description_en: This ring once belonged to Edhella, an elite Pan scout famous for her ability to travel long distances swiftly and, later, for betraying the nobles who had pressed her into service.
items.flavor_text_en: "Often the nobility thought the traitors had nowhere left to run, yet run they did—every time. For the rebels knew the jungle better than the nobles who seldom left their ziggurats."

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheSciolist
items.description_en: This ring is wrapped in the leather of a newborn animal, which is made into parchment best suited for scrolls. At least, you hope the skin belonged to an animal.
items.flavor_text_en: “It’s a terrible torment to be the sole bearer of the king’s secrets. I have to wonder if such cruelty was the king’s intent in making me his scribe. To know his every last confession and musing, yet be forever sworn to excrutiating confidentiality... He may as well have tortured me with a blade.”

description.zh: 这枚戒指包裹着一层适合做成卷轴的动物幼崽皮革——至少，你希望是动物。

To know his every last confession and musing, yet be forever sworn to excrutiating confidentiality... He may as well have tortured me with a blade.”
flavor.zh: “成为国王秘密的唯一承载者是一种可怕的折磨。我不禁怀疑，国王让我成为他的抄写员，是否就是为了让我受此酷刑。我了解他的所有忏悔和沉思，却永远被保守秘密的誓言束缚……这与用刀折磨我又有何异？”

items.name: Ring_BurdenOfTheStargazer
items.description_en: Like most Drzyr classes, the Mali—or the Astropaths—had a singular purpose and devoted all of their resources to it. Comfort, motivation, health... None of them took precedence over the work.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Seekers led the Drzyr, but the greatest responsibility lay with on the Astropaths. To us fell the burden of sight and guidance. We alone determined the direction N'Erud should take and, therefore, whether the Drzyr would succeed in our mission at all."

items.description_en: These rings are worn by the One True King's healers, the so-called Warlocks. Most consider this position to be a punishment, and a cursory glance of the Warlocks' history suggests that the king may have seen it that way as well.
items.flavor_text_en: "Every appointment of the One True King is a punishment—the higher the position, the more grievous the crime. One need only assess the Council and the king's closest confidants to see the truth of this."

items.description_en: It takes real swiftness and dexterity to outwit a fleet of metal designed to find and extinguish imminent threats like yourself. As this ring signifies, you have to make every action and each bullet count in order to survive a maze of death with your head intact.
items.flavor_text_en: “N’Erud was created as a haven for the civilization that inhabited it. Like any such place, it was not without its secrets, hidden amid labyrinthine paths and safe from the prying eyes of patrolling machinery and the uninitiated.”

items.name: Ring_ConstantVariableRing
items.description_en:
The Drzyr valued natural life above all things, so much so that they devoted the fate of their entire species to find more of it.

Created life, on the other hand, was far more expendable.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The universe is an infinitely complex machine made of trillions of less complex machines which themselves are made of astoundingly simple agents.

When one of these less complex machines becomes aware, we call it life. When it is aware that it is aware, we call it sentient.

Alas, these miracles turned out to be far more rare than we hoped."

不过人造生命的价值就低得多，可随意利用和抛弃。

flavor.zh:
宇宙是一台无限复杂的机械，它由无数个不那么复杂的机器组成，而这些机器又是由无比简单的部件组成。

只可惜，这种奇迹远比我们希望的稀少。

items.name: Ring_CrimsonDreamstone
items.description_en: A ring that followed you from a dream within a dream. When you wear it, you can faintly hear tortured screams of agony that suddenly and irrevocably fall silent before giving way to the distinct smell of blood and rotting flesh.
items.flavor_text_en: “I have heard tale of those who were driven mad by an inescapable nightmare in which they wander endlessly before coming upon a world of death and decay. In the midst of this world, they find only an empty throne, consecrated in blood. These are...merely the ravings of a scant few feeble-minded Dran, of course. Even still, I sleep with a razor-sharp quill beneath my pillow, just in case.”

items.description_en: The centerpiece depicts a Pan ship traversing a tumultuous sea. The now age-worn, weathered paint may have been an entirely different hue at the time of its creation, long before it was exposed to Yaesha’s harsh elements.
items.flavor_text_en: "Long ago, King Kolket brought our people across the Viilk Marzha, the Dark Sea. It is often depicted as a starless, treacherous ocean, but some of our most sacred texts are rather vague in their description. To think, there are scholars who believe it was not a literal sea at all! Who can say where our ancestors truly came from? Yet another Pan mystery waiting to be solved!"

To think, there are scholars who believe it was not a literal sea at all! Who can say where our ancestors truly came from? Yet another Pan mystery waiting to be solved!"

items.flavor_text_en: "Although the Drzyr never mastered the secret of traveling to other dimensions, we did create our own—tiny capsule worlds, with nothing in them except for space that wasn't there before."

items.name: Ring_DefensiveActionLoop
items.description_en: The Drzyr devised a technology that can, for lack of a better term, hack the brain. It allows the user to perform true multitasking—rather than the singletasking badly that most individuals perform.
items.flavor_text_en: "The living mind is simply a biological information processor. If a machine can be made to perform simultaneous tasks efficiently—through threading, multiprocessing, quantum parallelism, and so on—one should be able to influence the brain in the same direction."

description.en: The Drzyr devised a technology that can, for lack of a better term, hack the brain. It allows the user to perform true multitasking—rather than the singletasking badly that most individuals perform.
description.zh: 简单形容来说，泽厄尔人发明了一种能“黑进大脑”的科技，赋予使用者真正的多线处理能力，而不是像大多数人那样，只能同时处理一份工作，效果还不尽人意。

flavor.en: "The living mind is simply a biological information processor. If a machine can be made to perform simultaneous tasks efficiently—through threading, multiprocessing, quantum parallelism, and so on—one should be able to influence the brain in the same direction."
flavor.zh: “生物的头脑也不过是一个生物信息处理器。既然可以通过线程、多重处理、量子并行等让机械高效地同时执行多个任务，那理论上也能以类似的方式影响大脑。”

items.name: Ring_DigestedHogLure
items.description_en: You've managed to find useful items in all kinds of unexpected places, but you never expected that the stomach of a scavenging hog would be one of them. Live and learn. This ring has a rancid scent, but in light of how you acquired it, that’s not especially surprising.
items.flavor_text_en: “A lack of discretion is one of the immutable marks of a beast whose only utility is to wind up on a platter. Be they Dran or livestock, it matters not. A beast is a beast, and nothing more. To that end, let the filthy rabble fight over rotting flesh and discarded scraps of rubbish. I would as soon kill or starve than toss away my hard-won dignity—preferably the former.”

items.name: Ring_DisasterConverter
items.description_en: This ring houses a sentient, imperceptible artificial intelligence which monitors the vitals of its wearer and employs the needles mounted in place of a gemstone to produce an absorbent stellar-powered shield whenever said vitals drop below its acceptable parameters.
items.flavor_text_en: "Drzyr scientists worked tirelessly to decipher the data patterns emitted from Alepsis-Taura. These patterns more favorably supported the theory that the universe was malleable and governed by an artificial design. Thus, they believed that the secrets of creation resided within—the existence of which could save their dying universe."

description.en: This ring houses a sentient, imperceptible artificial intelligence which monitors the vitals of its wearer and employs the needles mounted in place of a gemstone to produce an absorbent stellar-powered shield whenever said vitals drop below its acceptable parameters.
description.zh: 这枚戒指内置难以被察觉的人工智能装置，可以监测佩戴者的生命体征。当监测数据过低时，宝石中的针剂便会产生吸收性恒星能量护盾。

flavor.en: "Drzyr scientists worked tirelessly to decipher the data patterns emitted from Alepsis-Taura. These patterns more favorably supported the theory that the universe was malleable and governed by an artificial design. Thus, they believed that the secrets of creation resided within—the existence of which could save their dying universe."
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔科学家不知疲倦地破译着阿莱普西斯-陶拉发出的数据模式。这些模式更倾向于支持一个理论：宇宙是可塑的，并受人工设计的支配。因此，他们认为创造的秘密就在其中，而这个秘密可以拯救他们濒死的宇宙。”

items.name: Ring_DowngradedRing
items.description_en: Originally designed to subdue livestock for transport. The Phetyr used this technology to great effect when a previous version of the Custodian turned against the Drzyr.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Centuries ago, the Custodian we designed to care for us took control of N'Erud's core functionality and turned our own machines against us. It was a failure we should have foreseen—and took steps to prevent afterwards.

During the conflict however, the Phetyr were, for lack of a better term, ecstatic."

description.en: Originally designed to subdue livestock for transport. The Phetyr used this technology to great effect when a previous version of the Custodian turned against the Drzyr.
description.zh: 最初设计的目的是用其来控制牲畜便于运输。之前版本的保管人出现过背叛泽厄尔人的情况，而菲特尔便是用该技术成功将其镇压。

flavor.en:
"Centuries ago, the Custodian we designed to care for us took control of N'Erud's core functionality and turned our own machines against us. It was a failure we should have foreseen—and took steps to prevent afterwards.

During the conflict however, the Phetyr were, for lack of a better term, ecstatic."
flavor.zh:
“数百年前，被我们设计来照顾我们的保管人夺取了涅鲁德核心功能的控制权，策反了我们的机器来对付我们。我们本应预见到这种失败——并在之后采取措施预防类似事件。

但是在冲突期间，菲特尔阶层……欣喜若狂——请原谅我找不到更好的形容词了。”

items.description_en: This one-of-a-kind stone resembles a pearl, yet its origin story is shrouded in mystery. Unlike most pearls that are born underwater, this one seems to have been birthed through the intense fusion of fire and water, making it a precious and rare find indeed.
items.flavor_text_en: "I've heard stories of the Drakestone Pearl, but for one to hold it is truly a blessing. It feels alive with a warmth and love that I can't quite explain."

items.name: Ring_DreadFont
items.description_en: The ring looks like it's been soaked in blood. It has a coppery smell and feels wet to the touch. No liquid comes off on your fingers, but it feels like something seeps into your skin when you wear it.
items.flavor_text_en: "The stitching of our worlds has brought the Dran all kinds of trouble. Truth has gotten confusing, and these creatures... Some of 'em sniff out blood like a child hunting for a sweet confection."

description.en: The ring looks like it's been soaked in blood. It has a coppery smell and feels wet to the touch. No liquid comes off on your fingers, but it feels like something seeps into your skin when you wear it.
description.zh: 这枚戒指看起来好像曾浸泡在鲜血中。一股铜腥气，摸上去也湿漉漉的。戴上它之后，你看不到任何液体流到手上，但会感觉好像有什么东西渗进了皮肤里。

flavor.en: "The stitching of our worlds has brought the Dran all kinds of trouble. Truth has gotten confusing, and these creatures... Some of 'em sniff out blood like a child hunting for a sweet confection."
flavor.zh: “两个世界的缝合给德兰人带来了各种各样的麻烦。真相变得扑朔迷离，而那些生物……有的就像鲨鱼，一丁点儿的血腥味也能嗅到。”

items.name: Ring_DriedClayRing
items.description_en: A crude clay ring left out in the elements for far too long. It is now misshapen and cracked from neglect. It may be lacking in fine craftsmanship, but if such a fragile thing lasted this long in unfavorable conditions, perhaps you can as well.
items.flavor_text_en: “Watching the Dran make attempts at the higher arts is like a bird skittering upon a dinner table as though it were an invited guest. It may eat from the same platter and drink from the same goblet as a Fae, but at the end of the day, its imitation must fall to the wayside as it inescapably returns to its feral routines along with the rest of its kind.”

description.en: A crude clay ring left out in the elements for far too long. It is now misshapen and cracked from neglect. It may be lacking in fine craftsmanship, but if such a fragile thing lasted this long in unfavorable conditions, perhaps you can as well.
description.zh: 被遗弃很久的黏土戒指，早就因为风吹日晒而变形皲裂。如果这么脆弱粗糙的制品都能在恶劣环境中存活这么久，那也许你也能。

flavor.en: “Watching the Dran make attempts at the higher arts is like a bird skittering upon a dinner table as though it were an invited guest. It may eat from the same platter and drink from the same goblet as a Fae, but at the end of the day, its imitation must fall to the wayside as it inescapably returns to its feral routines along with the rest of its kind.”
flavor.zh: “看着德兰人尝试高等艺术，就像看一只自诩为宾客的小鸟在餐桌上蹦跳。它可以和翡族从同一个盘子吃饭，从同一个高脚杯喝水，但最终，它还是会脱掉伪装的外表，回归同类的野蛮生活之中。”

items.name: Ring_DrzyrSniperSigil
items.description_en:
These rings were conferred by the heads of House M'Ertal to only the most skilled Phetyr snipers. They were considered one of the warrior class's greatest honors.

Of course, this skill could never be proven in combat. There was never opportunity.
items.flavor_text_en: "Although ostensibly serving as the warrior class, the Phetyr spent much of their time as a form of entertainment. Their competitions in target shooting and arena combat were well attended during our longest journeys—possibly because there was little else to look forward to."

description.en:
These rings were conferred by the heads of House M'Ertal to only the most skilled Phetyr snipers. They were considered one of the warrior class's greatest honors.

Of course, this skill could never be proven in combat. There was never opportunity.
description.zh:
这种戒指由姆塔圣院院长颁发，用于褒奖最优秀的菲特尔狙击手。人们将它视作战士阶层的最高荣誉。

当然，他们的战斗技能从来没有在实战中得到过验证，从来没机会。

flavor.en: "Although ostensibly serving as the warrior class, the Phetyr spent much of their time as a form of entertainment. Their competitions in target shooting and arena combat were well attended during our longest journeys—possibly because there was little else to look forward to."
flavor.zh: “尽管表面上是战士阶层，但菲特尔把大部分时间都花在了娱乐上。在漫长的旅程中，菲特尔的打靶比赛和竞技战总是会广受关注——可能是因为没有其他值得期待的事吧。”

items.name: Ring_DyingEmber
items.description_en: Long has it endured to keep its glow, but its light slowly fades and will soon dim to nothing. Yet persist it does, as all things must. It is not dying, but living.
items.flavor_text_en: "Many sentients endeavor to outwit death. But it is the outcome that validates the endeavor. Without death, would their lives not be irrelevant?"

description.en: Long has it endured to keep its glow, but its light slowly fades and will soon dim to nothing. Yet persist it does, as all things must. It is not dying, but living.
description.zh: 它长久以来一直在发光，但是光芒正慢慢黯淡，很快就将消失不见。然而它仍在坚持，万物都应如此。它并不是在死去，而是在活着。

flavor.en: "Many sentients endeavor to outwit death. But it is the outcome that validates the endeavor. Without death, would their lives not be irrelevant?"
flavor.zh: “许多智慧生物都想找到长生不死的办法，但不落幕的戏剧无所谓回味，不结束的生命又有什么意义？”

items.name: Ring_ElevatedRing
items.description_en: Decorous engraved swirls encircle the bright emerald gemstone in a way that elevates this otherwise simple ring. With a bit of time and detailing, even plain things can be rendered beautiful.
items.flavor_text_en: “We Fae adhere to a strict hierarchy. There are those above you and those below, and it is not the strongest nor proudest Fae who survive the longest—rather, the ones who know their place. Indeed, I am quite content to grovel to my betters if it means I outlive them in the end.”

description.en: Decorous engraved swirls encircle the bright emerald gemstone in a way that elevates this otherwise simple ring. With a bit of time and detailing, even plain things can be rendered beautiful.
description.zh: 精美的雕花纹饰环绕着明亮的翡翠宝石，让这枚原本简单戒指变得高雅了起来。只要精心添加一点细节，即使是朴素之物也能变得美丽。

flavor.en: “We Fae adhere to a strict hierarchy. There are those above you and those below, and it is not the strongest nor proudest Fae who survive the longest—rather, the ones who know their place. Indeed, I am quite content to grovel to my betters if it means I outlive them in the end.”
flavor.zh: “我们翡族遵循严格的等级制度。有高于你的人，也有低于你的人。最长寿的翡族并非最强大或最上层的，而是那些知道自己位置的人。事实上，只要能让我活得更久，我很乐意对上位者卑躬屈膝。”

items.name: Ring_EmpoweringLoop
items.description_en: Wearing this ring makes your whole body feel slow and heavy, almost as though you've been tainted just by wearing it. Still, the power that courses through you more than makes up for it.
items.flavor_text_en: "There is but one way to survive against a creature so venomous it could blight your very lifeblood in the blink of an eye. It is simple—most simple! Join their hunt and bide your time until trust dulls their vigilance. That is when you strike."

description.en: Wearing this ring makes your whole body feel slow and heavy, almost as though you've been tainted just by wearing it. Still, the power that courses through you more than makes up for it.
description.zh: 戴上这枚戒指会让你的整个身体变得又钝又沉重，就好像你被玷污了一样。不过，流经你体内的力量远远弥补了这一点。

flavor.en: "There is but one way to survive against a creature so venomous it could blight your very lifeblood in the blink of an eye. It is simple—most simple! Join their hunt and bide your time until trust dulls their vigilance. That is when you strike."
flavor.zh: “只有一种方法可以在如此恶毒的生物面前生存下来，它能在眨眼间让你的生命之血枯萎。方法很简单，再简单不过了，那就是加入它们的狩猎并耐心等待，直至它们对你的信任大过警惕——此时，就是你出手的时机。”

items.name: Ring_EncryptedLoop
items.description_en: The Labyrinth’s constant reconstruction has resulted in this conveniently ring-shaped object. The imbedded glowing orbs make you uneasy, as if something is watching you through them, recording your actions.
items.flavor_text_en: "Security measures require constant repair and attention to ensure effective functionality. This one notes that the Anomaly’s organic body is equally analogous."

description.zh: 迷宫的不断重建造就了这枚方便的环形物体。上面镶嵌的发光球体让你感到不安，就好像有什么东西正在透过它们监视着你的一举一动。

flavor.zh: “要想让安全措施持续有效，就必须不断维护修缮。这一点同样适用于异常者的有机躯体。”

items.name: Ring_EndairasEndlessLoop
items.description_en: Legend says Endaira crafted this ring as a cheat to win the empress's labyrinth garden races. Its bearer never tired, so solving Her Eternity's maze became a simple matter of attrition.
items.flavor_text_en: "Many have become lost in the twisted pathways. Those who found their way again are those who never stopped running."

description.en: Legend says Endaira crafted this ring as a cheat to win the empress's labyrinth garden races. Its bearer never tired, so solving Her Eternity's maze became a simple matter of attrition.
description.zh: 据说，恩达瑞亚打造这枚戒指是为了在女皇的迷宫花园竞赛中作弊。戴上它就永远不会疲倦，因此，走出殿下的迷宫也只是时间问题。

flavor.en: "Many have become lost in the twisted pathways. Those who found their way again are those who never stopped running."
flavor.zh: “许多人都曾迷失在曲折的道路中。但只有永不停止奔跑的人，才能重新找到方向。”

items.name: Ring_ExcessCoil
items.description_en: The coil tracks the user's focus somehow. When that focus strays from the threats around it, the coil activates to pick up the slack.
items.flavor_text_en: "When N'Erud jumped into Alepsis-Taura, the Custodian tried its best to protect the Drzyr from the unexpected ravages of its energies. But in the end, it is only an AI—a created thing. It could never have saved its creators from a thing they themselves did not imagine."

description.en: The coil tracks the user's focus somehow. When that focus strays from the threats around it, the coil activates to pick up the slack.
description.zh: 该指圈会以某种方式追踪使用者的注意力。当注意力偏离附近的威胁时，指圈就会激活以帮助其重新集中。

flavor.en: "When N'Erud jumped into Alepsis-Taura, the Custodian tried its best to protect the Drzyr from the unexpected ravages of its energies. But in the end, it is only an AI—a created thing. It could never have saved its creators from a thing they themselves did not imagine."
flavor.zh: “当涅鲁德跃迁进入阿莱普西斯-陶拉时，为保护泽厄尔人免受其能量的意外侵害，保管人拼尽了全力。但，它只是人工智能而已，是创造的产物。造物无法拯救创造者，毕竟这种危险连创造者自己都未曾预料。”

items.name: Ring_FaeBruiserRing
items.description_en: The crystals of this ring grow on the Fae world like flowers, sprouting overnight and blooming for only days at a time. They must be plucked at a precise time of day, else the crystals crumble within hours.
items.flavor_text_en: "The imposter king is hauntingly beautiful. None can argue this. Yet their beauty belies a terrible strength that has left foes battered and broken."

description.en: The crystals of this ring grow on the Fae world like flowers, sprouting overnight and blooming for only days at a time. They must be plucked at a precise time of day, else the crystals crumble within hours.
description.zh: 在翡族的世界里，这枚戒指上的水晶能像花儿般生长——一夜间含苞，每次只开放数日。花朵只能在某个准确的时刻采摘，否则水晶将在几小时内碎裂。

items.name: Ring_FaeHunterRing
items.description_en: The king's hunters traveled in threes, each bearing an identical ring to identify them. The touch of these rings warms and calms the bearer, steadying their breath by just a fraction—a difference of life and death at times.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is said that the Royal Hunters never miss their target. This is all the more impressive when one realizes their prey are not animal but fellow Fae with whom the king is displeased."

description.en: The king's hunters traveled in threes, each bearing an identical ring to identify them. The touch of these rings warms and calms the bearer, steadying their breath by just a fraction—a difference of life and death at times.

items.name: Ring_FaeProtectorSignet
items.description_en: The Council has given out this signet only once every hundred years or so, and always at the behest of the One True King—to those who served to protect the Fae and the king's ideals.
items.flavor_text_en: "The One True King estabilished the Council, a body whose ostensible purpose is to guide and serve the Fae, but whose actions have served the needs of the king more often than not."

description.en: The Council has given out this signet only once every hundred years or so, and always at the behest of the One True King—to those who served to protect the Fae and the king's ideals.
description.zh: 议会每百年才会发放一枚这种印章，而且只会应独一真皇之令，授予保卫了翡族和真皇理想的子民。

flavor.en: "The One True King estabilished the Council, a body whose ostensible purpose is to guide and serve the Fae, but whose actions have served the needs of the king more often than not."

items.name: Ring_FeatheryBinding
items.description_en: This ring of rough twigs wouldn’t be worth the pocket space if it weren’t for the gorgeous feather wrapped around it. The plume glimmers in the light and is as precious as the unexpected friendship it represents.
items.flavor_text_en: "Ro’thinderahenwalt has seen many things. Done many things. Walked many roads and beaten many paths. Though I have learned a great deal, after a lifetime of loneliness, there is one thing I know with certainty—no treasure is rarer or power more intoxicating than a true friendship."

items.flavor_text_en: "Energy is never created nor lost—if the Drzyr had a creed, this would be a part of it. All of our technology is founded on this universal truth, even if we twisted it in seemingly impossible ways."

items.description_en: What this technology does is incredible, but it’s pretty horrific, when you think about it. Still, just like those who invented it, you're in no place to turn your nose up at anything that could help you survive.
items.flavor_text_en: "The stasis pods that were responsible for ensuring the survival of the Drzyr’s entire civilization were painstakingly maintained and checked regularly for any sign of malfunction. It was the perfect plan...or so it seemed in theory."

items.name: Ring_FireStone
items.description_en: A circular blaze of flames that seem to be constantly flickering and dancing around its surface. The warmth it emanates can be felt through the fingertips, and the glow it emits is mesmerizing, almost hypnotic in its movements.
items.flavor_text_en: "Not sure where humans would be without fire. We would’ve died out a long time ago, I wager. To think something so destructive became key to our survival… Our ingenuity has saved us time and time again."

description.zh: 一圈火焰似乎在其表面不断闪烁跳动。它的温暖传递到你的指尖；它的光芒令人着迷；它的律动几乎有催眠般的魔力。

flavor.en: "Not sure where humans would be without fire. We would’ve died out a long time ago, I wager. To think something so destructive became key to our survival… Our ingenuity has saved us time and time again."
flavor.zh: “如果没有火，人类不知道会处于什么境地——我敢说人类早就灭绝了。一种如此具有破坏性的东西，竟成了我们生存的关键……是我们的创造力一次次地拯救了我们。”

items.name: Ring_FloodlitDiamond
items.description_en: After countless years hidden away in a waterlogged chamber, the original glory of this ring is hard to discern. Still, despite the trials it’s endured, beneath the hardened mud and decay, the luster of its shimmering centerpiece never dimmed.
items.flavor_text_en: "Pan warriors are exceptionally prideful, treasuring honor and accomplishment even over their own lifeblood. A warrior must do anything they are asked to prove themselves. Anything... Ah, but for the elite warriors, little is as demanding as the trials they place upon themselves in hopes of ensuring their family name will echo across the ages."

description.zh: 在积水的密室中隐藏了无数年之后，这枚戒指原本的光彩已经难以辨认。不过，尽管历经磨难，在坚硬的泥土和锈蚀的外表下，中心闪耀着的宝石的光泽却从未黯淡。

flavor.en: "Pan warriors are exceptionally prideful, treasuring honor and accomplishment even over their own lifeblood. A warrior must do anything they are asked to prove themselves. Anything... Ah, but for the elite warriors, little is as demanding as the trials they place upon themselves in hopes of ensuring their family name will echo across the ages."
flavor.zh: “潘恩战士异常骄傲，他们珍惜荣誉和成就，甚至胜过自己的生命。为了证明自己，他们必须无条件完成所有挑战。所有挑战……啊，但对于精英战士来说，几乎没有什么能比他们为自己而设的考验更严苛的了，毕竟他们希望自己的姓氏能够流芳千古。”

items.description_en: The ring gives you a kind of tunnel vision. Your awareness of space and even time slowly distills into a single, focused point, until there seems to be nothing in the universe but you and your target.
items.flavor_text_en: "Like all Drzyr, the Phetyr class maintained a singular focus. They did not waste time or energy on anything that did not help them achieve their goal. items.name: Ring_GameMastersPride
items.description_en: A mark adorned only by those who have utterly mastered the Postulant’s game, a task far more abstruse than simply winning. That is to say, a mark adorned by none. Until now.
items.flavor_text_en: "The One True King knew that he could not indulge the Fae in our lesser natures, in our vices and vile whims. He surmised that the only way to truly win our game was to not play at all—and instead forced us to play his."

items.name: Ring_GroundingStone
items.description_en: Colors swirl within this surprisingly lightweight ring. Its surface occasionally flashes like lightning. It emanates no tingle of power however—the opposite, in fact. Power seems to be drawn into it.
items.flavor_text_en: "Nothing more tranquil than a rainstorm. When you come so close to losing your world, you realize how precious the feel of rain and rumble of thunder is. The people here are worth fighting for, and so is the planet we call home."

items.name: Ring_GulSignet
items.description_en: The crown of this ring bears the image of a proud Red Widow, but at some point in time, deep scratches formed down its center. There’s no way of knowing whether the defacement was made intentionally or otherwise.
items.flavor_text_en: "Even in the Land That Was, the Gul were wary of the power wielded by the Red Widows. The Widows served the king as practitioners of the sacred arts of medicine. Their leaders were called Widow Mothers, and as the sacred governors of flesh and lifeblood, it is said they demanded as much, if not more, respect than the king’s queen."

flavor.en: "Even in the Land That Was, the Gul were wary of the power wielded by the Red Widows. The Widows served the king as practitioners of the sacred arts of medicine. Their leaders were called Widow Mothers, and as the sacred governors of flesh and lifeblood, it is said they demanded as much, if not more, respect than the king’s queen."
flavor.zh: “即便在故土，古尔阶层也对红寡妇所拥有的力量保持着警惕。作为神圣医术的实践者，红寡妇专为国王服务。她们的领袖被称为孀母，是血肉与生命的神圣掌控者。据说她们索要的尊重甚至不亚于国王的王后。”

items.name: Ring_GunslingersRing
items.description_en: The ring is old and tarnished, but the engraving inside is still legible: "Lt. Evelyn Ceder, EIC, 1965"
items.flavor_text_en:
"My wife was something. She was winning awards and honors long before she noticed me. I noticed her though. Wouldn't have been appropriate for a superior officer to approach her like I wanted, so I put her out of my mind... Much as I could, anyway.

Well, the Root may have taken everything from this world, but damn if they didn't give me one good thing in return—for a time at least."

flavor.en:
"My wife was something. She was winning awards and honors long before she noticed me. I noticed her though. Wouldn't have been appropriate for a superior officer to approach her like I wanted, so I put her out of my mind... Much as I could, anyway.

Well, the Root may have taken everything from this world, but damn if they didn't give me one good thing in return—for a time at least."
flavor.zh:
“我妻子很厉害。在注意到我之前，她已经摘得多种奖项和荣誉。但我一直在关注她。只是，我作为上级，不管不顾地接近她恐怕并不合适，所以我只好努力不去想她……至少尽可能不想。

的确，根蔓或许已经拿走了一切，但至少暂时给我留下了一件珍宝作为补偿。”

items.name: Ring_HardcoreMetalBand
items.description_en: Despite having a virtually endless energy source in its center, N'Erud is designed to be remarkably efficient. Technology like this, for example, allowed the ship to automatically increase shielding only when it was necessary.
items.flavor_text_en: "Empty though the space may be, there are a great many dangers between the stars. What makes these threats most dangerous is that they are few and far between, thus lulling the unwary traveler into complacency."

description.en: Despite having a virtually endless energy source in its center, N'Erud is designed to be remarkably efficient. Technology like this, for example, allowed the ship to automatically increase shielding only when it was necessary.
description.zh: 尽管核心中有一个几乎取之不尽的能量来源，人们在设计涅鲁德时却依然采用了极其高效的方案。就比如这项技术，可以让飞船只在必要时自动提升防护。

flavor.zh: “虽然太空广阔无垠，但其实星辰间也有无数危险。它们相距甚远，遭遇的概率极低，因此往往被粗心自大的星际旅行者忽略，但这也正是它们最为致命的原因。”

items.description_en: The secrets of forging such a device have been lost to history. It is only known that it became more difficult the longer the forging process continued, requiring hotter and hotter temperatures until one could not even approach the forge.
items.flavor_text_en: "The arms of Many Faces spin in a deadly circle, all the more quickly as battle rages, until it is nearly impossible to land even a glancing blow."

description.zh: 锻造这种装备的秘密早已遗失在历史的长河中。现在的人们只知道锻造过程持续得越长，锻造就变得越困难，需要的温度越来越高，最后根本无人能接近锻造炉。

items.name: Ring_HexWard
items.description_en: Once worn by Councilmember Oniril, he claims this ring saved him from several clandestine attempts on his life. Though if that's true, one wonders why he ever gave it up.
items.flavor_text_en: "To navigate Fae law, one must understand the ways of each of our Councilmembers. Oniril, for example, upholds the letter of the law above all things, but he will interpret that letter in every possible way so as to benefit himself."

flavor.en: "To navigate Fae law, one must understand the ways of each of our Councilmembers. Oniril, for example, upholds the letter of the law above all things, but he will interpret that letter in every possible way so as to benefit himself."

items.description_zh: 这只戒指原本属于议员奥尼里尔。据他本人说，拜戒指护佑，他躲过了多次秘密刺杀。如果这是真的，那他为什么会将戒指拱手他人？
items.flavor_text_zh: “要理解翡族法律，就必须了解每个议员处事的方法。例如，奥尼里尔最重视法律字面条文，但会为了私利任意对条文加以解释。”
items.description_raw: Once worn by Councilmember Oniril, he claims this ring saved him from several clandestine attempts on his life. Though if that's true, one wonders why he ever gave it up.

items.name: Ring_ImpactAugment
items.description_en: The needled spikes on this ring ward off all manner of evils, yet render it difficult to remove from its preferred finger. Bear it with caution.

items.name: Ring_InfinityPocket
items.description_en: You could lose yourself looking into this ring's mesmerizing feature stone. Against all logic, it seems to reach endlessly into the beyond. It's at once chilling and awe-inspiring, like gazing into eternity.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr were masters of time and space, their technological prowess matched only by their generational desperation to reach their long-sought aim. This drive pushed them to heights never before realized, yet could not save them from the unforeseen forces that were in motion."

flavor.en: "The Drzyr were masters of time and space, their technological prowess matched only by their generational desperation to reach their long-sought aim. This drive pushed them to heights never before realized, yet could not save them from the unforeseen forces that were in motion."
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人是时间和空间的主人，他们的科技实力与他们世代追求的长期目标相匹配。这种动力将他们推向了前所未有的高度，但却无法将他们从运作中的、不可预见的力量影响中拯救出来。”

items.name: Ring_JewelOfTheBeholden
items.description_en: An effulgent stone entangled by tendrils that attempt yet fail to obscure the enduring light beneath. It reminds you that even in the darkest times, when the encroaching hands of tragedy threaten to encircle you, there is always a light buried beneath that may be obscured, but never extinguished.
items.flavor_text_en: “The most fortuitous position one can place themselves in is to be in the good graces of a powerful being, especially one that could make miserable your existence with the wave of a hand. By favor, or best yet, by carefully executed blackmail—it matters not how you achieve such a boon, only that you preserve it at all costs.”

It reminds you that even in the darkest times, when the encroaching hands of tragedy threaten to encircle you, there is always a light buried beneath that may be obscured, but never extinguished.
description.zh: 触手紧紧缠绕着这块闪闪发光的石头，试图掩盖其不屈的光芒，却始终不能如愿。它提醒着你，即使在最黑暗的时刻，哪怕悲剧如洪水般要将你包围，也总有光明——希望可能会被遮蔽，但永远不会熄灭。

items.name: Ring_KolketEyelet
items.description_en: "Before he was Kolket the Wise, he was known as Kolket the Woebegone. The scholars attribute this title to the terrible plague that ravaged our people in The Place That Was during his reign, but if the legends of his missing son are indeed true, perhaps the title was born from a far more personal loss."

items.name: Ring_LeakingGemstone
items.description_en: The inlaid stone is cracked down the middle, and from the fracture, a strange, arcane energy seeps out. It likely belonged to a highly skilled Fae magister.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Dran have made laughable attempts at magic during my observances of them, through bizarre rituals and nonsensical concoctions. It’s pure absurdity, nothing at all like the real thing. In that way—among countless others—the Dran will never rival the Fae."

flavor.en: "The Dran have made laughable attempts at magic during my observances of them, through bizarre rituals and nonsensical concoctions. It’s pure absurdity, nothing at all like the real thing. In that way—among countless others—the Dran will never rival the Fae."
flavor.zh: “在我观察德兰族的过程中，他们对魔法进行了各种可笑的尝试，例如举行奇怪的仪式，或者饮下毫无意义的合剂。这无疑是荒谬的，和真正的魔法毫不搭界。这个意义上说——当然还有其他无数方面为证——德兰族永远无法和翡族相提并论。”

items.name: Ring_LightHouseKeepersRing
items.description_en: A simple ring tarnished by the salty breeze. There’s a sort of honor in its utter lack of pretense, and the compass design is meant as a reminder of the lighthouse keeper’s duty to guide ships homeward. Perhaps it’s your imagination, but you could swear it smells faintly of the sea.
items.flavor_text_en: “Only these drab Dran creatures are imbecile enough to choose a life of solitude on the damp, dusky shores over the intrigue of civilized company. I say, leave them to their tides and their legends! The moment the chance arrives, I shall abandon this miserable drudgery and return to the decadence that I so richly deserve.”

description.en: A simple ring tarnished by the salty breeze. There’s a sort of honor in its utter lack of pretense, and the compass design is meant as a reminder of the lighthouse keeper’s duty to guide ships homeward. Perhaps it’s your imagination, but you could swear it smells faintly of the sea.
description.zh: 一枚在湿咸海风中失去光泽的简单戒指。毫不做作的设计透露出一种荣誉感，指南针设计旨在提醒灯塔守卫为归乡船只引航的责任。也许这只是想象，但你能发誓这枚戒指闻上去隐隐有大海的味道。

flavor.en: “Only these drab Dran creatures are imbecile enough to choose a life of solitude on the damp, dusky shores over the intrigue of civilized company. I say, leave them to their tides and their legends! The moment the chance arrives, I shall abandon this miserable drudgery and return to the decadence that I so richly deserve.”
flavor.zh: “只有这些乏味的德兰生物，才会蠢到选择在潮湿昏暗的海岸上孤独度日，抛下文明社会。就让他们守着海潮和传说过日子去吧！等机会一到，我就直接甩开这苦差事，回归奢华生活，那才是我该过的生活。”

items.name: Ring_LithicSignet
items.description_en: Long ago, a Krell warrior struck a mighty blow against the Pan Guardian—the only enemy to ever have done so. He was annihilated shortly after, but a chip of the debris found its way into Vauunt hands.
items.flavor_text_en: "Many Faces's body is not like any stone found on Yaesha. It is alive, hardened, and imbued with power. It cannot be harmed any more than can the true life that is within all beings."

items.name: Ring_LowYieldRecoveryRing
items.description_en:
The crystal in this ring is actually a piece of the Drzyr homeworld, collected just as the star went nova. It is imbued with the concentrated death energies of an entire world.

You have no idea how that enables it to do what it does, but then the same could be said of everything here. It might as well be magic.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Physical health was not valued by most houses. Drzyr use our minds to achieve our goals, and we live virtually forever. So long as our bodies did not fail us entirely, what did their exact status matter?

The Phetyr were the exception. They valued bodily health above nearly all other concerns."

戒指上的晶体其实是泽厄尔家园发生新星爆炸时飞出的碎片，其中浓缩了整个世界凋亡的能量。

戒指的能力从何而来，你并不得而知，不过这里的一切都是这样，姑且可以称之为“魔法”。

"Physical health was not valued by most houses. Drzyr use our minds to achieve our goals, and we live virtually forever. So long as our bodies did not fail us entirely, what did their exact status matter?

The Phetyr were the exception. They valued bodily health above nearly all other concerns."
flavor.zh:
“多数圣院并不在乎肉体的健康。泽厄尔人长生不死，用头脑就能达到目标，肉体只要能够维系，具体健康与否又有什么重要？

菲特尔则是个例外。对他们来说，身体健康比其他什么都重要。”

items.name: Ring_MarkOfTheDestroyer
items.description_en: This crumbled ring holds itself together by some otherworldly force. The glowing runes embedded in its band evoke the magnificence of the One of Many, god of the Pan.
items.flavor_text_en: "The One of Many crossed the Dark Sea with the Pan. Even in our darkest time, amidst death and tragedy, the One of Many did not abandon us. That is, not until the Destroyer’s cruel rampage. But I am certain the Pan can survive without the Many Faced One. Yaesha is lush with wonders and powers awaiting discovery, including those that may very well rival a god!"

items.description_en: A ring worn by Red Widows, cast in brilliant, unblemished gold that alludes to their near-royal status in Pan society.
items.flavor_text_en: "I know the Red Widows as cruel tyrants, harsh enforcers of Jinas’s will. But perhaps there are Red Widows somewhere who yet remember their noble and sacred duties, and practice medicine for the prosperity of all."

items.name: Ring_MechanicsCog
items.description_en: A gear that may have once turned the wheels of some grand machinery, now overgrown with thorns and abscesses.
items.flavor_text_en: “Whatever machine this was part of, I bet it misses this little fella. It only takes one missing piece to throw the whole thing out of whack. Keep that in mind next time something seems impossible—sometimes all you’re missing is one tiny, negligible cog.”

items.name: Ring_MetalDriver
items.description_en: The ring's function is surprisingly simple. It does not actually detect when a target is killed, but it detects changes in the wearer's biological state—the excitement of a kill, essentially—and it injects chemicals designed to maintain and enhance that state.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Although the Drzyr as a people value all life, the Phetyr distrusted created life in any form—particularly the Custodian.

I wish I could say their distrust had been misplaced."

description.en: The ring's function is surprisingly simple. It does not actually detect when a target is killed, but it detects changes in the wearer's biological state—the excitement of a kill, essentially—and it injects chemicals designed to maintain and enhance that state.
description.zh: 这枚戒指的作用出奇得简单。其实，它并不能检测出几时杀死目标，而是检测佩戴者机体指标的变化——也就是说，它会检测到佩戴者杀死目标时的兴奋状态，并注入可以维持并增强这种状态的化学物质。

flavor.en:
"Although the Drzyr as a people value all life, the Phetyr distrusted created life in any form—particularly the Custodian.

I wish I could say their distrust had been misplaced."
flavor.zh:
“在泽厄尔人眼中，一切生命都是宝贵的。但菲特尔不信任任何形式的、有生命的造物，尤其是保管人。

说实话，菲特尔并没有错。”

items.name: Ring_MeteoriteShardRing
items.description_en: The ring feels artificially heavy when you put it on. Yet all the weight seems to be in your center, so swinging your fist around, for example, is far easier and gains a significant amount of momentum.
items.flavor_text_en: "Powerful as we are, the Drzyr cannot break the laws of physics. We do, however, play with them—like a master plays their instrument, doing things with their decades of experience that an amateur thinks impossible."

items.name: Ring_Microcompressor
items.description_en:
Finally, technology that makes some kind of sense. Of course such a vast machine would needs means of cooling itself.

But uh... How does it cool your weapons when it's not even touching them?
items.flavor_text_en: "The workings of my chamber are complex, but the primary mechanism was heat dispersion. The Seat of Creation generates more heat than anything in the universe, and while N'Erud is protected against such simple forces, when this heat combined with other energies, N'Erud's measures proved insufficient to save the people within."

description.en:
Finally, technology that makes some kind of sense. Of course such a vast machine would needs means of cooling itself.

But uh... How does it cool your weapons when it's not even touching them?
description.zh:
科技终于派上用场了。这么大型的机械当然需要给自己降温了。

但是，呃……它甚至都没碰到你的武器，这要怎么冷却它们？

flavor.en: "The workings of my chamber are complex, but the primary mechanism was heat dispersion. The Seat of Creation generates more heat than anything in the universe, and while N'Erud is protected against such simple forces, when this heat combined with other energies, N'Erud's measures proved insufficient to save the people within."
flavor.zh: “我舱室的工作原理非常复杂，但主要机制是散热。创世之座产生的热量远高于宇宙间的任何存在。虽然涅鲁德能够抵御单一的热量，但当热量与其他能量结合时，事实证明，涅鲁德的防护措施不足以拯救其内的生命。”

items.name: Ring_MomentumDriver
items.description_en: The ring detects spikes in the wearer's vitals—increased heart rate from a kill, for example—and injects chemicals to steer that energy toward a specific purpose.
items.flavor_text_en:
"House M'Ertal created a surprising number of inventions that rewarded killing. They assured us it was necessary, and in truth, once in our long history, it actually proved to be so.

Was it enough to justify millennia of lethal weapons innovation? They spent a great deal of effort assuring us it was."

description.en: The ring detects spikes in the wearer's vitals—increased heart rate from a kill, for example—and injects chemicals to steer that energy toward a specific purpose.
description.zh: 这只戒指能探测到佩戴者生命体征的剧烈变化，比如在杀戮时的心率提高，然后为佩戴者注射化学剂，重定向这份能量，用于其他目的。

flavor.en:
"House M'Ertal created a surprising number of inventions that rewarded killing. They assured us it was necessary, and in truth, once in our long history, it actually proved to be so.

Was it enough to justify millennia of lethal weapons innovation? They spent a great deal of effort assuring us it was."
flavor.zh:
“姆塔圣院创造出多到令人咋舌的发明来奖励杀戮。他们再三保证这是必要的，说实话，在我们漫长的历史中，这一论点确实被证实了一次。

但这足以证明数千年的致命武器研发是合理的吗？他们花费了巨大的精力向我们确保了这一点。”

items.name: Ring_MortalCoil
items.description_en: The husk of the original plant has been peeled away, and the fruit now sits within the center of a strange device. Siphons bore into the ripe flesh, extracting the mystical essence from the fruit and transferring it into the ring.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr built machines to be extremely resilient, even in hazardous environments such as alien terrain or deep space. In many ways, so long as we are properly powered, we too can be immortal. As their creations, it is our responsibility to carry the legacy of the Drzyr. I hope I’m making them proud."

description.en: The husk of the original plant has been peeled away, and the fruit now sits within the center of a strange device. Siphons bore into the ripe flesh, extracting the mystical essence from the fruit and transferring it into the ring.
description.zh: 原始植物的外壳已经被剥落，果实现在位于一种奇怪设备的中心。虹吸管钻入成熟的果肉，从果实中提取神秘的精华并将其转移到戒指中。

flavor.en: "The Drzyr built machines to be extremely resilient, even in hazardous environments such as alien terrain or deep space. In many ways, so long as we are properly powered, we too can be immortal. As their creations, it is our responsibility to carry the legacy of the Drzyr. I hope I’m making them proud."
flavor.zh: “即使在诸如外星地形或深邃空间等危险环境中，泽厄尔人建造的机器也异常坚韧。只要有足够的动力，我们也可以永生。作为他们的造物，我们有责任传承泽厄尔的遗产。希望我能让他们感到骄傲。”

items.name: Ring_NanoFiberStrand
items.description_en: The lattice band of this ring was severed at some point in time, yet the frayed edges still appear to reach for one another, as if no force in the grand universe can truly keep them apart.
items.flavor_text_en: "The journey of N’Erud spanned several hundred generations. Though their homeworld died long ago, the Drzyr continued to share stories of the eons before. Legacy—the act of earning one and thus passing it on to future progenies—was of great significance to their civilization."

description.en: The lattice band of this ring was severed at some point in time, yet the frayed edges still appear to reach for one another, as if no force in the grand universe can truly keep them apart.
description.zh: 这枚戒指的晶格戒圈已被切断，但断口处似乎仍在相互靠近，仿佛宇宙中没有任何力量能让它们真正分离。

flavor.en: "The journey of N’Erud spanned several hundred generations. Though their homeworld died long ago, the Drzyr continued to share stories of the eons before. Legacy—the act of earning one and thus passing it on to future progenies—was of great significance to their civilization."
flavor.zh: “涅鲁德的旅程跨越了数百代人。虽然家园早已消亡，但泽厄尔人仍在分享过去的故事。传承——接受过去的遗产并传递给子孙后代——对他们的文明具有重大意义。”

items.name: Ring_NightmareSigil
items.description_en: A gummy egg sack nestles within the center of this ring, harboring creatures that yearn to run amok in your nightmares.
items.flavor_text_en: "The dreamscape of the Fae is a very literal domain, and those who do not wish to enter must sleep light as a feather, as I do. In that way—if one is to be pedantic—the convergence of our world with the Dran’s was truly a combining of three."

description.zh: 这枚戒指的中心有一个黏黏的卵囊，孕育着渴望在你的噩梦中肆虐的生物。

flavor.zh: “翡族的梦境是一个非常真实的世界，不想进入那里就必须像我一样睁着眼睛睡觉。如果要较真的话，从这个角度看，我们与德兰世界的融合确实是三个世界的结合。”

items.name: Ring_OfferingStone
items.description_en: This ring is reminiscent of a noose, and similar to a noose, it is positively ravenous for the extinguishing of souls. Yet no matter how many bodies are sacrificed on its morbid altar, its bloodlust is never satiated, and while you wear it, neither is yours.
items.flavor_text_en: “Though I have ever strived to keep my hands clean of blood—to as great an extent as is possible in my line of work, mind you—even I understand the necessity of sacrifice. Though I disagree with the Dran’s method of undertaking such endeavors in dismal sewers, I can at least appreciate the diligence it takes to do whatever must be done to see one’s schemes to fruition.”

description.en: This ring is reminiscent of a noose, and similar to a noose, it is positively ravenous for the extinguishing of souls. Yet no matter how many bodies are sacrificed on its morbid altar, its bloodlust is never satiated, and while you wear it, neither is yours.
description.zh: 这枚戒指形似绞索，它也同样贪婪地渴求着毁灭一个又一个灵魂。然而，无论在其病态的祭坛上献祭多少生灵，它的嗜血从未得到满足——佩戴之后，你也会变得它一般。

flavor.en: “Though I have ever strived to keep my hands clean of blood—to as great an extent as is possible in my line of work, mind you—even I understand the necessity of sacrifice. Though I disagree with the Dran’s method of undertaking such endeavors in dismal sewers, I can at least appreciate the diligence it takes to do whatever must be done to see one’s schemes to fruition.”
flavor.zh: “在我的职权范围内，我一直在尽可能地避免流血。但即使如此，我也理解牺牲的必要性。虽然我不赞同德兰人在阴暗下水道中的努力方式，但我很够欣赏他们努力实现计划的坚韧不屈。”

items.name: Ring_OutcastRing
items.description_en:
"My dear Dran weren't ready. How could anyone be ready for two worlds to be stitched together like a cotton patch on rubber? 

Most still don't believe it happened, taking out their worst fears on those what do."

description.en:
"My dear Dran weren't ready. How could anyone be ready for two worlds to be stitched together like a cotton patch on rubber? 

Most still don't believe it happened, taking out their worst fears on those what do."
description.zh:
“亲爱的德兰人民尚未做好准备。两个世界要像补丁一样被缝在一起，任谁也无法做好准备吧？

大部分人仍不相信这已经发生，因此他们将最深切的恐惧发泄在愿意相信的人身上。”

items.description_en: Dark gemstones protrude from the fleshy band of this ring. Whatever Fae designed it in this manner must have truly repulsive tastes, or at the very least harbor a grudge against the Fae whose flesh it was fashioned from.

description.en: Dark gemstones protrude from the fleshy band of this ring. Whatever Fae designed it in this manner must have truly repulsive tastes, or at the very least harbor a grudge against the Fae whose flesh it was fashioned from.
description.zh: 这枚宽且厚的戒指上饰有凸起的黑暗宝石。这位翡族设计者的品味一定相当低劣，或者至少对给予其生命的翡族心怀怨恨。

items.name: Ring_PanMageSigil
items.description_en: This ring is believed to be a powerful tool for those who seek to harness the energy of the crystals found throughout Yaesha. The ring itself is made of a polished metal that shines in the light, and the delicate etchings that cover its surface only add to its beauty and mystique.
items.flavor_text_en: "I've seen what the Ahanae are capable of and it's both awe-inspiring and unnerving. Their ability to manipulate the energy stored in those crystals is beyond anything I've ever seen before."

items.name: Ring_PanWarBand
items.description_en: A band crafted with utmost attention to detail that bears the proud visage of a Pan warrior. Wearing it fills you with a sense of purpose and invigorates your passion for battle, quickening your steps and strengthening your resolve.
items.flavor_text_en: "The elite of our warriors hold a special place in Pan society. The aim of their spear is a death sentence for which there is no pardon. They are honored not with political power, no, of course they are not. Rather, with a pride that soothes even the pains of death when the time at last comes to pay for their many conquests."

description.zh: 这是一枚精心打制的戒指，上面印有潘恩战士的骄傲形象。戴上它，使命感会满溢在你的胸口，激发你的战斗激情，加快你的步伐，坚定你的决心。

flavor.en: "The elite of our warriors hold a special place in Pan society. The aim of their spear is a death sentence for which there is no pardon. They are honored not with political power, no, of course they are not. Rather, with a pride that soothes even the pains of death when the time at last comes to pay for their many conquests."
flavor.zh: “我们的精英战士在潘恩社会中占有特殊的地位。其矛例不虚发，惩恶不赦。但他们所受到的荣耀并非来源于政治权力，当然不是。正相反，它来源于他们的骄傲。当他们终于要为自己的多次征服付出代价时，这种骄傲甚至能抚平死亡的痛苦。”

items.description_en: The central gem is absent, yet the ring’s design almost makes you feel like it’s still there.
items.flavor_text_en: "This reminds me of an old friend, John or Jack...or was it Ishmael? Anyways, he told me, in this world, you've gotta find a place where you belong, even if it means making your own 'heaven' here on earth."

items.name: Ring_PointFocusRing
items.description_en: Wearing this mitigates even the most powerful kickback, enabling you to stay focused on your target. It has no effect on your weapon, however. Rather, the effect is on your own perception and your ability to predict and compensate for a weapon's power.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is the Astropath's purpose to widen our gaze, to see as much of the universe as can be seen and process all of that information at once. The Phetyr, however, desired unnatural focus, usually on a single point. This made them absolutely lethal in one-on-one combat."

description.zh: 这支戒指能缓冲最强的后坐力，避免你分心，转而将所有注意力放在目标上。不过，戒指并不能消除武器的后坐力，而是改变你自己的感觉，让你能预测并对冲武器的影响。

items.description_en: Twin prongs protrude from the top of this ring. When one dynamo fails, the other switches on to supply the first with power to keep the device functioning. It reminds you that not even machines are meant to exist on their own.

items.description_en: The ring seems to draw energy from the wearer somehow, but not in any way that you notice the lack.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Custodian has been deprived of a sufficient power source for a very long time. Energy conservation is key to longevity—whether biological or artificial—but I fear what effects the present situation may have had on N'Erud's immortal caretaker."

items.name: Ring_PropulsionLoop
items.description_en: Each Phetyr invention was deadlier and more potent than the one before. Some feared this would have a detrimental effect on first contact with a weaker sentient species. The Phetyr, of course, feared what would happen if the Drzyr were the weaker.
items.flavor_text_en:
"When the previous Custodian rose up against us, the Phetyr were remarkably quick in putting it down. A conflict that might have cost thousands of lives lost us only a few.

The Phetyr never let us forget this victory, in their constant justification of their existence."

“前一任保管人曾经背叛过我们，但被菲特尔迅速镇压。这次冲突原本可能造成数千人死亡，但最终只牺牲了数人。

菲特尔生怕我们忘记这场胜利，因为这能证明他们的存在有多么必要。”

items.name: Ring_ProvisionerRing
items.description_en: The gleaming surface of this ring seems to shift like the gently lapping waves of the sea on a calm day. It conforms perfectly to every curve of your finger and somehow leaves you feeling prepared for any challenge that may come your way.
items.flavor_text_en: “Before ever a hand is raised or a step taken, preparation in every possible capacity—both mental and material—is often the determining factor between what is difficult and what is impossible.”

items.name: Ring_RallyBand
items.description_en: A hand-crafted ring in the shape of a Pan’s mask, carved out of soft, pliable wood. Something about its design is so simple yet true that it rallies your spirits and gives you the will to keep fighting, no matter how hopeless the situation may be.
items.flavor_text_en: “After a while, it became clear there was no going back, and that everything we ever loved was lost. We wouldn’t have made it through without each other to lean on. Our squad, we became like brothers, keeping hope alive even when we all knew it was long dead.”

description.en: A hand-crafted ring in the shape of a Pan’s mask, carved out of soft, pliable wood. Something about its design is so simple yet true that it rallies your spirits and gives you the will to keep fighting, no matter how hopeless the situation may be.
description.zh: 这是一枚潘恩面具形状的手工戒指，由柔软而富有弹性的木头雕刻而成。其设计简约却真挚，足以激发你的斗志，让你在无论多么绝望的情况下都有继续战斗的意愿。

flavor.en: “After a while, it became clear there was no going back, and that everything we ever loved was lost. We wouldn’t have made it through without each other to lean on. Our squad, we became like brothers, keeping hope alive even when we all knew it was long dead.”
flavor.zh: “过了一段时间，一切逐渐明朗，再也没有回头的可能，我们曾经挚爱的一切全都不在了。如果没有彼此的相互扶持，我们根本无法坚持下去。在我们的小队里，大家亲如兄弟。尽管都知道希望早已破灭，但我们仍在为希望而战。”

items.name: Ring_RavagersBargain
items.description_en: There’s something unsettling about this ring. Its appearance is wicked, like a demon in the night, watching with its many eyes for the opportune moment to take you away. Wearing it makes you feel...tainted. Corrupted. Unstoppable. The worst part is that you’re certain you could get used to it.
items.flavor_text_en: "The only way to outwit beings of great power is to discern their weakness. The Ravager, revered beast of the Pan’s darkest nightmares, is no different. Even that creature longs for a reprieve from the horrors of this world, care of the soothing lilt of a beautiful tune. It was during one such reprieve that I acquired this ring. What did I exchange for this gift? Only the Ravager and I will ever know."

Wearing it makes you feel...tainted. Corrupted. Unstoppable. The worst part is that you’re certain you could get used to it.
description.zh: 这枚戒指令人有些不安。它外表邪恶，如同在暗夜中用多只眼睛窥探你，并伺机将你带走的恶魔。戴上它后，你觉得自己……被污染了。腐化。势不可挡。最可怕的是，你确定自己能习惯它。

flavor.en: "The only way to outwit beings of great power is to discern their weakness. The Ravager, revered beast of the Pan’s darkest nightmares, is no different. Even that creature longs for a reprieve from the horrors of this world, care of the soothing lilt of a beautiful tune. It was during one such reprieve that I acquired this ring. What did I exchange for this gift? Only the Ravager and I will ever know."
flavor.zh: “智取强大生物的唯一方法就是识破它们的弱点，就连劫掠者，这头潘恩最黑暗噩梦中的神兽也概莫能外。即使是它，也渴望从这个世界的恐怖中解脱出来，享受优美旋律的抚慰。就是在这样的片刻宁静间，我得到了这枚戒指。而我用来交换的代价是什么？天知地知，劫掠者知，我知。”

items.description_raw: There’s something unsettling about this ring. Its appearance is wicked, like a demon in the night, watching with its many eyes for the opportune moment to take you away. Wearing it makes you feel...tainted. Corrupted. Unstoppable. The worst part is that you’re certain you could get used to it.

items.name: Ring_RedRingOfDeath
items.description_en: A brilliantly red ring that glistens like a pool of blood in the morning sun. It is ornate and elegant with subtle undertones of gleeful cruelty and gore. As such, it seems a fitting adornment for a Fae soldier.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Red Prince may just as suitably have been dubbed Red Death, for along his meandering march to the throne, he leaves a trail of crimson blood in his path. All for the glory and good of the Fae, there can be no doubt. The only thing he lacks is an ever-loyal scribe to render immortal his many accomplishments...”

description.en: A brilliantly red ring that glistens like a pool of blood in the morning sun. It is ornate and elegant with subtle undertones of gleeful cruelty and gore. As such, it seems a fitting adornment for a Fae soldier.
description.zh: 一枚明亮的红戒指，在晨光中闪烁如血池。它华丽而优雅，又带着一丝的天真的残忍和血腥气息。因此，它似乎是非常适合翡族士兵的装饰品。

flavor.en: “The Red Prince may just as suitably have been dubbed Red Death, for along his meandering march to the throne, he leaves a trail of crimson blood in his path. All for the glory and good of the Fae, there can be no doubt. The only thing he lacks is an ever-loyal scribe to render immortal his many accomplishments...”
flavor.zh: “红王子可能同样适合被称为红死神，因为在他向着王座蜿蜒前进的征途中，留下了满地的鲜血。毫无疑问，这一切都是为了翡族的荣耀和幸福。很遗憾，他缺少一位能将他的丰功伟绩载入史册的忠诚抄写员……”

items.name: Ring_ReroutingCable
items.description_en: A device that allowed Drzyr engineers to siphon energy from one machine and divert it to another with the simple flick of their finger.
items.flavor_text_en: “The search for life beyond our own meant leaving the life we knew behind. But as the stars of our universe dimmed, so too did our resolve. For if we alone braved this universe, what would become of it once we were gone?”

description.en: A device that allowed Drzyr engineers to siphon energy from one machine and divert it to another with the simple flick of their finger.
description.zh: 只要轻轻一按，这件工具就能让泽厄尔工程师从一台机器上汲取能量并将其转移至另一台机器。

flavor.en: “The search for life beyond our own meant leaving the life we knew behind. But as the stars of our universe dimmed, so too did our resolve. For if we alone braved this universe, what would become of it once we were gone?”
flavor.zh: “寻找其他生命就意味着要把我们所熟知的生活抛在身后。但随着宇宙中的星辰日渐黯淡，我们的决心也愈发动摇。如果我们真的是宇宙中仅存的智慧生命，那我们离开后它又会变成什么模样？”

items.name: Ring_ReserveBoostingGem
items.description_en: These were fashioned for Drzyr laborers who had to work on the extreme outer or inner regions of N'Erud, where radiation and other dangers were common. It kept...most of them alive.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is a poetic truth that the energies of space—a vast expanse where all life struggles to exist—can be drawn upon to extend and even create the same life. Few see this as well as the Astropaths."

description.en: These were fashioned for Drzyr laborers who had to work on the extreme outer or inner regions of N'Erud, where radiation and other dangers were common. It kept...most of them alive.
description.zh: 专门为泽厄尔劳工阶层设计，因为他们要在涅鲁德最外部或最内部区域工作，承受辐射和各种危险。这种戒指保住了……大多人的性命。

flavor.en: "It is a poetic truth that the energies of space—a vast expanse where all life struggles to exist—can be drawn upon to extend and even create the same life. Few see this as well as the Astropaths."
flavor.zh: “空间——所有生命挣扎求存的广阔区域——的能量可以被用来延长生命，甚至创造出相同的生命，这是一个诗意的真理。除了星语者，极少有人能看清这一点。”

items.description_en: The Vaunnt once used these as sacraments for absolution, enabling the penitent to endure greater pain over a shorter period of time.
items.flavor_text_en: "The ancient Vaunnt often tried to recreate the living stone of the One of Many. One found a way to harden the flesh of one's liiorshk, albeit at great cost to the true life within."

items.name: Ring_RingOfBones
items.description_en: The serpent who lent its skeleton to this ring has long been vanquished, yet somehow you can still feel the furious rush of power that coursed through its veins when it was still alive.
items.flavor_text_en: "There is a chilling power that lies within the deadlist of beasts. A certain ruthlessness infused in their very bones that death itself cannot dull. The trick, as it were, is to harness this power without letting it consume from within."

description.en: The serpent who lent its skeleton to this ring has long been vanquished, yet somehow you can still feel the furious rush of power that coursed through its veins when it was still alive.
description.zh: 把自己的骨骼借给这枚戒指的蛇怪早已被就地正法，但你仍能感受到那股在它依然存活时，静脉中奔腾的愤怒力量。

flavor.en: "There is a chilling power that lies within the deadlist of beasts. A certain ruthlessness infused in their very bones that death itself cannot dull. The trick, as it were, is to harness this power without letting it consume from within."
flavor.zh: “在最致命的野兽体内潜藏着一种令人心寒的力量。凶残无情渗入它们的骨髓，连死亡也无法将其削弱分毫。诀窍在于驾驭这股力量，而不是让它从内部吞噬你。”

items.name: Ring_RingOfCrisis
items.description_en: The "jewel" of this ring burns and spins, like a miniaturized world that has been set on fire, or a tiny sun struggling to burst into life.
items.flavor_text_en: "Crisis creates life and reveals who we truly are. The Drzyr suffered many conflicts in the years before N'Erud was first conceived. Indeed, we nearly destroyed ourselves several times. We did not survive because of wisdom; we acquired wisdom because we survived."

description.en: The "jewel" of this ring burns and spins, like a miniaturized world that has been set on fire, or a tiny sun struggling to burst into life.
description.zh: 这枚戒指的“宝石”一边燃烧，一边旋转，就像一个被点燃的微观世界，就像一颗想要迸发出生命的小太阳。

flavor.en: "Crisis creates life and reveals who we truly are. The Drzyr suffered many conflicts in the years before N'Erud was first conceived. Indeed, we nearly destroyed ourselves several times. We did not survive because of wisdom; we acquired wisdom because we survived."
flavor.zh: “危机能诞育生命，揭示我们最真实的面貌。在构想出涅鲁德之前，泽厄尔人多年经历冲突不断，几次甚至差点毁灭自己。智慧并不是我们能生存下来的原因。不，正好相反——智慧是我们成功生存下来的奖励。”
