items.name: Ring_RingOfDeflection
items.description_en: A small-scale version of the technology that protects N'Erud. Planets are normally protected from the ravages of space by things like atmospheres and magnetic fields, but N'Erud has none of these.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Seekers had grown arrogant. I would not say so to them directly—though perhaps I should have. They had begun to believe that our technology was the pinnacle of all creation, forgetting that we ourselves were also created things."

description.en: A small-scale version of the technology that protects N'Erud. Planets are normally protected from the ravages of space by things like atmospheres and magnetic fields, but N'Erud has none of these.
description.zh: 涅鲁德护卫科技的缩小版。天然星球一般具有磁场、大气层等，能缓冲和避免太空中存在的种种伤害，但这些涅鲁德都没有，只能靠科技保护自身。

flavor.en: "The Seekers had grown arrogant. I would not say so to them directly—though perhaps I should have. They had begun to believe that our technology was the pinnacle of all creation, forgetting that we ourselves were also created things."
flavor.zh: “追寻者逐渐变得盲目自大。这话我不会直接对他们说，虽然其实应该说出来。他们自负地以为我们的科技是创世的巅峰，却忘记了自己也只是被创造出来的存在而已。”

items.flavor_text_en: "The Laemir are able to keep their secrets largely because of the way they speak. It is impossible to pin the priests down to any direct answer."

items.name: Ring_RingOfFlawedBeauty
items.description_en: The flower was once blush pink, but the color has long since eroded away. One petal is missing, as if plucked by a star-crossed lover.
items.flavor_text_en: "Clementine lost a good friend. Now, they’re not dead or anything—but being apart for so long, sometimes it feels that way. Distance hurts, even when we think it doesn't."

description.en: The flower was once blush pink, but the color has long since eroded away. One petal is missing, as if plucked by a star-crossed lover.
description.zh: 曾经的嫣红色早已侵蚀殆尽。一片花瓣不知所踪，就像被苦命的恋人摘走了一般。

flavor.en: "Clementine lost a good friend. Now, they’re not dead or anything—but being apart for so long, sometimes it feels that way. Distance hurts, even when we think it doesn't."
flavor.zh: “克莱门汀失去了一位挚友——并不是死了，但是他们已经分开太久了，所以会有这种感觉。我们总觉得‘距离不是问题’，但它却能实实在在地伤人。”

items.name: Ring_RingOfGrace
items.description_en: A plain but well-fashioned band. Though it doesn’t look particularly impressive, it cost the wearied Dran years of hard work and wages. Meant for someone special, but in her absence, you’ll have to do.
items.flavor_text_en: "When you get gaps and tears in yourself, you've got to patch it up with something—or someone—else. But if they’re ever ripped open or torn apart, all that stuffing falls right out. Nothing left but frayed edges and scraps of who you were, the kind of hurts that can’t never be mended."

description.en: A plain but well-fashioned band. Though it doesn’t look particularly impressive, it cost the wearied Dran years of hard work and wages. Meant for someone special, but in her absence, you’ll have to do.
description.zh: 一个简简单单、却相当有品的戒指。别看外表平平无奇，其实是德兰人不辞惫累，花了数年的功夫和财力打造而成。本来是要送给某位特别的“她”，但既然原主不在，就归你了。

flavor.en: "When you get gaps and tears in yourself, you've got to patch it up with something—or someone—else. But if they’re ever ripped open or torn apart, all that stuffing falls right out. Nothing left but frayed edges and scraps of who you were, the kind of hurts that can’t never be mended."
flavor.zh: “心中要是有了破口、裂隙，可以用其他什么东西——或者什么人填补。但补上的伤口如果再次被撕开，其中填补的东西就会呼呼啦啦全掉出来，心也就成了毛了边儿、碎了里子的口袋，再也补不回来了。”

items.flavor_text_en: “Those who are easily cast the fool are my favorite sort of Fae...and there are pitiful few I don’t count amongst their numbers.”

description.en: The woven band weighs suspiciously light for jewelry meant to be fashioned of metal, and it leaves behind a stubborn chalky residue on your fingertips.
description.zh: 对于金属制成的首饰来说，该指环的重量轻得令人称奇，但佩戴时会在指尖留下顽固的白色残留物。

flavor.en: “Those who are easily cast the fool are my favorite sort of Fae...and there are pitiful few I don’t count amongst their numbers.”

items.name: Ring_RingOfOmens
items.description_en: This ring bears a depiction of the moon rising over Yaesha, tinged with the color of Blood Moon Essence. Although the crest is common enough, the particular coloring is rarely seen and often feared.
items.flavor_text_en: "The jungle kills so that it might live. Flesh feeds soil, bones grow into blooms. Even under the Blood Moon, all things remain connected to all things."

items.name: Ring_RingOfOrdnance
items.description_en: The crest of this ring resembles a popular N’Erudian turret. It was worn by the Xul to further augment and customize the weapons they designed, and many engineers were exceptionally finicky about their preferred specifications.
items.flavor_text_en: "When the first Custodian turned the machines against us, we sought the Phetyr for salvation instead of the Xul. House Lythla was utterly humbled. Their engineers took precious care to fashion new inventions with greater fail-safes from then on, fearing both another rebellion and the ire of their humiliated leaders."

description.zh: 这枚戒指的饰章酷似流行的涅鲁德炮台。佩戴戒指的苏勒阶层会用其进一步强化和定制他们所设计的武器——毕竟很多工程师都对自己偏好的规格分外挑剔。

flavor.en: "When the first Custodian turned the machines against us, we sought the Phetyr for salvation instead of the Xul. House Lythla was utterly humbled. Their engineers took precious care to fashion new inventions with greater fail-safes from then on, fearing both another rebellion and the ire of their humiliated leaders."
flavor.zh: “当第一位保管人驱使机器人叛乱时，我们选择了向菲特尔，而并非苏勒阶层求助。里斯拉圣院彻底被打垮了。自那以后，出于对再次发生叛乱，以及羞恼的领导层怒火的恐惧，他们的工程师如履薄冰地设计新发明，并附加了更多的失效保护装置。”

items.name: Ring_RingOfRestocking
items.description_en: The Phetyr were trained for precision using tools like this one. Warriors who could hit their target every time were rewarded with the ability to...hit more targets.
items.flavor_text_en: "House M'Ertal devised a great many solutions to motivate their warriors. One might have been suspicious of their desire to train elite killers among a people who desired only knowledge, but in hindsight, any ulterior motives they might have had are laughably irrelevant."

description.en: The Phetyr were trained for precision using tools like this one. Warriors who could hit their target every time were rewarded with the ability to...hit more targets.
description.zh: 菲特尔使用这种工具做精准度训练。每次都能击中目标的战士可以获得奖励，奖品就是……击中更多目标的能力。

flavor.en: "House M'Ertal devised a great many solutions to motivate their warriors. One might have been suspicious of their desire to train elite killers among a people who desired only knowledge, but in hindsight, any ulterior motives they might have had are laughably irrelevant."
flavor.zh: “姆塔圣院为了激励自己的战士，设计了大量方案。或许有人曾质疑，在这样一个知识为先的族群中培养精英杀手是出于什么动机。但事后看来，无论动机为何，都十分可笑且毫无意义。”

items.name: Ring_RingOfRetribution
items.description_en: Many rings have borne this name throughout Dran history, each with a different visage but the same dark legacy. Whatever its form, the ring draws power from rage and hatred.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Nightweaver, now, is a pitiable creature. Oh, I'm not saying she doesn't deserve death. She's a danger, that's sure. But she's full of hate she is, and that's the saddest way I can think to live."

description.en: Many rings have borne this name throughout Dran history, each with a different visage but the same dark legacy. Whatever its form, the ring draws power from rage and hatred.
description.zh: 在德兰的历史上，很多戒指都用过这个名字。它们的外表各不相同，但本质却一样黑暗。不管形式如何变化，这种戒指都是从愤怒和仇恨中汲取力量。

flavor.en: "The Nightweaver, now, is a pitiable creature. Oh, I'm not saying she doesn't deserve death. She's a danger, that's sure. But she's full of hate she is, and that's the saddest way I can think to live."
flavor.zh: “织夜者已经变成了一个可悲的生物。哦，我不是说她不该死。她当然很危险。但是她已经被仇恨所控制，我觉得这远比死亡更加痛苦。”

items.name: Ring_RingOfSpirits
items.description_en: Adorned with the mark of a distiller, this ring was worn by a Pan whose potent spirits earned them friends in high places, and countless fanciful gifts like this one.
items.flavor_text_en: "I do not indulge in revelry, for there is no weakness greater than a clouded, sullied mind. Indulgence, though it may soften the cruel agonies of this world, makes one forget what is most important: ambition. And who benefits from that more than those in power?"

description.en: Adorned with the mark of a distiller, this ring was worn by a Pan whose potent spirits earned them friends in high places, and countless fanciful gifts like this one.
description.zh: 这枚戒指上饰有酿酒师的标志，佩戴它的潘恩所酿的烈酒为他赢得了高朋满座，也赢得了无数像这枚戒指一样的精美礼物。

flavor.en: "I do not indulge in revelry, for there is no weakness greater than a clouded, sullied mind. Indulgence, though it may soften the cruel agonies of this world, makes one forget what is most important: ambition. And who benefits from that more than those in power?"
flavor.zh: “我不沉湎于狂欢，因为没有什么弱点比一个混沌而污浊的头脑更大。虽然放纵可能可以缓解这个世界的残酷痛苦，但会使人忘记了最重要的东西：野心。而谁又能比那些掌权者更能从中受益呢？”

items.description_en: The inscription reads "Literally Impossible". This bauble likely belonged to someone who enjoyed making life harder for themselves. Unlikely they were actually an Admiral.
items.flavor_text_en: "It's a wonder this thing is even holding together. I wouldn't be surprised if it disintegrated into dust as soon as it hit the ground. Good luck getting more than a handful of scrap for it, if even that."

items.name: Ring_RingOfTheCastaway
items.description_en: A makeshift ring crafted from rummaged wire by small and forlorn hands in mourning over the loss of their loved ones. It is a last gift to those whose lives were cast away without a thought from those left to repair the rift their sudden absence left behind.
items.flavor_text_en: “Though the despicable Dran somehow curried the king’s favor, to let them propagate would surely have brought the superior Fae to ruin. So, in an effort to prevent a catastrophe, Fae soldiers had no choice but to cull the vulgar masses for the greater good of all.”

description.zh: 一枚简陋的戒指，是悲伤的小小人儿在逝去亲人的遗物中翻找出电线制成的，也是他们送出的最后一份礼物。逝者已逝，徒留生者孤独地修补内心的裂痕。

flavor.en: “Though the despicable Dran somehow curried the king’s favor, to let them propagate would surely have brought the superior Fae to ruin. So, in an effort to prevent a catastrophe, Fae soldiers had no choice but to cull the vulgar masses for the greater good of all.”
flavor.zh: “尽管卑鄙的德兰人不知何故获得了国王的青睐，但让他们繁衍下去必然会导致高贵翡族的灭亡。因此，为了防止这种灾难，翡族士兵别无选择，只能为了更高的利益而铲除低劣之辈。”

items.flavor_text_en: "Several artifacts like this were brought from the homeland. They were created in concert with the ancient Pan rulers, designed to work in harmony with one another. For after all, none of us swim alone."

items.flavor_text_en: "Shandala and the Sarillians withstood the One True King's irruptions for unending years. It seems the harder the king tried to subdue them, the more stubborn they became."

items.description_en: This gilded ring is magnificent to behold, yet upon closer inspection, the allure of its presentation crumbles and one is able to glimpse the blemishes beneath its golden exterior and the cracks that mar its mirrored surface.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Fae are so often accused of vanity, but is it truly a crime if such a wealth of pride is warranted, earned, and utterly irrefutable? I, for one, would take sweet vanity and the whispers it elicits over morose mediocrity any day!”

flavor.zh: “翡族经常被指责爱慕虚荣，但如果这种骄傲是有保证的、是努力赢来的，而且完全无可辩驳，那这种虚荣真的还有罪吗？就我来说，我可以接受甜蜜的虚荣，并愿意忍受这份虚荣在平庸之辈中引发的窃窃私语！”

Assembled from fragments of a larger piece, possibly a necklace, the ring is believed to possess mysterious powers that are unlocked only by enduring its brutal discomfort.

items.name: Ring_Rotward
items.description_en: Forged from an unusually warm metal found deep beneath Yaesha's crust, this ring can fend off entropy itself.
items.flavor_text_en: "Yaesha was not free of the plague. Jinas learned this firsthand, and for a time, we feared we had fled our homeland for nothing. But the Red Widows found something far greater than the plague in these jungles."

description.en: Forged from an unusually warm metal found deep beneath Yaesha's crust, this ring can fend off entropy itself.
description.zh: 由发现于耶莎地下深处的罕见温热金属锻造而成。这枚戒指可以抵御熵本身。

items.name: Ring_RustedHeirloom
items.description_en: On close inspection, the rust on this ring is merely cosmetic, scraping off rather easily. The ring's core is unweathered and unweakened even by the ravages of time.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Renthir family were once staunch supporters of, and highly favored by, the One True King. That favor waned, however, upon a request for clemency on their son's behalf. The price of asking, it would seem, was generations of goodwill."

description.en: On close inspection, the rust on this ring is merely cosmetic, scraping off rather easily. The ring's core is unweathered and unweakened even by the ravages of time.
description.zh: 仔细观察就能发现，戒指上的锈迹只浮于表面，很容易刮掉。即使经过了时间的洗礼，戒指的核心仍然未受侵蚀，强大如初。

flavor.en: "The Renthir family were once staunch supporters of, and highly favored by, the One True King. That favor waned, however, upon a request for clemency on their son's behalf. The price of asking, it would seem, was generations of goodwill."
flavor.zh: “伦蒂尔家族曾是独一真皇的拥趸，真皇也对他们青眼有加。然而，当他们请求对儿子的宽大处理时，这种宠爱就突然消散了。似乎这一请求赔上了几代人积累的信誉。”

items.description_en: The green stone is not found anywhere on Yaesha. It is assumed to come from the Pan's homeland, but its properties are largely unknown.
items.flavor_text_en: "Experience is gained from Life. Wisdom is gained from Death. All can benefit from both, for all are part of the Balance."

items.name: Ring_SapphireDreamstone
items.description_en: The bright blue color, reminiscent of clear lakes and cloudless skies found only in paintings and dreams, is striking on whatever finger it adorns. Whoever owned it before possessed strong—and expensive—tastes.
items.flavor_text_en: "The One True King appointed a personal scribe to record his greatest deeds and most idle musings. The position was never permitted to leave the king’s side—and thereby belonged to the Fae the king trusted the least."

description.zh: 这枚戒指明亮的蓝色，让人想起在画作和梦境中才能见到的清澈湖泊和晴朗天空。无论戴在哪只手指上，它都十分引人注目。其前主人的品味那是相当的高端大气。

items.name: Ring_SealOfTheEmpress
items.description_en: The Seal of Jinas is granted only to the empress's most loyal followers—those who have proven their worth.
items.flavor_text_en: "Jinas's loyalists have always been bound—both to her and to each other—by the same creed: None of us swim alone. All things are connected to all things."

description.en: The Seal of Jinas is granted only to the empress's most loyal followers—those who have proven their worth.
description.zh: 吉娜斯的封印只会授予女皇最忠诚的拥护者——那些证明了自己价值的人。

items.description_zh: 吉娜斯的封印只会授予女皇最忠诚的拥护者——那些证明了自己价值的人。

items.name: Ring_SealedResinLoop
items.description_en: The sticky, hardened tree sap preserves a moment of ancient history within its foggy hue, suspending a single instant in time forever.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan can learn much from our past, that I do not dispute. But we must not remain stuck in it like the old Vaunnts! If the Pan are to survive both Janis and the pestilence, we must find a new way—and once I find it, I will seize it and never look back."

description.en: The sticky, hardened tree sap preserves a moment of ancient history within its foggy hue, suspending a single instant in time forever.
description.zh: 粘稠又坚硬的树脂以其朦胧的色调，将远古历史上的一瞬保存了下来，使其永久凝固在时光之中。

flavor.en: "The Pan can learn much from our past, that I do not dispute. But we must not remain stuck in it like the old Vaunnts! If the Pan are to survive both Janis and the pestilence, we must find a new way—and once I find it, I will seize it and never look back."
flavor.zh: “潘恩能从我们的过去中学到许多东西，这毋庸置疑。但我们绝不能像老沃恩特一样永远活在过去！如果潘恩能从詹尼斯和瘟疫中幸存下来，我们就必须找到一条全新的道路——一旦找到，我必将坚持到底，永不回头。”

items.name: Ring_SecurityHalfMeasure
items.description_en: The syringes on this ring are used to extract blood from its wearer upon entering a state of duress, where it then undergoes a molecular-altering process to transfuse the blood into just enough stellar power to generate a barrier.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr sought to transcend the line between machines and organics. By infusing a machine with artificial intelligence or replacing Drzyr flesh and limbs with machinery, the Drzyr achieved what they believed to be the next stage in the evolution of their species."

description.en: The syringes on this ring are used to extract blood from its wearer upon entering a state of duress, where it then undergoes a molecular-altering process to transfuse the blood into just enough stellar power to generate a barrier.
description.zh: 处于危急状况时，戒指上的注射器会从佩戴者身上提取血液并进行分子改造，将血液转化为足以生成屏障的恒星能量。

flavor.en: "The Drzyr sought to transcend the line between machines and organics. By infusing a machine with artificial intelligence or replacing Drzyr flesh and limbs with machinery, the Drzyr achieved what they believed to be the next stage in the evolution of their species."
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人希望能突破机器和有机体之间的界限。他们将人工智能注入机器，或者用机械取代泽厄尔人的血肉和肢体，并认为自己实现了物种进化的下一阶段。”

items.name: Ring_ShadowOfMisery
items.description_en: Gazing into this pitch-black stone is like peering over the edge of an abysmal void of misery, where all that endures is an all-encompassing anguish that consumes from within and infects all those in its vicinity.
items.flavor_text_en: “Miserable, loathsome creatures that exist merely as a spectacle of misery for the rest of us to watch in horror and pity from a great distance. That is all the Dran are, from birth to death, and all they might ever strive to be.”

description.en: Gazing into this pitch-black stone is like peering over the edge of an abysmal void of misery, where all that endures is an all-encompassing anguish that consumes from within and infects all those in its vicinity.
description.zh: 凝视这块漆黑的石头，就像凝视深渊的边缘，深处有躲不了、化不开的痛苦，吞噬内心，然后传递给周边一切事物。

flavor.en: “Miserable, loathsome creatures that exist merely as a spectacle of misery for the rest of us to watch in horror and pity from a great distance. That is all the Dran are, from birth to death, and all they might ever strive to be.”
flavor.zh: “可悲又可憎的生物，他们的存在只是为了让我们遥遥观望，为他们的苦难或惊叹，或惋惜。这就是对德兰人从生到死的精确概括，同时也可能是他们挣扎的目标。”

items.name: Ring_ShaedStone
items.description_en: This ring is a contradiction incarnate—a token of beauty and ghastly hardship alike. Its dimly mirrored surface begs you to search your own reflection and seek out the hidden contradictions lurking within.
items.flavor_text_en: “Perception is the only difference between concepts such as good and evil, right and wrong, and so on and so forth. The ability to shift your perspective just so in a way that allows you to dance between these extremes as needed is the true art of the Fae.”

description.en: This ring is a contradiction incarnate—a token of beauty and ghastly hardship alike. Its dimly mirrored surface begs you to search your own reflection and seek out the hidden contradictions lurking within.
description.zh: 这枚戒指本身就是矛盾的化身——既象征美丽，又象征困苦。戒身呈朦胧的的镜面，引诱你在其上寻找自己的倒影，探寻隐藏其中的矛盾。

flavor.en: “Perception is the only difference between concepts such as good and evil, right and wrong, and so on and so forth. The ability to shift your perspective just so in a way that allows you to dance between these extremes as needed is the true art of the Fae.”
flavor.zh: “感知是善恶、对错等概念之间的唯一区别。可以改变观点，让你根据需要在对立的两极之间摇摆的这种能力，是翡族的真正艺术。”

items.name: Ring_ShardBandedRing
items.description_en: The material molded around this ring seems strangely organic to the touch—familiar, even. But you can’t recall where you have seen it before.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Labyrinth’s security measures see neither friend nor foe. They see only what is there that should not be. Then purge."

description.zh: 围绕在戒指周围的材料摸上去很奇怪，像是有机体，甚至有种熟悉的感觉，但你又想不起来在哪里见过。

flavor.en: "The Labyrinth’s security measures see neither friend nor foe. They see only what is there that should not be. Then purge."
flavor.zh: “迷宫的安全措施看不到敌人或是朋友，它们只能看到不该存在的东西，然后进行清除。”

items.name: Ring_ShieldAlternator
items.description_en: A small storage device that contains an immense amount of energy, ready to be dispersed in a fraction of a moment when it’s needed most.
items.flavor_text_en: "Creation is a form of art, and art often takes the form of its creator. This is true of machines as well. I was designed with delicate intention to be completely neutral in all matters. For other intelligences, however, morality does not serve their creator’s purpose. And in some rare cases, a lack of morality is the purpose itself."

description.en: A small storage device that contains an immense amount of energy, ready to be dispersed in a fraction of a moment when it’s needed most.
description.zh: 一个蕴含着巨大能量的小型存储设备，可以在最需要的时候瞬间释放。

flavor.en: "Creation is a form of art, and art often takes the form of its creator. This is true of machines as well. I was designed with delicate intention to be completely neutral in all matters. For other intelligences, however, morality does not serve their creator’s purpose. And in some rare cases, a lack of morality is the purpose itself."
flavor.zh: “创造是一门艺术，而艺术往往会体现其创造者的形态。对机器来说也是如此。我被精心设计为在所有事务中保持完全中立。然而，对于某些智慧体来说，道德并不符合其创造者的目的。在某些罕见的情况下，甚至‘缺乏道德’本身就是目的。”

items.name: Ring_ShinyHogLure
items.description_en: Though it’s covered in blood, it gives off a pleasing scent that whips even the most reclusive game into a frenzy. Used only by the most skilled—or desperate—woodsmen.
items.flavor_text_en: "We Dran are a hard-working folk. We'll run ourselves ragged if it puts even a spot of extra food on the family table. Shame how some folk like to take advantage of that."

items.name: Ring_SingedRing
items.description_en: It's hot to the touch, but strangely doesn't burn you. It actually feels cool while it's on your finger, though a wisp of smoke rises from wherever it brushes against the fringe of your clothing.
items.flavor_text_en: "We've been burned. We've been drowned. We've been bled and left to die. There's a reason the Dran are the way they are. As their Oracle, I feel it all."

description.en: It's hot to the touch, but strangely doesn't burn you. It actually feels cool while it's on your finger, though a wisp of smoke rises from wherever it brushes against the fringe of your clothing.
description.zh: 摸上去很烫，但奇怪的是又不会烫伤你。戴在手指上之后甚至会感觉很清凉——虽然只要它触碰到你的衣服，就会燎起一阵青烟。

flavor.en: "We've been burned. We've been drowned. We've been bled and left to die. There's a reason the Dran are the way they are. As their Oracle, I feel it all."
flavor.zh: “火烧水溺，流血待毙，德兰人全都经历过。过去的苦痛造就了今天的德兰族。作为神思者，我能感知他们心中的一切。“

items.description_en: The engravings on this ring represent a clan of Pan often shrouded in mystery—warriors who struck from the shadows and slipped away like smoke.
items.flavor_text_en: "The ancients believed Many Faces could never fall in battle, for his eyes were everywhere, and he could never be struck from behind."

items.name: Ring_SoulFeast
items.description_en: This ornate ring is crowned with a red stone, almost as though it’s stained with the blood of fallen allies. As dark as it may be, that thought spurs you to action and gives you the determination to forgo rest until every drop has been avenged.
items.flavor_text_en: "My wretched life in Yaesha was marred by the sting of loneliness, a soul-deep isolation that I could not allow myself to fully acknowledge, for fear it would consume from within. If there had been anyone to confide in, or even just a willing ear to listen... Ro’thinderahenwalt’s castaway soul might have been saved."

description.zh: 这枚华丽的戒指镶嵌着一颗红宝石，几乎就像是被倒下的盟友的血染红了一样。尽管这个想法可能很黑暗，但它能激励你采取行动，让你不眠不休，直至血债血偿为止。

flavor.en: "My wretched life in Yaesha was marred by the sting of loneliness, a soul-deep isolation that I could not allow myself to fully acknowledge, for fear it would consume from within. If there had been anyone to confide in, or even just a willing ear to listen... Ro’thinderahenwalt’s castaway soul might have been saved."
flavor.zh: “孤独之刺毁了我在耶莎的悲惨生活，那是一种源于灵魂深处的孤立感，我甚至不敢对我自己承认这一点，因为我害怕它会将我由内至外吞没。如果有人可以听我倾诉，或者哪怕有双愿意倾听的耳朵……罗辛德拉亨沃尔特被抛弃的灵魂或许就能得到拯救。”

items.name: Ring_SoulGuard
items.description_en: The jewel set within this ring was crafted by the Ahanae in collaboration with the Laemir. It ties the life of the wearer to those that serve them.
items.flavor_text_en: "When the Ravager first attacked, the Pan only survived because we fought together. When one fell, another took their place while a third aided the fallen."

items.name: Ring_SoulLink
items.description_en: Balance is infused into Yaesha's very stones and can sometimes be bent to a particular will. This azure mineral, for example, can be fashioned such that it draws life and spirit from those around it.
items.flavor_text_en: "At the last, we pushed the Ravager back when we realized that destroying it was not as important as protecting each other."

description.en: Balance is infused into Yaesha's very stones and can sometimes be bent to a particular will. This azure mineral, for example, can be fashioned such that it draws life and spirit from those around it.
description.zh: 耶莎的石头中被注入了平衡，有时可以按照人们的特定意愿进行改造。比如这种碧蓝色的矿石，经过改造就可以从周围生物中汲取生命和灵气。

flavor.en: "At the last, we pushed the Ravager back when we realized that destroying it was not as important as protecting each other."
flavor.zh: “最后，我们终于意识到，保护彼此比毁灭劫掠者更加重要。也就是这样，我们才击退了劫掠者。”

items.name: Ring_SoulShard
items.description_en: This ring is made up of a fair number of crystals. You can actually feel the magical energy flowing through them and into your very being, strengthening your resolve and lending additional vigor to your attacks.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Ahanae are masters of the arcane arts, and it is they alone who are capable of manipulating the magical energies infused within the crystals found throughout our jungles. Jinas knows this, which is why she relies on their abilities yet also goes to great lengths to keep them under tight control.”

items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr were a long-lived species, and rare few tired of the companionship of their own kind. Those who did turned to the infinite camaraderie of artificial intelligence, who served as a crucial diversion from the reality of N’Erud’s imminent jump."

flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人是极其长寿的种族，很少有人厌倦同类的陪伴，至于那些例外，则转而向人工智能寻求无限的温情。对于这些人来说，人工智能是帮助他们转移注意力的关键，能让他们忘记涅鲁德即将跃迁的现实。”

items.flavor_text_en: "The Balance is not merely a fact to be observed. The Balance is power. Those who understand it can bend it to their needs."

items.name: Ring_StockpileCharger
items.description_en: A perfectly mundane ring in all respects... unless one tries to count its segments, in which case one finds that they never quite reach the end.
items.flavor_text_en: "What if you could be assured that the tools you needed tomorrow would be there waiting for you? What if you never had to save and store again to survive? These are gifts the Fae are more than happy to bestow... in our own way."

items.name: Ring_StoneOfBalance
items.description_en: The artisans who crafted these rings understood that the Balance was more than a spiritual precept. It is a physical power that dwells within the Yaesha's very trees and rocks.
items.flavor_text_en: "For Yaesha keeps the Balance herself. When one thing waxes, another wanes. One who learns the connection between any two things can thus invoke change upon both."

description.en: The artisans who crafted these rings understood that the Balance was more than a spiritual precept. It is a physical power that dwells within the Yaesha's very trees and rocks.
description.zh: 打造这种戒指的工匠们明白，“平衡”不仅仅是一种精神戒律。它是真实存在的物质力量，寄居于耶莎的一草一木、一沙一石之中。

flavor.en: "For Yaesha keeps the Balance herself. When one thing waxes, another wanes. One who learns the connection between any two things can thus invoke change upon both."
flavor.zh: “耶莎会自己保持平衡。一物消，则有一物长。只要你能明白任何两件事物间的联系，就能对两者进行改变。”

items.name: Ring_StoneOfContinuance
items.description_en: It's not a stone at all but an infinitely complex device that draws resources from the surrounding environment and feeds them directly to the wearer.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Longevity. This was the one thing all houses desired. N'erud will not last forever. The Drzyr are long-lived but not immortal. Even the stars and planets will one day fail. All of this was known.

Anything we could do, therefore, to stem the inevitable tide of entropy was highly sought after."

description.en: It's not a stone at all but an infinitely complex device that draws resources from the surrounding environment and feeds them directly to the wearer.
description.zh: 实际上这不是一块石头，而是一个无比复杂的装置。它可以从周围环境中获取资源，然后直接输送给佩戴者。

flavor.en:
"Longevity. This was the one thing all houses desired. N'erud will not last forever. The Drzyr are long-lived but not immortal. Even the stars and planets will one day fail. All of this was known.

Anything we could do, therefore, to stem the inevitable tide of entropy was highly sought after."
flavor.zh:
“长生。这就是所有圣院都渴求的东西。涅鲁德无法永存。泽厄尔人虽然长寿，但也并非不朽。即便是日月星辰，也终有陨落的一天。这些我们都知道。

因此，只要有任何方法能抑制那不可避免的熵潮，我们都会竭力完成。”

items.name: Ring_StoneOfExpanse
items.description_en: With this ring on, your vision expands in a way that's hard to describe. Distant objects are drawn closer, easier to hit, but anything already near you slips from your field of vision like water.
items.flavor_text_en: "The stellar currents have more utility than simply guiding N'Erud. They connect points in time and space, allowing those with the Sight to traverse or at least see across them. This has applications both at an astronomical level and, if one is clever about it, an individual one."

items.description_en: The ring is uncomfortable—alternately warm, cold, slimy, prickly... Sensations shift across it like the colors of the stone itself.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is known that some of the king's counselors would steal from him. Indeed, the One True King himself was aware of this and would often conspicuously leave valuable relics lying about as a form of evaluation."

flavor.en: “It is said that King Kolket left no heir, but every Pan youngling grew up hearing legends of a long-lost prince who went missing during their dangerous voyage across the Dark Sea. Tragically, many young, tenderhoofed explorers met untimely demises searching for proof of his existence.”
flavor.zh: “据说科尔凯特国王没有留下后代，但每个小潘恩都是听着某位王子的传说长大的——在穿越险象环生的黑暗之海之时，王子失去了踪影。为了寻找王子存在的证据，众多年轻稚嫩的潘恩探险家踏上旅途却不幸罹难，为这个传说又添加了许多悲剧色彩。”

items.name: Ring_TightlyWoundCoil
items.description_en:
When a living body doesn't have to spend as many resources to keep itself alive, it has more resources available to kill.

At least, that's what the Phetyr were thinking when they made this.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The Custodian was designed to value life—especially Drzyr life—and to maximize efficiency. In this design, we did not fail. The Custodian rightly calculated that we would become extinct before our quest was complete, and it tried to turn us back.

So, the Custodian did not turn on us. It was we who turned on it."

So, the Custodian did not turn on us. It was we who turned on it."
flavor.zh:
“最初设计保管人，是为了保护生命——尤其是泽厄尔人的生命——并使效率最大化。从这方面来看，我们的设计并不失败。保管人做出了正确的计算，发现我们在探索结束前就会走向灭绝，所以他想让我们回头。

所以，保管人并没有背叛我们。是我们背叛了它。”

items.description_en: The carvings on this ring are inhumanly intricate—almost impossibly so. Time itself seems to slow as you follow the interlaced filigree with your eyes.
items.flavor_text_en: "Time is a construct for which the Fae have little interest. It never sways or changes. It offers no surprises or entertainment... Unless it is placed in the hands of that rare artisan who can shift it ever so slightly to her needs."

items.description_en: The beautiful engraving of a doe on this ring almost makes you forgive the countless deer who have painfully wronged you in the past. Almost.
items.flavor_text_en: "When we first arrived on Yaesha, the does knew her forests far better than the Pan. items.description_en: The dials mounted on the top were used to precisely adjust the tension of whatever once resided in the gallery of this ring. Given the lack of its presence, the tension was clearly not tight enough.
items.flavor_text_en: "The deep oceans of the Drzyr homeworld perfectly replicated the extreme environment of space, thus facilitating our understanding and study of deep space exploration. In many ways, the Drzyr were uniquely positioned to make such a drastic exodus. Were there indeed other life in the universe, it is unlikely that they could have mastered the cosmos in the way the Drzyr did. "

items.name: Ring_VacuumSeal
items.description_en:
You tell yourself it's not a black hole. It can't be. A black hole even the size of a pin would destroy this entire world, wouldn't it?

But if it's not a black hole, why does it suck in the light like that?
items.flavor_text_en: "There is no power source in the universe greater than that of Alepsis-Taura. A normal black hole produces so much dark energy that it can sustain its own existence, but Alepsis-Taura produces enough energy to sustain both itself, N'Erud, and all the stars in the universe a trillion times over."

description.en:
You tell yourself it's not a black hole. It can't be. A black hole even the size of a pin would destroy this entire world, wouldn't it?

But if it's not a black hole, why does it suck in the light like that?
description.zh:
你心想：这不是——也不可能是黑洞。否则，只要一个针头大小的黑洞，整个世界就就会不复存在。不是吗？

可话说回来，如果不是黑洞，那为什么连光都无法从中逃脱？

flavor.en: "There is no power source in the universe greater than that of Alepsis-Taura. A normal black hole produces so much dark energy that it can sustain its own existence, but Alepsis-Taura produces enough energy to sustain both itself, N'Erud, and all the stars in the universe a trillion times over."
flavor.zh: “整个宇宙中没有比阿莱普西斯-陶拉更伟大的能量源。一个普通黑洞产生的暗物质就足以支撑自身的存在，而阿莱普西斯-陶拉产生的能量，是其自身、涅鲁德和宇宙中所有星辰所需的亿万倍。”

items.description_en: The glittering hues wax in the daylight and wane by moonlight. Worn by Gul warriors who require the strength to slay foes a hundred times their betters.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Immortals think themselves supreme to the Gul. But freedom and suppression comprise yet another cycle in Yaesha’s great Balance. Should the rebels prevail, they will not offer grace to their oppressors. And the cycle will begin again, unending."

items.description_en: The unobservant might be fooled into thinking the central gemstone is a precious diamond. When viewed at certain angles, subtle green glints reveal that it’s actually made from glass.
items.flavor_text_en: “I confess, we Fae are fond of things that sparkle. A glittering coin, a fanciful gemstone... Whatever it’s made from is far less important than the intensity of its gleam, surely you agree. Come now, it doesn’t really matter, does it? It looks so lovely on you.”

items.description_en: The original glyph was dissected and repurposed into something new, its erratic pieces held together by additional metal cinches and precisely placed wires. Whatever secrets it once protected as a glyph are all but forgotten.
items.flavor_text_en: "My creator was a low-ranking member of House Lythla. His previous creations did not meet the necessary safety requirements required by the Seekers. items.name: Ring_WoodRing
items.description_en: The humble ring of a Dran dockworker. It’s simplistic in design, but you can’t deny the level of care that must have gone into carefully sanding its rough wooden texture until the surface was as smooth as glass.
items.flavor_text_en: “The dockworkers inexplicably take immense pride in their work, claiming to read the sea as though it were an ancient tome of ageless wisdom. Rubbish, of course, but if it keeps them preoccupied and out of my sight, I have no cause for complaint. Yes, leave them to their legible waters! May they drown in them.”

description.zh: 德兰码头工人佩戴的朴素戒指。设计简单，但既然能将其粗糙的木质纹理打磨至如玻璃般光滑，那其中肯定也倾注了大量的心血。

flavor.en: “The dockworkers inexplicably take immense pride in their work, claiming to read the sea as though it were an ancient tome of ageless wisdom. Rubbish, of course, but if it keeps them preoccupied and out of my sight, I have no cause for complaint. Yes, leave them to their legible waters! May they drown in them.”
flavor.zh: “码头工人对自己的工作有种莫名的自豪，声称他们能够像阅读古老的典籍一样解读大海。当然，这纯属胡说八道，但如果这能让他们远离我的视线，那我也没有什么好抱怨的。是的，就让他们去解读大海吧，如果能溺死在那里就更好了。”

items.name: Weapon_AbyssalHook
items.description_en: A giant anchor repurposed as a weapon. It’s unsettling how something built for function so readily became a merciless killing instrument. The unnerving scraping sound it makes when it’s dragged across the ground is the stuff of nightmares.
items.flavor_text_en: “Legend has it that the Sunken Witch has a number of calling cards. First, a mirthless laugh that is often the last thing her victims hear. Second, an anchor she acquired from a ship after bludgeoning its crew to death. Lastly, a complete lack of mercy, which is why there are only legends rather than firsthand accounts of the sea witch.”

description.en: A giant anchor repurposed as a weapon. It’s unsettling how something built for function so readily became a merciless killing instrument. The unnerving scraping sound it makes when it’s dragged across the ground is the stuff of nightmares.
description.zh: 原本是巨大的船锚，现在却是武器。为劳作而锤炼的部件，竟会如此轻易地变成无情的杀人工具，这不禁引人深思。当它拖过地面，会发出沉闷的刮擦声，简直是噩梦的绝佳素材。

flavor.en: “Legend has it that the Sunken Witch has a number of calling cards. First, a mirthless laugh that is often the last thing her victims hear. Second, an anchor she acquired from a ship after bludgeoning its crew to death. Lastly, a complete lack of mercy, which is why there are only legends rather than firsthand accounts of the sea witch.”
flavor.zh: “传说失落女巫有如下几个标志。首先，是她无情的笑声，这通常是其受害者生前最后听到声音。其次，是一只船锚，这是她用棍棒火火打死一整艘船上的船员后的战利品。第三，她完全不知仁慈为何物，这就是为什么只有海洋女巫的传说，没有任何第一手资料。”

items.name: Weapon_AlphaOmega
items.description_en: This weapon harnesses the Root’s very essence—its deceptive beauty, its pitiless decimation—to serve as the absolute apex of deadwood lethality.
items.flavor_text_en: "Immortality. Cessation. The corruption promises both, but the two cannot exist in tandem. Every end requires a beginning, and every beginning requires an end."

description.en: This weapon harnesses the Root’s very essence—its deceptive beauty, its pitiless decimation—to serve as the absolute apex of deadwood lethality.
description.zh: 这把武器糅合了根蔓的本质——带有欺骗性的美丽，毫不留情的破坏力——是枯树致命力量的终极体现。

flavor.en: "Immortality. Cessation. The corruption promises both, but the two cannot exist in tandem. Every end requires a beginning, and every beginning requires an end."

items.description_en: True to its name, this weapon is nothing more or less than a harbinger of anguish. It hurts to hold, but given what it does to those on the receiving end of its fury, that seems a fair price to pay.

items.description_en: This is the weapon used to "assassinate" the One True King. He wasn't actually killed, of course, only put in a kind of eternal sleep, but if this dagger can do that to such a powerful being, then killing Root with it should be easy.
items.flavor_text_en: "Despite what people might say, laws are not made to be broken. They can, however, be interpreted, elided, even wilfully misunderstood. Any law can be circumvented in the right circumstances—even the laws of the One True King."

items.description_en: This weapon is a patchwork of various parts, held together with bolts, duct tape, and sheer optimism. Its rugged exterior may appear improvised, but it's a formidable and lethal tool on the battlefield.

items.name: Weapon_BasicShovel
items.description_en: This basic tool has clearly been to hell and back, and its journey is far from over. The blade’s edges have been roughly sharpened so that it can function as a rudimentary weapon of sorts.
items.flavor_text_en: “The biggest mistake you can make while exploring the unknown is to underestimate your enemy—but that goes both ways. I don’t care how many horns or wings or whatever a foe may be packing, if they see this shovel and think the odds are in their favor, you’re in a prime position to make sure that’s the last thought they ever have.”

items.description_en: An ancient, quick, and versatile blade suited for almost any situation. It excels at controlling areas with its wide-arcing swings and fast recovery. Excellent against hordes of smaller enemies and perfect for dealing damage in a pinch.
items.flavor_text_en: "Something familiar about this blade… It's seen a lot, and done even more. This is where it all begins, and where it all ends—at the end of a sword."

items.name: Weapon_Bow
items.description_en: The Postulant grants these to those who can defeat him. None know why. Some suspect that the game is mere preamble—that perhaps the true game is what its players do next.
items.pickup_description_en:
A lightweight, easy handling bow designed for hunting. High critical chance, bonus damage on Weakspot hits, and a low sound profile.

Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.
items.flavor_text_en:
"It was a grave risk to go after the One True King. This was known, but the stakes were thought high enough to justify the risk.

Alas that we did not calculate the consequences of success."

flavor.en:
"It was a grave risk to go after the One True King. This was known, but the stakes were thought high enough to justify the risk.

Alas that we did not calculate the consequences of success."
flavor.zh:
“对抗独一真皇风险极高，所有人都知道这一点。但赌注之高，让大家认为这风险也是合理的。

可惜啊，我们都没有计算过成功的后果。”

items.description_en: The sturdy metal and leather bracers now feature sharp, curved blades that can tear through flesh and bone with ease. Worn on the hands and wrists, these claw weapons are both practical and intimidating, perfect for close-quarters combat.

items.name: Weapon_CoachGun
items.description_en: This weapon is a force to be reckoned with, boasting high damage and a decent fire rate. However, due to its design, the shotgun's magazine capacity is very low, making each shot count. Its worn appearance and simple mechanics give it a no-nonsense, utilitarian feel, and it's clear that this shotgun has seen its fair share of action.
items.flavor_text_en: "Before the Root came, this old double-barrel shotgun was favored by prison guards for stopping escaping prisoners. One blast to warn, and the second to bring them down. But in the dangerous world of deadwood, there's no time for warnings."

description.zh: 这件武器是无法忽视的力量，伤害很高，射速也不错。但是，由于设计的原因，这把霰弹枪的弹匣容量非常低，所以每发射击都要慎重。破旧的外观和简单的机械结构给了它一种严肃、实用的感觉，而且很明显，这把霰弹枪久经沙场。

flavor.zh: “在根蔓出现之前，这把旧双管霰弹枪是监狱守卫打击越狱的利器。第一枪警告，第二枪放倒。不过在枯树危险四伏的世界里没有鸣枪示警的时间。”

items.name: Weapon_CorruptedAphelion
items.description_en: To be at a planet's aphelion is to be furthest from its sun, as far from its guardian star's warmth and light as it is possible to be. That embrace of darkness is infused into the very core of this weapon.
items.flavor_text_en: "Light. Dark. They are just separate ends of a spectrum that is now obsolete. There is only the insurmountable void between the two, and in the end, we will ensure this void is all that remains."

description.zh: 所谓行星的远日点，也就是指距离太阳最远的位置，此时，守护星的温暖和光芒最为微弱。而这黑暗的拥抱，就是被注入此武器核心之中的力量。

items.name: Weapon_CorruptedCubeGun
items.description_en: This memento of the Labyrinth’s deadliest defense now flickers with infested corruption. It evokes visions of the last bastion breeched and devastated; empty ruins devoid of all hope, derelict doorways that open to lifeless nothingness.
items.flavor_text_en: “A pawn of our design laid bare the convergence, a myriad of doorways from which we invaded civilization after civilization. When the final world acquiesces and succumbs to ruination, so too will the convergence fall.”

items.name: Weapon_CorruptedNebula
items.description_en: While the swirling mist within shimmers with the beauty of a nebula, in truth it is a cloud of nanites that neither think nor feel. Their only purpose is to break down all matter at the cellular level with a single-minded focus that would be awe inspiring were it not so horrifyingly efficient.

Their only purpose is to break down all matter at the cellular level with a single-minded focus that would be awe inspiring were it not so horrifyingly efficient.
description.zh: 虽然其中的薄雾闪烁着微光，美若星云，但它其实是一团纳米机器人，既不思考，也没有感觉。它们存在的唯一的目的就是在细胞层面上分解所有物质——如果不是效率高得吓人，这种专注倒也会令人心生敬意。

items.name: Weapon_CorruptedSavior
items.description_en: When in the midst of a desperate battle, it is human nature to reach for a glimmer of hope in the darkness to stave off the insurmountable dread that has taken root. That hope has saved many a soul and many a world, but is it enough to save existence itself?
items.flavor_text_en: “The concept of salvation from nothingness is a result of flawed logic. Nothingness is the salvation, life is the corruption, and we are the cure for the afflicted.”

description.en: When in the midst of a desperate battle, it is human nature to reach for a glimmer of hope in the darkness to stave off the insurmountable dread that has taken root. That hope has saved many a soul and many a world, but is it enough to save existence itself?
description.zh: 在陷入绝境时，人类会本能地寻找黑暗中的一线希望，以抵御其实早已根植于内心的恐惧。这份希望曾拯救过许多灵魂和许多世界，但它能够拯救存在本身吗？

items.name: Weapon_Crossbow
items.description_en: Some form of this weapon can be found in most cultures and most worlds, and the Pan are no exception. All warlike peoples have a need to strike enemies from afar, eventually giving way to a greater need for maximum damage with minimum effort.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The nobility benefited from generations of training and extended life spans within which to do so. Navun's rebels, on the other hand, carried numbers but lacked skill—a deadly gap to bridge.

Fortunately for Navun, the Gul rebels also had a steep advantage in ingenuity."

description.en: Some form of this weapon can be found in most cultures and most worlds, and the Pan are no exception. All warlike peoples have a need to strike enemies from afar, eventually giving way to a greater need for maximum damage with minimum effort.
description.zh: 在大多数文化和世界中都能找到类似的武器，潘恩社会也不例外。所有好战的种族都需要从远处攻击敌人，最终的目的在于以最小的代价造成最大的伤害。

flavor.en:
"The nobility benefited from generations of training and extended life spans within which to do so. Navun's rebels, on the other hand, carried numbers but lacked skill—a deadly gap to bridge.

Fortunately for Navun, the Gul rebels also had a steep advantage in ingenuity."
flavor.zh:
“贵族世代接受军事训练，又因为长寿，受训时间远高于常人。而纳文的叛军虽然人数众多，但缺乏战斗技能——这是致命的劣势。

但是纳文很幸运，叛军里有古尔人，这又给他们带来了独特的优势。”

items.description_en: On first glance, the weapon seems flimsy, merely decorative. But its ornate filigree is no pretense. It bears a destructive force to match.
items.pickup_description_en: A pinpoint accurate split-barreled rifle that fires two shots. High base damage, but cannot score Weakspot hits. Charge to fire.

items.name: Weapon_Dreamcatcher
items.description_en:
There is an ethereal lightness to this weapon, as though it were made of paper or breath.

Though it strikes its foes forcibly enough.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Some believe dreams to be prophecy. Others, a random narrative woven by misfiring synapses.

Yet dreams are nothing more than the true essence of the self, the soul untethered—entirely inscrutable yet imperative to possess."

items.name: Weapon_Enigma
items.description_en: It shifts and rearranges itself at random, a miniature version of the Labyrinth it came from—and just as unpredictable.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Labyrinth is evidence that all things are connected—either conceived by a singular creator or the incidental result of arbitrary sequencing. The relevance of either possibility is negligible. Coincidence is as strong a connection as creation."

description.en: It shifts and rearranges itself at random, a miniature version of the Labyrinth it came from—and just as unpredictable.
description.zh: 忠实复刻原版的迷你迷宫，会随机变化和调序，与真实迷宫一样难以预测。

flavor.en: "The Labyrinth is evidence that all things are connected—either conceived by a singular creator or the incidental result of arbitrary sequencing. The relevance of either possibility is negligible. Coincidence is as strong a connection as creation."

items.name: Weapon_Godsplitter
items.description_en: The blade of the imposter king appears to be two disparate swords fused together, but it has been forged of a single piece—a wonder made possible by great skill and the strange Fae metal used to craft it.
items.pickup_description_en: An expertly balanced blade that is the product of advanced Fae metallurgy.
items.flavor_text_en:
"There is an ineluctable truth throughout all known creation: nothing is ever truly gained nor truly lost.

Energy transfers from one object to the next. One life lost ends up as fuel for another. And when two worlds twine, the will of one is sundered in twain.

This is the inevitability of the universe."

description.en: The blade of the imposter king appears to be two disparate swords fused together, but it has been forged of a single piece—a wonder made possible by great skill and the strange Fae metal used to craft it.
description.zh: 冒牌翡王的兵刃看上去像是由两把完全不同的剑融合而成，但实际上它是一体锻造的——这是靠高超技术和奇异翡族金属实现的工艺奇迹。

flavor.en:
"There is an ineluctable truth throughout all known creation: nothing is ever truly gained nor truly lost.

Energy transfers from one object to the next. One life lost ends up as fuel for another. And when two worlds twine, the will of one is sundered in twain.

This is the inevitability of the universe."
flavor.zh:
“所有已知的造物都遵循一条不变的真理：无所谓失，也无所谓得。

能量不会消散，只是从一种形式转化为另一种形式；死亡也不是终结，而是另一条生命的养料。两界交织，一个人的意志就会分裂。

这就是宇宙无可回避的定律。”

items.name: Weapon_Greatsword
items.description_en: The years of rust covering the giant broadsword only add to its menacing appearance. Its handle is carefully wrapped in cloth for a better grip, allowing the wielder to control the weapon's incredible weight. Dozens of sharp ridges line the edges like rows of razor-sharp teeth, promising to cause permanent damage with each strike.
items.flavor_text_en: "I may be a bit too old to wield this sword, but if I were still in my prime, I might have given it a go. Hell, the sheer size and weight of the thing could make even the Root tremble in fear. Ah, but those days are long gone for me."

description.zh: 经年的锈迹爬满了这把巨型阔剑的剑身，但只给它平添了几分威严。它的手柄用织物精细包裹，便于抓握，让使用者能更好掌控它的惊人重量。几十条锋利的脊线排列在边缘，就像一排排锋利的牙齿，保证每一击都会造成永久伤害。

items.name: Weapon_HerosSword
items.description_en: A nimble and adaptable weapon, capable of handling a variety of situations with ease. Its versatility lies in its ability to effectively control areas with its wide-arcing swings and quick recovery, allowing for swift strikes against groups of smaller foes. Additionally, it shines in its ability to deliver a heavy blow in a pinch, making it an excellent choice for dealing with larger enemies as well.
items.flavor_text_en: "I remember the day when the Wanderer departed, leaving behind their loyal companion, this sword. The very same blade that had fought alongside them in countless battles, now lay on the ground of Ward 13, a testament to the hero's journey. Though the Wanderer moved on, the sword remained, a silent sentinel waiting for its next worthy wielder to take up its cause."

items.name: Weapon_Katana
items.description_en:
Much like Earth, this world held out against the Root as long as they could—so long that the weapons their armies used to fight off the initial attacks were destroyed, lost, or forgotten. They had to make do with whatever they could find.

Unfortunately, it wasn't enough to save them.
items.flavor_text_en: "History within the two Cores followed a similar path. At a macro level in fact, one might notice no difference at all. The contrast becomes apparent, however, when one investigates history at an individual level."

description.en:
Much like Earth, this world held out against the Root as long as they could—so long that the weapons their armies used to fight off the initial attacks were destroyed, lost, or forgotten. They had to make do with whatever they could find.

Unfortunately, it wasn't enough to save them.
description.zh:
与地球一样，这个世界也曾竭尽全力抵御根蔓侵袭。这场奋战旷日持久，最初那批武器已经被摧毁，丢失，遗忘在历史的长河里。他们只好拿起一切可用的东西作为武器。

只可惜，这样并没能拯救他们。

items.description_en: Its crude design has the look of something hastily—desperately—put together, but the energy centralized at its tip remains fatal no matter how it is delivered.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is against my purpose to grow attached to the worlds’ children. I oversee all, but seldom interfere. So long as a single intelligent lifeform remains, so too does its world. But the entity must endure its life on its own."

items.description_raw: This lever action hunting rifle may have some wear and tear, but it's been well taken care of and remains a dependable tool for any survivor. Its sturdy construction and reliable mechanics make it a popular choice among hunters and adventurers alike.

items.name: Weapon_LeverAction_Rusty
items.description_en: Whoever once carried this weapon trusted it immensely, based on its age and wear and tear. They also didn’t return from their last hunt, and it’s easy to see why.
items.flavor_text_en: "A gun is only as good as its wielder, so the saying goes. If you don’t take care of your weapon properly, it shows. Not just to me—but to the Root, too."

items.description_en: This weapon feels...hungry, if that's even possible. Its barrel seems to rise of its own accord when an enemy is near, and you swear you can hear it rumbling at the scent of blood.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Ravager represents Death and destruction. In its absence, there is peace. The Doe represents Life and peace. What, then, does its absence bring?"

description.en: This weapon feels...hungry, if that's even possible. Its barrel seems to rise of its own accord when an enemy is near, and you swear you can hear it rumbling at the scent of blood.

flavor.en: "The Ravager represents Death and destruction. In its absence, there is peace. The Doe represents Life and peace. What, then, does its absence bring?"

items.description_en: "The tale of the lost tribe ended in terrible tragedy. They died for nothing, and the secret ways of their civilization are lost forever. Perhaps there is yet something we can learn from this tale, as we can all tales, but I cannot think of it. Not yet."

items.name: Weapon_Monarch
items.description_en: A sophisticated gun with a built-in harpoon for entrapping your enemies and bending them to your will. In the same vein as a tyrannical monarch, its form of justice is swift and brutal, and its rule is absolute.
items.flavor_text_en: “As a fervent observer of the world around me and a cognoscente of history, I can assure you that once a being of power makes a quarry of you, the only choice is to never be seen in their presence again. For once caught, such individuals scarcely ever break free.”

description.zh: 一把精致的枪，内置鱼叉，用于诱捕你的敌人并让他们屈服于你的意志。与暴君一样，它伸张正义的方式迅速而残酷，它的统治也无可置疑。

flavor.en: “As a fervent observer of the world around me and a cognoscente of history, I can assure you that once a being of power makes a quarry of you, the only choice is to never be seen in their presence again. For once caught, such individuals scarcely ever break free.”
flavor.zh: “作为世界的热心观察者以及历史的资深鉴赏家，我可以向你保证，一旦上位者将你视为猎物，你唯一的选择就是永远不再出现在他们的面前。因为一旦被捕获，就几乎无法逃脱。”

items.description_en: Ancient crystals found only in depths of Yaesha’s deepest caves adorn this gun made of stone. Surprisingly, moss has sprouted atop the barrel, bringing a measure of softness to nature’s hardest material.
items.flavor_text_en: "The spirits of Yaesha are fearsome and unpredictable. As younglings, we are taught to fear their wrath. But why must we always be afraid? If the Pan are ever to truly thrive on Yaesha, we must learn to tame it!"

items.name: Weapon_Nightfall
items.description_en:
Its skin undulates, as though invisible creatures skittered underneath, sliding against your palms and tasting—just tasting—your flesh. The back of your neck tingles every time you touch it.

If you could hold a nightmare in your hands, you're certain this is what it would feel like.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Alas, dear sister, though dreams were ever your expertise, they brought you little joy. Imagined shadows, half-heard whispers in the dark, shivers in the blood... In these, your passion and talent had always lain.

It seems so obvious now."

description.en:

If you could hold a nightmare in your hands, you're certain this is what it would feel like.
description.zh:
它的表层起伏不定，好像有看不见的生物在下面游动，抚摸着你的手掌，品尝着——对，只是品尝——你的血肉。每次拿起它都让你汗毛直竖。

你敢肯定，把噩梦握在手中的感觉也不过如此。

flavor.en:
"Alas, dear sister, though dreams were ever your expertise, they brought you little joy. Imagined shadows, half-heard whispers in the dark, shivers in the blood... In these, your passion and talent had always lain.

It seems so obvious now."
flavor.zh:
“唉，亲爱的姐妹，操控梦境虽然是你的专长，但以前很少能为你带来快乐。幻想中的阴影，黑暗中的呢喃，鲜血中的战栗……这些一直是你的热情与天赋所在。

当然，这一点如今是显而易见的了。”

items.name: Weapon_Nightshade
items.description_en:
"Was it these twined kingdoms that drove her to prey upon the fearful? Did the unholy twisting of our worlds drive her mad as it did so many others?

Or does she revel in a freedom she has always desired, now that her king and tyrant sleeps?

I fear I have always known the answer."

items.name: Weapon_OrnateBlade
items.description_en: The workmanship of this blade is exquisite—intricate, delicate, yet the blade is as strong as any metal you have seen.
items.flavor_text_en: "The forsaken prince's past has only hardened his personality—like tempered steel. His father, imperious and immortal. His mother, strong yet bitter. It is a miracle he survived to adulthood at all...and that he has not slaughtered more along the way."

description.zh: 这把刀巧夺天工，精致而精巧，但又比你见过的任何金属都坚硬。

flavor.en: "The forsaken prince's past has only hardened his personality—like tempered steel. His father, imperious and immortal. His mother, strong yet bitter. It is a miracle he survived to adulthood at all...and that he has not slaughtered more along the way."
flavor.zh: “被遗弃的王子有着悲惨的过去，但那只让他的个性愈发坚毅——就像淬火的钢铁。他的父亲，不朽而专横。他的母亲，强大但尖刻。他能活到成年简直是个奇迹……而且他一路上居然未多造杀孽，这就更不可思议了。”

items.name: Weapon_PlasmaCutter
items.description_en: If a tool can be used to construct a machine, then it can also be used to destroy one. The Plasma Cutter is one of the few weapons to receive the approval of all Drzyr—especially after the Custodian's rebellion, where destroying Drzyr machines became essential.
items.flavor_text_en:
"With only two notable exceptions, the Custodian has always served the Drzyr willingly, even helping us design the means of its own destruction. It was never naïve in this, but a willing partner.

I have had many years to consider the parallels between our dismantling of the Custodian and what our Creator has done to the Drzyr."

description.en: If a tool can be used to construct a machine, then it can also be used to destroy one. The Plasma Cutter is one of the few weapons to receive the approval of all Drzyr—especially after the Custodian's rebellion, where destroying Drzyr machines became essential.
description.zh: 如果一件工具能用于建造机械，那就同样能用于毁灭机械。等离子切割器是为数不多获得全体泽厄尔人意志认可的武器——这一点非常难得，特别是在保管人叛变之后，因为大家都对能摧毁泽厄尔机械的东西异常谨慎。

flavor.en:
"With only two notable exceptions, the Custodian has always served the Drzyr willingly, even helping us design the means of its own destruction. It was never naïve in this, but a willing partner.

I have had many years to consider the parallels between our dismantling of the Custodian and what our Creator has done to the Drzyr."
flavor.zh:
“除了两个显著特例外，保管人一直自愿服务泽厄尔人，甚至帮助我们设计毁灭它自己的方法。它在这方面绝不天真，只是心甘情愿成为我们的伙伴。

多年来我一直在思考，我们拆解保管人与造物主对泽厄尔人所做的一切有没有相似之处。”

items.name: Weapon_PulseRifle
items.description_en: The Phetyr maintained a wide variety of weaponry—too wide, if you ask the other Drzyr. Distinctions between things like automatic, semi-automatic, selective fire, etc. were lost on all but those who "needed" such things.
items.flavor_text_en: "Caid Jaru, the head of House M'Ertal, held annual seminars espousing the advantages of new weaponry innovations and identifying gaps in their current arsenal. These seminars might have been sensible had we encountered even one enemy in all our travels."

flavor.en: "Caid Jaru, the head of House M'Ertal, held annual seminars espousing the advantages of new weaponry innovations and identifying gaps in their current arsenal. These seminars might have been sensible had we encountered even one enemy in all our travels."
flavor.zh: “凯德·伽鲁是姆塔圣院的院长。他每年都会举办研讨会，宣讲武器创新的优势，并发掘当前武器库的不足之处。整个旅途中我们哪怕遇到过一个敌人，都能让研讨会变得有点意义。”

items.name: Weapon_RebellionSpear
items.description_en: Though the materials are crude, this spear was crafted with expert skill. The Gul rebels, under the tutelage of Navun, learned to shape weapons that were every bit as dangerous as the fine heirlooms wielded by the nobility.
items.flavor_text_en: "It was Navun who first spread the word of the Thaen's death. Few believed her except for the slaves, whose entire subservience assumed the immortality of their masters. Navun thus birthed and nurtured the rebellion that now tears at our walls. She is mother, warrior, and terrorist all."

items.description_en: "The Doe first appeared to the Vaunnt as a blessed portent, a sign that the Pan's long journey had come to an end. But the Doe also symbolizes compassion and sacrifice, and so the vision that at first was taken to mean rest was later interpreted as a call to protect."

items.name: Weapon_Redeemer
items.description_en: A handgun woven together with replicated remnants of deadwood and shards of the World Stone, crafted in homage to the Traveler.
items.flavor_text_en: "I designed this weapon myself, using your adventures as a reference point. I would not have been able to fulfill my purpose without you. Now I am the first and only Drzyr creation to have ever roved upon a living civilization’s planet. Conclusion: my creator would be proud."

flavor.en: "I designed this weapon myself, using your adventures as a reference point. I would not have been able to fulfill my purpose without you. Now I am the first and only Drzyr creation to have ever roved upon a living civilization’s planet. Conclusion: my creator would be proud."
flavor.zh: “我以你的冒险经历为参考，亲自设计了这件武器。没有你，我就无法实现自己的目标。现在，我是第一个，也是唯一一个，在现存文明星球上漫步的泽厄尔造物。结论：我的造物主会感到骄傲。”

items.name: Weapon_RepairTool
items.description_en: In the heat of battle, it’s easy to focus on taking down as many enemies as possible, but when an ally falls, your priorities have a way of shifting fast. This thing may not be the deadliest weapon, but its ability to heal those brave enough to fight at your side is invaluable.
items.flavor_text_en: “For a species as long-lived as the Drzyr, the restorative capabilities of nanotechnology proved essential to the preservation of vitality. They knew that to prevent decay on a micro level was the first step in potentially unlocking the secret to preventing decay on the macro level as well.”

description.zh: 在激烈的战斗中，你很容易专注于尽可能多地击倒敌人，但当一位盟友倒下时，你的优先事项会迅速发生改变。这东西虽然不是最致命的武器，但它治愈那些勇敢与你并肩作战者的能力可是无价之宝。

flavor.zh: “对于像泽厄尔这样长寿的物种来说，纳米技术的恢复能力是维持生命力的关键。他们深知，防止微观层面的衰败是揭开防止宏观层面衰败秘密的第一步。”

items.description_en: Despite its haphazard assembly, the makeshift auto pistol proves to be surprisingly reliable in combat, with a rusty barrel, crude trigger, and cobbled-together magazine all working together seamlessly to pack a powerful punch against the most dangerous enemies.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Root always come in groups, and so should your bullets."

description.en: Despite its haphazard assembly, the makeshift auto pistol proves to be surprisingly reliable in combat, with a rusty barrel, crude trigger, and cobbled-together magazine all working together seamlessly to pack a powerful punch against the most dangerous enemies.
description.zh: 这把临时的自动手枪虽然组装得比较随意，但在战斗中却出奇得可靠。生锈的枪管、粗糙的扳机和拼凑的弹匣，三者配合得天衣无缝，能够对最危险的敌人造成强力的打击。

items.flavor_text_en: “The Root never left us any time for sentimentality. I don’t care if the darn thing’s saved your life countless times—when you find something better, you’ve gotta take it. And don’t you dare look back.”

items.name: Weapon_Repulsor
items.description_en: A grotesque fusion of the Root's twisted biological elements and the eerie aesthetic of the Dreamer's helmet. The weapon is crafted from a hauntingly cold, metallic silver and is punctuated by ominous, red-glowing circles.
items.flavor_text_en: "The irony of it all was that we had unwittingly dismantled our own defenses, opening the door for them to invade. With the destruction of our world's barriers, our only means of combatting the Root was to wield its own grotesque weaponry against it."

description.zh: 这把武器用寒冷刺骨的白银制成，外形诡怪，融合了根蔓扭曲的生物结构和梦游者头盔的瘆人外观，带有冰冷的金属光泽，上面烙有许多发红光的圆圈，令人感到非常不安。

flavor.en: "The irony of it all was that we had unwittingly dismantled our own defenses, opening the door for them to invade. With the destruction of our world's barriers, our only means of combatting the Root was to wield its own grotesque weaponry against it."

items.description_en: A single-action revolver from a bygone era, its age evident in its weathered appearance despite the obvious effort put into keeping it functional. While its physical state may have seen better days, its reliability remains unmatched even to this day.
items.flavor_text_en: "Hell, when I was young, a revolver was already considered an old relic, but seeing it still in use after all these years is a testament to its quality and reliability. It may show its age, but it's still one of the best guns out there."

description.en: A single-action revolver from a bygone era, its age evident in its weathered appearance despite the obvious effort put into keeping it functional. While its physical state may have seen better days, its reliability remains unmatched even to this day.
description.zh: 来自旧时代的单动式左轮手枪。虽然明显有人精心维护保养，但斑驳的外表还是暴露了其年龄。它的物理状态也许比不上巅峰时期，但直到今天，它的可靠性一直无与伦比。

flavor.en: "Hell, when I was young, a revolver was already considered an old relic, but seeing it still in use after all these years is a testament to its quality and reliability. It may show its age, but it's still one of the best guns out there."

items.name: Weapon_RitualistScythe
items.description_en: The foreboding make of this scythe is like an unspoken promise to leave nothing but death, suffering, and destruction in its wake. The blade is stained a rusty red, and grasping the bones that comprise the staff sends a shiver of dread down your spine.
items.flavor_text_en: “Dran ritualists are zealots to the core, dedicated wholeheartedly to those arcane arts that require an especially honed tolerance for depravity and the stench of death. Though the power and resources their acts garner is tempting, there are more comfortable and less pungent ways to make a living.”

items.description_en:
The weapon shrouds itself in a luminous mist that bears the sharp tang of cinnamon and lime.

It makes sense that such destructive Fae magic would smell...appetizing.
items.flavor_text_en: "Gunsmithing is unpopular among the Fae. It is considered barbaric, pedestrian, or even trite. But for any given art, there exists a passionate artisan who will devote their life to it. The results of such a master can only change the world."

items.description_en:
The Drzyr invented combustive propulsion eons ago. It was later made obsolete by magnetic, ionic, and other technologies.

The Drzyr's warrior class, however, found new uses for deprecated combustion.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Phetyr encouraged and supported the technological progress of all other classes, not because they were unified in purpose with the rest of the Drzyr, but because their own purpose always benefited from our innovations."

items.description_en: An old but reliable weapon that is best used for close range combat. Its compact size and high rate of fire make it ideal for skirmishes and cramped environments where maneuverability is key. While it may lack the punch of larger weapons, its quick and precise bursts can make all the difference in a tight spot.
items.flavor_text_en: "The scarcity of ammo only makes each bullet more precious. Every shot fired is a gamble with fate, however, the more you can unleash, the better your odds of surviving."

items.name: Weapon_Shotgun
items.description_en: This weapon is from an era before the era of the Root. Though old and rusted, its components are superbly crafted. They seem custom-made for each other, not the disparate, slapped-together parts of most weapons you've seen.
items.flavor_text_en: "The paxultek Ford is said to have visited Yaesha many times over the course of his long life—a life that rivals the span of even the lowest among the Immortals. Historians are still finding relics of his world and expeditions, teaching us more about the strange and deadly world he comes from."

description.zh: 这把武器打造于根蔓入侵之前的世代。尽管古老且锈迹斑斑，但其部件构造十分契合，就像是为彼此量身打造，而不是像你见过的大多武器那样，由一堆不相干的材料硬凑而成。

flavor.en: "The paxultek Ford is said to have visited Yaesha many times over the course of his long life—a life that rivals the span of even the lowest among the Immortals. Historians are still finding relics of his world and expeditions, teaching us more about the strange and deadly world he comes from."
flavor.zh: “据说那个叫福特的帕苏泰克，在他漫长的一生中曾多次拜访耶莎。他的生命长度几乎能赶上某些英年早逝的不朽者了。历史学家仍在不断发现与他有关的物品——来自他的世界和他的远征，让我们越来越了解他那个世界的奇异与危险。”

items.description_en: A formidable sword forged from the charred remains of Singe, the Root Dragon. Its sharp edges glint menacingly, and the hilt is adorned with intricate Root growth, imbued with the fury of its monstrous predecessor.

items.name: Weapon_Sorrow
items.description_en: With rare exception, the spirits of Yaesha stay out of mortal concerns. Yet should need or vengeance call, they are quite capable of lending their aid. Pray their aid is for and not against you.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The origins of Yaesha's spirit sisters are a deep mystery. Those few who speak to mortals talk about Mother Stem and Mother Stream, but it is unknown whether these are simply concepts or actual beings.

Then again, the spirits themselves are both concept and being, so perhaps such a distinction is unnecessary."

description.en: With rare exception, the spirits of Yaesha stay out of mortal concerns. Yet should need or vengeance call, they are quite capable of lending their aid. Pray their aid is for and not against you.
description.zh: 除了极少数的例外，绝大部分耶莎精灵都会远离凡人。但在听到了需求或复仇的召唤时，祂们也完全有能力提供帮助。所以，最好祈祷祂们帮的是你，而不是你的敌人。

flavor.en:
"The origins of Yaesha's spirit sisters are a deep mystery. Those few who speak to mortals talk about Mother Stem and Mother Stream, but it is unknown whether these are simply concepts or actual beings.

Then again, the spirits themselves are both concept and being, so perhaps such a distinction is unnecessary."
flavor.zh:
“耶莎精灵姐妹的起源完全是个谜。少数与凡人交谈的精灵提到过‘草木之母’和‘溪流之母’，但我们并不清楚她们是真的存在，还是只是某种概念。

话又说回来，精灵本身就既是概念又是存在，所以也许根本没必要进行区分。”

items.description_en: This weapon was fashioned with care and precision by a master gunsmith with the common Dran in mind. From the choice of hardwood to its metal detailing and the lightweight design, each decision lends to a much-lauded balance between practicality and artistry.
items.flavor_text_en: "If there is one good thing to be said about the Dran—and there is indeed only one such thing—it is that they possess the artisanal skill to bring true innovation into being. What they lack, however, are any ambitions of their own. A dreadful waste, really."

items.flavor_text_en:
"The Drzyr did not die in Alepsis-Taura, though in what form they now exist, I cannot say. Nothing is lost in the universe. It is merely repurposed.

“泽厄尔人并没有在阿莱普西斯-陶拉中消亡，虽然我也不知道他们现下以何种形式存在。宇宙中的任何事物都不会湮灭，只是会被重新利用。

但是他们的‘重新利用’不太可能保留以前的意识奇迹。”

items.name: Weapon_Staff
items.description_en: Crafted from an assortment of pipes and scrap metals. Despite its haphazard construction, it offers impressive reach in melee combat, allowing the wielder to keep enemies at a distance. The uneven surface of the staff gives it a unique texture that improves grip, and the combination of materials makes it surprisingly sturdy.
items.flavor_text_en: "Despite its appearance, I must say I'm impressed with the design of this weapon. It just goes to show that it's not about how pretty or shiny a weapon is, but rather if it can get the job done."

items.name: Weapon_StarShot
items.description_en: The name of this weapon is no embellishment. From a technical perspective, it uses gravitic rails to launch microminiaturized spheroids of plasma—literal tiny stars.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Shortly after N'Erud's christening, Caid Jaru and I stood within the Core Observatory, watching the star at N'Erud's center glow and burn. He mused—in jest I thought—about creating smaller such stars, the kind one might hold in the palm of their hand. ‘What kind of gods could we be?’ he wondered.

I have since learned that Jaru never jests."

description.en: The name of this weapon is no embellishment. From a technical perspective, it uses gravitic rails to launch microminiaturized spheroids of plasma—literal tiny stars.
description.zh: 这件武器的名字一点也没有夸张。从技术角度来看，它使用引力轨道发射微型等离子球体——名副其实是发射出一颗颗小小星辰。

flavor.en:
"Shortly after N'Erud's christening, Caid Jaru and I stood within the Core Observatory, watching the star at N'Erud's center glow and burn. He mused—in jest I thought—about creating smaller such stars, the kind one might hold in the palm of their hand. ‘What kind of gods could we be?’ he wondered.

I have since learned that Jaru never jests."
flavor.zh:
“涅鲁德诞生后不久的一天，我和凯德·伽鲁正站在核心观象台中，欣赏涅鲁德中心的星辰燃烧、发光。凯德·伽鲁忽然提起想复刻这颗星，打造出微型的掌上核心，他说：‘若能如愿，不知我们会成为什么样的神明？’

我当时以为在说笑，后来才知道，伽鲁从来不开玩笑。

items.name: Weapon_Starkiller
items.description_en: A sleek and highly advanced long gun that was clearly designed for cold, merciless destruction. It must have been a twisted circumstance that propelled its creator to misappropriate the force of gravity in such a risky manner.
items.flavor_text_en: “If Rhom has one legacy, that’d be the stunning misuse of power. In a world where the few survivors struggled to endure unlivable conditions and their own brutal mutations, somewhere in the shadows this twisted science project of death was also created. Damn them all.”

flavor.en: “If Rhom has one legacy, that’d be the stunning misuse of power. In a world where the few survivors struggled to endure unlivable conditions and their own brutal mutations, somewhere in the shadows this twisted science project of death was also created. Damn them all.”
flavor.zh: “如果说洛姆有什么遗产，那就是对权力的惊人滥用。在这个为数不多的幸存者艰难求存，忍受严苛环境和自身残酷变异的世界中，在阴影中的某处，这个扭曲的死亡科学项目也被创造出来。他们所有人都该死。”

items.name: Weapon_Stonebreaker
items.description_en: It’s not only the size of this enormous blade that lends to its weight, but also the tangible rush of powerful magic harnessed within. When you grasp it, it sends a small yet disconcerting shiver through your fingertips all the way to your heart.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan are doomed without the One of Many to protect them. And yet, the Pan have been doomed many times over in our history. Still, we remain. The Balance will not result in our end—not yet."

description.en: It’s not only the size of this enormous blade that lends to its weight, but also the tangible rush of powerful magic harnessed within. When you grasp it, it sends a small yet disconcerting shiver through your fingertips all the way to your heart.

items.description_raw: This weapon feels unstable, the very stones shifting in your hands. At least its volatile instability can be channeled in a particular direction.

items.name: Weapon_ViceGrips
items.description_en: A tool of the Ofildi, designed to lift and carry cumbrous cargo. It is not difficult to imagine how a tool of such strength could also serve as a weapon.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is a blessing that in all our millennia of travel, the Ofildi never once rebelled—not because they feared the Phetyr, for the Ofildi outnumbered the Phetyr ten to one and had access to potent weapons of their own, but because the Ofildi were unified in purpose with all Drzyr."

description.en: A tool of the Ofildi, designed to lift and carry cumbrous cargo. It is not difficult to imagine how a tool of such strength could also serve as a weapon.
description.zh: 欧菲迪的工具，用来举起和运送沉重的货物。当然，这种强力的工具也能当成武器使用。

flavor.en: "It is a blessing that in all our millennia of travel, the Ofildi never once rebelled—not because they feared the Phetyr, for the Ofildi outnumbered the Phetyr ten to one and had access to potent weapons of their own, but because the Ofildi were unified in purpose with all Drzyr."
flavor.zh: “幸运的是，在我们的千年旅程中，欧菲迪从未反叛过。这并不是因为他们惧怕菲特尔——欧菲迪的人数十倍于菲特尔，而且拥有自己的强大武器，而是因为欧菲迪与全体泽厄尔人有着别无二致的目标。”

items.name: Weapon_WorldsEdge
items.description_en: Crafted from the very fragments of the shattered World Stone, this formidable sword possesses a unique ability to turn the Root's power against them. Though heavier than most swords, it more than compensates with its crushing blows. Crackling with root energy, it seems almost alive in the hands of its wielder, hungry for the blood of any and all foes.
items.flavor_text_en: "Harsgaard had us all fooled, played us like a fiddle. Who could have guessed that he was in cahoots with the Root? And yet, despite all odds, he managed to survive all these years...though I wouldn't exactly call it 'surviving'."

description.en: Crafted from the very fragments of the shattered World Stone, this formidable sword possesses a unique ability to turn the Root's power against them. Though heavier than most swords, it more than compensates with its crushing blows. Crackling with root energy, it seems almost alive in the hands of its wielder, hungry for the blood of any and all foes.
description.zh: 这把令人望而生畏的利剑由世界之石的碎片所锻造，拥有能以根蔓之力对抗根蔓的独特能力。虽然比大部分剑都更沉重，但其粉碎性的力量弥补了这小小不足。根蔓的力量在剑身中涌动，握在手中仿若活物，渴望一切敌人的鲜血。

flavor.en: "Harsgaard had us all fooled, played us like a fiddle. Who could have guessed that he was in cahoots with the Root? And yet, despite all odds, he managed to survive all these years...though I wouldn't exactly call it 'surviving'."
flavor.zh: “我们都被哈斯加德骗了，他把我们当猴耍。谁能想到他是和根蔓串通好的？尽管困难重重，这些年他还是想办法活了下来……虽然我觉得那不算‘活着’。”

items.name: Weapon_Wrathbringer
items.description_en: An approximation of the One True King’s oppressive mace, immensely sized down so that it’s possible for a mortal like you to wield. It also serves as a reminder of the crimson-tinged battle in which a mere mortal like yourself managed to slay a god and king.
items.flavor_text_en: “The One True King is rarely moved to engage in battle, rather preferring to end things quickly, or better yet, with excruciating slowness upon a fresh pike. You must have really and truly gotten under his skin. Bravo, my friend! Never fail to remember that I was cheering you on from afar and celebrated your achievement most jubilantly.”

description.en: An approximation of the One True King’s oppressive mace, immensely sized down so that it’s possible for a mortal like you to wield. It also serves as a reminder of the crimson-tinged battle in which a mere mortal like yourself managed to slay a god and king.
description.zh: 它很像独一真皇的权杖，但缩小了很多，所以像你这样的凡人也能够使用。它也让人想起了那场血腥的战斗：那一次，一个与你一般无二的凡人竟然战胜了一位神明和国王。

flavor.en: “The One True King is rarely moved to engage in battle, rather preferring to end things quickly, or better yet, with excruciating slowness upon a fresh pike. You must have really and truly gotten under his skin. Bravo, my friend! Never fail to remember that I was cheering you on from afar and celebrated your achievement most jubilantly.”
flavor.zh: “独一真皇很少参战，一旦参战，要么速战速决，要么用长矛最大限度地延长痛苦——他坑喜欢后者。你肯定是彻底把他激怒了。好样的，我的朋友！永远不要忘记，我会一直在远处为你加油，并且为你的成就欢呼雀跃。”
