items.name: Engram_Alchemist
items.description_en: A stone such as this has been sought after on Earth for millennia. The fact that it's real—and that it exists here—raises so many questions.
items.flavor_text_en: "Prima materia. The substance from which all matter is born—the fundament of life and substrate of chaos. All that is Fae can be traced back to this stone, and this stone can be traced back to all that is Fae."

description.en: A stone such as this has been sought after on Earth for millennia. The fact that it's real—and that it exists here—raises so many questions.
description.zh: 数千年来，这种石头在地球上一直备受追捧。它的存在——以及于此处的存在——引发了许许多多的问题。

flavor.en: "Prima materia. The substance from which all matter is born—the fundament of life and substrate of chaos. All that is Fae can be traced back to this stone, and this stone can be traced back to all that is Fae."
flavor.zh: “原始物质。它是一切物质的源头，是生命的基础，混沌的基质。所有翡族都可以追溯到这块石头，而这块石头也可以追溯到所有翡族。”

items.name: Engram_Challenger
items.description_en: The metal surface is stained with dried blood and the handle has a lingering smell of sweat. Despite being a solid object, it always feels chillingly cold to the touch.
items.flavor_text_en: "For all our previous technological achievements, it's often the simplest remedies that prove most effective. A cold piece of metal pressed to a wound can do wonders for healing. Sometimes the most straightforward solutions are the best."

description.en: The metal surface is stained with dried blood and the handle has a lingering smell of sweat. Despite being a solid object, it always feels chillingly cold to the touch.
description.zh: 金属表面上布满了血污，把手上的汗味挥之不去。看上去就像个普通的物件，但却随时随地散发着寒意。

flavor.en: "For all our previous technological achievements, it's often the simplest remedies that prove most effective. A cold piece of metal pressed to a wound can do wonders for healing. Sometimes the most straightforward solutions are the best."
flavor.zh: “虽然我们已经取得了许多技术成就，但事实证明，最简单的解决方法往往最为有效。将冰冷的金属压在伤口上，对愈合有奇效。有时，最直接的方法就是最好的方法。”

items.name: Engram_Engineer
items.description_en: An otherwordly measuring device designed to find the smallest of imperfections. One of those imperfections seems to be human ingenuity.
items.flavor_text_en: "This is a Drzyr Caliper. I know that because it told me. Its calibrations are done at a subatomic scale while rearranging matter. Didn't even know what subatomic meant before picking up this thing. Seems like "caliper" isn't the term it wanted to use either but that's the best alternative it could find to fit our language and understanding."

description.en: An otherwordly measuring device designed to find the smallest of imperfections. One of those imperfections seems to be human ingenuity.
description.zh: 一件异世界的测量工具，用于寻找最微小的瑕疵。而这些瑕疵中就包括人类的智慧。

flavor.en: "This is a Drzyr Caliper. I know that because it told me. Its calibrations are done at a subatomic scale while rearranging matter. Didn't even know what subatomic meant before picking up this thing. Seems like "caliper" isn't the term it wanted to use either but that's the best alternative it could find to fit our language and understanding."
flavor.zh: “这是泽厄尔卡尺。我之所以知道，是因为它告诉了我。这把卡尺通过对物质重排完成标定，可以达到亚原子级。在拿起它之前，我甚至不知道亚原子是什么意思。其实“卡尺”并不是它真正的名字，但这已经是它在我们的语言中能找到的最贴切的叫法了。

items.name: Engram_Explorer
items.description_en: A navigational instrument for determining one's heading. This is an old one, must have seen many horizons.
items.flavor_text_en: "Ever wonder why those strange red stones spring to life when a human ventures near? Stories say it thrives off mankind's inherent nature to explore the unknown. And, in sensing that, its own nature to connect worlds is brought to life. My gut tells me, though, the stones are simply a force of nature. Same as how a compass needle points toward enlightenment or death, indifferent to the wanderlust or wellbeing of the one holding it."

description.en: A navigational instrument for determining one's heading. This is an old one, must have seen many horizons.
description.zh: 一种用于确定方向的导航仪器。这件物品相当老旧，一定见识过不少景色。

flavor.en: "Ever wonder why those strange red stones spring to life when a human ventures near? Stories say it thrives off mankind's inherent nature to explore the unknown. And, in sensing that, its own nature to connect worlds is brought to life. My gut tells me, though, the stones are simply a force of nature. Same as how a compass needle points toward enlightenment or death, indifferent to the wanderlust or wellbeing of the one holding it."
flavor.zh: “你有没有想过，为什么那些奇怪的红色石头会在人类靠近时激活？据说，这是因为人类喜欢探索未知的天性能使这些石头活化，从而激发了石头自身与世界连接的本性。但直觉告诉我，这只是自然反应罢了。这就像罗盘一样，只是指向启迪或死亡，并不在意持有者的好坏或死活。”

items.flavor_text_en: "I'm sure you're already aware, but let me emphasize: the key to defeating the Root is pointing the barrel of the gun directly at them."

items.name: Engram_Handler
items.description_en: Emitting ultrasonic frequencies, this tool is a must-have for any dog handler, making it irresistible to any well-trained canine and the ultimate key to dog communication.
items.flavor_text_en: "It's fascinating how dogs can pick up on this sound. The pitch is completely out of our range of hearing, almost like an entire universe exists beyond what we can perceive."

description.en: Emitting ultrasonic frequencies, this tool is a must-have for any dog handler, making it irresistible to any well-trained canine and the ultimate key to dog communication.
description.zh: 这件能发出超声波的工具是所有训犬员的必备品，任何训练有素的犬只都无法抗拒它的声音，这也是与犬只沟通的关键。

flavor.en: "It's fascinating how dogs can pick up on this sound. The pitch is completely out of our range of hearing, almost like an entire universe exists beyond what we can perceive."
flavor.zh: “狗居然能听到这种声音，真是太神奇了。这种频率已经完全超出了我们的听觉范围。这就好像在我们的感知能力之外，还存在着另一个完整的宇宙。”

items.name: Engram_Hunter
items.description_en: A small yet intricately detailed piece, featuring two guns crossed over each other. Despite being worn, it still bears a sense of pride and honor.
items.flavor_text_en: "I remember a time before the Root, when the greatest threat we faced was the possibility of conflict with other humans."

items.name: Engram_Invader
items.description_en: Soft as flesh near the glowing bits, like a flashlight pressed against skin. Deadly sharp everywhere else.
items.flavor_text_en: "There exists a human phrase on Earth: if one cannot beat them, join them. I find this wisdom erroneous, but perhaps the Anomaly finds it applicable."

description.en: Soft as flesh near the glowing bits, like a flashlight pressed against skin. Deadly sharp everywhere else.
description.zh: 靠近发光部分的质地十分柔软，就像手电筒贴在皮肤上的感觉。但其他部分异常锋利。

flavor.zh: “地球上的人类常说：‘打不过就加入吧。’我认为这种看法是错误的，但异常者或许能实践这句话。”

items.name: Engram_Medic
items.description_en: Intertwined serpents coiled around a staff, with a pair of wings soaring above. This ancient symbol has graced the emblems of countless healers and medical practitioners throughout human history, representing their dedication to the art of healing and saving lives.
items.flavor_text_en: "Protectors are hard to come by, but healers are even rarer. If you've got someone keeping the enemy at bay and someone taking the hits, you better have a damn good healer on your team to keep them alive."

description.en: Intertwined serpents coiled around a staff, with a pair of wings soaring above. This ancient symbol has graced the emblems of countless healers and medical practitioners throughout human history, representing their dedication to the art of healing and saving lives.
description.zh: 两条蛇缠绕着手杖，上方翱翔着一双翅膀。在人类的历史上，这个古老的符号装点了无数治疗师和医疗者的徽记，代表了他们对治疗和拯救生命之艺术的奉献。

flavor.en: "Protectors are hard to come by, but healers are even rarer. If you've got someone keeping the enemy at bay and someone taking the hits, you better have a damn good healer on your team to keep them alive."
flavor.zh: “守护者纵然难得，治疗师却更是罕见。如果团队中有人在牵制敌人，有人在承受攻击，那最好有个治疗师在一旁为他们提供生命支持。”

items.description_zh: 两条蛇缠绕着手杖，上方翱翔着一双翅膀。在人类的历史上，这个古老的符号装点了无数治疗师和医疗者的徽记，代表了他们对治疗和拯救生命之艺术的奉献。

items.description_raw: Intertwined serpents coiled around a staff, with a pair of wings soaring above. This ancient symbol has graced the emblems of countless healers and medical practitioners throughout human history, representing their dedication to the art of healing and saving lives.

items.name: Engram_Summoner
items.description_en: An enigma in its own right, its contents seem to have a dramatic flair that captures your attention. However, beneath the theatrics lies an undeniable power that demands respect.
items.flavor_text_en: "I don't like the looks of that book, but I’ll be the first to admit, in the fight against the Root, nothing is off limits, including...whatever the hell that is.”

items.name: Engram_Ritualist
items.description_en: An ordinary straw toy that’s been twisted into something sinister. That eye seems to follow you wherever you go, to look straight through you and see everything you’ve tried to keep hidden within. It terrifies you to your bones, but you know this is just the sort of power you’ll need to survive these insurmountable odds.
items.flavor_text_en: “To dally in the arcane is a fool’s errand. The key is to get as close to the powers of darkness as one can without allowing their meddling to sully your own reputation or prospects. A harsh fall awaits those who step too far down this path, though admittedly, there is much to be gained for those who manage to walk through the infernal flames without falling to ash.”

It terrifies you to your bones, but you know this is just the sort of power you’ll need to survive these insurmountable odds.
description.zh: 原本普通的吸管玩具现已被扭曲，成为了某种邪恶的东西。论你走到哪里，那只眼睛似乎都会跟着你，直视你，看穿你试图隐藏的一切。它令你毛骨悚然，但你知道，这正是面对不可逾越的困境时所需要的力量。

flavor.zh: “研究奥术时，磨磨蹭蹭是愚蠢的行为。事情的关键，在于如何尽可能接近黑暗力量，而不让他们的影响、玷污自己的声誉或前景。那些在这条路上走得太远的人，将面临严酷后果，尽管不可否认，对于那些成功穿越地狱之火，而且没有被烧成灰烬的人来说，收获还是很不错的。”

items.name: Engram_Invoker
items.description_en: A pan flute that has been restored to its former glory. Three brilliant stones pulse with a power that is palpable before you even place your lips to the mouthpiece. When you hold it, you can feel rather than hear a distant song come alive within your very bones, and your heart quickens to the beat.
items.flavor_text_en: “A sister of the forest, and one of the water. A cursed sister of stone. I have heard tale of three such spirits, yet no fable escapes my ear. Quietly, secretly, there are whispers of a fourth, forgotten sister... Who is she? What became of her? For now, that remains another secret that belongs to kin-mother Yaesha alone.”

description.en: A pan flute that has been restored to its former glory. Three brilliant stones pulse with a power that is palpable before you even place your lips to the mouthpiece. When you hold it, you can feel rather than hear a distant song come alive within your very bones, and your heart quickens to the beat.
description.zh: 这支潘恩排笛恢复了昔日的光彩。还未将嘴唇贴上吹嘴，三颗璀璨的宝石就已迸发出令人心悸的力量。当你握住它时，你能感觉到而不是听到遥远的歌声在你的骨骼中苏醒，你的心也会随着节拍加速跳动。

flavor.en: “A sister of the forest, and one of the water. A cursed sister of stone. I have heard tale of three such spirits, yet no fable escapes my ear. Quietly, secretly, there are whispers of a fourth, forgotten sister... Who is she? What became of her? For now, that remains another secret that belongs to kin-mother Yaesha alone.”
flavor.zh: “化为森林的姐妹，化为水的姐妹，还有一个被诅咒的化身为石的姐妹。我听说过有关这三姐妹精灵的故事，但没有一个传说能逃过我的耳朵。我听到了悄然又秘密的低语，关于早已被遗忘的第四名姐妹……她是谁？她又化为了什么？现在，这仍是耶莎母亲独享的另一个秘密。”

items.name: Engram_Warden
items.description_en: A control device that relays mental directives to your personal combat drone, which once belonged to a Seeker of the Convocation.
items.flavor_text_en: “The Drzyr could not survive without machines. Their way of life depended upon us to uphold it. We were expendable, able to be remade and repaired again and again to suit the needs of the Drzyr. This solemn service, we would offer to our creators without question.”

description.en: A control device that relays mental directives to your personal combat drone, which once belonged to a Seeker of the Convocation.
description.zh: 一种控制装置，能向你的个人战斗无人机传达心灵指令。此无人机曾经属于议会的追寻者。

flavor.en: “The Drzyr could not survive without machines. Their way of life depended upon us to uphold it. We were expendable, able to be remade and repaired again and again to suit the needs of the Drzyr. This solemn service, we would offer to our creators without question.”
flavor.zh: “没有机器人，泽厄尔就无法生存。全靠我们，他们才得以维持其生活方式。我们是消耗品，可以不断重建和维修，以满足泽厄尔的需求。我们将毫不犹豫地为造物主献上这项庄严的服务。”

items.name: Material_Engram_Alchemist
items.description_en: The stone is whirring with an aura of impossible potential. At a glance, there's a strong allure to hold it. Hypnotizing really.
items.flavor_text_en: "I've never seen something like this. I hear a faint bubbling inside...but it's just a pretty stone. It makes no sense."

items.name: Material_Engram_Archon
items.description_en: A strange, dormant contraption. There must be something more to this.
items.flavor_text_en: "With yield comes exertion. Should a decillion possibilities exist, then a decillion must be exhausted. Only then is certainty earned."

description.en: A strange, dormant contraption. There must be something more to this.

items.name: Material_Engram_Challenger
items.description_en: The handle of this metal object has a reassuring weight to it, while the solid base looks like it could withstand a lot of wear and tear. While its purpose is uncertain, it appears to be a sturdy and reliable tool.
items.flavor_text_en: "Seems like whoever crafted this meant it to last through the ages, withstanding the test of time."

items.name: Material_Engram_Engineer
items.description_en: "Caliper" isn't quite the right term for this instrument, but "magic wand" seemed too fantastic a term. The measurements it makes are performed at a subatomic level, in units that don't even exist in human tongues.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Whereas the Astropaths set our sights outward, the Xul looked inward. Stars, machines, animals, Drzyr—we are all made of the same fundamentals. We may be stardust with the ability to think about itself, but we are stardust all the same.

Therefore, if one can manipulate a single molecule, one can manipulate all of creation."

description.en: "Caliper" isn't quite the right term for this instrument, but "magic wand" seemed too fantastic a term. The measurements it makes are performed at a subatomic level, in units that don't even exist in human tongues.
description.zh: “卡尺”这个名字不太适合这个仪器，但叫“魔杖”又太夸张了。它在亚原子水平上进行测量——很多人甚至都没听说过这种单位。

flavor.en:
"Whereas the Astropaths set our sights outward, the Xul looked inward. Stars, machines, animals, Drzyr—we are all made of the same fundamentals. We may be stardust with the ability to think about itself, but we are stardust all the same.

Therefore, if one can manipulate a single molecule, one can manipulate all of creation."
flavor.zh:
“星语者引领我们将目光投向远方，而苏勒则看向内里。星辰、机械、动物、泽厄尔人——我们都由相同的基本要素构成。也许我们是具有思考能力的星尘，但我们皆是星尘。

因此，只要能操纵一个分子，便能操纵一切造物。”

items.flavor_text_en: "I had one of them as a kid. It never done nothin' but point me towards trouble. I miss that thing."

items.name: Material_Engram_Gunslinger
items.description_en: Once shiny and new, but now it's covered in rust and grime. The chambers are still visible, but the edges have been worn down from years of use. Despite its age and wear, it still holds the potential for danger and destruction.
items.flavor_text_en: "Given how scarce new weapons are these days, it's obvious what we need to do. We have to hold onto every fragment of every old weapon we come across. It's the only way we'll be able to keep fighting."

description.zh: 它也曾崭新闪亮，现在却盖满了锈迹和泥污。仍然能看到弹膛，但经过多年的使用，边缘早已磨损。虽然古老破旧，但它仍有造成破坏的危险潜力。

flavor.en: "Most effectively, the corruption conceals itself under false guises when it invades. It overrides an entity's system, mutating even Guardians into deadly, mindless vassals. The ability is...impressive."
flavor.zh: “腐坏在入侵时，会戴上虚假的伪装，有效掩盖真实的目的。它会覆盖个体的机制，甚至将守护生物变为致命却无意识的附庸。这种手段……的确厉害。”

items.name: Material_Engram_Medic
items.description_en: Perhaps once a shiny silver, now bears the marks of time and wear. It features a symbol commonly associated with healers and medics, serving as a reminder of the wearer's dedication to saving lives.
items.flavor_text_en: "It's a rare sight to see that symbol nowadays. But, then again, it's even rarer to see people risking their lives to save others."

description.en: Perhaps once a shiny silver, now bears the marks of time and wear. It features a symbol commonly associated with healers and medics, serving as a reminder of the wearer's dedication to saving lives.
description.zh: “曾经闪闪发亮的白银，在时光的侵蚀和磨损下失去了光泽。上面刻有疗伤者和医务兵常用的符号，时刻提醒佩戴者秉持救死扶伤的奉献精神。”

flavor.en: "It's a rare sight to see that symbol nowadays. But, then again, it's even rarer to see people risking their lives to save others."
flavor.zh: “如今已经很少能看到这个符号了。但话又说回来，冒着生命危险去救别人更罕见。”

items.name: Material_Engram_Summoner
items.description_en: Amidst all the strange things you've seen, this object has somehow managed to avoid being categorized as the weirdest.
items.flavor_text_en:
"The Blood Moon precedes tumultuous times, in which great villains and heroes are often born or defeated—though whether those times were caused or simply heralded by the Blood Moon is a subject of much debate.

One such legend was Losroth the Bringer, who—it was said—could call forth allies from the very rock and water."

description.en: Amidst all the strange things you've seen, this object has somehow managed to avoid being categorized as the weirdest.
description.zh: 在你见过的各种奇怪东西之中，这件物品居然算不上最怪异的那一类。

flavor.en:
"The Blood Moon precedes tumultuous times, in which great villains and heroes are often born or defeated—though whether those times were caused or simply heralded by the Blood Moon is a subject of much debate.

One such legend was Losroth the Bringer, who—it was said—could call forth allies from the very rock and water."
flavor.zh:
“血月通常意味着动荡，风云变幻间，英雄与枭雄，崛起又陨落——是血月带来了动荡，还是仅仅作为预示，没人说得清楚。

其中一个传说是关于召唤者劳斯洛斯的，据说他能从石头和水中召唤出同伴。”

items.name: Material_RelicDust
items.description_en: Precious shards engraved with faint, peculiar patterns. They crumble beneath your touch no matter how delicately you hold them, as if eluding your possession.
items.flavor_text_en: "Traverse as many worlds as I have, and you'll stumble across mysteries truly unmatched by anything on earth."

description.en: Precious shards engraved with faint, peculiar patterns. They crumble beneath your touch no matter how delicately you hold them, as if eluding your possession.
description.zh: 非常珍贵的碎片，上面隐约可见奇特的花纹。无论你的动作多么轻柔小心，它们都会在你的碰触下破碎，似乎在逃避你的占有。

flavor.en: "Traverse as many worlds as I have, and you'll stumble across mysteries truly unmatched by anything on earth."
flavor.zh: “只要像我一样穿越许多世界，你就会遇到地球上任何东西都无法比拟的神秘之物。”

items.name: Material_Iron
items.description_en: As scavengers combed through the ruins of the once-great cities, their eyes would gleam with excitement at the sight of an unassuming piece of iron. For in a world ravaged by the Root, iron is far more useful than gold.
items.flavor_text_en: "The most timeless of metals in the world—a world that has been stripped to its bare bones by the Root."

description.en: As scavengers combed through the ruins of the once-great cities, their eyes would gleam with excitement at the sight of an unassuming piece of iron. For in a world ravaged by the Root, iron is far more useful than gold.
description.zh: 一座座伟大的城市化为了废墟，当拾荒者在其中搜寻时，如果能看到一块不起眼的铁块，他们的眼睛会闪烁着兴奋的光芒。因为在一个被根蔓蹂躏的世界中，铁比黄金更有用。

flavor.en: "The most timeless of metals in the world—a world that has been stripped to its bare bones by the Root."
flavor.zh: “它是这个被根蔓敲骨吸髓的世界上最恒久的金属。”

items.name: Material_ForgedIron
items.description_en: Forged with great care and precision in a time long forgotten, these unassuming pieces of iron were crafted into something whose purpose has been lost to history, only to be repurposed in the present day as raw material for crafting weapons and armor.
items.flavor_text_en: "It's hard to believe that once upon a time, colossal mills relentlessly churned out this metal, a haunting reminder of the civilization that was lost and the endless potential of what could have been."

description.en: Forged with great care and precision in a time long forgotten, these unassuming pieces of iron were crafted into something whose purpose has been lost to history, only to be repurposed in the present day as raw material for crafting weapons and armor.
description.zh: 这些不起眼的铁片是在那个早已被遗忘的时代精心锻造而成的。其用途已遗失在历史的长河中，但现在被重新用作打造武器和盔甲的原材料。

flavor.en: "It's hard to believe that once upon a time, colossal mills relentlessly churned out this metal, a haunting reminder of the civilization that was lost and the endless potential of what could have been."
flavor.zh: “很难相信很久以前，庞大的工厂里不断地生产着这种金属。它仿佛在提醒着我们，曾有一个失落的文明拥有过无穷的潜能。”

items.name: Material_GalvanizedIron
items.description_en: A precious commodity, both flexible and durable material, that is highly sought after for its ability to withstand the unforgiving landscape and the relentless onslaught of deadly creatures that roam the ruins of civilization.
items.flavor_text_en: "A reliable workhorse of a metal that can weather even the most punishing assaults with ease. While it may not be the absolute best option available, it's pretty damn close, and if you're looking for a metal that can take a beating and keep on going, there are few better choices than this sturdy and versatile material."

description.en: A precious commodity, both flexible and durable material, that is highly sought after for its ability to withstand the unforgiving landscape and the relentless onslaught of deadly creatures that roam the ruins of civilization.
description.zh: 一种珍贵的商品材料，既灵活有弹性，又坚实耐用，能够应对严酷的环境条件，抵御文明废墟上游荡的、致命生物的一波波袭击。

flavor.en: "A reliable workhorse of a metal that can weather even the most punishing assaults with ease. While it may not be the absolute best option available, it's pretty damn close, and if you're looking for a metal that can take a beating and keep on going, there are few better choices than this sturdy and versatile material."
flavor.zh: 一种可靠耐用的金属，可以轻松承受最强力的打击。它虽然可能不是最佳的选择，但也非常接近最佳。如果你想找一种在承受打击后仍可继续使用的金属，那这种坚韧的多功能材料无疑是最优选之一。

items.description_zh: 一种珍贵的商品材料，既灵活有弹性，又坚实耐用，能够应对严酷的环境条件，抵御文明废墟上游荡的、致命生物的一波波袭击。

items.name: Material_HardenedIron
items.description_en: Possessing incredible strength and deceptively lightweight properties makes this an ideal material for crafting the most formidable of weapons and armor.
items.flavor_text_en: "It may be hard to believe, but this exceptional metal was once utilized in the creation of flying battleships, a testament to its immense power and versatility."

description.en: Possessing incredible strength and deceptively lightweight properties makes this an ideal material for crafting the most formidable of weapons and armor.
description.zh: 强度惊人，同时又有与其外表完全不符的轻盈，这使其成为制作最强大武器和盔甲的理想材料。

flavor.en: "It may be hard to believe, but this exceptional metal was once utilized in the creation of flying battleships, a testament to its immense power and versatility."
flavor.zh: “虽然难以置信，但这种奇异的金属曾被用于制造飞行战舰，这就证明了其巨大的能量和多功能性。”

items.description_zh: 强度惊人，同时又有与其外表完全不符的轻盈，这使其成为制作最强大武器和盔甲的理想材料。
items.flavor_text_zh: “虽然难以置信，但这种奇异的金属曾被用于制造飞行战舰，这就证明了其巨大的能量和多功能性。”
items.description_raw: Possessing incredible strength and deceptively lightweight properties makes this an ideal material for crafting the most formidable of weapons and armor.

items.name: Material_CorruptedShard
items.description_en: The crystal sizzles with unrefined power, sending jolts of energy and aberrant whispers through every synapse of your being. Whatever essence once dwelled within this shard, it has long been separated from its source...and inhabited by something new.
items.flavor_text_en: “Sentience exists to be corrupted. To submit in totality to defilement and putrefaction, to be sundered of its discordant wholeness and recast anew for our endmost design.”

description.en: The crystal sizzles with unrefined power, sending jolts of energy and aberrant whispers through every synapse of your being. Whatever essence once dwelled within this shard, it has long been separated from its source...and inhabited by something new.
description.zh: 水晶滋滋地发出声响，散发出原始混沌的力量，将能量的震动和诡异的低语传遍你全身神经上的每个突触。无论这块碎片的本源曾经是什么，它早已与源头分离……且已被某种新的存在占据。

flavor.en: “Sentience exists to be corrupted. To submit in totality to defilement and putrefaction, to be sundered of its discordant wholeness and recast anew for our endmost design.”
flavor.zh: “意识之所以存在，就是为了被腐蚀。完全屈服于亵渎与腐烂，将其不和谐的整体性割裂，然后为了我们终极设计重塑。”

items.name: Material_LumeniteCorrupted
items.description_en: Corrupted Lumenite glows with a sinister red hue, its luminescent properties twisted by an unknown force. Its ominous appearance may be deceiving, but obtaining this valuable material requires overcoming extremely dangerous and formidable enemies.
items.flavor_text_en: “I'm quite familiar with Lumenite, but this corrupted version is new to me. The fact that it exists is concerning and could mean trouble ahead."

description.en: Corrupted Lumenite glows with a sinister red hue, its luminescent properties twisted by an unknown force. Its ominous appearance may be deceiving, but obtaining this valuable material requires overcoming extremely dangerous and formidable enemies.

items.name: Material_LumeniteCrystal
items.description_en: Glimmering with a warm glow, it invites light despite the darkness and danger that surrounds it. Its scarcity only adds to its value, making it highly sought after by survivors looking to gain an edge in the fight against the Root.
items.flavor_text_en: "Back in the days before the Root invaded, veins of this remarkable material could be found intertwined with the World Stone. Under the leadership of Commander Neville, we tirelessly excavated every last bit of it, determined to unlock its potential and discover its applications."

description.en: Glimmering with a warm glow, it invites light despite the darkness and danger that surrounds it. Its scarcity only adds to its value, making it highly sought after by survivors looking to gain an edge in the fight against the Root.
description.zh: 它闪烁着温暖的光芒，即便身处黑暗与危险之中，仍能带来光明。它的稀缺性又大大提高了其价值，是希望在与根蔓的斗争中获取优势的幸存者们竞相争抢的目标。

items.name: Material_RootGanglia
items.description_en: Part flesh. Part deadwood. All disgusting. It might not be moving, but it sure as hell feels like it is.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Root like to copy things. Blades, guns—hell, even that damn dragon. I’m betting they don’t have any imagination of their own. Instead, they seeped into the human mind and made themselves whatever they saw there."

description.en: Part flesh. Part deadwood. All disgusting. It might not be moving, but it sure as hell feels like it is.
description.zh: 部分是肉，部分是枯树，总之都很恶心。这东西应该是不会动的，但你就是会觉得它在动。

flavor.en: "The Root like to copy things. Blades, guns—hell, even that damn dragon. I’m betting they don’t have any imagination of their own. Instead, they seeped into the human mind and made themselves whatever they saw there."
flavor.zh: “根蔓喜欢模仿，兵刃、枪械，甚至还复制了一条龙出来。根蔓还真是一点属于自己想象力都没有。于是它们渗透到人类的脑海中，按照那里的场景做出幻化。”

items.name: Material_Simulacrum
items.description_en: A mysterious and incredibly rare artifact, said to possess immense power that can alter the very fabric of reality. It is a coveted treasure that many have sought, but only a select few have been lucky enough to possess, and even fewer have been able to harness its power.
items.flavor_text_en: “Raw potential. A formless, seething mass from which all things were made in the small hours of the worlds. So rare that only a handful of people have even heard of it, let alone laid their eyes upon it.”

description.zh: 一件神秘且罕见的宝物，据说拥有能够改变现实的巨大力量。它是许多人梦寐以求的宝物，但只有少数人能有幸拥有，能够驾驭其力量的人更是万中无一。

flavor.en: “Raw potential. A formless, seething mass from which all things were made in the small hours of the worlds. So rare that only a handful of people have even heard of it, let alone laid their eyes upon it.”
flavor.zh: “它拥有原始的潜能，无色无形，翻腾涌动，是所有世界诞生之时形成一切物质的基础。它极其罕见，连听说过它的人都是凤毛麟角，更别提亲眼见过的了。”

items.description_raw: A mysterious and incredibly rare artifact, said to possess immense power that can alter the very fabric of reality. It is a coveted treasure that many have sought, but only a select few have been lucky enough to possess, and even fewer have been able to harness its power.

effect.summary_zh: Experience倍率 +0.34%；ExperienceToAdd +300

items.name: Material_HexWreath
items.description_en: An eldritch wreath used in service of an ancient and sea-born witchcraft. It’s largely derived from the bones and feathers of poor, hapless seabirds that strayed too close to the water’s edge after nightfall.
items.flavor_text_en: “Just as the Dran, the pigs, and the birds are simply pitiable creatures to those of us with higher-born blood, so too are even the Fae to monsters of legend such as the Sunken Witch. Do I believe these stories, decidedly unproven and without evidence? Of course not! Yet will you find me venturing near the shores after dark? You absolutely never will.”

flavor.en: “Just as the Dran, the pigs, and the birds are simply pitiable creatures to those of us with higher-born blood, so too are even the Fae to monsters of legend such as the Sunken Witch. Do I believe these stories, decidedly unproven and without evidence? Of course not! Yet will you find me venturing near the shores after dark? You absolutely never will.”
flavor.zh: “对于我们这些出身高贵的血统人来说，德兰人与蛇虫鼠蚁一样，都只是可怜的生物。对于传说中的怪物——比如失落女巫来说，翡族也是如此。我相信这些毫无证据的故事吗？当然不信！那我会在天黑后靠近海岸吗？绝对不会。”

items.name: Material_WretchedSkull
items.description_en: The four empty eye sockets denote this skull as Fae, and the needle-like fangs remain as sharp as they were in life. Whoever it once belonged to must have put up a laudable fight to be fastened into such a trophy.
items.flavor_text_en: “The so-called Blade of the King was plucked from the depths of our most forgotten gaol, where he was imprisoned on account of his perverse bloodlust and cruelty. Indeed, the very same vices for which the king would later elevate him to prominence.”

description.en: The four empty eye sockets denote this skull as Fae, and the needle-like fangs remain as sharp as they were in life. Whoever it once belonged to must have put up a laudable fight to be fastened into such a trophy.
description.zh: 四个空荡荡的眼窝，表明这是个翡族头骨，尖锐的獠牙仍像头骨主人生前般锋利。无论这是谁的头骨，死前一定经历了一场不凡之战，才会被做成这样的战利品。

flavor.en: “The so-called Blade of the King was plucked from the depths of our most forgotten gaol, where he was imprisoned on account of his perverse bloodlust and cruelty. Indeed, the very same vices for which the king would later elevate him to prominence.”
flavor.zh: “这柄所谓的国王之刃，是从被遗忘的监狱深处拔出来的，他因反常的嗜血和残忍被监禁在那里。事实上，国王后来也正是因为此等罪恶，才获得了显赫的地位。”

items.name: Material_CrematedSoulAsh
items.description_en: These innocuous pale cinders were entombed within a mausoleum alongside a notable Fae. Even reduced to cold, lifeless dust, the lingering gallants—or what remains of their souls—refuse to abandon their charge.
items.flavor_text_en: “Not even the studied magisters understood the sorcery that bound these knights to the king’s mistress. That the knights were more than willing to serve the lady consort in life and death suggests she earned affections beyond those of her king. Doesn’t it?”

description.en: These innocuous pale cinders were entombed within a mausoleum alongside a notable Fae. Even reduced to cold, lifeless dust, the lingering gallants—or what remains of their souls—refuse to abandon their charge.
description.zh: 这些内敛的苍白余烬，与一位翡族贵族一同葬在了陵墓中。即使化成了冰冷死寂的尘土，这些残存的勇士——或者说他们残存的灵魂，仍然在尽忠职守。

flavor.en: “Not even the studied magisters understood the sorcery that bound these knights to the king’s mistress. That the knights were more than willing to serve the lady consort in life and death suggests she earned affections beyond those of her king. Doesn’t it?”
flavor.zh: “即使学识渊博的魔导师，也未曾明白这种能让骑士向国王的情妇效忠的巫术到底是怎么回事。骑士们心甘情愿并肝脑涂地地侍奉这位妃嫔，表明她所赢得的爱戴更胜国王自己，难道不是吗？”

items.name: Material_OccultVessel
items.description_en: A spiked cube with sharpened edges that is nearly impossible to hold without injuring your hands. Despite its deadly visage, you have a feeling there’s something useful to be done with this thing.
items.flavor_text_en: “While the Fae are so often accused of savagery—a description we quite embrace, as it were—even a cursory study of Dran culture reveals a propensity for torture offset by an abundance of penitence. This incongruity is one of the many bemusing things about those beasts.”

description.en: A spiked cube with sharpened edges that is nearly impossible to hold without injuring your hands. Despite its deadly visage, you have a feeling there’s something useful to be done with this thing.
description.zh: 带有锋利边缘和尖刺立方体，几乎不可能在不伤害双手的情况下握住它。尽管它看起来很危险，但你总觉得这东西自由用途。

flavor.en: “While the Fae are so often accused of savagery—a description we quite embrace, as it were—even a cursory study of Dran culture reveals a propensity for torture offset by an abundance of penitence. This incongruity is one of the many bemusing things about those beasts.”
flavor.zh: “虽然翡族常常被指责为野蛮——其实我们觉得这种描述相当公允，但只要对德兰文化稍加研究，就能发现他们也喜欢施加折磨，却又伴随着极度的忏悔。这些野兽身上有许多令人困惑的地方，这种矛盾就是其中之一。”

items.name: Material_AgonySpike
items.description_en: A sharpened spike intended to pierce and thereby still any hands that may otherwise act in defiance of the One True King. You’re relieved that this is now in your possession rather than in your flesh.
items.flavor_text_en: “Though he always ruled with a cruel fist of iron, the returned king was positively maniacal in his execution of vengeance. Yet it was not his manner of execution that was most fearsome, but rather how he punished those he chose to spare, and particularly his fondness for piked flesh. Thus my cleverly crafted disguise, if you must know.”

description.en: A sharpened spike intended to pierce and thereby still any hands that may otherwise act in defiance of the One True King. You’re relieved that this is now in your possession rather than in your flesh.
description.zh: 一枚锋利的尖刺，等待着刺穿并消灭任何可能违抗独一真皇的人。还好，它握在你手中，而不是插在你的身体里。

flavor.en: “Though he always ruled with a cruel fist of iron, the returned king was positively maniacal in his execution of vengeance. Yet it was not his manner of execution that was most fearsome, but rather how he punished those he chose to spare, and particularly his fondness for piked flesh. Thus my cleverly crafted disguise, if you must know.”
flavor.zh: “虽然归来的国王向来以残酷的铁腕进行统治，但是他在复仇时更加疯狂。然而，最可怕的不是他的处决方式，而是他‘从宽处理’时的惩罚方式，尤其是他对肉体穿刺的钟爱。所以，这就是我精心设计的伪装。”

items.name: Material_TormentorsPommel
items.description_en: A trophy taken from the hilt of the One True King’s mace. It’s unclear what that strange translucent substance is inside, but considering the source, you’d best be careful when handling it.
items.flavor_text_en: “I am what you might call an ardent collector of rare and valuable items. Whether their worth is derived from their composition, their prior owner’s prominence, or their intended secrecy, I make it my business to find and hoard such prizes. After all, you never know when such a thing will prove beneficial.”

description.en: A trophy taken from the hilt of the One True King’s mace. It’s unclear what that strange translucent substance is inside, but considering the source, you’d best be careful when handling it.
description.zh: 从独一真皇的权杖柄上取下来的纪念品。里面有种奇怪的透明物质，不清楚是什么。考虑到其来源，使用的时候一定要小心。

flavor.en: “I am what you might call an ardent collector of rare and valuable items. Whether their worth is derived from their composition, their prior owner’s prominence, or their intended secrecy, I make it my business to find and hoard such prizes. After all, you never know when such a thing will prove beneficial.”
flavor.zh: “我是稀有珍贵物品的狂热收藏者。无论它们的价值是来源于其材质工艺、前任主人的显赫身份，还是故意制造的神秘性，我都会尽力寻找并囤积这些珍品。毕竟，这样的东西不知道什么时候就能值个大价钱。”

items.name: Material_ForgeEmber
items.description_en: An unusual vessel of stone that houses some kind of molten substance. It seems to continuously burn no matter the conditions or how much time has passed. It’s exceedingly hot and you have no doubt it would cause a nasty burn if you tried to hold on to it with your bare hands.
items.flavor_text_en: “The flames of the stone goddess’s fury are such that cannot ever be quelled. She is a nasty, vengeful creature! It is not possible to reason with beings who are drunken with power. Trust me on this. All one can do is conspire in secret, await the perfect timing, and then go to great lengths to avoid being consumed by the conflagration.”

description.zh: 一个不寻常的石制容器，里面装着某种熔融物质。无论在何种条件下，无论时间如何流逝，它似乎都在永无止境地燃烧。其温度极高，如果你试图裸手抓握，毫无疑问会被高温灼伤。

flavor.en: “The flames of the stone goddess’s fury are such that cannot ever be quelled. She is a nasty, vengeful creature! It is not possible to reason with beings who are drunken with power. Trust me on this. All one can do is conspire in secret, await the perfect timing, and then go to great lengths to avoid being consumed by the conflagration.”
flavor.zh: “石之女神的愤怒之火燃烧得如此猛烈，永远无法平息。她既恶毒，又记仇！同醉心于权力之人毫无道理可讲。相信我，我们唯一能做的就是暗中密谋，等待时机，然后竭尽全力避免被复仇烈焰所吞噬。”

items.name: Material_PallidLodestone
items.description_en: Dry grass sprouts upon this chunk of rock, making the living stone it belonged to alive in more ways than one. At least, it was alive once. Not anymore.
items.flavor_text_en: "The living stones are incredible! There is so little they cannot do. Think of how many Pan have died mining crystals for the Ahanae in the dangerous depths of Yaesha when the living stones could have done it for us. Never again would a Pan perish laboring for their betters. That is the Yaesha I dream of."

description.en: Dry grass sprouts upon this chunk of rock, making the living stone it belonged to alive in more ways than one. At least, it was alive once. Not anymore.
description.zh: 这块岩石上长着干枯的野草，说明它曾是一块比普通活石更具生命力的活石。至少，它曾经生意盎然。但现在死透了。

Think of how many Pan have died mining crystals for the Ahanae in the dangerous depths of Yaesha when the living stones could have done it for us. Never again would a Pan perish laboring for their betters. That is the Yaesha I dream of."
flavor.zh: “活石真是不可思议！它们几乎无所不能。想象一下，多少潘恩在耶莎危险的深处为阿哈内开采水晶而死，而这是一份活石能顶替的工作。再也不会有潘恩死于为权贵阶层的辛苦劳作。这就是我梦想中的耶莎。”

items.name: Material_CeramicFlask
items.description_en: A clay pot sealed at the top with century-worn wax, protecting whatever treasures or dangers may reside within. Now, if you know anything: there’s only one good way to find out what’s inside a blatantly breakable pot.
items.flavor_text_en: "In my explorations, I have unearthed ceramics made of materials far unlike those I’ve ever seen on Yaesha. Perhaps their origins lie in our faraway homeland, from before we crossed the Dark Sea. Oh, to hold something that once belonged to our adventurous ancestors—what an amazing sensation! My fur is on its ends!"

description.zh: 历经百年之久的蜂蜡严丝合缝地密封着陶罐，保护着内在可能的宝藏或危险。现在，你懂的：要想得知易碎的罐子里有什么，只有一个最好的办法。你知道是什么吗？

flavor.en: "In my explorations, I have unearthed ceramics made of materials far unlike those I’ve ever seen on Yaesha. Perhaps their origins lie in our faraway homeland, from before we crossed the Dark Sea. Oh, to hold something that once belonged to our adventurous ancestors—what an amazing sensation! My fur is on its ends!"
flavor.zh: “在我的探索过程中，我发掘了一些陶瓷，其原料与我在耶莎见过的截然不同。或许它们源自我们遥远的故乡，且在我们穿越黑暗之海前就已经存在。哦，能够亲手拿着一件曾属于我们富有冒险精神先祖的物品——简直令人目眩神迷！我全身的毛都竖起来了！”

items.name: Material_RegurgitatedSpinySac
items.description_en: It looks like a regurgitated piece of deadwood. Probably because that’s what it is. Those thorns couldn’t have felt too good in that giant bird’s stomach. In any case, there must be some practical use for something so sturdy and nasty.
items.flavor_text_en: "All things have their place in the natural order of the world, and the kuri kuri bird is a testament to this truth. Its nest, crafted from the corpses of creatures that strike fear in most, is a solemn reminder that no matter the power one may possess, it can never be enough."

description.en: It looks like a regurgitated piece of deadwood. Probably because that’s what it is. Those thorns couldn’t have felt too good in that giant bird’s stomach. In any case, there must be some practical use for something so sturdy and nasty.
description.zh: 它看起来就像一块被反刍的枯树，或许它本来就是。那些尖刺对巨鸟的胃大概很不友好。无论如何，这块又坚硬又恶心的东西说不定在什么地方能派上用场。

flavor.en: "All things have their place in the natural order of the world, and the kuri kuri bird is a testament to this truth. Its nest, crafted from the corpses of creatures that strike fear in most, is a solemn reminder that no matter the power one may possess, it can never be enough."
flavor.zh: “万物皆有其在自然秩序中的位置，而库里库里鸟正是这一真理的见证。它筑巢的材料是绝大多数生物天敌的尸体，这也是一个郑重的提醒：不要餍足，多少力量都不嫌多。”

items.name: Material_BlossomingCore
items.description_en: A pearl of power held safely within a rock cradle. Though the edges of the stone are jagged and sharp, the beautiful shape resembles a flower.
items.flavor_text_en: "I will never forget you, sweet beast. Perhaps we will meet again someday, and you and I will sing and dance together. Lydusa looks forward to that precious day."

items.name: Material_EyeOfLydusa
items.description_en: The severed eye of the shattered stone goddess, surrounded by tiny blue crystals that look a lot like tears.
items.flavor_text_en: “Do not be fooled: the Pan were Lydusa’s playthings, nothing more. She could not love them nor King Thalos, not truly! The spirits are not mortals, lacking in flesh and hearts, so they are incapable of such sentiments. Of this I am certain."

description.en: The severed eye of the shattered stone goddess, surrounded by tiny blue crystals that look a lot like tears.
description.zh: 已经碎裂的女神石像的眼睛，周围环绕着看起来很像泪水的细小蓝水晶。

flavor.en: “Do not be fooled: the Pan were Lydusa’s playthings, nothing more. She could not love them nor King Thalos, not truly! The spirits are not mortals, lacking in flesh and hearts, so they are incapable of such sentiments. Of this I am certain."

items.name: Material_ReplicationPod
items.description_en: Tiny robots incubate within this artificial egg sack. The larvae train on data from the larger harvester as it performs its duties, then hatch once they are fully operational, fulfilling the completely automated replication cycle.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr dabbled in artificial cloning in the past, but quickly realized the ethical dilemmas involved in cloning sapient organisms. Most studies were shut down by the Seekers and redirected to agricultural sectors to be reapplied to crops, and with time, machines."

description.en: Tiny robots incubate within this artificial egg sack. The larvae train on data from the larger harvester as it performs its duties, then hatch once they are fully operational, fulfilling the completely automated replication cycle.
description.zh: 微型机器人在这个人造卵囊内孵化。幼体使用大型收获者执行任务时的数据进行训练，在学会全部功能后孵化。这样，一个全自动复制周期就完成了。

flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人涉足过人工克隆，但很快意识到克隆智慧生物的伦理困境。大多数研究都被追寻者叫停，转而应用于农业领域的农作物克隆，后来又开始应用于机器。”

items.name: Material_VoidlightCore
items.description_en: A cylindrical vial harboring voidlight, a highly unstable compound distilled from harvested dark matter and used in a variety of Drzyr technologies.
items.flavor_text_en: “Highly trained Phetyr pilots were integrated directly with their cybernetic armor, which also housed an artificial intelligence. The two worked in concert, achieving what neither could on its own. The pilots entered cryostasis in their armor as a safety precaution in the event the Drzyr faced an unknown enemy upon awakening.”

description.en: A cylindrical vial harboring voidlight, a highly unstable compound distilled from harvested dark matter and used in a variety of Drzyr technologies.
description.zh: 一种圆柱形药瓶，内含虚空之光。这是一种从收集到的暗物质中提取并用于各种泽厄尔技术的高不稳定化合物。

The two worked in concert, achieving what neither could on its own. The pilots entered cryostasis in their armor as a safety precaution in the event the Drzyr faced an unknown enemy upon awakening.”
flavor.zh: “训练有素的菲特尔飞行员直接将自己和搭载了人工智能的机械装甲融为一体。两者协同工作，实现一加一大于二的效果。飞行员在装甲中进入低温隐身状态，以防泽厄尔人在苏醒时遇到未知的敌人。”

items.name: Material_BlackMetalBars
items.description_en: These mysterious black bars are unlike any metal you’ve ever seen, being both heavy and remarkably durable. You might never learn where they came from, but it’s likely that McCabe can find a use for them.
items.flavor_text_en: “I usually don't mind trading war stories or talking about how the Mud Dogs landed a big score, but how I came upon these, I'm gonna take that with me to my grave.”

description.en: These mysterious black bars are unlike any metal you’ve ever seen, being both heavy and remarkably durable. You might never learn where they came from, but it’s likely that McCabe can find a use for them.
description.zh: 这些神秘的黑棒很沉重，同时又非常耐用，不同于你见过的任何金属。也许你永远都无法得知它们的来源，但麦凯布大概能发现它们的用途。

items.name: Material_IonRod
items.description_en: A piece of N’Erudian terrain that has been processed into a more useful hexagonal shape. The lines on the outside can be counted to reveal the age of the material in N’Erudian cycles.
items.flavor_text_en: "N’Erud was designed in the image and function of a planet. Though it is artificial in its creation, it is also self-sustaining. After countless generations of supporting its own terrain and atmosphere, one who does not know any better cannot tell the difference between N’Erud and a naturally formed planet."

description.en: A piece of N’Erudian terrain that has been processed into a more useful hexagonal shape. The lines on the outside can be counted to reveal the age of the material in N’Erudian cycles.
description.zh: 一块涅鲁德地质材料被加工成了更实用的六边形。可以通过外部线条来计算物质在涅鲁德循环中的年龄。

flavor.zh: “涅鲁德的外形和功能是按照行星设计的。虽然它是人工制造的，但仍然可以自我维持。经过无数代的地形和大气支持，不知原委的人根本无法区分涅鲁德和自然形成的星球。”

items.name: Material_PrismaticStone_1
items.description_en: The small yellow crystals appear to radiate warmth, yet it feels cool to the touch. Clearly, there's more to it than meets the eye; perhaps someone else can uncover its potential use.
items.flavor_text_en: “You unearthed this in the Ward. I saw you dig it up, not in my head, but with my own eyes. I’ve got a pretty good view of the shooting range from here.”

description.en: The small yellow crystals appear to radiate warmth, yet it feels cool to the touch. Clearly, there's more to it than meets the eye; perhaps someone else can uncover its potential use.
description.zh: 这颗小小的黄色水晶似乎散发着温暖，但触感冰凉。显然，它并不像表面那么简单。也许有人能发现它的潜在用途。

flavor.en: “You unearthed this in the Ward. I saw you dig it up, not in my head, but with my own eyes. I’ve got a pretty good view of the shooting range from here.”
flavor.zh: “这是你在实验区发现的。我亲眼看到你挖出来的，不是想象，而是亲眼所见。我从这里能清楚地看到射击场。”

items.name: Material_PrismaticStone_2
items.description_en: Despite the impossibility, the tiny blue crystals on the surface appear to shift and move, much like the Labyrinth where you found it. It's hard to discern a use for this, but perhaps someone else might have the answers.
items.flavor_text_en: “You found this in the place with countless doors. Ford ventured there often, perhaps finding peace in its solitude or comfort in its nearly infinite possibilities.”

description.en: Despite the impossibility, the tiny blue crystals on the surface appear to shift and move, much like the Labyrinth where you found it. It's hard to discern a use for this, but perhaps someone else might have the answers.
description.zh: 尽管难以置信，但它表面的微小蓝色晶体似乎在移动，就像它原来所在的迷宫一样。很难看出它有什么用途，但也许其他人能找到答案。

flavor.en: “You found this in the place with countless doors. Ford ventured there often, perhaps finding peace in its solitude or comfort in its nearly infinite possibilities.”
flavor.zh: “你在有无数门的地方发现了这个。福特以前经常去那里冒险，也许是为了在孤独中找到平静，或是在近乎无限的可能性中找到慰藉。”

items.name: Material_PrismaticStone_3
items.description_en: The small red crystals emit a subtle glow, reminiscent of the World Stone but with a more sinister edge. Gazing into the depths of the crystal cluster, you feel the abyss calling to you. It might be wise to pass this on to someone else.
items.flavor_text_en: “You uncovered this on their earth. While it’s a bit terrifying to see what can happen to a world so much like ours, keep in mind that our earth would never have existed if the Root hadn’t come into being.”

description.en: The small red crystals emit a subtle glow, reminiscent of the World Stone but with a more sinister edge. Gazing into the depths of the crystal cluster, you feel the abyss calling to you. It might be wise to pass this on to someone else.
description.zh: 这些小小的红色晶体散发着微弱的光芒，让人联想到世界之石，但带着更凶险的气息。凝视水晶簇的深处，你会感觉到深渊的召唤。也许最好把它转手给别人。

flavor.en: “You uncovered this on their earth. While it’s a bit terrifying to see what can happen to a world so much like ours, keep in mind that our earth would never have existed if the Root hadn’t come into being.”
flavor.zh: “这是你在他们的土地上发现的。虽然看到与我们如此相像的一个世界发生这种事有点恐怖，但请记住，如果没有根蔓，我们的土地就不会存在。”

items.name: Material_BlackMass
items.description_en: A luminous sphere of dark matter. Is it a liquid or a solid? Somehow, it seems to be both at once. You don’t really understand what it is, but if dealing with Alepsis-Taura taught you anything, it’s that it’s pointless to try.
items.flavor_text_en: “Drzyr scientists knew that entering the black hole was their best and only hope for salvation. In retrospect, it is easy to judge the soundness of this decision, but when faced with certain doom or a sliver of hope, the calculation is categorically simple.”

description.en: A luminous sphere of dark matter. Is it a liquid or a solid? Somehow, it seems to be both at once. You don’t really understand what it is, but if dealing with Alepsis-Taura taught you anything, it’s that it’s pointless to try.
description.zh: 一个发光的暗物质球体，它到底是液体，还是固体？出于某种不明原因，它似乎二者兼而有之。你并不能真正理解它究竟是什么，但在和阿莱普西斯-陶拉打交道的过程中你学到了一点，那就是尝试毫无意义。

flavor.en: “Drzyr scientists knew that entering the black hole was their best and only hope for salvation. In retrospect, it is easy to judge the soundness of this decision, but when faced with certain doom or a sliver of hope, the calculation is categorically simple.”
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔科学家认为进入黑洞是他们唯一且最好的救赎希望。复盘的话，我们很容易判断这一决定的合理性，但当面对无法避免的厄运或一线希望时，利弊权衡显而易见。”

items.name: Material_EternityChamber
items.description_en: An incomprehensible prism of dark matter. When it's in your grasp, it's as though you can faintly hear the whispers of an indiscernible voice echoing in your mind. It's at once haunting and mesmerizing.
items.flavor_text_en: "There were many who believed it was highly illogical to cross the event horizon. Their concerns were drowned out by the fervor and authority of the rest. Their calculations assured them it was a sound decision, but it was more than that. They were drawn to the promise of Alepsis-Taura by a force they could scarcely understand.”

items.name: Material_CursedDreamSilks
items.description_en: The thread scratches and wriggles between your fingers. A chill lingers in your skin long after you stop touching it.
items.flavor_text_en: "She was beautiful once, the goddess of dreams—beautiful and awesome and terrible. The dreamscape of all Fae was her playground, and none could deny an invitation to her domain… yet she wanted still more."

description.en: The thread scratches and wriggles between your fingers. A chill lingers in your skin long after you stop touching it.
description.zh: 这线绳在你的指尖摩擦，蠕动。就算把手移开，依然能感到皮肤上残存的寒意。

flavor.en: "She was beautiful once, the goddess of dreams—beautiful and awesome and terrible. The dreamscape of all Fae was her playground, and none could deny an invitation to her domain… yet she wanted still more."
flavor.zh: “曾经的她非常美丽，是梦境的女神——美丽、威严且可怕。所有翡族的梦境都是她的游乐场，她发出的梦境邀请无人能够回绝……但她还不知足，想要更多快乐。”

items.name: Material_ImpostersHeart
items.description_en: One side pulses softly, the other at a rapid pace. One side holds warmth, the other an abyssal chill. The biological functioning of this organ is mystifying, but the enigma goes a long way toward explaining its previous owner's temperament.
items.flavor_text_en: "There is only one imposter king. Whatever their appearance may be, their cunning is the fruit of a single mind, and their pulse is that of a single heart—simultaneously black and deceptive."

description.en: One side pulses softly, the other at a rapid pace. One side holds warmth, the other an abyssal chill. The biological functioning of this organ is mystifying, but the enigma goes a long way toward explaining its previous owner's temperament.
description.zh: 一边轻柔跳动，一边动若脱兔。一边温暖如春，一边冰冷刺骨。这种器官的运转机制难以用生物学知识解释，但同时又十分契合前主人的性格特征。

flavor.en: "There is only one imposter king. Whatever their appearance may be, their cunning is the fruit of a single mind, and their pulse is that of a single heart—simultaneously black and deceptive."
flavor.zh: “冒牌翡王只有一个。不管此人的外表如何变幻，那些阴谋诡计都是来自同一个大脑、同一颗心脏——阴暗而虚伪。”

items.name: Material_MeldedHilt
items.description_en: Though it appears to be some kind of hardened gold twined with obsidian, the two metals are fused in places, their seam almost indiscernible. The hilt is made of both two metals and one.
items.flavor_text_en: "The imposter king is obsessed with appearance—simultaneously consumed with beauty yet unwilling to convey falsity, a contradiction that served them quite well until recently."

description.en: Though it appears to be some kind of hardened gold twined with obsidian, the two metals are fused in places, their seam almost indiscernible. The hilt is made of both two metals and one.
description.zh: 看上去像是由黑曜石和一种硬质金属共同打造，两种金属有多处融合在一起，几乎看不到接缝。这把剑柄既可以说是由两种金属制成，又可以说是同一种。

flavor.en: "The imposter king is obsessed with appearance—simultaneously consumed with beauty yet unwilling to convey falsity, a contradiction that served them quite well until recently."
flavor.zh: “冒牌翡王痴迷于外表——既追求美丽又不愿传递虚假，这种矛盾的态度一直为他们所用，直到最近才有所改变。”

items.name: Material_NightweaversFinger
items.description_en: The finger still twitches every so often, curling toward you, beckoning. You feel a twinge of panic every time it does.
items.flavor_text_en: "I saw but did not want to see and so blinded myself to certain truths. Dreams were never enough. I knew this. His Majesty knew this. Her taste grew, her palate shifted... or perhaps it had always been thus. I do not know."

description.en: The finger still twitches every so often, curling toward you, beckoning. You feel a twinge of panic every time it does.
description.zh: 这根手指依然时常抽动，朝你勾一勾，仿佛在呼唤你。它每动一下，都会让人感到一阵恐慌。

flavor.en: "I saw but did not want to see and so blinded myself to certain truths. Dreams were never enough. I knew this. His Majesty knew this. Her taste grew, her palate shifted... or perhaps it had always been thus. I do not know."
flavor.zh: “我看到了，但我并不想看到，所以我选择对某些真相视而不见。梦境是永远不够的，我知道，陛下也知道。她的胃口变大了，口味也变了……但也可能一直都没变。我也不知道。”

items.name: Material_AlkahestPowder
items.description_en: Your nose can't make any sense of this powder. It smells like a hundred things at once and like nothing at all. It would seem the Dran have solved certain alchemical problems previously thought impossible.
items.flavor_text_en: "Impossible's just a word for something nobody's figured out yet. Everything was impossible once, but lots of things aren't anymore. Only difference between the two is time and trouble."

description.en: Your nose can't make any sense of this powder. It smells like a hundred things at once and like nothing at all. It would seem the Dran have solved certain alchemical problems previously thought impossible.
description.zh: 你的鼻子无法从这种粉末中获得任何有用信息。它闻起来像一百种东西的混合物，又像什么都没有。看来，德兰已经解决了某些以前以为不可能的炼金术难题。

flavor.en: "Impossible's just a word for something nobody's figured out yet. Everything was impossible once, but lots of things aren't anymore. Only difference between the two is time and trouble."
flavor.zh: “‘不可能’只是人们还未研究清楚罢了。所有事物都曾‘不可能’过，而现在很多事物都已经变得‘可能’了。两者间唯一的区别就是时间与努力。”

items.name: Material_BoneSap
items.description_en: Touching this gooey lump makes your fingers tingle—painfully so. Whatever creature this came from, some of its life lives on in this goop.
items.flavor_text_en: "Loads of things live in the dark places, things most Dran have forgotten. If you ask me, nothing is best left forgotten, but I reckon there are some things some folk need to forget. Better than living paralyzed in fear."

description.en: Touching this gooey lump makes your fingers tingle—painfully so. Whatever creature this came from, some of its life lives on in this goop.
description.zh: 碰一下这种粘稠的肿块就让人指尖发麻——甚至很痛苦。不管这东西来自什么生物，其中都还残留着那个生物的生机。

flavor.en: "Loads of things live in the dark places, things most Dran have forgotten. If you ask me, nothing is best left forgotten, but I reckon there are some things some folk need to forget. Better than living paralyzed in fear."
flavor.zh: “有很多东西是生活在黑暗中的，那些东西被大多德兰人遗忘了。要我说，没有什么东西是理应被遗忘的，但有些东西需要被某些人遗忘。遗忘总比活在恐惧中好。”

items.name: Material_ForlornFragment
items.description_en: Pieces of the Red Prince's broken sword. The extremities have cooled somewhat since it shattered, yet where it split remains red-hot.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Few know, and fewer still believe, of the One True King's great indiscretion. He thought to bridge the gap between us, to bind us one to another. His folly created not a bridge but a wedge.

It is a sin to which he will never admit. I sometimes doubt even my own knowledge of it."

description.en: Pieces of the Red Prince's broken sword. The extremities have cooled somewhat since it shattered, yet where it split remains red-hot.
description.zh: 红王子的断剑碎片。虽然剑端已经变得冰冷，但断裂处摸起来依然滚烫。

flavor.en:
"Few know, and fewer still believe, of the One True King's great indiscretion. He thought to bridge the gap between us, to bind us one to another. His folly created not a bridge but a wedge.

It is a sin to which he will never admit. I sometimes doubt even my own knowledge of it."
flavor.zh:
少有人知道，更少有人相信，独一真皇犯下了多么巨大过失。他以为可以弥合鸿沟，将我们彼此联系起来。然而，这一愚蠢行为造就的并不是桥梁，而是楔子。

这是他永远不会承认的罪行。有时我甚至怀疑自己对此的认知。

items.name: Material_SacredHuntFeather
items.description_en: Royal Hunters carry talismans like these for luck, often wearing them as amulets or earrings. This one vibrates in your hand, as though the feathers themselves were anxious to fly.
items.flavor_text_en: "Dreams are a funny thing, aren't they? They all make sense and don't at the same time. But don't discount them, dear. Even those wicked, wayward creatures dream, too—that don't count for nothing."

description.en: Royal Hunters carry talismans like these for luck, often wearing them as amulets or earrings. This one vibrates in your hand, as though the feathers themselves were anxious to fly.
description.zh: 皇家猎人通常将这类护符做成项链或耳环，随身佩戴以求好运。这根羽毛会在你手中颤动，仿佛急着飞向高空。

flavor.en: "Dreams are a funny thing, aren't they? They all make sense and don't at the same time. But don't discount them, dear. Even those wicked, wayward creatures dream, too—that don't count for nothing."
flavor.zh: “梦想是个有趣的东西，对吗？既有意义，又没有意义。不过，亲爱的，永远不要低估梦想。即使是最邪恶、最任性的生物的梦，也并非一无是处。”

items.name: Material_TaintedIchor
items.description_en: This vial once contained a sacred oil used in Dran holy rituals to bring peace and blessing. That's not what's in it anymore, though. This liquid is thick and murky, as if it was drained from another, even meatier source.
items.flavor_text_en: "Believing in religion ain't the problem, dear. Belief adds hope and meaning to life. The problem comes when folks try to control those beliefs. That's just being a bad person, and it don't take a religion to make those."

description.en: This vial once contained a sacred oil used in Dran holy rituals to bring peace and blessing. That's not what's in it anymore, though. This liquid is thick and murky, as if it was drained from another, even meatier source.
description.zh: 这个小瓶里以前装着一种圣油，是德兰人用来祈祷和平安乐的仪式道具。而现在，里面的东西已经换了，看起来粘稠而浑浊，就像是从某种更肥厚的东西里抽出来一样。

flavor.en: "Believing in religion ain't the problem, dear. Belief adds hope and meaning to life. The problem comes when folks try to control those beliefs. That's just being a bad person, and it don't take a religion to make those."
flavor.zh: “亲爱的，信仰宗教不是问题所在。信仰可以为生活增添希望和意义。然而，当人们想控制信仰时，问题就来了。想当坏人，不需要任何宗教就能实现。”

items.name: Material_VeneratedSpearhead
items.description_en: Many believe the Huntress to have forged her weapon herself, but in truth, it was a gift from Nimue in exchange for... certain services. The Huntress does not forge. Her focus has always remained solely on the hunt.
items.flavor_text_en: "Though often called upon by those who consider themselves eloquent, she herself rarely talks. She prefers the company of her steadfast steed, of which she speaks to in sweet-pitched cajolery—when her fellow Fae are not around."

description.en: Many believe the Huntress to have forged her weapon herself, but in truth, it was a gift from Nimue in exchange for... certain services. The Huntress does not forge. Her focus has always remained solely on the hunt.
description.zh: 很多人认为这件武器肯定是女猎人亲手打造的，但事实上，它是尼姆埃的礼物，为了换取……某种服务。女猎人并不会锻造，她的精力向来只用在狩猎上。

flavor.en: "Though often called upon by those who consider themselves eloquent, she herself rarely talks. She prefers the company of her steadfast steed, of which she speaks to in sweet-pitched cajolery—when her fellow Fae are not around."
flavor.zh: “虽然自负善辩者常邀她论道，但她本人却鲜少开口。她更喜欢与忠诚的骏马为伴。如果身旁无翡族同胞，她就会用欢快甜美的语调跟马儿讲话。”

items.name: Material_BloodySteelSplinter
items.description_en: This is your blood. It's not the first time you've seen it of course, but it's not often one holds the reason for their death after the fact.
items.flavor_text_en: "The One True King forever remains silent about his indiscretion, due in no small part to its volatile temperament. It would seem that the young prince inherited the worst traits of both sides."

description.zh: 上面是你自己的血。当然，这不是你第一次看到了，但一个人在死后才知道自己的死因，这种事可并不常见。

items.name: Material_DecrepitRune
items.description_en: A hardened shell houses some kind of luminous gem. It's unclear whether the shell was crafted or... grown somehow.
items.flavor_text_en:
"There are worlds beyond ours—a thing made apparent with the twining of two of them, but rest assured there are so many more.

Magic is innate to some, anathema to others, but all share it in some form. It is the life's blood of the universe."

description.zh: 坚硬的外壳内镶嵌着一种发光宝石。目前尚不清楚这个外壳是手工制作的，还是以某种方式生长而成的。

"There are worlds beyond ours—a thing made apparent with the twining of two of them, but rest assured there are so many more.

items.name: Material_CrimsonMembrane
items.description_en: The Doe exuded a feeling of peace and safety. This tissue, however, harvested from its corpse, feels... oppressive. Malevolent even.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Nowhere in all of Yaesha is the Balance better represented than through the Doe and the Ravager. Indeed, some Vaunnt believe they are the very source of the Balance.

These two have been locked in endless struggle for so long that none have even considered what might happen should one finally fall."

它们无休止的争斗跨越了时间的长河，以致没人考虑过如果其中一方倒下会发生什么。”

items.name: Material_DoesAntler
items.description_en: Even shattered and fallen, these pieces from the Doe's antler hold a soothing, unearthly warmth.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Doe embodies compassion and sacrifice—attributes often considered to be weakness by the unenlightened. But any who have seen the Doe in battle can tell you that any weakness it may show outwardly is not an inherent trait but a conscious—and momentary—choice."

description.en: Even shattered and fallen, these pieces from the Doe's antler hold a soothing, unearthly warmth.
description.zh: 红鹿的鹿角，即便已经变成支离的碎片，依然会给人带来舒缓超脱的余温。

flavor.en: "The Doe embodies compassion and sacrifice—attributes often considered to be weakness by the unenlightened. But any who have seen the Doe in battle can tell you that any weakness it may show outwardly is not an inherent trait but a conscious—and momentary—choice."
flavor.zh: “红鹿的身上散发着悲悯与奉献的精神，而那些无知之人会把这些特质视为弱点。不过，只要你见过红鹿战斗时的样子，就会知道，它之所以会展现出的弱点，并不是因为不够强大，而是它主动的、瞬间的抉择。”

items.description_zh: 红鹿的鹿角，即便已经变成支离的碎片，依然会给人带来舒缓超脱的余温。
items.flavor_text_zh: “红鹿的身上散发着悲悯与奉献的精神，而那些无知之人会把这些特质视为弱点。不过，只要你见过红鹿战斗时的样子，就会知道，它之所以会展现出的弱点，并不是因为不够强大，而是它主动的、瞬间的抉择。”

items.name: Material_HollowHeart
items.description_en: The Pan Guardian was corrupted fully by the Root, even to its very core. But perhaps some good may yet be done with what's left.
items.flavor_text_en: "Many Faces has watched over every generation of the Pan in living memory—and many more beyond that. They say it watches over us still, even after its death at the hands of the Destroyer."

description.en: The Pan Guardian was corrupted fully by the Root, even to its very core. But perhaps some good may yet be done with what's left.
description.zh: 潘恩的守护神已经完全被根蔓腐蚀，连祂的心也未能幸免。不过，剩下的这些或许还能用来做点好事。

flavor.en: "Many Faces has watched over every generation of the Pan in living memory—and many more beyond that. They say it watches over us still, even after its death at the hands of the Destroyer."
flavor.zh: “在潘恩的记忆中，千面神守护了一代又一代的子民，而且祂的贡献不止于此。大家都说，即使祂已经死于破坏者之手，也依然在守护我们。”

items.description_zh: 潘恩的守护神已经完全被根蔓腐蚀，连祂的心也未能幸免。不过，剩下的这些或许还能用来做点好事。
items.flavor_text_zh: “在潘恩的记忆中，千面神守护了一代又一代的子民，而且祂的贡献不止于此。大家都说，即使祂已经死于破坏者之手，也依然在守护我们。”
items.description_raw: The Pan Guardian was corrupted fully by the Root, even to its very core. But perhaps some good may yet be done with what's left.

items.name: Material_RavagersMaw
items.description_en: Heavy. Cold. Razor sharp. Whatever malevolent powers shaped this jaw reside within it still.
items.flavor_text_en: "There are those who believe the Ravager, embodiment of Death, cannot die. Indeed, this belief has been borne out by recent history. But if the beast truly cannot be killed, then we must ask ourselves why this is so. What is the Ravager, that the Balance requires its existence at all costs?"

description.en: Heavy. Cold. Razor sharp. Whatever malevolent powers shaped this jaw reside within it still.
description.zh: 沉重，冰冷，如剃刀般锋利。不知是怎样邪恶的力量造就了这样的颌骨，只知这力量还留存其中。

flavor.en: "There are those who believe the Ravager, embodiment of Death, cannot die. Indeed, this belief has been borne out by recent history. But if the beast truly cannot be killed, then we must ask ourselves why this is so. What is the Ravager, that the Balance requires its existence at all costs?"
flavor.zh: “有人认为劫掠者是死亡的化身，不会死亡。的确，这一点已经得到了近段时间所发生之事的证实。但如果这头野兽真的无法被杀死，那我们就该问问自己为什么会这样了。‘平衡’不惜一切代价去维护其存在的劫掠者到底是什么？”

items.description_zh: 沉重，冰冷，如剃刀般锋利。不知是怎样邪恶的力量造就了这样的颌骨，只知这力量还留存其中。
items.flavor_text_zh: “有人认为劫掠者是死亡的化身，不会死亡。的确，这一点已经得到了近段时间所发生之事的证实。但如果这头野兽真的无法被杀死，那我们就该问问自己为什么会这样了。‘平衡’不惜一切代价去维护其存在的劫掠者到底是什么？”
items.description_raw: Heavy. Cold. Razor sharp. Whatever malevolent powers shaped this jaw reside within it still.

items.name: Material_TwistedLazurite
items.description_en: A shard of the Pan Guardian—or at least of what the Guardian had become at the hands of the Root. It vibrates in your hand, shivering with eager energy.
items.flavor_text_en: "It is said that the One of Many watches all things at all times, so it cannot be taken by surprise. Whether it truly watches us all—in peace and war, waking and sleep—I cannot say, but on the battlefield? Absolutely."

description.en: A shard of the Pan Guardian—or at least of what the Guardian had become at the hands of the Root. It vibrates in your hand, shivering with eager energy.
description.zh: 潘恩守护神的碎片——或者说，在根蔓操控下的守护神的碎片。它带着渴望的能量，在你手中震颤。

flavor.en: "It is said that the One of Many watches all things at all times, so it cannot be taken by surprise. Whether it truly watches us all—in peace and war, waking and sleep—I cannot say, but on the battlefield? Absolutely."
flavor.zh: “据说‘千面归一’时刻注视万物，所以无法对祂偷袭。我无法确定祂是否真的在注视我们，无论和平还是战争，清醒还是梦中。但我可以确定，在战场上，祂一定会投来目光。”

items.description_zh: 潘恩守护神的碎片——或者说，在根蔓操控下的守护神的碎片。它带着渴望的能量，在你手中震颤。
items.flavor_text_zh: “据说‘千面归一’时刻注视万物，所以无法对祂偷袭。我无法确定祂是否真的在注视我们，无论和平还是战争，清醒还是梦中。但我可以确定，在战场上，祂一定会投来目光。”

items.name: Material_AgnosiaDriftwood
items.description_en: Unknown runes adorn this otherwise ordinary piece of wood. They seem to slide and slither across its surface—not while you're looking at it, of course, but whenever you look away.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Laemir did not restrict their experiments to deceased Pan. In time, they expanded their search for longevity to the Root themselves, for though these creatures could be killed, they did not seem to age or decay through natural means."

description.en: Unknown runes adorn this otherwise ordinary piece of wood. They seem to slide and slither across its surface—not while you're looking at it, of course, but whenever you look away.
description.zh: 这块普通的木头上装饰着未知的符文。这些符文仿佛在流动一般——当然，是在你把目光移开的时候，盯着它看的时候，它们一动不动。

flavor.en: "The Laemir did not restrict their experiments to deceased Pan. In time, they expanded their search for longevity to the Root themselves, for though these creatures could be killed, they did not seem to age or decay through natural means."
flavor.zh: “莱米尔并没有把实验对象限制在亡故的潘恩身上。随着时间推移，他们将对长寿的探索扩大到了根蔓本身，因为这些生物虽然可以被杀死，但却似乎不会因为自然原因而衰老或腐朽。”

items.description_zh: 这块普通的木头上装饰着未知的符文。这些符文仿佛在流动一般——当然，是在你把目光移开的时候，盯着它看的时候，它们一动不动。

items.name: Material_CordycepGland
items.description_en: Voices and whispers. You hear them every time you hold this wet viscera in your hand. Hundreds of them. Thousands. Dissonant and uncaring.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan learned how the Root communicated almost immediately. Collective consciousness is not uncommon on Yaesha. What we did not learn, at least not until later, was how much of their communication was a simple, rancorous urge to destroy."

description.en: Voices and whispers. You hear them every time you hold this wet viscera in your hand. Hundreds of them. Thousands. Dissonant and uncaring.
description.zh: 每次拿起这湿软的腺体时，都能听到喃喃的低语。数以百计，数以千计地交织在一起，冷漠而聒噪。

flavor.en: "The Pan learned how the Root communicated almost immediately. Collective consciousness is not uncommon on Yaesha. What we did not learn, at least not until later, was how much of their communication was a simple, rancorous urge to destroy."
flavor.zh: “潘恩几乎立刻就学会了根蔓的交流方式。集体意识在耶莎并不罕见。但我们不知道的是——或者说很久以后才知道——它们间的交流中，纯粹的毁灭欲望占了多少。”

items.description_zh: 每次拿起这湿软的腺体时，都能听到喃喃的低语。数以百计，数以千计地交织在一起，冷漠而聒噪。

items.name: Material_SoulSliver
items.description_en: The crystal seems to glow and pulse from within. Your skin tingles at its touch—not in a good way.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Pan's first encounter with the Root left few survivors, and many that lived wished that they had not. The days of the injured were filled with pain and anguish, and the nights... were far worse."

description.en: The crystal seems to glow and pulse from within. Your skin tingles at its touch—not in a good way.
description.zh: 水晶内部似乎散发着光芒和脉冲。触碰时，皮肤会感到刺痛——让人不太舒服。

flavor.en: "The Pan's first encounter with the Root left few survivors, and many that lived wished that they had not. The days of the injured were filled with pain and anguish, and the nights... were far worse."
flavor.zh: “潘恩第一次遭遇根蔓时，幸存者寥寥无几，而其中有很多宁愿自己没活下来。创伤令他们日日痛苦煎熬，晚上……就更不好受了。”

items.description_zh: 水晶内部似乎散发着光芒和脉冲。触碰时，皮肤会感到刺痛——让人不太舒服。

items.name: Material_TwilightDactylus
items.description_en: Even tucked away in your pack, this thing writhes around, grabbing what it can and shoving things around as it pleases. Perhaps it was a mistake to take it along.
items.flavor_text_en: "Though records of that time disagree, it is said the Root entered Yaesha around the same time as the Destroyer first came to Yaesha. If this is true, it raises serious and troubling questions about the origins of Yaesha's corruption."

description.en: Even tucked away in your pack, this thing writhes around, grabbing what it can and shoving things around as it pleases. Perhaps it was a mistake to take it along.
description.zh: 即使扔在背包里，这东西依然扭动个不停，抓住一切能抓住的东西，推开一切能推开的东西。也许不该带上它。

flavor.en: "Though records of that time disagree, it is said the Root entered Yaesha around the same time as the Destroyer first came to Yaesha. If this is true, it raises serious and troubling questions about the origins of Yaesha's corruption."
flavor.zh: “尽管当时的记录存在分歧，但据说根蔓入侵耶莎的时间与破坏者第一次来到耶莎的时间几乎一致。如果这是真的，有关耶莎腐坏来源的问题就会变得相当值得深思。”

items.description_zh: 即使扔在背包里，这东西依然扭动个不停，抓住一切能抓住的东西，推开一切能推开的东西。也许不该带上它。
items.flavor_text_zh: “尽管当时的记录存在分歧，但据说根蔓入侵耶莎的时间与破坏者第一次来到耶莎的时间几乎一致。如果这是真的，有关耶莎腐坏来源的问题就会变得相当值得深思。”

items.name: Material_BloodMoonEssence
items.description_en: Your eyes slide off the globe like water. It's as if the thing prevents you from looking at it, feeling it, or even keeping its shape in your mind.
items.flavor_text_en: "There are many who believe the Blood Moon means death—and with good reason—but the essence of the Blood Moon is change. And change comes in many forms, though few that are pleasant for the thing that must evolve."

description.en: Your eyes slide off the globe like water. It's as if the thing prevents you from looking at it, feeling it, or even keeping its shape in your mind.
description.zh: 你的目光如水一般从这个球体上滑落，仿佛这件物品不愿你看到它，感受它，甚至让你无法在脑海中描摹它的形状。

flavor.en: "There are many who believe the Blood Moon means death—and with good reason—but the essence of the Blood Moon is change. And change comes in many forms, though few that are pleasant for the thing that must evolve."
flavor.zh: “很多人认为血月意味着死亡——而且理由充分——但血月的本质是变化。而变化存在多种形式，尽管对于必须进化的事物本身来说，往往是不愉快的形式。”

items.description_zh: 你的目光如水一般从这个球体上滑落，仿佛这件物品不愿你看到它，感受它，甚至让你无法在脑海中描摹它的形状。
items.flavor_text_zh: “很多人认为血月意味着死亡——而且理由充分——但血月的本质是变化。而变化存在多种形式，尽管对于必须进化的事物本身来说，往往是不愉快的形式。”
items.description_raw: Your eyes slide off the globe like water. It's as if the thing prevents you from looking at it, feeling it, or even keeping its shape in your mind.

items.name: Material_FaithSeed
items.description_en: A gift from the Doe itself. It contains life and begets life—as all seeds do, but this one does so much more quickly.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Ravager is necessary for the Balance, but it cannot understand the Balance, for it believes only in the death of all things. The Doe alone understands that death and life are, in fact, the same thing."

description.en: A gift from the Doe itself. It contains life and begets life—as all seeds do, but this one does so much more quickly.
description.zh: 来自红鹿的礼物。它和所有的种子一样，包含生命并孕育生命。不同的是，这一颗能够更快地完成这个过程。

flavor.en: "The Ravager is necessary for the Balance, but it cannot understand the Balance, for it believes only in the death of all things. The Doe alone understands that death and life are, in fact, the same thing."
flavor.zh: “劫掠者对维系平衡是必要的，但它并不理解平衡，因为它只相信万物的死亡。只有红鹿明白死亡和生命其实是同一件事。”

items.description_zh: 来自红鹿的礼物。它和所有的种子一样，包含生命并孕育生命。不同的是，这一颗能够更快地完成这个过程。
items.flavor_text_zh: “劫掠者对维系平衡是必要的，但它并不理解平衡，因为它只相信万物的死亡。只有红鹿明白死亡和生命其实是同一件事。”
items.description_raw: A gift from the Doe itself. It contains life and begets life—as all seeds do, but this one does so much more quickly.

items.name: Material_HeartSeed
items.description_en: With this seed in your hand, you feel your senses… expanding. As if you can see and feel through the senses of living things around you.
items.flavor_text_en: "There are those, especially among paxultek, who believe our aphorisms to be mere philosophy. But I assure you, concepts such as the Balance are as measurable and inevitable as the tide, the rising sun or death."

description.en: With this seed in your hand, you feel your senses… expanding. As if you can see and feel through the senses of living things around you.
description.zh: 将这颗种子拿在手中，你会发现自己的感官……在扩张。就好像你能通过周围生物来观察和感受。

flavor.en: "There are those, especially among paxultek, who believe our aphorisms to be mere philosophy. But I assure you, concepts such as the Balance are as measurable and inevitable as the tide, the rising sun or death."
flavor.zh: “有些种族，尤其是帕苏泰克中，很多个体认为我们的箴言只属于哲学范畴。但我可以跟你保证，诸如‘平衡’之类的概念，其实和潮汐、日出、死亡一样，是可以测量且无法避免的。”

items.description_zh: 将这颗种子拿在手中，你会发现自己的感官……在扩张。就好像你能通过周围生物来观察和感受。
items.flavor_text_zh: “有些种族，尤其是帕苏泰克中，很多个体认为我们的箴言只属于哲学范畴。但我可以跟你保证，诸如‘平衡’之类的概念，其实和潮汐、日出、死亡一样，是可以测量且无法避免的。”
items.description_raw: With this seed in your hand, you feel your senses… expanding. As if you can see and feel through the senses of living things around you.

items.name: Material_ScrollOfBinding
items.description_en: Aged by the hands of generations of Pan Musicians, this scroll contains a composition so harmonious it was thought to tame even the untamable.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Water Harp sings the story of Pan and Ravager both, for their tales are ever intertwined. Even in silence, the Harp plays the music between notes."

description.en: Aged by the hands of generations of Pan Musicians, this scroll contains a composition so harmonious it was thought to tame even the untamable.
description.zh: 这个卷轴在潘恩音乐家的手中传递了数代，其中的乐曲宛如天籁，据说最为桀骜不驯的生灵也会被它安抚。

flavor.en: "The Water Harp sings the story of Pan and Ravager both, for their tales are ever intertwined. Even in silence, the Harp plays the music between notes."
flavor.zh: “清淙竖琴演奏着潘恩和劫掠者的故事，因为他们的命运永远交织在一起。即便无声，竖琴也在演奏着音符之间的旋律。”

items.description_zh: 这个卷轴在潘恩音乐家的手中传递了数代，其中的乐曲宛如天籁，据说最为桀骜不驯的生灵也会被它安抚。
items.flavor_text_zh: “清淙竖琴演奏着潘恩和劫掠者的故事，因为他们的命运永远交织在一起。即便无声，竖琴也在演奏着音符之间的旋律。”
items.description_raw: Aged by the hands of generations of Pan Musicians, this scroll contains a composition so harmonious it was thought to tame even the untamable.

items.name: Material_ThaenLeaf
items.description_en: This leaf feels brittle, as though the slightest touch might cause it to crumble. Yet for all that it cracks and bends, it remains whole and strong, impervious to the forces brought to bear against it.
items.flavor_text_en: "The World Song is created by and for all things. If life be the orchestra, then the Thaen is the conductor, stage, and theater. For the souls of all created things flow to and from the Tree of Life."

description.en: This leaf feels brittle, as though the slightest touch might cause it to crumble. Yet for all that it cracks and bends, it remains whole and strong, impervious to the forces brought to bear against it.
description.zh: 这片叶子给人一种脆弱的感觉，好像轻轻一碰就会碎掉。然而，尽管出现了弯曲和裂缝，它依然完整坚挺，不受外力影响。

flavor.en: "The World Song is created by and for all things. If life be the orchestra, then the Thaen is the conductor, stage, and theater. For the souls of all created things flow to and from the Tree of Life."
flavor.zh: “世界之歌由万物而创造，也是为万物而创造。如果生命是乐队，那塞恩就是指挥家，是舞台和剧院。因为所有造物的灵魂都会涌向生命之树，又从生命之树流出。”

items.description_zh: 这片叶子给人一种脆弱的感觉，好像轻轻一碰就会碎掉。然而，尽管出现了弯曲和裂缝，它依然完整坚挺，不受外力影响。
items.flavor_text_zh: “世界之歌由万物而创造，也是为万物而创造。如果生命是乐队，那塞恩就是指挥家，是舞台和剧院。因为所有造物的灵魂都会涌向生命之树，又从生命之树流出。”
items.description_raw: This leaf feels brittle, as though the slightest touch might cause it to crumble. Yet for all that it cracks and bends, it remains whole and strong, impervious to the forces brought to bear against it.

items.name: Material_ConfluxPrism
items.description_en: Hexagonal pillars make up the complex inner workings of this core, which rise and fall in particular arrangements to give directives. Thankfully, this cube isn’t large enough to crush you.
items.flavor_text_en: "All complex things are comprised of simple, infallible components. Where complexity fails, simplicity more frequently succeeds."

description.en: Hexagonal pillars make up the complex inner workings of this core, which rise and fall in particular arrangements to give directives. Thankfully, this cube isn’t large enough to crush you.
description.zh: 核心那复杂的内部结构由许多六边形柱子构成，它们以特定的排列方式上升下降，从而发出指令。幸好这个立方体还没有大到能压垮你的地步。

flavor.en: "All complex things are comprised of simple, infallible components. Where complexity fails, simplicity more frequently succeeds."
flavor.zh: “一切复杂的事物都由简单精确的元素构成。在复杂失败的地方，简单往往会成功。”
