items.description_raw: Hexagonal pillars make up the complex inner workings of this core, which rise and fall in particular arrangements to give directives. Thankfully, this cube isn’t large enough to crush you.

items.name: Material_CipherRod
items.description_en: This device, which fits in the palm of your hand, contains more knowledge than you could ever hope to comprehend. You may still find some use for it, though.
items.flavor_text_en: "The entity known as Ford sought to purge the corruption… thus he was permitted to traverse the Labyrinth, undisturbed by both Guardian and I. Yet invariably—we observed."

description.en: This device, which fits in the palm of your hand, contains more knowledge than you could ever hope to comprehend. You may still find some use for it, though.
description.zh: 这台设备还不及一掌大，但其中包含着浩瀚如星辰的知识，即便你穷极一生也无法理解。不过说不定能派上什么其他用场。

flavor.en: "The entity known as Ford sought to purge the corruption… thus he was permitted to traverse the Labyrinth, undisturbed by both Guardian and I. Yet invariably—we observed."
flavor.zh: “那个名为福特的实体试图净化腐坏……因此被允许穿过迷宫，不受我与守护生物的干扰。但我们仍在观察——向来如此。”

items.name: Material_AcidicJawbone
items.description_en: For all his talk of essences and merging consciousness, Tal'Ratha's severed jawbone feels solid enough to make a formidable weapon.
items.flavor_text_en: "I alone can preserve the Drzyr. I alone can withstand Alepsis-Taura's hunger—entropy's embrace. All things are greater than the sum of their individual components, and so in this way, I will become the greatest of all sentient beings."

description.en: For all his talk of essences and merging consciousness, Tal'Ratha's severed jawbone feels solid enough to make a formidable weapon.
description.zh: 尽管达拉裟嘴上说着本质与意识融合，他断裂的颌骨却异常坚实，足以打造成一件强大的武器。

flavor.en: "I alone can preserve the Drzyr. I alone can withstand Alepsis-Taura's hunger—entropy's embrace. All things are greater than the sum of their individual components, and so in this way, I will become the greatest of all sentient beings."
flavor.zh: “我能一力保护泽厄尔，也能一力抵御阿莱普西斯-陶拉饥饿的吞噬，避免热寂的降临。众多单一部分能组成一个大的整体，而这个整体比单一的相加更为强大。从这一点上说，我将成为宇宙中最伟大的智慧存在。”

items.name: Material_EidolonShard
items.description_en: It has no substance. It barely has a form—like holding a soap bubble that won't pop. Like a gas nebula has been tamed to rest in the palm of your hand.
items.flavor_text_en: "Even I cannot see the full extent to which Alepsis-Taura changed our world. The lifeless were given life; the living, death; and the dead...became something I do not wholly understand."

description.en: It has no substance. It barely has a form—like holding a soap bubble that won't pop. Like a gas nebula has been tamed to rest in the palm of your hand.
description.zh: 它没有实质内容，几乎连形状都没有——像一个不会爆炸的肥皂泡泡。拿在手上，就像一团驯服的星云卧在掌中。

flavor.en: "Even I cannot see the full extent to which Alepsis-Taura changed our world. The lifeless were given life; the living, death; and the dead...became something I do not wholly understand."
flavor.zh: “阿莱普西斯-陶拉对这个世界的改造之深，连我都无法完全看清。无生命体被赋予了生命，活着的个体被赋予了死亡，而死亡的个体……变成了我无法完全理解的存在。”

items.name: Material_SpicedBile
items.description_en:
This...is disgusting.

But you know—you know—that if you leave it behind, you'll regret it.
items.flavor_text_en:
"I have spent eons in this chamber, protected from my doom yet isolated from my people. In all that time, my only friend and sustenance was the ambit ember.

And a rewarding friend it turned out to be."

description.en:
This...is disgusting.

But you know—you know—that if you leave it behind, you'll regret it.
description.zh:
这玩意儿……太恶心了。

但你清楚，非常清楚，如果放着不管，你会后悔的。

flavor.en:
"I have spent eons in this chamber, protected from my doom yet isolated from my people. In all that time, my only friend and sustenance was the ambit ember.

And a rewarding friend it turned out to be."
flavor.zh:
“我已在这间舱室中度过了千万年。这虽让我免遭厄运，但也将我与同胞隔绝。千万年来，我唯一的朋友和养分便是灵烬。

事实证明，它实乃益友。”

items.description_zh:

items.name: Material_VoidCinder
items.description_en: A body that spends millennia in the void, near the constant gravitational energies of a massive black hole, cannot remain as it is for long. It either succumbs to the powerful energies pressing in against it or, as in this case, it grows stronger.
items.flavor_text_en:
"My kin thought themselves strong enough to withstand Alepsis-Taura, or perhaps they thought N'Erud would protect them or that the singularity's energies to be harmless.

They were wrong on all counts. Like the universe itself, Alepsis-Taura is neither aware of nor cares for any of us—only its own eternal hunger."

description.en: A body that spends millennia in the void, near the constant gravitational energies of a massive black hole, cannot remain as it is for long. It either succumbs to the powerful energies pressing in against it or, as in this case, it grows stronger.
description.zh: 一具在虚空中度过了千年的身体，又在巨大黑洞的恒定引力附近，自然不可能长久保持原样。它要么屈服于施加其上的巨大力量，要么像这种情况一样，变得更加强大。

flavor.en:
"My kin thought themselves strong enough to withstand Alepsis-Taura, or perhaps they thought N'Erud would protect them or that the singularity's energies to be harmless.

They were wrong on all counts. Like the universe itself, Alepsis-Taura is neither aware of nor cares for any of us—only its own eternal hunger."
flavor.zh:
“我的族人认为自己强到可以抵御阿莱普西斯-陶拉，或以为涅鲁德会保护他们，抑或指望奇点能量不会造成伤害。

几种看法都错了。天地不仁，以万物为刍狗，阿莱普西斯-陶拉也一样，只想填饱自己永恒的辘辘饥肠，完全不在乎我们——甚至都不知道我们的存在。”

items.name: Material_CrackedShell
items.description_en: The shell of one of those creatures from the hatchery. It's inert, dead, harmless... Yet the warmth of life pulses ever so faintly from within.
items.flavor_text_en: "Alepsis-Taura did not consume everything. Though nothing can escape it forever, there exist forms of life that can resist even entropy for a time."

description.en: The shell of one of those creatures from the hatchery. It's inert, dead, harmless... Yet the warmth of life pulses ever so faintly from within.
description.zh: 来自孵化场的一只生物的壳。它是无害的惰性死物……但生命的温暖却在其内部微弱地跳动着。

flavor.en: "Alepsis-Taura did not consume everything. Though nothing can escape it forever, there exist forms of life that can resist even entropy for a time."
flavor.zh: “阿莱普西斯-陶拉并没有吞噬一切。虽然其中的万事万物永远都无法逃出，但里面也存在着甚至能暂时抵御熵的生命形式。”

items.description_zh: 来自孵化场的一只生物的壳。它是无害的惰性死物……但生命的温暖却在其内部微弱地跳动着。

items.name: Material_MutatedGrowth
items.description_en: The circuitry of the Drzyr is evident here, but there is more than that. Fleshy tubes and pustules emerge from its sockets, giving the appearance of a thing both wild and designed.
items.flavor_text_en:
"No scientific field is alien to the Drzyr. If it can be studied, we have studied it—and adapted it, improved it, and evolved.

The secret, of course, is that nothing exists that cannot be studied. Therefore, all things are an opportunity to evolve."

description.en: The circuitry of the Drzyr is evident here, but there is more than that. Fleshy tubes and pustules emerge from its sockets, giving the appearance of a thing both wild and designed.
description.zh: 泽厄尔的线路在这里非常明显，而且不仅如此。肉质的管子和脓疱从它的孔洞里冒出来，让它看上去既狂野，又很有设计感。

flavor.en:
"No scientific field is alien to the Drzyr. If it can be studied, we have studied it—and adapted it, improved it, and evolved.

The secret, of course, is that nothing exists that cannot be studied. Therefore, all things are an opportunity to evolve."
flavor.zh:
“泽厄尔人熟知一切科学领域。凡所可研究，无所不研究——然后适应、改造并最终进化它。

当然了，秘密就是只要存在就皆可研究。因此，万物都是进化的契机。”

items.name: Material_SeekerResidue
items.description_en:
The phantoms of this strange world have substance. Weight.

I mean, obviously. A spirit or whatever wouldn't have packed a punch like that.
items.flavor_text_en:
"It was once believed that genetic programming was our god, that even sentience was determined by a random sequence of nucleotides. But this was quickly recognized as insufficient.

There is more to sentient life than cold code can explain—spirit, soul, a ghost within the organic machine.

This is what we sought."

description.en:
The phantoms of this strange world have substance. Weight.

I mean, obviously. A spirit or whatever wouldn't have packed a punch like that.
description.zh:
这个奇怪世界中的鬼灵有“重量”，并非虚无的存在。

咳，这还用说吗？灵魂什么的怎么可能一拳到肉。

flavor.en:
"It was once believed that genetic programming was our god, that even sentience was determined by a random sequence of nucleotides. But this was quickly recognized as insufficient.

There is more to sentient life than cold code can explain—spirit, soul, a ghost within the organic machine.

This is what we sought."
flavor.zh:
“人们曾经认为，基因编码就是我们的神，就连感性都是由随机的核苷酸序列决定的。但人们很快就意识到这种论述存在欠缺。

生命的感性部分——精神、灵魂、甚至包括机械的意识，都远不是冰冷的编码可以解释的。

这正是我们在寻找的东西。”

items.name: Material_SentrysOldIris
items.description_en: It has no independent power source that you can find, but it hums with energy. Light shines from within, as though the star that powers N'Erud gives life to everything within its walls.
items.flavor_text_en:
"It was not enough to create a star. That vast energy then had to be stored, transferred, utilized.

Can a god create a power source so potent even he cannot harness it? I do not know. But for a brief time, the Drzyr had done just that."

description.en: It has no independent power source that you can find, but it hums with energy. Light shines from within, as though the star that powers N'Erud gives life to everything within its walls.
description.zh: 你找不到任何独立的能源，但它却充盈着能量。内部闪烁着光芒，似乎那颗为涅鲁德提供能量的星辰，也赋予了墙内的一切以生命。

flavor.en:
"It was not enough to create a star. That vast energy then had to be stored, transferred, utilized.

Can a god create a power source so potent even he cannot harness it? I do not know. But for a brief time, the Drzyr had done just that."
flavor.zh:
创造恒星远不止创造本身，因为你还要将这种巨大的能量储存，传输，并加以利用。

神能够创造出连自己都无法驾驭的能源吗？我不知道。但泽厄尔人在短时间内做到了。

items.name: Material_EscalationCircuit
items.description_en:
The Custodian is an impossibly complex machine. It would be reductive to claim that any one piece was wholly responsible for any aspect of its personality.

Yet you're pretty sure this "escalation circuit" is growling at you.
items.flavor_text_en:
"Look deep enough, and all life can be reduced to comprehensible components, each performing a finite task so simple it could be explained to a child.

Yet who can explain how bountiful simplicity creates the infinite complexity of sentience?"

description.en:
The Custodian is an impossibly complex machine. It would be reductive to claim that any one piece was wholly responsible for any aspect of its personality.

Yet you're pretty sure this "escalation circuit" is growling at you.
description.zh:
保管人是一台极其复杂的机器，理论上几乎不可能存在。没法简单地说哪个部件能对它整体个性的任何方面负责。

但是你很确定这堆“升级电路”正在对你咆哮。

flavor.en:
"Look deep enough, and all life can be reduced to comprehensible components, each performing a finite task so simple it could be explained to a child.

Yet who can explain how bountiful simplicity creates the infinite complexity of sentience?"
flavor.zh:
“只要深入探究，所有生命都可以归结为通俗易懂的组成部分，各自执行简单的任务，其中的原理连小孩子都能听懂。

然而，到底如何从大量的简单中创造出无限的复杂，谁又能解释得清楚呢？”

items.name: Material_IonicCrystal
items.description_en:
Ionic crystals are common in nature—salt, for example—yet each has its own unique conductive and absorptive properties. These crystals, for example, seem to muffle kinetic energy, hardly bouncing even when dropped.

Seems like that could be a useful property.
items.flavor_text_en: "All Drzyr acquire a basic education in molecular and atomic physics, creating new and exciting compounds as early as their first half-century of life. To the Drzyr, rearranging protons and electrons is as simple as reorganizing one's bedchambers."

items.name: Material_StasisCore
items.description_en: This N'Erud has been hurtling abandoned for unknown millennia, yet this component still retains its power as if it were newly made.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Drzyr were built—a word I do not use lightly—to endure. And so, our technology is designed to endure with us. It would be a foolish people indeed who spent finite resources on a thing they themselves would outlast."

description.en: This N'Erud has been hurtling abandoned for unknown millennia, yet this component still retains its power as if it were newly made.
description.zh: 涅鲁德已经废弃了千万年，但它的组件居然仍保持着原有的能量，就像新的一样。

flavor.en: "The Drzyr were built—a word I do not use lightly—to endure. And so, our technology is designed to endure with us. It would be a foolish people indeed who spent finite resources on a thing they themselves would outlast."
flavor.zh: “泽厄尔人天生韧性极强——要知道，‘天生’这个词我可不会轻易使用。因为这一点，我们的科技也相当耐用。只有最愚蠢的人才会用有限的资源打造甚至还不如自己长寿的产品。”

items.name: Material_ForgottenMemory
items.description_en: A precious manifestation incubates this growth. The Root around it clings desperately, as if straining to remember its first connection, the first memory of something—someone—besides itself.
items.flavor_text_en: "The Core’s children begot the corruption. Is it strange to feel… sentimental? Perhaps the corruption was infantile once. Benign. A fragile new creation reaching out for its creator."

description.en: A precious manifestation incubates this growth. The Root around it clings desperately, as if straining to remember its first connection, the first memory of something—someone—besides itself.
description.zh: 被一种珍贵的具象体滋养的材料，周围的根蔓拼命要抓牢它，似乎在尽全力回忆最初的联系，回忆除自己以外最初的某件东西——或某个人。

flavor.en: "The Core’s children begot the corruption. Is it strange to feel… sentimental? Perhaps the corruption was infantile once. Benign. A fragile new creation reaching out for its creator."
flavor.zh: “腐坏是核心的孩子造就的。我有些可怜腐坏……是不是很奇怪？或许腐坏最初也是个脆弱无害的婴孩，只想伸出手触碰自己的‘母亲’。”

items.name: Material_DreadCore
items.description_en: The still-pulsing heart of a truly ghastly creature. Holding it for too long stirs a touch of madness within you.
items.flavor_text_en: "The corruption is ever evolving. As it consumes, it advances itself. Logic dictates that the strongest and most developed among them are either the eldest… or simply the most efficient."

description.zh: 一颗依然在跳动的心脏，来自一种可怕的生物。长时间握在手中，会隐约激发出你内心的疯狂。

flavor.en: "The corruption is ever evolving. As it consumes, it advances itself. Logic dictates that the strongest and most developed among them are either the eldest… or simply the most efficient."

items.name: Material_NecrocyteStrand
items.description_en: Once a small and benign growth, it has evolved into a plump abscess with enough veins and organs to fully sustain itself.
items.flavor_text_en: "The corruption emulates that which is familiar to the realm’s inhabitants. Through the process of assimilation, in a single instant, it gains the biological advantages that took a species its entire existence to acquire."

description.zh: 本来只是很小的良性增生，现在却已恶化成肥大的囊肿，并有血管和器官为其提供充足的养分。

flavor.en: "The corruption emulates that which is familiar to the realm’s inhabitants. Through the process of assimilation, in a single instant, it gains the biological advantages that took a species its entire existence to acquire."
